```txt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Engine wiring
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The upstream engines do not all export the same kind of CMake target:
#
#   * a LIBRARY target  -> link it in-process and define REVENANT_LINK_<NAME>=1
#   * an EXECUTABLE     -> build it alongside the addon and bake its output path
#                          in as REVENANT_<NAME>_BIN_HINT so the addon can spawn
#                          it without the user configuring anything
#   * no target at all  -> nothing is linked; at runtime the addon looks for
#                          the tool via options.toolPath, REVENANT_<NAME>_PATH,
#                          then PATH, and reports it as unavailable otherwise.
#
# In every case the addon keeps working: the subprocess backend is always
# compiled in.
function(revenant_wire_engine name)
  string(TOUPPER "${name}" _upper)
  set(_candidates ${ARGN})
  set(_wired FALSE)

  if(REVENANT_HAVE_${_upper})
    foreach(_tgt IN LISTS _candidates)
      if(NOT TARGET ${_tgt})
        continue()
      endif()
      get_target_property(_type ${_tgt} TYPE)
      get_target_property(_imported ${_tgt} IMPORTED)

      if(_type STREQUAL "EXECUTABLE")
        if(NOT _imported)
          add_dependencies(revenant_native ${_tgt})
        endif()
        target_compile_definitions(revenant_native PRIVATE
          "REVENANT_${_upper}_BIN_HINT=\"$<TARGET_FILE:${_tgt}>\"")
        message(STATUS "REVENANT bindings: ${name} -> executable target '${_tgt}' (subprocess backend)")
        set(_wired TRUE)
        break()
      elseif(_type MATCHES "^(STATIC|SHARED|MODULE|INTERFACE|OBJECT)_LIBRARY$")
        target_link_libraries(revenant_native PRIVATE ${_tgt})
        target_compile_definitions(revenant_native PRIVATE REVENANT_LINK_${_upper}=1)
        message(STATUS "REVENANT bindings: ${name} -> linked library target '${_tgt}'")
        set(_wired TRUE)
        break()
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endif()

  if(_wired)
    target_compile_definitions(revenant_native PRIVATE REVENANT_HAVE_${_upper}=1)
  else()
    target_compile_definitions(revenant_native PRIVATE REVENANT_HAVE_${_upper}=0)
    message(STATUS "REVENANT bindings: ${name} -> not built here (runtime lookup via REVENANT_${_upper}_PATH / PATH)")
  endif()
endfunction()

# Candidate target names, most specific first. Adjust here if an upstream
# project renames its targets.
revenant_wire_engine(revng        revng::revng revng revngSupport)
revenant_wire_engine(novmp        NoVmp novmp)
revenant_wire_engine(unthemidator unthemidator Unthemidator unthemidator_cli)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
install(TARGETS revenant_native
  LIBRARY DESTINATION .
  RUNTIME DESTINATION .
)

```

`native/bindings/src/addon.cpp`:

```cpp
// REVENANT native addon (revenant_native.node)
//
// N-API entry point that exposes the native engines to @revenant/core.
//
//   getVersion()                       -> object   (sync)
//   loadBinary(path)                   -> Promise<BinaryInfo>
//   liftBinary(path, options?)         -> Promise<LiftResult>
//   devirtBinary(path, options?)       -> Promise<DevirtResult>
//
// Design notes
// ------------
// * Result objects mirror the shapes in @revenant/shared (BinaryInfo,
//   LiftResult, DevirtResult) so the TypeScript side can pass them through.
// * Every long operation runs on the libuv thread pool through an
//   AsyncWorker and settles a Promise; the JS thread is never blocked.
// * Argument mistakes throw a TypeError synchronously. Runtime failures reject
//   the promise with an Error carrying a stable `code` property:
//     EINVAL  ENOENT  EPARSE  ETOOLMISSING  ESPAWN  ETIMEDOUT  ETOOLFAILED  ENATIVE
// * revng, NoVmp and unthemidator are driven through an engine backend. None
//   of them ships a stable embeddable C++ API, so the backend that is always
//   compiled in runs the tool as a child process: no shell, explicit argv,
//   stdin closed, merged stdout/stderr captured with a size cap, hard timeout
//   that kills the whole process tree. If a future engine build exports a
//   library target, CMake defines REVENANT_LINK_<ENGINE> and an in-process
//   backend can be added next to the subprocess one without changing the JS API.
// * Inputs are hostile by definition. The header parser below never trusts a
//   length or offset read from the file; every read is bounds-checked.

#ifndef NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
#define NAPI_CPP_EXCEPTIONS
#endif
#ifndef NAPI_VERSION
#define NAPI_VERSION 8
#endif

#include <napi.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <optional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <cerrno>
#include <csignal>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

#ifndef REVENANT_NATIVE_VERSION
#define REVENANT_NATIVE_VERSION "0.1.0"
#endif
#ifndef REVENANT_HAVE_REVNG
#define REVENANT_HAVE_REVNG 0
#endif
#ifndef REVENANT_HAVE_NOVMP
#define REVENANT_HAVE_NOVMP 0
#endif
#ifndef REVENANT_HAVE_UNTHEMIDATOR
#define REVENANT_HAVE_UNTHEMIDATOR 0
#endif

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace revenant {

// ===========================================================================
// Errors
// ===========================================================================

/// A failure with a stable machine-readable code, surfaced to JS as err.code.
class RevError : public std::runtime_error {
 public:
  RevError(std::string code, const std::string& message)
      : std::runtime_error(message), code_(std::move(code)) {}
  const std::string& code() const noexcept { return code_; }

 private:
  std::string code_;
};

// ===========================================================================
// Small utilities
// ===========================================================================

fs::path PathFromUtf8(const std::string& s) {
  return fs::path(std::u8string(s.begin(), s.end()));
}

std::string PathToUtf8(const fs::path& p) {
  const std::u8string u = p.u8string();
  return std::string(u.begin(), u.end());
}

std::string Hex(uint64_t value) {
  char buf[2 + 16 + 1];
  std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "0x%llx", static_cast<unsigned long long>(value));
  return buf;
}

std::string ToLower(std::string s) {
  std::transform(s.begin(), s.end(), s.begin(),
                 [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
  return s;
}

uint64_t NowMs() {
  using namespace std::chrono;
  return static_cast<uint64_t>(
      duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
}

#ifdef _WIN32
std::wstring Widen(const std::string& s) {
  if (s.empty()) return {};
  const int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), static_cast<int>(s.size()), nullptr, 0);
  if (n <= 0) throw RevError("EINVAL", "string is not valid UTF-8");
  std::wstring out(static_cast<size_t>(n), L'\0');
  MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), static_cast<int>(s.size()), out.data(), n);
  return out;
}

std::string Narrow(const std::wstring& s) {
  if (s.empty()) return {};
  const int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), static_cast<int>(s.size()), nullptr, 0,
                                    nullptr, nullptr);
  if (n <= 0) return {};
  std::string out(static_cast<size_t>(n), '\0');
  WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), static_cast<int>(s.size()), out.data(), n, nullptr,
                      nullptr);
  return out;
}

std::string LastErrorMessage(DWORD err) {
  wchar_t* buf = nullptr;
  const DWORD len = FormatMessageW(
      FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER | FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM | FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
      nullptr, err, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPWSTR>(&buf), 0, nullptr);
  std::string msg = len ? Narrow(std::wstring(buf, len)) : std::string("unknown error");
  if (buf) LocalFree(buf);
  while (!msg.empty() && (msg.back() == '\n' || msg.back() == '\r' || msg.back() == ' ')) {
    msg.pop_back();
  }
  return msg + " (" + std::to_string(err) + ")";
}
#endif

std::optional<std::string> GetEnv(const char* name) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  const std::wstring wname = Widen(name);
  const DWORD n = GetEnvironmentVariableW(wname.c_str(), nullptr, 0);
  if (n == 0) return std::nullopt;
  std::wstring buf(n, L'\0');
  const DWORD written = GetEnvironmentVariableW(wname.c_str(), buf.data(), n);
  buf.resize(written < n ? written : 0);
  if (buf.empty()) return std::nullopt;
  return Narrow(buf);
#else
  const char* v = std::getenv(name);
  if (!v || !*v) return std::nullopt;
  return std::string(v);
#endif
}

bool IsRegularFile(const fs::path& p) {
  std::error_code ec;
  return fs::is_regular_file(p, ec);
}

/// Resolve a user-supplied input path to an absolute, existing regular file.
/// Making it absolute also guarantees it can never be mistaken for a command
/// line option by a tool (it starts with '/' or a drive letter, never '-').
fs::path ResolveInputFile(const std::string& utf8) {
  std::error_code ec;
  fs::path abs = fs::absolute(PathFromUtf8(utf8), ec);
  if (ec) throw RevError("EINVAL", "cannot resolve path: " + utf8);
  abs = abs.lexically_normal();
  if (!fs::exists(abs, ec)) throw RevError("ENOENT", "file not found: " + PathToUtf8(abs));
  if (!fs::is_regular_file(abs, ec)) {
    throw RevError("EINVAL", "not a regular file: " + PathToUtf8(abs));
  }
  return abs;
}

// ===========================================================================
// SHA-256 (streamed over the input file; FIPS 180-4)
// ===========================================================================

class Sha256 {
 public:
  void Update(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    total_ += len;
    Absorb(data, len);
  }

  std::string FinalHex() {
    const uint64_t bits = total_ * 8;
    const uint8_t pad = 0x80;
    Absorb(&pad, 1);
    const uint8_t zero = 0;
    while (fill_ != 56) Absorb(&zero, 1);
    uint8_t len[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) len[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(bits >> (56 - 8 * i));
    Absorb(len, 8);
    static const char* digits = "0123456789abcdef";
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(64);
    for (uint32_t word : h_) {
      for (int shift = 28; shift >= 0; shift -= 4) out.push_back(digits[(word >> shift) & 0xF]);
    }
    return out;
  }

 private:
  static uint32_t Rotr(uint32_t x, int n) { return (x >> n) | (x << (32 - n)); }

  void Absorb(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    while (len > 0) {
      const size_t take = std::min(len, static_cast<size_t>(64) - fill_);
      std::memcpy(block_.data() + fill_, data, take);
      fill_ += take;
      data += take;
      len -= take;
      if (fill_ == 64) {
        Compress(block_.data());
        fill_ = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  void Compress(const uint8_t* p) {
    static constexpr uint32_t K[64] = {
        0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4,
        0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe,
        0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174, 0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f,
        0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da, 0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7,
        0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967, 0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc,
        0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b,
        0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070, 0x19a4c116,
        0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7,
        0xc67178f2};
    uint32_t w[64];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
      w[i] = (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[4 * i]) << 24) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[4 * i + 1]) << 16) |
             (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[4 * i + 2]) << 8) | static_cast<uint32_t>(p[4 * i + 3]);
    }
    for (int i = 16; i < 64; ++i) {
      const uint32_t s0 = Rotr(w[i - 15], 7) ^ Rotr(w[i - 15], 18) ^ (w[i - 15] >> 3);
      const uint32_t s1 = Rotr(w[i - 2], 17) ^ Rotr(w[i - 2], 19) ^ (w[i - 2] >> 10);
      w[i] = w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1;
    }
    uint32_t a = h_[0], b = h_[1], c = h_[2], d = h_[3];
    uint32_t e = h_[4], f = h_[5], g = h_[6], h = h_[7];
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
      const uint32_t s1 = Rotr(e, 6) ^ Rotr(e, 11) ^ Rotr(e, 25);
      const uint32_t ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const uint32_t t1 = h + s1 + ch + K[i] + w[i];
      const uint32_t s0 = Rotr(a, 2) ^ Rotr(a, 13) ^ Rotr(a, 22);
      const uint32_t maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const uint32_t t2 = s0 + maj;
      h = g; g = f; f = e; e = d + t1;
      d = c; c = b; b = a; a = t1 + t2;
    }
    h_[0] += a; h_[1] += b; h_[2] += c; h_[3] += d;
    h_[4] += e; h_[5] += f; h_[6] += g; h_[7] += h;
  }

  std::array<uint32_t, 8> h_{0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a,
                             0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19};
  std::array<uint8_t, 64> block_{};
  size_t fill_ = 0;
  uint64_t total_ = 0;
};

// ===========================================================================
// Binary loader (PE / ELF / Mach-O headers)
// ===========================================================================

struct SectionInfo {
  std::string name;
  uint64_t virtualAddress = 0;
  uint64_t virtualSize = 0;
  uint64_t rawOffset = 0;
  uint64_t rawSize = 0;
  bool readable = false;
  bool writable = false;
  bool executable = false;
};

struct ProtectorHint {
  std::string kind = "none";  // matches ProtectorKind in @revenant/shared
  double confidence = 0.0;
  std::vector<std::string> evidence;
};

struct BinaryInfo {
  std::string path;
  std::string format = "unknown";
  std::string architecture = "unknown";
  std::string endianness = "little";
  int bits = 32;
  uint64_t entryPoint = 0;
  uint64_t imageBase = 0;
  uint64_t size = 0;
  std::string hash;
  std::vector<SectionInfo> sections;
  ProtectorHint protector;
  std::vector<std::string> warnings;
};

/// Random-access reader that refuses any read outside the file.
class FileReader {
 public:
  explicit FileReader(const fs::path& path) : stream_(path, std::ios::binary) {
    if (!stream_) throw RevError("ENOENT", "cannot open file: " + PathToUtf8(path));
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto sz = fs::file_size(path, ec);
    if (ec) throw RevError("ENOENT", "cannot stat file: " + PathToUtf8(path));
    size_ = static_cast<uint64_t>(sz);
  }

  uint64_t size() const { return size_; }

  bool InBounds(uint64_t offset, uint64_t length) const {
    return length <= size_ && offset <= size_ - length;
  }

  std::vector<uint8_t> ReadAt(uint64_t offset, size_t length, const char* what) {
    if (!InBounds(offset, length)) {
      throw RevError("EPARSE", std::string("truncated or malformed file: ") + what +
                                   " lies outside the file");
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(length);
    stream_.clear();
    stream_.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(offset), std::ios::beg);
    stream_.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(buf.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(length));
    if (static_cast<size_t>(stream_.gcount()) != length) {
      throw RevError("EPARSE", std::string("short read while reading ") + what);
    }
    return buf;
  }

  std::string HashAll() {
    Sha256 sha;
    std::vector<uint8_t> chunk(1 << 16);
    stream_.clear();
    stream_.seekg(0, std::ios::beg);
    while (stream_) {
      stream_.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(chunk.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(chunk.size()));
      const std::streamsize got = stream_.gcount();
      if (got <= 0) break;
      sha.Update(chunk.data(), static_cast<size_t>(got));
    }
    return sha.FinalHex();
  }

 private:
  std::ifstream stream_;
  uint64_t size_ = 0;
};

/// Endian-aware view over a byte buffer. Offsets are checked.
class Fields {
 public:
  Fields(const std::vector<uint8_t>& data, bool bigEndian) : data_(data), big_(bigEndian) {}

  uint64_t U(size_t offset, size_t width) const {
    if (width > 8 || offset > data_.size() || data_.size() - offset < width) {
      throw RevError("EPARSE", "header field lies outside its structure");
    }
    uint64_t v = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < width; ++i) {
      const size_t idx = big_ ? offset + i : offset + width - 1 - i;
      v = (v << 8) | data_[idx];
    }
    return v;
  }
  uint16_t U16(size_t o) const { return static_cast<uint16_t>(U(o, 2)); }
  uint32_t U32(size_t o) const { return static_cast<uint32_t>(U(o, 4)); }
  uint64_t U64(size_t o) const { return U(o, 8); }

 private:
  const std::vector<uint8_t>& data_;
  bool big_;
};

std::string SanitizeName(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t maxLen) {
  std::string out;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < maxLen && bytes[i] != 0; ++i) {
    const unsigned char c = bytes[i];
    out.push_back((c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7f) ? static_cast<char>(c) : '?');
  }
  return out;
}

void ParsePe(FileReader& file, BinaryInfo& info) {
  const auto dos = file.ReadAt(0, 0x40, "DOS header");
  const uint32_t lfanew = Fields(dos, false).U32(0x3c);

  const auto nt = file.ReadAt(lfanew, 4 + 20, "PE signature and COFF header");
  if (!(nt[0] == 'P' && nt[1] == 'E' && nt[2] == 0 && nt[3] == 0)) {
    throw RevError("EPARSE",
                   "MZ file without a PE signature (DOS/NE/LE executables are not supported)");
  }
  const Fields coff(nt, false);
  const uint16_t machine = coff.U16(4);
  const uint16_t sectionCount = coff.U16(6);
  const uint16_t optSize = coff.U16(20);

  switch (machine) {
    case 0x014c: info.architecture = "x86"; break;
    case 0x8664: info.architecture = "x86_64"; break;
    case 0x01c0:
    case 0x01c4: info.architecture = "arm"; break;
    case 0xaa64: info.architecture = "arm64"; break;
    case 0x5032:
    case 0x5064: info.architecture = "riscv"; break;
    default:     info.architecture = "unknown"; break;
  }
  info.format = "pe";
  info.endianness = "little";
  info.bits = (machine == 0x8664 || machine == 0xaa64 || machine == 0x5064) ? 64 : 32;

  const uint64_t optOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(lfanew) + 24;
  if (optSize >= 32) {
    const auto opt = file.ReadAt(optOffset, optSize, "PE optional header");
    const Fields o(opt, false);
    const uint16_t magic = o.U16(0);
    if (magic == 0x20b) {
      info.bits = 64;
      info.imageBase = o.U64(24);
      info.entryPoint = info.imageBase + o.U32(16);  // reported as a virtual address
    } else if (magic == 0x10b) {
      info.bits = 32;
      info.imageBase = o.U32(28);
      info.entryPoint = info.imageBase + o.U32(16);
    } else {
      info.warnings.push_back("unrecognized PE optional header magic " + Hex(magic));
    }
  } else {
    info.warnings.push_back("PE optional header is missing or too small");
  }

  // The PE format allows at most 96 sections; anything larger is hostile.
  constexpr uint16_t kMaxSections = 96;
  uint16_t count = sectionCount;
  if (count > kMaxSections) {
    info.warnings.push_back("section count " + std::to_string(sectionCount) +
                            " exceeds the PE limit; only the first 96 are reported");
    count = kMaxSections;
  }
  const uint64_t tableOffset = optOffset + optSize;
  for (uint16_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
    const uint64_t off = tableOffset + static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * 40;
    if (!file.InBounds(off, 40)) {
      info.warnings.push_back("section table is truncated at entry " + std::to_string(i));
      break;
    }
    const auto raw = file.ReadAt(off, 40, "section header");
    const Fields s(raw, false);
    SectionInfo sec;
    sec.name = SanitizeName(raw.data(), 8);
    sec.virtualSize = s.U32(8);
    sec.virtualAddress = info.imageBase + s.U32(12);
    sec.rawSize = s.U32(16);
    sec.rawOffset = s.U32(20);
    const uint32_t ch = s.U32(36);
    sec.executable = (ch & 0x20000000u) != 0;
    sec.readable = (ch & 0x40000000u) != 0;
    sec.writable = (ch & 0x80000000u) != 0;
    info.sections.push_back(std::move(sec));
  }
}

void ParseElf(FileReader& file, BinaryInfo& info) {
  const auto ident = file.ReadAt(0, 16, "ELF identification");
  if (ident[4] != 1 && ident[4] != 2) throw RevError("EPARSE", "invalid ELF class");
  if (ident[5] != 1 && ident[5] != 2) throw RevError("EPARSE", "invalid ELF data encoding");
  const bool is64 = ident[4] == 2;
  const bool big = ident[5] == 2;

  const size_t ehSize = is64 ? 64 : 52;
  const auto eh = file.ReadAt(0, ehSize, "ELF header");
  const Fields h(eh, big);

  info.format = "elf";
  info.bits = is64 ? 64 : 32;
  info.endianness = big ? "big" : "little";

  const uint16_t machine = h.U16(18);
  switch (machine) {
    case 3:   info.architecture = "x86"; break;
    case 62:  info.architecture = "x86_64"; break;
    case 40:  info.architecture = "arm"; break;
    case 183: info.architecture = "arm64"; break;
    case 8:   info.architecture = "mips"; break;
    case 243: info.architecture = "riscv"; break;
    default:  info.architecture = "unknown"; break;
  }

  info.entryPoint = is64 ? h.U64(24) : h.U32(24);
  const uint64_t shoff = is64 ? h.U64(40) : h.U32(32);
  const uint16_t shentsize = h.U16(is64 ? 58 : 46);
  uint32_t shnum = h.U16(is64 ? 60 : 48);
  const uint16_t shstrndx = h.U16(is64 ? 62 : 50);

  const size_t minEnt = is64 ? 64 : 40;
  if (shoff == 0 || shnum == 0) return;  // no section headers: legal
  if (shentsize < minEnt) {
    info.warnings.push_back("section header entry size is too small; sections not parsed");
    return;
  }
  constexpr uint32_t kMaxSections = 4096;
  if (shnum > kMaxSections) {
    info.warnings.push_back("section count capped at 4096");
    shnum = kMaxSections;
  }

  struct RawSection {
    uint32_t nameOffset = 0;
    SectionInfo info;
  };
  std::vector<RawSection> raws;
  uint64_t strOffset = 0;
  uint64_t strSize = 0;

  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < shnum; ++i) {
    const uint64_t off = shoff + static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * shentsize;
    if (off < shoff || !file.InBounds(off, minEnt)) {
      info.warnings.push_back("section header table is truncated at entry " + std::to_string(i));
      break;
    }
    const auto raw = file.ReadAt(off, minEnt, "ELF section header");
    const Fields s(raw, big);
    RawSection rs;
    rs.nameOffset = s.U32(0);
    const uint32_t type = s.U32(4);
    const uint64_t flags = is64 ? s.U64(8) : s.U32(8);
    rs.info.virtualAddress = is64 ? s.U64(16) : s.U32(12);
    rs.info.rawOffset = is64 ? s.U64(24) : s.U32(16);
    const uint64_t size = is64 ? s.U64(32) : s.U32(20);
    rs.info.virtualSize = size;
    rs.info.rawSize = (type == 8 /* SHT_NOBITS */) ? 0 : size;
    rs.info.readable = (flags & 0x2) != 0;    // SHF_ALLOC
    rs.info.writable = (flags & 0x1) != 0;    // SHF_WRITE
    rs.info.executable = (flags & 0x4) != 0;  // SHF_EXECINSTR
    if (i == shstrndx) {
      strOffset = rs.info.rawOffset;
      strSize = size;
    }
    raws.push_back(std::move(rs));
  }

  constexpr size_t kMaxName = 128;
  for (auto& rs : raws) {
    if (strSize > 0 && rs.nameOffset < strSize) {
      const uint64_t avail = strSize - rs.nameOffset;
      const size_t want = static_cast<size_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(avail, kMaxName));
      const uint64_t at = strOffset + rs.nameOffset;
      if (at >= strOffset && file.InBounds(at, want)) {
        const auto bytes = file.ReadAt(at, want, "section name");
        rs.info.name = SanitizeName(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
      }
    }
    info.sections.push_back(std::move(rs.info));
  }
}

void ParseMachO(FileReader& file, BinaryInfo& info, uint32_t magicBe) {
  info.format = "macho";
  if (magicBe == 0xcafebabe || magicBe == 0xcafebabf) {
    info.warnings.push_back(
        "universal (fat) Mach-O: architecture slices are not enumerated by the native loader");
    return;
  }
  // 0xfeedface / 0xfeedfacf read big-endian mean a big-endian file; the byte
  // swapped forms mean little-endian.
  const bool big = (magicBe == 0xfeedface || magicBe == 0xfeedfacf);
  const bool is64 = (magicBe == 0xfeedfacf || magicBe == 0xcffaedfe);
  const auto hdr = file.ReadAt(0, is64 ? 32 : 28, "Mach-O header");
  const Fields h(hdr, big);
  const uint32_t cpu = h.U32(4);
  info.bits = is64 ? 64 : 32;
  info.endianness = big ? "big" : "little";
  switch (cpu) {
    case 7:          info.architecture = "x86"; break;
    case 0x01000007: info.architecture = "x86_64"; break;
    case 12:         info.architecture = "arm"; break;
    case 0x0100000c: info.architecture = "arm64"; break;
    default:         info.architecture = "unknown"; break;
  }
  info.warnings.push_back("Mach-O load commands are not parsed by the native loader");
}

/// Cheap section-name heuristics. A hint for engine auto-selection only; the
/// TypeScript devirt plugins own real protector detection.
ProtectorHint DetectProtector(const BinaryInfo& info) {
  ProtectorHint hint;
  if (info.format != "pe") return hint;
  int vmp = 0;
  int themida = 0;
  int winlicense = 0;
  int enigma = 0;
  for (const auto& sec : info.sections) {
    const std::string n = ToLower(sec.name);
    int* counter = nullptr;
    if (n.rfind(".vmp", 0) == 0) {
      counter = &vmp;
    } else if (n == ".themida") {
      counter = &themida;
    } else if (n == ".winlice") {
      counter = &winlicense;
    } else if (n.rfind(".enigma", 0) == 0) {
      counter = &enigma;
    }
    if (counter) {
      ++*counter;
      hint.evidence.push_back("section " + sec.name);
    }
  }
  if (vmp > 0) {
    hint.kind = "vmprotect";
    hint.confidence = vmp >= 2 ? 0.9 : 0.7;
  } else if (themida > 0) {
    hint.kind = "themida";
    hint.confidence = 0.85;
  } else if (winlicense > 0) {
    hint.kind = "winlicense";
    hint.confidence = 0.85;
  } else if (enigma > 0) {
    hint.kind = "enigma";
    hint.confidence = 0.8;
  }
  return hint;
}

BinaryInfo LoadBinaryInfo(const fs::path& path, bool computeHash) {
  FileReader file(path);
  BinaryInfo info;
  info.path = PathToUtf8(path);
  info.size = file.size();
  if (info.size < 4) throw RevError("EPARSE", "file is too small to be an executable");

  const auto magic = file.ReadAt(0, 4, "magic");
  const uint32_t magicBe = (static_cast<uint32_t>(magic[0]) << 24) |
                           (static_cast<uint32_t>(magic[1]) << 16) |
                           (static_cast<uint32_t>(magic[2]) << 8) | static_cast<uint32_t>(magic[3]);

  if (magic[0] == 'M' && magic[1] == 'Z') {
    ParsePe(file, info);
  } else if (magicBe == 0x7f454c46) {  // "\x7fELF"
    ParseElf(file, info);
  } else if (magicBe == 0xfeedface || magicBe == 0xfeedfacf || magicBe == 0xcefaedfe ||
             magicBe == 0xcffaedfe || magicBe == 0xcafebabe || magicBe == 0xcafebabf) {
    ParseMachO(file, info, magicBe);
  } else {
    info.format = "unknown";
    info.warnings.push_back("unrecognized file magic " + Hex(magicBe));
  }

  info.protector = DetectProtector(info);
  if (computeHash) info.hash = file.HashAll();
  return info;
}

// ===========================================================================
// Child processes
// ===========================================================================

struct ProcessResult {
  int exitCode = -1;
  bool timedOut = false;
  bool truncated = false;
  std::string output;  // merged stdout + stderr
};

constexpr size_t kMaxCapturedOutput = 16u * 1024u * 1024u;

void AppendCapped(ProcessResult& result, const char* data, size_t len) {
  if (result.output.size() >= kMaxCapturedOutput) {
    result.truncated = true;
    return;
  }
  const size_t room = kMaxCapturedOutput - result.output.size();
  if (len > room) {
    len = room;
    result.truncated = true;
  }
  result.output.append(data, len);
}

#ifdef _WIN32

struct UniqueHandle {
  HANDLE h = nullptr;
  UniqueHandle() = default;
  explicit UniqueHandle(HANDLE handle) : h(handle) {}
  UniqueHandle(const UniqueHandle&) = delete;
  UniqueHandle& operator=(const UniqueHandle&) = delete;
  ~UniqueHandle() { Reset(); }
  void Reset() {
    if (h && h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(h);
    h = nullptr;
  }
  bool Valid() const { return h && h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; }
};

/// Quote one argument per the CommandLineToArgvW / MSVCRT rules.
void AppendQuotedArg(std::wstring& cmd, const std::wstring& arg) {
  if (!cmd.empty()) cmd.push_back(L' ');
  if (!arg.empty() && arg.find_first_of(L" \t\n\v\"") == std::wstring::npos) {
    cmd.append(arg);
    return;
  }
  cmd.push_back(L'"');
  for (size_t i = 0;; ++i) {
    size_t backslashes = 0;
    while (i < arg.size() && arg[i] == L'\\') {
      ++i;
      ++backslashes;
    }
    if (i == arg.size()) {
      cmd.append(backslashes * 2, L'\\');
      break;
    }
    if (arg[i] == L'"') {
      cmd.append(backslashes * 2 + 1, L'\\');
      cmd.push_back(L'"');
    } else {
      cmd.append(backslashes, L'\\');
      cmd.push_back(arg[i]);
    }
  }
  cmd.push_back(L'"');
}

ProcessResult RunProcess(const fs::path& exe, const std::vector<std::string>& args,
                         uint64_t timeoutMs, const std::optional<fs::path>& cwd) {
  // cmd.exe re-parses batch-file command lines with its own rules, which makes
  // safe argument quoting impossible. Refuse rather than risk injection.
  const std::string ext = ToLower(PathToUtf8(exe.extension()));
  if (ext == ".bat" || ext == ".cmd") {
    throw RevError("ESPAWN", "refusing to launch a batch file as a tool: " + PathToUtf8(exe));
  }

  SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa{};
  sa.nLength = sizeof(sa);
  sa.bInheritHandle = TRUE;

  UniqueHandle readEnd;
  UniqueHandle writeEnd;
  if (!CreatePipe(&readEnd.h, &writeEnd.h, &sa, 1 << 16)) {
    throw RevError("ESPAWN", "CreatePipe failed: " + LastErrorMessage(GetLastError()));
  }
  SetHandleInformation(readEnd.h, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);

  UniqueHandle nulIn(CreateFileW(L"NUL", GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, &sa,
                                 OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
  if (!nulIn.Valid()) {
    throw RevError("ESPAWN", "cannot open NUL: " + LastErrorMessage(GetLastError()));
  }

  // Restrict handle inheritance to exactly the two handles the child needs.
  SIZE_T attrSize = 0;
  InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(nullptr, 1, 0, &attrSize);
  std::vector<unsigned char> attrBuf(attrSize);
  auto* attrList = reinterpret_cast<LPPROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_LIST>(attrBuf.data());
  if (!InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(attrList, 1, 0, &attrSize)) {
    throw RevError("ESPAWN", "InitializeProcThreadAttributeList failed: " +
                                 LastErrorMessage(GetLastError()));
  }
  struct AttrGuard {
    LPPROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_LIST list;
    ~AttrGuard() { DeleteProcThreadAttributeList(list); }
  } attrGuard{attrList};

  HANDLE inherit[2] = {nulIn.h, writeEnd.h};
  if (!UpdateProcThreadAttribute(attrList, 0, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST, inherit,
                                 sizeof(inherit), nullptr, nullptr)) {
    throw RevError("ESPAWN",
                   "UpdateProcThreadAttribute failed: " + LastErrorMessage(GetLastError()));
  }

  STARTUPINFOEXW si{};
  si.StartupInfo.cb = sizeof(si);
  si.StartupInfo.dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES;
  si.StartupInfo.hStdInput = nulIn.h;
  si.StartupInfo.hStdOutput = writeEnd.h;
  si.StartupInfo.hStdError = writeEnd.h;
  si.lpAttributeList = attrList;

  std::wstring cmdline;
  AppendQuotedArg(cmdline, exe.wstring());
  for (const auto& a : args) AppendQuotedArg(cmdline, Widen(a));
  if (cmdline.size() >= 32767) throw RevError("EINVAL", "command line is too long");

  // A job object lets a timeout take down the tool and everything it spawned.
  UniqueHandle job(CreateJobObjectW(nullptr, nullptr));
  if (job.Valid()) {
    JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION limits{};
    limits.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE;
    SetInformationJobObject(job.h, JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, &limits, sizeof(limits));
  }

  const std::wstring exeW = exe.wstring();
  const std::wstring cwdW = cwd ? cwd->wstring() : std::wstring();
  PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
  const DWORD flags = CREATE_NO_WINDOW | CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT |
                      EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT | CREATE_SUSPENDED;
  if (!CreateProcessW(exeW.c_str(), cmdline.data(), nullptr, nullptr, TRUE, flags, nullptr,
                      cwd ? cwdW.c_str() : nullptr, &si.StartupInfo, &pi)) {
    throw RevError("ESPAWN", "failed to launch " + PathToUtf8(exe) + ": " +
                                 LastErrorMessage(GetLastError()));
  }
  UniqueHandle process(pi.hProcess);
  UniqueHandle thread(pi.hThread);
  if (job.Valid()) AssignProcessToJobObject(job.h, process.h);
  ResumeThread(thread.h);
  writeEnd.Reset();  // only the child holds the write end now

  ProcessResult result;
  const uint64_t deadline = timeoutMs ? NowMs() + timeoutMs : 0;
  std::vector<char> buf(1 << 16);

  auto drain = [&]() -> bool {
    bool any = false;
    for (;;) {
      DWORD avail = 0;
      if (!PeekNamedPipe(readEnd.h, nullptr, 0, nullptr, &avail, nullptr) || avail == 0) break;
      DWORD got = 0;
      const DWORD want = static_cast<DWORD>(std::min<size_t>(avail, buf.size()));
      if (!ReadFile(readEnd.h, buf.data(), want, &got, nullptr) || got == 0) break;
      AppendCapped(result, buf.data(), got);
      any = true;
    }
    return any;
  };

  for (;;) {
    const bool gotData = drain();
    const DWORD wait = WaitForSingleObject(process.h, gotData ? 0 : 25);
    if (wait == WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
      drain();
      break;
    }
    if (deadline && NowMs() >= deadline) {
      result.timedOut = true;
      if (job.Valid()) {
        TerminateJobObject(job.h, 1);
      } else {
        TerminateProcess(process.h, 1);
      }
      WaitForSingleObject(process.h, 5000);
      drain();
      break;
    }
  }

  DWORD code = 0;
  if (GetExitCodeProcess(process.h, &code)) result.exitCode = static_cast<int>(code);
  return result;
}

#else  // POSIX

ProcessResult RunProcess(const fs::path& exe, const std::vector<std::string>& args,
                         uint64_t timeoutMs, const std::optional<fs::path>& cwd) {
  // Everything the child needs is prepared before fork(): only
  // async-signal-safe calls are allowed between fork() and exec().
  const std::string exeStr = exe.string();
  const std::string cwdStr = cwd ? cwd->string() : std::string();
  std::vector<char*> argv;
  argv.reserve(args.size() + 2);
  argv.push_back(const_cast<char*>(exeStr.c_str()));
  for (const auto& a : args) argv.push_back(const_cast<char*>(a.c_str()));
  argv.push_back(nullptr);

  int out[2];
  int err[2];  // CLOEXEC pipe used to report exec failure
  if (pipe(out) != 0) throw RevError("ESPAWN", std::string("pipe failed: ") + std::strerror(errno));
  if (pipe(err) != 0) {
    const int e = errno;
    close(out[0]);
    close(out[1]);
    throw RevError("ESPAWN", std::string("pipe failed: ") + std::strerror(e));
  }
  fcntl(out[0], F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);
  fcntl(err[0], F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);
  fcntl(err[1], F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);

  const pid_t pid = fork();
  if (pid < 0) {
    const int e = errno;
    close(out[0]);
    close(out[1]);
    close(err[0]);
    close(err[1]);
    throw RevError("ESPAWN", std::string("fork failed: ") + std::strerror(e));
  }

  if (pid == 0) {
    // --- child ---
    setpgid(0, 0);  // own process group so a timeout can kill the whole tree
    const int devnull = open("/dev/null", O_RDONLY);
    if (devnull >= 0) dup2(devnull, STDIN_FILENO);
    dup2(out[1], STDOUT_FILENO);
    dup2(out[1], STDERR_FILENO);
    if (devnull > STDERR_FILENO) close(devnull);
    if (out[1] > STDERR_FILENO) close(out[1]);
    int failure = 0;
    if (!cwdStr.empty() && chdir(cwdStr.c_str()) != 0) failure = errno;
    if (failure == 0) {
      execv(exeStr.c_str(), argv.data());
      failure = errno;
    }
    const ssize_t ignored = write(err[1], &failure, sizeof(failure));
    (void)ignored;
    _exit(127);
  }

  // --- parent ---
  close(out[1]);
  close(err[1]);

  int execErrno = 0;
  ssize_t n;
  do {
    n = read(err[0], &execErrno, sizeof(execErrno));
  } while (n < 0 && errno == EINTR);
  close(err[0]);
  if (n == static_cast<ssize_t>(sizeof(execErrno)) && execErrno != 0) {
    close(out[0]);
    int status = 0;
    while (waitpid(pid, &status, 0) < 0 && errno == EINTR) {
    }
    throw RevError("ESPAWN", "failed to launch " + exeStr + ": " + std::strerror(execErrno));
  }

  ProcessResult result;
  const uint64_t deadline = timeoutMs ? NowMs() + timeoutMs : 0;
  std::vector<char> buf(1 << 16);
  bool eof = false;
  while (!eof) {
    int waitMs = -1;
    if (deadline) {
      const uint64_t now = NowMs();
      if (now >= deadline) {
        result.timedOut = true;
        kill(-pid, SIGKILL);
        kill(pid, SIGKILL);
        break;
      }
      waitMs = static_cast<int>(std::min<uint64_t>(deadline - now, 1000));
    }
    struct pollfd pfd {};
    pfd.fd = out[0];
    pfd.events = POLLIN;
    const int rc = poll(&pfd, 1, waitMs);
    if (rc < 0) {
      if (errno == EINTR) continue;
      break;
    }
    if (rc == 0) continue;
    const ssize_t got = read(out[0], buf.data(), buf.size());
    if (got > 0) {
      AppendCapped(result, buf.data(), static_cast<size_t>(got));
    } else if (got == 0) {
      eof = true;
    } else if (errno != EINTR && errno != EAGAIN) {
      eof = true;
    }
  }
  close(out[0]);

  int status = 0;
  while (waitpid(pid, &status, 0) < 0 && errno == EINTR) {
  }
  if (WIFEXITED(status)) {
    result.exitCode = WEXITSTATUS(status);
  } else if (WIFSIGNALED(status)) {
    result.exitCode = 128 + WTERMSIG(status);
  }
  return result;
}

#endif

// ===========================================================================
// Engines
// ===========================================================================

enum class Engine { Revng, NoVmp, Unthemidator };

struct EngineSpec {
  const char* id;                        // name used in JS and the TS registries
  const char* envVar;                    // explicit path override
  std::vector<const char*> executables;  // names searched on PATH
  const char* buildHint;                 // path baked in by CMake, or nullptr
  bool compiledIn;                       // built as part of this CMake tree
  bool linked;                           // linked in-process (library target)
};

#ifdef REVENANT_REVNG_BIN_HINT
constexpr const char* kRevngHint = REVENANT_REVNG_BIN_HINT;
#else
constexpr const char* kRevngHint = nullptr;
#endif
#ifdef REVENANT_NOVMP_BIN_HINT
constexpr const char* kNoVmpHint = REVENANT_NOVMP_BIN_HINT;
#else
constexpr const char* kNoVmpHint = nullptr;
#endif
#ifdef REVENANT_UNTHEMIDATOR_BIN_HINT
constexpr const char* kUnthemidatorHint = REVENANT_UNTHEMIDATOR_BIN_HINT;
#else
constexpr const char* kUnthemidatorHint = nullptr;
#endif

#ifdef REVENANT_LINK_REVNG
constexpr bool kRevngLinked = true;
#else
constexpr bool kRevngLinked = false;
#endif
#ifdef REVENANT_LINK_NOVMP
constexpr bool kNoVmpLinked = true;
#else
constexpr bool kNoVmpLinked = false;
#endif
#ifdef REVENANT_LINK_UNTHEMIDATOR
constexpr bool kUnthemidatorLinked = true;
#else
constexpr bool kUnthemidatorLinked = false;
#endif

const EngineSpec& SpecFor(Engine engine) {
  static const EngineSpec revng{"revng",   "REVENANT_REVNG_PATH",     {"revng"},
                                kRevngHint, REVENANT_HAVE_REVNG != 0, kRevngLinked};
  static const EngineSpec novmp{"novmp",   "REVENANT_NOVMP_PATH",     {"NoVmp", "novmp"},
                                kNoVmpHint, REVENANT_HAVE_NOVMP != 0, kNoVmpLinked};
  static const EngineSpec unthemidator{"unthemidator",
                                       "REVENANT_UNTHEMIDATOR_PATH",
                                       {"unthemidator"},
                                       kUnthemidatorHint,
                                       REVENANT_HAVE_UNTHEMIDATOR != 0,
                                       kUnthemidatorLinked};
  switch (engine) {
    case Engine::NoVmp:
      return novmp;
    case Engine::Unthemidator:
      return unthemidator;
    case Engine::Revng:
    default:
      return revng;
  }
}

std::optional<fs::path> SearchPath(const std::string& name) {
  const auto pathVar = GetEnv("PATH");
  if (!pathVar) return std::nullopt;
#ifdef _WIN32
  const char sep = ';';
  const std::vector<std::string> exts = {".exe", ".com", ""};
#else
  const char sep = ':';
  const std::vector<std::string> exts = {""};
#endif
  size_t start = 0;
  while (start <= pathVar->size()) {
    size_t end = pathVar->find(sep, start);
    if (end == std::string::npos) end = pathVar->size();
    std::string dir = pathVar->substr(start, end - start);
    start = end + 1;
    if (dir.size() >= 2 && dir.front() == '"' && dir.back() == '"') {
      dir = dir.substr(1, dir.size() - 2);
    }
    // Empty and relative PATH entries are skipped on purpose: resolving a
    // tool relative to the current directory is a classic hijack vector.
    if (dir.empty()) continue;
    const fs::path base = PathFromUtf8(dir);
    if (!base.is_absolute()) continue;
    for (const auto& ext : exts) {
      fs::path candidate = base / PathFromUtf8(name + ext);
      if (!IsRegularFile(candidate)) continue;
#ifndef _WIN32
      if (access(candidate.c_str(), X_OK) != 0) continue;
#endif
      return candidate;
    }
  }
  return std::nullopt;
}

/// Locate an engine executable: explicit option, env var, CMake hint, PATH.
std::optional<fs::path> FindEngine(Engine engine, const std::string& overridePath,
                                   std::string* source = nullptr) {
  const EngineSpec& spec = SpecFor(engine);
  auto set = [&](const char* s) {
    if (source) *source = s;
  };
  std::error_code ec;

  if (!overridePath.empty()) {
    const fs::path p = fs::absolute(PathFromUtf8(overridePath), ec);
    if (!ec && IsRegularFile(p)) {
      set("option");
      return p;
    }
    throw RevError("ETOOLMISSING",
                   std::string(spec.id) + ": toolPath does not exist: " + overridePath);
  }
  if (const auto env = GetEnv(spec.envVar)) {
    const fs::path p = fs::absolute(PathFromUtf8(*env), ec);
    if (!ec && IsRegularFile(p)) {
      set("env");
      return p;
    }
    throw RevError("ETOOLMISSING", std::string(spec.envVar) + " points at a missing file: " + *env);
  }
  if (spec.buildHint && *spec.buildHint) {
    const fs::path p = PathFromUtf8(spec.buildHint);
    if (IsRegularFile(p)) {
      set("build");
      return p;
    }
  }
  for (const char* name : spec.executables) {
    if (auto found = SearchPath(name)) {
      set("path");
      return found;
    }
  }
  return std::nullopt;
}

fs::path RequireEngine(Engine engine, const std::string& overridePath) {
  if (auto p = FindEngine(engine, overridePath)) return *p;
  const EngineSpec& spec = SpecFor(engine);
  throw RevError("ETOOLMISSING",
                 std::string(spec.id) +
                     " is not available. Build it with `npm run build:native`, put it on PATH, set " +
                     spec.envVar + ", or pass options.toolPath.");
}

struct ToolOptions {
  std::string toolPath;
  std::string outputPath;
  std::string cwd;
  std::vector<std::string> extraArgs;
  uint64_t timeoutMs = 0;
};

std::optional<fs::path> OptionalCwd(const ToolOptions& opts) {
  if (opts.cwd.empty()) return std::nullopt;
  std::error_code ec;
  const fs::path p = fs::absolute(PathFromUtf8(opts.cwd), ec);
  if (ec || !fs::is_directory(p, ec)) {
    throw RevError("EINVAL", "options.cwd is not a directory: " + opts.cwd);
  }
  return p;
}

fs::path AbsoluteOutput(const std::string& utf8) {
  std::error_code ec;
  const fs::path p = fs::absolute(PathFromUtf8(utf8), ec);
  if (ec) throw RevError("EINVAL", "cannot resolve outputPath: " + utf8);
  return p.lexically_normal();
}

/// Last `maxBytes` of tool output, for error messages.
std::string Tail(const std::string& s, size_t maxBytes = 2000) {
  if (s.size() <= maxBytes) return s;
  return "..." + s.substr(s.size() - maxBytes);
}

std::vector<std::string> NonEmptyLines(const std::string& text, size_t maxLines) {
  std::vector<std::string> lines;
  size_t start = 0;
  while (start < text.size() && lines.size() < maxLines) {
    size_t end = text.find('\n', start);
    if (end == std::string::npos) end = text.size();
    std::string line = text.substr(start, end - start);
    while (!line.empty() && (line.back() == '\r' || line.back() == ' ')) line.pop_back();
    if (!line.empty()) lines.push_back(std::move(line));
    start = end + 1;
  }
  return lines;
}

// --- revng -----------------------------------------------------------------

struct LiftOutcome {
  std::string tool = "revng";
  std::string irFormat = "llvm-ir";
  std::string irPath;
  uint64_t functionsLifted = 0;
  uint64_t durationMs = 0;
  int exitCode = 0;
  std::vector<std::string> warnings;
  std::string log;
};

/// Count `define` lines in textual LLVM IR. Returns nullopt for bitcode.
std::optional<uint64_t> CountIrFunctions(const fs::path& irPath) {
  std::ifstream in(irPath, std::ios::binary);
  if (!in) return std::nullopt;
  char magic[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
  in.read(magic, 4);
  if (in.gcount() == 4 && magic[0] == 'B' && magic[1] == 'C' &&
      static_cast<unsigned char>(magic[2]) == 0xC0 && static_cast<unsigned char>(magic[3]) == 0xDE) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  in.clear();
  in.seekg(0, std::ios::beg);
  uint64_t count = 0;
  std::string line;
  while (std::getline(in, line)) {
    if (line.rfind("define ", 0) == 0) ++count;
  }
  return count;
}

LiftOutcome RunLift(const fs::path& input, const ToolOptions& opts, bool legacyCli) {
  const fs::path tool = RequireEngine(Engine::Revng, opts.toolPath);
  const fs::path output =
      opts.outputPath.empty() ? fs::path(input).concat(".ll") : AbsoluteOutput(opts.outputPath);
  const std::optional<fs::path> cwd = OptionalCwd(opts);

  // Default: the pipeline-manager CLI, `revng artifact --analyze -o <out> lift <bin>`.
  // legacy:  the older `revng lift <bin> <out>` form (what core's RevngLifter uses).
  std::vector<std::string> args;
  if (legacyCli) {
    args = {"lift"};
    args.insert(args.end(), opts.extraArgs.begin(), opts.extraArgs.end());
    args.push_back(PathToUtf8(input));
    args.push_back(PathToUtf8(output));
  } else {
    args = {"artifact", "--analyze"};
    args.insert(args.end(), opts.extraArgs.begin(), opts.extraArgs.end());
    args.insert(args.end(), {"-o", PathToUtf8(output), "lift", PathToUtf8(input)});
  }

  const uint64_t started = NowMs();
  ProcessResult proc = RunProcess(tool, args, opts.timeoutMs, cwd);

  LiftOutcome out;
  out.durationMs = NowMs() - started;
  out.exitCode = proc.exitCode;
  if (proc.timedOut) {
    throw RevError("ETIMEDOUT", "revng timed out after " + std::to_string(opts.timeoutMs) +
                                    " ms\n" + Tail(proc.output));
  }
  if (proc.exitCode != 0) {
    throw RevError("ETOOLFAILED", "revng exited with code " + std::to_string(proc.exitCode) +
                                      "\n" + Tail(proc.output));
  }
  if (!IsRegularFile(output)) {
    throw RevError("ETOOLFAILED", "revng reported success but produced no output at " +
                                      PathToUtf8(output) + "\n" + Tail(proc.output));
  }
  out.irPath = PathToUtf8(output);
  if (const auto count = CountIrFunctions(output)) {
    out.functionsLifted = *count;
  } else {
    out.warnings.push_back("output is LLVM bitcode; functionsLifted was not counted");
  }
  if (proc.truncated) out.warnings.push_back("tool output exceeded 16 MiB and was truncated");
  out.log = std::move(proc.output);
  return out;
}

// --- devirtualizers ----------------------------------------------------------

struct DevirtOutcome {
  std::string plugin;
  std::string protector;
  bool success = false;
  std::string outputPath;
  std::vector<std::string> functions;
  uint64_t durationMs = 0;
  int exitCode = 0;
  std::vector<std::string> warnings;
  std::vector<std::string> errors;
  std::string log;
};

bool IsHexString(const std::string& s) {
  return !s.empty() && s.size() <= 16 &&
         std::all_of(s.begin(), s.end(), [](unsigned char c) { return std::isxdigit(c) != 0; });
}

/// NoVmp saves each lifted routine as `<hex rva>.<stage>.vtil` in `vms/`.
std::vector<std::string> CollectVtilRoutines(const fs::path& vtilDir) {
  std::vector<std::string> routines;
  std::error_code ec;
  size_t seen = 0;
  for (fs::directory_iterator it(vtilDir, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec)) {
    if (++seen > 100000) break;
    const fs::path p = it->path();
    if (ToLower(PathToUtf8(p.extension())) != ".vtil") continue;
    std::string stem = PathToUtf8(p.stem());
    const size_t dot = stem.find('.');
    const std::string stage = dot == std::string::npos ? std::string() : stem.substr(dot + 1);
    if (dot != std::string::npos) stem = stem.substr(0, dot);
    if (!stage.empty() && stage != "optimized") continue;
    if (stem.rfind("0x", 0) == 0) stem = stem.substr(2);
    if (IsHexString(stem)) routines.push_back("0x" + ToLower(stem));
  }
  std::sort(routines.begin(), routines.end());
  routines.erase(std::unique(routines.begin(), routines.end()), routines.end());
  return routines;
}

DevirtOutcome RunDevirt(const fs::path& input, Engine engine, const ToolOptions& opts,
                        const std::vector<std::string>& vmEntries) {
  const EngineSpec& spec = SpecFor(engine);
  const fs::path tool = RequireEngine(engine, opts.toolPath);
  const std::optional<fs::path> cwd = OptionalCwd(opts);
  std::error_code ec;

  DevirtOutcome out;
  out.plugin = spec.id;

  std::vector<std::string> args;
  fs::path expectedOutput;
  fs::path vtilDir;

  if (engine == Engine::NoVmp) {
    // NoVmp <image> [-vms <rva>...] [flags]. It writes lifted routines to a
    // `vms` directory next to the image and, when recompilation succeeds,
    // `<stem>.devirt<ext>`.
    out.protector = "vmprotect";
    args.push_back(PathToUtf8(input));
    if (!vmEntries.empty()) {
      args.push_back("-vms");
      args.insert(args.end(), vmEntries.begin(), vmEntries.end());
    }
    args.insert(args.end(), opts.extraArgs.begin(), opts.extraArgs.end());
    vtilDir = input.parent_path() / "vms";
    fs::path name = input.stem();
    name += ".devirt";
    name += input.extension();
    expectedOutput = input.parent_path() / name;
  } else {
    // Convention shared with core/src/devirt/unthemidator.ts: <image> -o <out>.
    out.protector = "themida";
    expectedOutput = opts.outputPath.empty() ? fs::path(input).concat(".unthemida")
                                             : AbsoluteOutput(opts.outputPath);
    args = {PathToUtf8(input), "-o", PathToUtf8(expectedOutput)};
    args.insert(args.end(), opts.extraArgs.begin(), opts.extraArgs.end());
  }

  const uint64_t started = NowMs();
  ProcessResult proc = RunProcess(tool, args, opts.timeoutMs, cwd);
  out.durationMs = NowMs() - started;
  out.exitCode = proc.exitCode;

  // A devirtualizer failing on a sample is an expected analysis outcome, not a
  // programming error: report it in the result (like the TS plugins do)
  // instead of rejecting.
  if (proc.timedOut) {
    out.errors.push_back(std::string(spec.id) + " timed out after " +
                         std::to_string(opts.timeoutMs) + " ms");
  } else if (proc.exitCode != 0) {
    out.errors.push_back(std::string(spec.id) + " exited with code " +
                         std::to_string(proc.exitCode));
    for (auto& line : NonEmptyLines(Tail(proc.output, 1000), 8)) {
      out.errors.push_back(std::move(line));
    }
  } else {
    out.success = true;
  }

  if (out.success && engine == Engine::NoVmp) {
    if (IsRegularFile(expectedOutput)) {
      out.outputPath = PathToUtf8(expectedOutput);
      if (!opts.outputPath.empty()) {
        const fs::path wanted = AbsoluteOutput(opts.outputPath);
        fs::copy_file(expectedOutput, wanted, fs::copy_options::overwrite_existing, ec);
        if (ec) {
          out.warnings.push_back("could not copy result to outputPath: " + ec.message());
        } else {
          out.outputPath = PathToUtf8(wanted);
        }
      }
    } else if (fs::is_directory(vtilDir, ec)) {
      out.outputPath = PathToUtf8(vtilDir);
      out.warnings.push_back("no recompiled image was produced; outputPath is the VTIL directory");
    } else {
      out.warnings.push_back("NoVmp exited cleanly but no output artifacts were found");
    }
    if (fs::is_directory(vtilDir, ec)) out.functions = CollectVtilRoutines(vtilDir);
  } else if (out.success) {
    if (IsRegularFile(expectedOutput)) {
      out.outputPath = PathToUtf8(expectedOutput);
    } else {
      out.success = false;
      out.errors.push_back("tool exited cleanly but produced no output at " +
                           PathToUtf8(expectedOutput));
    }
  }

  if (proc.truncated) out.warnings.push_back("tool output exceeded 16 MiB and was truncated");
  out.log = std::move(proc.output);
  return out;
}

// ===========================================================================
// N-API glue
// ===========================================================================

/// AsyncWorker that settles a Promise and attaches `code` to rejections.
class PromiseWorker : public Napi::AsyncWorker {
 public:
  explicit PromiseWorker(Napi::Env env)
      : Napi::AsyncWorker(env), deferred_(Napi::Promise::Deferred::New(env)) {}

  Napi::Promise Promise() const { return deferred_.Promise(); }

 protected:
  /// Runs on a worker thread. Must not touch any Napi value.
  virtual void Run() = 0;
  /// Runs on the JS thread after Run() succeeded.
  virtual Napi::Value Result(Napi::Env env) = 0;

  void Execute() final {
    try {
      Run();
    } catch (const RevError& e) {
      code_ = e.code();
      SetError(e.what());
    } catch (const std::bad_alloc&) {
      code_ = "ENATIVE";
      SetError("out of memory");
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
      code_ = "ENATIVE";
      SetError(e.what());
    } catch (...) {
      code_ = "ENATIVE";
      SetError("unknown native failure");
    }
  }

  void OnOK() final {
    Napi::Env env = Env();
    Napi::HandleScope scope(env);
    try {
      deferred_.Resolve(Result(env));
    } catch (const Napi::Error& e) {
      deferred_.Reject(e.Value());
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
      deferred_.Reject(Napi::Error::New(env, e.what()).Value());
    }
  }

  void OnError(const Napi::Error& e) final {
    Napi::Env env = Env();
    Napi::HandleScope scope(env);
    Napi::Object err = e.Value();
    err.Set("code", Napi::String::New(env, code_.empty() ? "ENATIVE" : code_));
    deferred_.Reject(err);
  }

 private:
  Napi::Promise::Deferred deferred_;
  std::string code_;
};

Napi::Array ToJsArray(Napi::Env env, const std::vector<std::string>& items) {
  Napi::Array arr = Napi::Array::New(env, items.size());
  for (size_t i = 0; i < items.size(); ++i) {
    arr.Set(static_cast<uint32_t>(i), Napi::String::New(env, items[i]));
  }
  return arr;
}

// --- argument parsing (JS thread) -------------------------------------------

std::string RequirePathArg(const Napi::CallbackInfo& info, const char* fn) {
  Napi::Env env = info.Env();
  if (info.Length() < 1 || !info[0].IsString()) {
    throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, std::string(fn) + "(path, ...): path must be a string");
  }
  std::string path = info[0].As<Napi::String>().Utf8Value();
  if (path.empty()) throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, std::string(fn) + ": path must not be empty");
  if (path.find('\0') != std::string::npos) {
    throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, std::string(fn) + ": path must not contain NUL bytes");
  }
  return path;
}

std::optional<Napi::Object> OptionalOptions(const Napi::CallbackInfo& info, const char* fn) {
  if (info.Length() < 2 || info[1].IsUndefined() || info[1].IsNull()) return std::nullopt;
  if (!info[1].IsObject() || info[1].IsArray() || info[1].IsFunction()) {
    throw Napi::TypeError::New(info.Env(), std::string(fn) + ": options must be an object");
  }
  return info[1].As<Napi::Object>();
}

std::string StringOption(Napi::Env env, const Napi::Object& o, const char* key) {
  Napi::Value v = o.Get(key);
  if (v.IsUndefined() || v.IsNull()) return {};
  if (!v.IsString()) {
    throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, std::string("options.") + key + " must be a string");
  }
  std::string s = v.As<Napi::String>().Utf8Value();
  if (s.find('\0') != std::string::npos) {
    throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, std::string("options.") + key + " must not contain NUL bytes");
  }
  return s;
}

std::vector<std::string> StringArrayOption(Napi::Env env, const Napi::Object& o, const char* key) {
  std::vector<std::string> out;
  Napi::Value v = o.Get(key);
  if (v.IsUndefined() || v.IsNull()) return out;
  const std::string label = std::string("options.") + key;
  if (!v.IsArray()) throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, label + " must be an array of strings");
  Napi::Array arr = v.As<Napi::Array>();
  constexpr uint32_t kMaxItems = 4096;
  if (arr.Length() > kMaxItems) throw Napi::RangeError::New(env, label + " has too many entries");
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < arr.Length(); ++i) {
    Napi::Value item = arr.Get(i);
    if (!item.IsString()) throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, label + " must be an array of strings");
    std::string s = item.As<Napi::String>().Utf8Value();
    if (s.find('\0') != std::string::npos) {
      throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, label + " entries must not contain NUL bytes");
    }
    out.push_back(std::move(s));
  }
  return out;
}

uint64_t TimeoutOption(Napi::Env env, const Napi::Object& o, uint64_t fallbackMs) {
  Napi::Value v = o.Get("timeoutMs");
  if (v.IsUndefined() || v.IsNull()) return fallbackMs;
  if (!v.IsNumber()) throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, "options.timeoutMs must be a number");
  const double ms = v.As<Napi::Number>().DoubleValue();
  constexpr double kMax = 24.0 * 60.0 * 60.0 * 1000.0;
  if (!(ms >= 1.0) || ms > kMax) {
    throw Napi::RangeError::New(env, "options.timeoutMs must be between 1 and 86400000");
  }
  return static_cast<uint64_t>(ms);
}

ToolOptions ParseToolOptions(Napi::Env env, const std::optional<Napi::Object>& o,
                             uint64_t defaultTimeoutMs) {
  ToolOptions t;
  t.timeoutMs = defaultTimeoutMs;
  if (!o) return t;
  t.toolPath = StringOption(env, *o, "toolPath");
  t.outputPath = StringOption(env, *o, "outputPath");
  t.cwd = StringOption(env, *o, "cwd");
  t.extraArgs = StringArrayOption(env, *o, "extraArgs");
  t.timeoutMs = TimeoutOption(env, *o, defaultTimeoutMs);
  return t;
}

// --- loadBinary -------------------------------------------------------------

Napi::Object BinaryInfoToJs(Napi::Env env, const BinaryInfo& b) {
  Napi::Object o = Napi::Object::New(env);
  o.Set("path", b.path);
  o.Set("format", b.format);
  o.Set("architecture", b.architecture);
  o.Set("endianness", b.endianness);
  o.Set("bits", Napi::Number::New(env, b.bits));
  o.Set("entryPoint", Hex(b.entryPoint));
  o.Set("imageBase", Hex(b.imageBase));

  Napi::Array sections = Napi::Array::New(env, b.sections.size());
  for (size_t i = 0; i < b.sections.size(); ++i) {
    const SectionInfo& s = b.sections[i];
    Napi::Object js = Napi::Object::New(env);
    js.Set("name", s.name);
    js.Set("virtualAddress", Hex(s.virtualAddress));
    js.Set("virtualSize", Napi::Number::New(env, static_cast<double>(s.virtualSize)));
    js.Set("rawOffset", Napi::Number::New(env, static_cast<double>(s.rawOffset)));
    js.Set("rawSize", Napi::Number::New(env, static_cast<double>(s.rawSize)));
    Napi::Object flags = Napi::Object::New(env);
    flags.Set("readable", Napi::Boolean::New(env, s.readable));
    flags.Set("writable", Napi::Boolean::New(env, s.writable));
    flags.Set("executable", Napi::Boolean::New(env, s.executable));
    js.Set("flags", flags);
    sections.Set(static_cast<uint32_t>(i), js);
  }
  o.Set("sections", sections);

  // Import/export tables are resolved by the TypeScript parsers; the native
  // loader only reads headers. The keys exist so the object satisfies BinaryInfo.
  o.Set("imports", Napi::Array::New(env, 0));
  o.Set("exports", Napi::Array::New(env, 0));
  o.Set("hash", b.hash);
  o.Set("size", Napi::Number::New(env, static_cast<double>(b.size)));

  Napi::Object protector = Napi::Object::New(env);
  protector.Set("kind", b.protector.kind);
  protector.Set("confidence", Napi::Number::New(env, b.protector.confidence));
  protector.Set("evidence", ToJsArray(env, b.protector.evidence));
  o.Set("protector", protector);
  o.Set("warnings", ToJsArray(env, b.warnings));
  return o;
}

class LoadBinaryWorker final : public PromiseWorker {
 public:
  LoadBinaryWorker(Napi::Env env, std::string path) : PromiseWorker(env), path_(std::move(path)) {}

 protected:
  void Run() override { info_ = LoadBinaryInfo(ResolveInputFile(path_), /*computeHash=*/true); }
  Napi::Value Result(Napi::Env env) override { return BinaryInfoToJs(env, info_); }

 private:
  std::string path_;
  BinaryInfo info_;
};

Napi::Value LoadBinary(const Napi::CallbackInfo& info) {
  std::string path = RequirePathArg(info, "loadBinary");
  auto* worker = new LoadBinaryWorker(info.Env(), std::move(path));
  Napi::Promise promise = worker->Promise();
  worker->Queue();
  return promise;
}

// --- liftBinary -------------------------------------------------------------

class LiftWorker final : public PromiseWorker {
 public:
  LiftWorker(Napi::Env env, std::string path, ToolOptions opts, bool legacyCli)
      : PromiseWorker(env), path_(std::move(path)), opts_(std::move(opts)), legacyCli_(legacyCli) {}

 protected:
  void Run() override { out_ = RunLift(ResolveInputFile(path_), opts_, legacyCli_); }

  Napi::Value Result(Napi::Env env) override {
    Napi::Object o = Napi::Object::New(env);
    o.Set("tool", out_.tool);
    o.Set("irFormat", out_.irFormat);
    o.Set("irPath", out_.irPath);
    o.Set("functionsLifted", Napi::Number::New(env, static_cast<double>(out_.functionsLifted)));
    o.Set("durationMs", Napi::Number::New(env, static_cast<double>(out_.durationMs)));
    o.Set("warnings", ToJsArray(env, out_.warnings));
    o.Set("exitCode", Napi::Number::New(env, out_.exitCode));
    o.Set("log", out_.log);
    return o;
  }

 private:
  std::string path_;
  ToolOptions opts_;
  bool legacyCli_;
  LiftOutcome out_;
};

Napi::Value LiftBinary(const Napi::CallbackInfo& info) {
  Napi::Env env = info.Env();
  std::string path = RequirePathArg(info, "liftBinary");
  const auto options = OptionalOptions(info, "liftBinary");
  ToolOptions opts = ParseToolOptions(env, options, 30ull * 60ull * 1000ull);

  bool legacyCli = false;
  if (options) {
    const std::string cli = StringOption(env, *options, "cli");
    if (cli == "legacy") {
      legacyCli = true;
    } else if (!cli.empty() && cli != "artifact") {
      throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, "options.cli must be 'artifact' or 'legacy'");
    }
  }

  auto* worker = new LiftWorker(env, std::move(path), std::move(opts), legacyCli);
  Napi::Promise promise = worker->Promise();
  worker->Queue();
  return promise;
}

// --- devirtBinary -----------------------------------------------------------

enum class EngineChoice { Auto, NoVmp, Unthemidator };

class DevirtWorker final : public PromiseWorker {
 public:
  DevirtWorker(Napi::Env env, std::string path, ToolOptions opts, EngineChoice choice,
               std::vector<std::string> vmEntries)
      : PromiseWorker(env),
        path_(std::move(path)),
        opts_(std::move(opts)),
        choice_(choice),
        vmEntries_(std::move(vmEntries)) {}

 protected:
  void Run() override {
    const fs::path input = ResolveInputFile(path_);
    Engine engine = Engine::NoVmp;
    if (choice_ == EngineChoice::Unthemidator) {
      engine = Engine::Unthemidator;
    } else if (choice_ == EngineChoice::Auto) {
      const BinaryInfo bin = LoadBinaryInfo(input, /*computeHash=*/false);
      if (bin.protector.kind == "vmprotect") {
        engine = Engine::NoVmp;
      } else if (bin.protector.kind == "themida" || bin.protector.kind == "winlicense") {
        engine = Engine::Unthemidator;
      } else {
        throw RevError("EINVAL",
                       "could not identify a supported protector from the section table; "
                       "pass options.engine ('novmp' or 'unthemidator') explicitly");
      }
    }
    out_ = RunDevirt(input, engine, opts_, vmEntries_);
  }

  Napi::Value Result(Napi::Env env) override {
    Napi::Object o = Napi::Object::New(env);
    o.Set("plugin", out_.plugin);
    o.Set("success", Napi::Boolean::New(env, out_.success));
    if (!out_.outputPath.empty()) o.Set("outputPath", out_.outputPath);
    o.Set("devirtualizedFunctions", ToJsArray(env, out_.functions));
    o.Set("protector", out_.protector);
    o.Set("durationMs", Napi::Number::New(env, static_cast<double>(out_.durationMs)));
    o.Set("warnings", ToJsArray(env, out_.warnings));
    o.Set("errors", ToJsArray(env, out_.errors));
    o.Set("exitCode", Napi::Number::New(env, out_.exitCode));
    o.Set("log", out_.log);
    return o;
  }

 private:
  std::string path_;
  ToolOptions opts_;
  EngineChoice choice_;
  std::vector<std::string> vmEntries_;
  DevirtOutcome out_;
};

Napi::Value DevirtBinary(const Napi::CallbackInfo& info) {
  Napi::Env env = info.Env();
  std::string path = RequirePathArg(info, "devirtBinary");
  const auto options = OptionalOptions(info, "devirtBinary");
  ToolOptions opts = ParseToolOptions(env, options, 60ull * 60ull * 1000ull);

  EngineChoice choice = EngineChoice::Auto;
  std::vector<std::string> vmEntries;
  if (options) {
    const std::string engine = ToLower(StringOption(env, *options, "engine"));
    if (engine == "novmp") {
      choice = EngineChoice::NoVmp;
    } else if (engine == "unthemidator") {
      choice = EngineChoice::Unthemidator;
    } else if (!engine.empty() && engine != "auto") {
      throw Napi::TypeError::New(env, "options.engine must be 'auto', 'novmp' or 'unthemidator'");
    }
    vmEntries = StringArrayOption(env, *options, "vmEntries");
    for (const auto& entry : vmEntries) {
      // VM entries are addresses. Enforcing that here also guarantees none of
      // them can be interpreted as a command line flag.
      const bool prefixed = entry.rfind("0x", 0) == 0 || entry.rfind("0X", 0) == 0;
      if (!IsHexString(prefixed ? entry.substr(2) : entry)) {
        throw Napi::TypeError::New(
            env, "options.vmEntries must be hexadecimal addresses, got '" + entry + "'");
      }
    }
  }

  auto* worker =
      new DevirtWorker(env, std::move(path), std::move(opts), choice, std::move(vmEntries));
  Napi::Promise promise = worker->Promise();
  worker->Queue();
  return promise;
}

// --- getVersion -------------------------------------------------------------

Napi::Object EngineStatus(Napi::Env env, Engine engine) {
  const EngineSpec& spec = SpecFor(engine);
  Napi::Object o = Napi::Object::New(env);
  o.Set("compiledIn", Napi::Boolean::New(env, spec.compiledIn));
  o.Set("linked", Napi::Boolean::New(env, spec.linked));
  o.Set("backend", spec.linked ? "in-process" : "subprocess");
  o.Set("envVar", spec.envVar);

  std::string source;
  std::optional<fs::path> found;
  try {
    found = FindEngine(engine, std::string(), &source);
  } catch (const RevError& e) {
    o.Set("error", e.what());  // e.g. the env var points at a missing file
  }
  o.Set("available", Napi::Boolean::New(env, found.has_value()));
  if (found) {
    o.Set("path", PathToUtf8(*found));
    o.Set("source", source);
  } else {
    o.Set("path", env.Null());
  }
  return o;
}

Napi::Value GetVersion(const Napi::CallbackInfo& info) {
  Napi::Env env = info.Env();
  Napi::Object o = Napi::Object::New(env);
  o.Set("name", "revenant_native");
  o.Set("version", REVENANT_NATIVE_VERSION);
  o.Set("napiVersion", Napi::Number::New(env, NAPI_VERSION));

#if defined(_MSC_VER)
  o.Set("compiler", std::string("msvc ") + std::to_string(_MSC_VER));
#elif defined(__clang__)
  o.Set("compiler", std::string("clang ") + __clang_version__);
#elif defined(__GNUC__)
  o.Set("compiler", std::string("gcc ") + __VERSION__);
#else
  o.Set("compiler", "unknown");
#endif

#if defined(_WIN32)
  o.Set("platform", "win32");
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
  o.Set("platform", "darwin");
#else
  o.Set("platform", "linux");
#endif

#ifdef NDEBUG
  o.Set("buildType", "release");
#else
  o.Set("buildType", "debug");
#endif

  Napi::Object engines = Napi::Object::New(env);
  engines.Set("revng", EngineStatus(env, Engine::Revng));
  engines.Set("novmp", EngineStatus(env, Engine::NoVmp));
  engines.Set("unthemidator", EngineStatus(env, Engine::Unthemidator));
  o.Set("engines", engines);
  return o;
}

// --- module -----------------------------------------------------------------

Napi::Object Init(Napi::Env env, Napi::Object exports) {
  exports.Set("loadBinary", Napi::Function::New(env, LoadBinary, "loadBinary"));
  exports.Set("liftBinary", Napi::Function::New(env, LiftBinary, "liftBinary"));
  exports.Set("devirtBinary", Napi::Function::New(env, DevirtBinary, "devirtBinary"));
  exports.Set("getVersion", Napi::Function::New(env, GetVersion, "getVersion"));
  return exports;
}

}  // namespace revenant

static Napi::Object InitRevenantNative(Napi::Env env, Napi::Object exports) {
  return revenant::Init(env, exports);
}

NODE_API_MODULE(revenant_native, InitRevenantNative)
```

`packages/cli/src/commands/analyze.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * `revenant analyze <binary>` — full analysis pipeline. Loads and parses the
 * binary, detects a commercial protector, and summarizes sections, imports, and
 * exports.
 */

import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { Command } from 'commander';
import { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import type { BinaryInfo, ProtectorDetection } from '@revenant/shared';
import { outputFor, toJson, type Cell } from '../output/index.js';

interface AnalyzeOptions {
  format?: string;
  output?: string;
}

interface AnalyzeResult {
  binary: BinaryInfo;
  protector: ProtectorDetection;
  sections: number;
  imports: number;
  exports: number;
}

export function registerAnalyzeCommand(program: Command): void {
  program
    .command('analyze')
    .description('Run the full analysis pipeline on a binary')
    .argument('<binary>', 'path to the binary to analyze')
    .option('--format <format>', 'output format: json | table | pretty')
    .option('--output <file>', 'write the full JSON result to a file')
    .action(async (binary: string, options: AnalyzeOptions, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      out.banner();

      const engine = new RevenantEngine();

      const loadSpin = out.spinner(`Loading ${binary}`).start();
      const loaded = await engine.loadBinary(binary);
      if (!loaded.ok || !loaded.data) {
        loadSpin.fail('Failed to load binary');
        out.error(loaded.error ?? 'unknown error');
        process.exitCode = 1;
        return;
      }
      const info = loaded.data;
      loadSpin.succeed(`Loaded ${info.format.toUpperCase()} / ${info.architecture}`);

      const detectSpin = out.spinner('Detecting protector').start();
      const detected = await engine.detectProtector(binary);
      const protector: ProtectorDetection = detected.ok && detected.data
        ? detected.data
        : { kind: 'unknown', confidence: 0, evidence: [detected.error ?? 'detection unavailable'] };
      detectSpin.succeed(
        protector.kind === 'none'
          ? 'No protector detected'
          : `Protector: ${protector.kind} (${(protector.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%)`,
      );

      const result: AnalyzeResult = {
        binary: info,
        protector,
        sections: info.sections.length,
        imports: info.imports.length,
        exports: info.exports.length,
      };

      if (options.output) {
        await writeFile(options.output, toJson(result), 'utf8');
        out.success(`Wrote analysis to ${options.output}`);
      }

      if (out.isJson) {
        out.data(result);
        return;
      }

      out.heading('Binary');
      out.keyValues([
        ['Path', info.path],
        ['Format', info.format],
        ['Architecture', `${info.architecture} (${info.bits}-bit, ${info.endianness}-endian)`],
        ['Entry point', info.entryPoint],
        ['Image base', info.imageBase],
        ['Size', `${info.size} bytes`],
        ['SHA-256', info.hash],
      ]);

      out.heading('Protector');
      out.keyValues([
        ['Detected', protector.kind],
        ['Confidence', `${(protector.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%`],
      ]);
      for (const line of protector.evidence) out.bullet(line);

      out.heading(`Sections (${info.sections.length})`);
      const sectionRows: Cell[][] = info.sections.map((s) => [
        s.name,
        s.virtualAddress,
        s.virtualSize,
        `${s.flags.readable ? 'r' : '-'}${s.flags.writable ? 'w' : '-'}${s.flags.executable ? 'x' : '-'}`,
        s.entropy != null ? s.entropy.toFixed(2) : '',
      ]);
      out.table(['name', 'vaddr', 'vsize', 'perms', 'entropy'], sectionRows, 'No sections.');

      out.heading('Symbols');
      out.keyValues([
        ['Imports', info.imports.length],
        ['Exports', info.exports.length],
      ]);
    });
}
```

`packages/cli/src/commands/cfg.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * `revenant cfg <binary> <function-address>` — build and display the
 * control-flow graph for a function.
 */

import { Command } from 'commander';
import { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import { outputFor, type Cell } from '../output/index.js';

export function registerCfgCommand(program: Command): void {
  program
    .command('cfg')
    .description('Build the control-flow graph for a function')
    .argument('<binary>', 'path to the binary')
    .argument('<function-address>', 'address of the function (e.g. 0x401000)')
    .action(
      async (binary: string, functionAddress: string, _options: unknown, command: Command) => {
        const out = outputFor(command);
        const engine = new RevenantEngine();
        const spin = out.spinner(`Building CFG for ${functionAddress}`).start();

        const res = await engine.getCfg(binary, functionAddress);
        if (!res.ok || !res.data) {
          spin.fail('CFG construction failed');
          out.error(res.error ?? 'unknown error');
          process.exitCode = 1;
          return;
        }
        const cfg = res.data;
        spin.succeed(`CFG built: ${cfg.blocks.length} block(s)`);

        if (out.isJson) {
          out.data(cfg);
          return;
        }

        out.banner();
        out.heading('Control-flow graph');
        out.keyValues([
          ['Function', cfg.function],
          ['Name', cfg.name ?? '(unnamed)'],
          ['Entry', cfg.entry],
          ['Blocks', cfg.blocks.length],
        ]);

        out.heading(`Blocks (${cfg.blocks.length})`);
        const rows: Cell[][] = cfg.blocks.map((b) => [
          b.id,
          b.start,
          b.end,
          b.instructionCount,
          b.successors.join(', '),
        ]);
        out.table(['id', 'start', 'end', 'insns', 'successors'], rows, 'No basic blocks recovered.');
      },
    );
}
```

`packages/cli/src/commands/devirt.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * `revenant devirt <binary>` — devirtualize a protected binary. The engine is
 * chosen explicitly via `--engine` or auto-detected from the binary's protector.
 */

import { Command } from 'commander';
import { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import type { ProtectorKind } from '@revenant/shared';
import { outputFor, type Cell } from '../output/index.js';

interface DevirtCmdOptions {
  engine?: string;
  output?: string;
  listEngines?: boolean;
}

function protectorLabel(protectors: readonly ProtectorKind[] | undefined): string {
  return protectors && protectors.length > 0 ? protectors.join(', ') : 'unknown';
}

export function registerDevirtCommand(program: Command): void {
  program
    .command('devirt')
    .description('Devirtualize a VMProtect / Themida protected binary')
    .argument('[binary]', 'path to the protected binary')
    .option('--engine <name>', 'devirt engine: novmp | unthemidator (auto-detect if omitted)')
    .option('--output <path>', 'output path for the recovered binary')
    .option('--list-engines', 'list the available devirtualization engines and exit')
    .action(async (binary: string | undefined, options: DevirtCmdOptions, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();

      if (options.listEngines) {
        const engines = engine.devirtRegistry.list().map((name) => {
          const plugin = engine.devirtRegistry.get(name);
          return { name, protectors: plugin?.supportedProtectors ?? [] };
        });
        if (out.isJson) {
          out.data(engines);
          return;
        }
        out.banner();
        out.heading('Devirtualization engines');
        const rows: Cell[][] = engines.map((e) => [e.name, protectorLabel(e.protectors)]);
        out.table(['engine', 'protectors'], rows, 'No engines registered.');
        return;
      }

      if (!binary) {
        out.error('Missing required argument: <binary> (or pass --list-engines)');
        process.exitCode = 1;
        return;
      }

      out.banner();
      const spin = out.spinner(`Devirtualizing ${binary}`).start();

      const res = await engine.devirt(binary, {
        plugin: options.engine,
        outputPath: options.output,
      });
      if (!res.ok || !res.data) {
        spin.fail('Devirtualization failed');
        out.error(res.error ?? 'unknown error');
        process.exitCode = 1;
        return;
      }
      const result = res.data;
      if (result.success) {
        spin.succeed(
          `Devirtualized ${result.devirtualizedFunctions.length} function(s) in ${result.durationMs} ms`,
        );
      } else {
        spin.fail('Devirtualization reported failure');
      }

      if (out.isJson) {
        out.data(result);
        if (!result.success) process.exitCode = 1;
        return;
      }

      out.heading('Devirtualization result');
      out.keyValues([
        ['Plugin', result.plugin],
        ['Protector', result.protector],
        ['Success', result.success],
        ['Output', result.outputPath ?? '(none)'],
        ['Functions', result.devirtualizedFunctions.length],
        ['Duration', `${result.durationMs} ms`],
      ]);

      if (result.warnings.length > 0) {
        out.heading(`Warnings (${result.warnings.length})`);
        for (const w of result.warnings) out.bullet(w);
      }
      if (result.errors.length > 0) {
        out.heading(`Errors (${result.errors.length})`);
        for (const e of result.errors) out.error(e);
      }
      if (!result.success) process.exitCode = 1;
    });
}
```
