`packages/cli/src/commands/lift.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * `revenant lift <binary>` — lift a binary to LLVM IR using a named lifter
 * (default: the registry's first lifter, revng).
 */

import { Command } from 'commander';
import { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import { outputFor } from '../output/index.js';

interface LiftOptions {
  output?: string;
  lifter?: string;
  functions?: string[];
}

export function registerLiftCommand(program: Command): void {
  program
    .command('lift')
    .description('Lift a binary to LLVM IR')
    .argument('<binary>', 'path to the binary to lift')
    .option('--output <path>', 'output path for the generated IR')
    .option('--lifter <name>', 'lifter to use (default: revng)')
    .option('--functions <addrs...>', 'limit lifting to these function addresses')
    .action(async (binary: string, options: LiftOptions, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      out.banner();

      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      const spin = out
        .spinner(`Lifting ${binary}${options.lifter ? ` with ${options.lifter}` : ''}`)
        .start();

      const res = await engine.lift(binary, {
        lifter: options.lifter,
        outputPath: options.output,
        functions: options.functions,
      });
      if (!res.ok || !res.data) {
        spin.fail('Lift failed');
        out.error(res.error ?? 'unknown error');
        process.exitCode = 1;
        return;
      }
      const result = res.data;
      spin.succeed(`Lifted ${result.functionsLifted} function(s) in ${result.durationMs} ms`);

      if (out.isJson) {
        out.data(result);
        return;
      }

      out.heading('Lift result');
      out.keyValues([
        ['Tool', result.tool],
        ['IR format', result.irFormat],
        ['Output', result.irPath ?? '(in-memory)'],
        ['Functions lifted', result.functionsLifted],
        ['Duration', `${result.durationMs} ms`],
      ]);

      if (result.warnings.length > 0) {
        out.heading(`Warnings (${result.warnings.length})`);
        for (const w of result.warnings) out.bullet(w);
      }
    });
}
```

`packages/cli/src/commands/project.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * `revenant project <action>` — manage analysis projects through the engine's
 * ProjectManager (one SQLite-backed project per binary).
 */

import { Command } from 'commander';
import { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import type { ProjectInfo } from '@revenant/shared';
import { outputFor, type Cell } from '../output/index.js';

function renderProject(command: Command, info: ProjectInfo): void {
  const out = outputFor(command);
  out.heading('Project');
  out.keyValues([
    ['ID', info.id],
    ['Name', info.name],
    ['Binary', info.binaryPath],
    ['Database', info.databasePath],
    ['Created', info.createdAt],
    ['Updated', info.updatedAt],
  ]);
}

export function registerProjectCommand(program: Command): void {
  const project = program.command('project').description('Manage analysis projects');

  // --- create ------------------------------------------------------------
  project
    .command('create')
    .description('Create a project for a binary')
    .argument('<name>', 'project name')
    .requiredOption('--binary <path>', 'path to the target binary')
    .action(async (name: string, options: { binary: string }, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      out.banner();
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      const spin = out.spinner(`Creating project ${name}`).start();
      try {
        const proj = await engine.projects.create(name, options.binary);
        spin.succeed(`Project ${proj.info.name} ready`);
        if (out.isJson) out.data(proj.info);
        else renderProject(command, proj.info);
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('Project creation failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- list --------------------------------------------------------------
  project
    .command('list')
    .description('List known projects')
    .action(async (_options: unknown, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      try {
        const projects = await engine.projects.list();
        if (out.isJson) {
          out.data(projects);
          return;
        }
        out.banner();
        out.heading(`Projects (${projects.length})`);
        const rows: Cell[][] = projects.map((p) => [p.id, p.name, p.binaryPath, p.updatedAt]);
        out.table(['id', 'name', 'binary', 'updated'], rows, 'No projects.');
      } catch (err) {
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- open --------------------------------------------------------------
  project
    .command('open')
    .description('Open a project by id')
    .argument('<id>', 'project id')
    .action(async (id: string, _options: unknown, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      const spin = out.spinner(`Opening ${id}`).start();
      try {
        const proj = await engine.projects.open(id);
        spin.succeed(`Opened ${proj.info.name}`);
        if (out.isJson) out.data(proj.info);
        else renderProject(command, proj.info);
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('Open failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- delete ------------------------------------------------------------
  project
    .command('delete')
    .description('Delete a project')
    .argument('<id>', 'project id')
    .action(async (id: string, _options: unknown, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      const spin = out.spinner(`Deleting ${id}`).start();
      try {
        await engine.projects.delete(id);
        spin.succeed(`Deleted project ${id}`);
        if (out.isJson) out.data({ id, deleted: true });
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('Delete failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });
}
```

`packages/cli/src/commands/strings.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * `revenant strings <binary>` — extract printable strings from a binary.
 */

import { Command } from 'commander';
import { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import type { ExtractedString } from '@revenant/shared';
import { outputFor, type Cell } from '../output/index.js';

type Encoding = 'ascii' | 'utf-8' | 'utf-16';

interface StringsOptions {
  minLength?: string;
  encoding?: string;
  section?: string;
}

function parseEncodings(value?: string): Encoding[] | undefined {
  if (!value) return undefined;
  const allowed: Encoding[] = ['ascii', 'utf-8', 'utf-16'];
  const picked = value
    .split(',')
    .map((e) => e.trim())
    .filter((e): e is Encoding => (allowed as string[]).includes(e));
  return picked.length > 0 ? picked : undefined;
}

export function registerStringsCommand(program: Command): void {
  program
    .command('strings')
    .description('Extract printable strings from a binary')
    .argument('<binary>', 'path to the binary')
    .option('--min-length <n>', 'minimum string length', '4')
    .option('--encoding <list>', 'comma-separated encodings: ascii,utf-8,utf-16')
    .option('--section <name>', 'only strings located in this section')
    .action(async (binary: string, options: StringsOptions, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      const spin = out.spinner(`Extracting strings from ${binary}`).start();

      let strings: ExtractedString[];
      try {
        strings = await engine.analysis.getStrings(binary, {
          minLength: Number(options.minLength ?? '4'),
          encodings: parseEncodings(options.encoding),
        });
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('String extraction failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
        return;
      }

      if (options.section) {
        strings = strings.filter((s) => s.section === options.section);
      }
      spin.succeed(`Found ${strings.length} string(s)`);

      if (out.isJson) {
        out.data(strings);
        return;
      }

      out.banner();
      out.heading(`Strings (${strings.length})`);
      const rows: Cell[][] = strings.map((s) => [s.address, s.encoding, s.section ?? '', s.value]);
      out.table(['address', 'encoding', 'section', 'value'], rows, 'No strings found.');
    });
}
```

`packages/cli/src/commands/vm.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * `revenant vm <action>` — manage hardened analysis VMs and drive the in-guest
 * agent. Lifecycle actions (create/start/stop/list/status) go through the core
 * VmManager (QEMU/WHPX backend); guest actions (exec/upload/stealth-test/
 * load-driver/monitor) connect to the in-guest GuestAgent over its JSON-RPC
 * control channel.
 */

import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { Command } from 'commander';
import { RevenantEngine, GuestAgent } from '@revenant/core';
import type { VmDisplayInfo } from '@revenant/core';
import type { VmInfo, RuntimeAnalysisConfig } from '@revenant/shared';
import { outputFor, type Cell, Output } from '../output/index.js';

/** Default host-only endpoint the guest agent listens on. */
const GUEST_HOST = process.env['REVENANT_GUEST_HOST'] ?? '192.168.56.101';
const GUEST_PORT = Number(process.env['REVENANT_GUEST_PORT'] ?? '51515');

/** Connect a GuestAgent, run the body, and always close the connection. */
async function withGuest<T>(fn: (agent: GuestAgent) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const agent = new GuestAgent();
  await agent.connect(GUEST_HOST, GUEST_PORT);
  try {
    return await fn(agent);
  } finally {
    agent.close();
  }
}

function renderVmInfo(out: Output, info: VmInfo): void {
  out.heading(`VM: ${info.name}`);
  out.keyValues([
    ['State', info.state],
    ['OS', info.os],
    ['UUID', info.uuid ?? '(none)'],
    ['CPUs', info.cpuCount],
    ['Memory', `${info.memoryMb} MB`],
    ['Hardened', info.hardened],
    ['Snapshot', info.snapshotName ?? '(none)'],
  ]);
}

export function registerVmCommand(program: Command): void {
  const vm = program.command('vm').description('Manage analysis virtual machines');

  // --- create ------------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('create')
    .description('Create a new (optionally hardened) analysis VM')
    .requiredOption('--name <name>', 'VM name')
    .option('--iso <path>', 'install media (ISO) to attach on first boot')
    .option('--os <label>', 'guest OS label', 'windows-10-x64')
    .option('--memory <mb>', 'memory in MB', '4096')
    .option('--cpus <n>', 'CPU count', '2')
    .option('--no-harden', 'skip anti-detection hardening')
    .action(
      async (
        options: {
          name: string;
          iso?: string;
          os: string;
          memory: string;
          cpus: string;
          harden: boolean;
        },
        command: Command,
      ) => {
        const out = outputFor(command);
        out.banner();
        const engine = new RevenantEngine();
        const spin = out.spinner(`Creating VM ${options.name}`).start();
        try {
          const info = await engine.vm.create({
            name: options.name,
            os: options.os,
            cpuCount: Number(options.cpus),
            memoryMb: Number(options.memory),
            isoPath: options.iso,
            harden: options.harden,
          });
          spin.succeed(`Created VM ${info.name} (${info.state})`);
          if (out.isJson) out.data(info);
          else renderVmInfo(out, info);
        } catch (err) {
          spin.fail('VM creation failed');
          out.error((err as Error).message);
          process.exitCode = 1;
        }
      },
    );

  // --- start -------------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('start')
    .description('Start a VM (headless by default, --headed for interactive window)')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .option('--headed', 'open an interactive display window (like VirtualBox)', false)
    .action(async (name: string, options: { headed: boolean }, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      const mode = options.headed ? 'headed' : 'headless';
      const spin = out.spinner(`Starting ${name} (${mode})`).start();
      try {
        const info = await engine.vm.start(name, !options.headed);
        spin.succeed(`Started ${name} (${info.state}, ${mode})`);
        if (out.isJson) out.data(info);
        else {
          renderVmInfo(out, info);
          if (!options.headed) {
            const display = await engine.vm.display(name);
            out.info(`VNC available at ${display.vncAddress} — connect any time to get a live window`);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('Start failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- stop --------------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('stop')
    .description('Stop a VM')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .option('--force', 'request an immediate power-off', false)
    .action(async (name: string, options: { force: boolean }, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      const spin = out.spinner(`Stopping ${name}`).start();
      try {
        await engine.vm.stop(name);
        spin.succeed(`Stopped ${name}`);
        if (out.isJson) out.data({ name, action: 'stop', force: options.force, ok: true });
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('Stop failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- list --------------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('list')
    .description('List known VMs and their state')
    .action(async (_options: unknown, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      try {
        const vms = await engine.vm.list();
        if (out.isJson) {
          out.data(vms);
          return;
        }
        out.banner();
        out.heading(`Virtual machines (${vms.length})`);
        const rows: Cell[][] = vms.map((v) => [
          v.name,
          v.state,
          v.os,
          v.cpuCount,
          v.memoryMb,
          v.hardened,
        ]);
        out.table(['name', 'state', 'os', 'cpus', 'memMb', 'hardened'], rows, 'No VMs found.');
      } catch (err) {
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- status ------------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('status')
    .description('Show detailed status for one VM')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .action(async (name: string, _options: unknown, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      try {
        const info = await engine.vm.status(name);
        if (out.isJson) out.data(info);
        else {
          out.banner();
          renderVmInfo(out, info);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- display ------------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('display')
    .description('Show VNC connection info for a VM (connect to get a live interactive window)')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .option('--open', 'attempt to launch a VNC viewer automatically', false)
    .action(async (name: string, options: { open: boolean }, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      try {
        const display = await engine.vm.display(name);
        if (out.isJson) {
          out.data(display);
        } else {
          out.banner();
          out.heading(`Display: ${name}`);
          out.keyValues([
            ['Mode', display.headed ? 'Headed (SDL window)' : 'Headless (VNC only)'],
            ['VNC Address', display.vncAddress],
            ['VNC Port', display.vncPort],
            ['VNC Display', `:${display.vncDisplay}`],
          ]);
          out.info('Connect with any VNC viewer to get a live interactive window.');
          out.info(`  Example: vncviewer ${display.vncAddress}`);
          out.info(`  Or TightVNC: tvnviewer localhost::${display.vncPort}`);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- exec --------------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('exec')
    .description('Run a command inside the guest via the agent')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .argument('<command>', 'command to run in the guest')
    .argument('[args...]', 'command arguments')
    .action(
      async (name: string, cmd: string, args: string[], _options: unknown, command: Command) => {
        const out = outputFor(command);
        const spin = out.spinner(`[${name}] exec ${cmd}`).start();
        try {
          const result = await withGuest((agent) => agent.execute({ command: cmd, args }));
          if (result.exitCode === 0) spin.succeed(`[${name}] exit ${result.exitCode}`);
          else spin.fail(`[${name}] exit ${result.exitCode}`);
          if (out.isJson) {
            out.data(result);
          } else {
            if (result.stdout) process.stdout.write(`${result.stdout}\n`);
            if (result.stderr) process.stderr.write(`${result.stderr}\n`);
          }
          if (result.exitCode !== 0) process.exitCode = 1;
        } catch (err) {
          spin.fail('exec failed');
          out.error((err as Error).message);
          process.exitCode = 1;
        }
      },
    );

  // --- upload ------------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('upload')
    .description('Upload a local file into the guest')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .argument('<local>', 'local file path')
    .argument('<remote>', 'destination path inside the guest')
    .action(
      async (
        name: string,
        local: string,
        remote: string,
        _options: unknown,
        command: Command,
      ) => {
        const out = outputFor(command);
        const spin = out.spinner(`[${name}] upload ${local} → ${remote}`).start();
        try {
          await withGuest((agent) => agent.uploadFile(local, remote));
          spin.succeed(`[${name}] uploaded ${local}`);
          if (out.isJson) out.data({ name, local, remote, ok: true });
        } catch (err) {
          spin.fail('upload failed');
          out.error((err as Error).message);
          process.exitCode = 1;
        }
      },
    );

  // --- stealth-test ------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('stealth-test')
    .description('Run the VMAware anti-detection test suite inside the guest')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .action(async (name: string, _options: unknown, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const spin = out.spinner(`[${name}] running VMAware`).start();
      try {
        const result = await withGuest((agent) =>
          agent.execute({ command: 'vmaware', args: ['--json'] }),
        );
        if (result.exitCode === 0) spin.succeed(`[${name}] VMAware completed`);
        else spin.fail(`[${name}] VMAware exit ${result.exitCode}`);
        if (out.isJson) {
          out.data({ vm: name, exitCode: result.exitCode, report: result.stdout });
        } else {
          out.heading(`Stealth test: ${name}`);
          if (result.stdout) process.stdout.write(`${result.stdout}\n`);
          if (result.stderr) out.warn(result.stderr);
        }
        if (result.exitCode !== 0) process.exitCode = 1;
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('stealth-test failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- load-driver -------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('load-driver')
    .description('Load a kernel driver inside the guest')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .argument('<driver>', 'path to the driver inside the guest')
    .action(async (name: string, driver: string, _options: unknown, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const spin = out.spinner(`[${name}] loading driver ${driver}`).start();
      try {
        await withGuest((agent) => agent.loadDriver(driver));
        spin.succeed(`[${name}] driver loaded`);
        if (out.isJson) out.data({ vm: name, driver, ok: true });
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('load-driver failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });

  // --- runtime-analyze ----------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('runtime-analyze')
    .description(
      'Automated runtime analysis: upload sample, execute in VM, monitor, dump drivers/memory, download artifacts',
    )
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .argument('<sample>', 'host path to the sample binary')
    .requiredOption('-o, --output <dir>', 'host directory for collected artifacts')
    .option('--args <args...>', 'arguments to pass to the sample')
    .option('--time <ms>', 'execution time in ms', '30000')
    .option('--driver', 'load as a kernel driver instead of usermode exe')
    .option('--no-dump-drivers', 'skip driver image dumping')
    .option('--no-dump-memory', 'skip process memory dumping')
    .option('--no-snapshot', 'skip pre-execution VM snapshot')
    .option('--no-restore', 'do not restore VM after collection')
    .option('--pre-cmd <cmds...>', 'guest commands to run before sample')
    .option('--post-cmd <cmds...>', 'guest commands to run after collection')
    .action(
      async (
        name: string,
        sample: string,
        options: {
          output: string;
          args?: string[];
          time: string;
          driver?: boolean;
          dumpDrivers: boolean;
          dumpMemory: boolean;
          snapshot: boolean;
          restore: boolean;
          preCmd?: string[];
          postCmd?: string[];
        },
        command: Command,
      ) => {
        const out = outputFor(command);
        out.banner();
        const engine = new RevenantEngine();

        const config: RuntimeAnalysisConfig = {
          vmName: name,
          samplePath: resolve(sample),
          outputDir: resolve(options.output),
          sampleArgs: options.args,
          executionTimeMs: Number(options.time),
          isDriver: options.driver ?? false,
          dumpDrivers: options.dumpDrivers,
          dumpProcessMemory: options.dumpMemory,
          snapshotBefore: options.snapshot,
          restoreAfter: options.restore,
          preCommands: options.preCmd,
          postCommands: options.postCmd,
        };

        // Show progress via event bus.
        engine.events.on('runtime:progress', (p) => {
          if (!out.isJson) out.info(`[${p.stage}] ${p.percent}% — ${p.message}`);
        });

        const spin = out.spinner(`Runtime analysis on ${name}`).start();
        try {
          const result = await engine.runRuntimeAnalysis(config);
          if (!result.ok) {
            spin.fail('Runtime analysis failed');
            out.error(result.error ?? 'Unknown error');
            process.exitCode = 1;
            return;
          }
          spin.succeed(
            `Runtime analysis complete — ${result.data!.artifacts.length} artifacts collected in ${(result.data!.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`,
          );
          if (out.isJson) {
            out.data(result.data);
          } else {
            const r = result.data!;
            out.heading('Results');
            out.keyValues([
              ['Sample', r.samplePath],
              ['SHA-256', r.sampleHash],
              ['Duration', `${(r.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`],
              ['Processes seen', r.processes.length],
              ['Artifacts', r.artifacts.length],
              ['Restored', r.restored],
            ]);
            if (r.artifacts.length > 0) {
              out.heading('Artifacts');
              const rows: Cell[][] = r.artifacts.map((a) => [
                a.kind,
                a.name,
                a.hostPath,
                a.size,
              ]);
              out.table(['kind', 'name', 'path', 'size'], rows);
            }
            if (r.warnings.length > 0) {
              out.heading('Warnings');
              for (const w of r.warnings) out.warn(w);
            }
            out.info(`Full report: ${resolve(options.output, 'analysis-report.json')}`);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          spin.fail('Runtime analysis failed');
          out.error((err as Error).message);
          process.exitCode = 1;
        }
      },
    );

  // --- monitor -----------------------------------------------------------
  vm.command('monitor')
    .description('Monitor a process inside the guest (by PID or name)')
    .argument('<name>', 'VM name')
    .argument('<process>', 'process PID or name to monitor')
    .action(async (name: string, proc: string, _options: unknown, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const spin = out.spinner(`[${name}] monitoring ${proc}`).start();
      try {
        const resolved = await withGuest(async (agent) => {
          let pid = Number(proc);
          if (!Number.isInteger(pid)) {
            const procs = await agent.getProcessList();
            const match = procs.find((p) => p.name === proc);
            if (!match) throw new Error(`No process named '${proc}' in the guest`);
            pid = match.pid;
          }
          await agent.monitorProcess(pid);
          return pid;
        });
        spin.succeed(`[${name}] monitor attached to PID ${resolved}`);
        if (out.isJson) out.data({ vm: name, process: proc, pid: resolved, ok: true });
      } catch (err) {
        spin.fail('monitor failed');
        out.error((err as Error).message);
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
    });
}
```

`packages/cli/src/commands/xrefs.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * `revenant xrefs <binary> <address>` — list cross-references for an address.
 *
 * The engine resolves direct references that target an address (inbound). The
 * `--direction` flag selects which side to show; outbound recovery is reported
 * as unavailable until the analysis layer exposes it.
 */

import { Command } from 'commander';
import { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import type { CrossReference } from '@revenant/shared';
import { outputFor, type Cell } from '../output/index.js';

type Direction = 'to' | 'from' | 'both';

interface XrefsOptions {
  direction?: string;
}

function normalizeDirection(value?: string): Direction {
  return value === 'to' || value === 'from' || value === 'both' ? value : 'both';
}

export function registerXrefsCommand(program: Command): void {
  program
    .command('xrefs')
    .description('List cross-references to/from an address')
    .argument('<binary>', 'path to the binary')
    .argument('<address>', 'address to query (e.g. 0x401000)')
    .option('--direction <dir>', 'to | from | both', 'both')
    .action(async (binary: string, address: string, options: XrefsOptions, command: Command) => {
      const out = outputFor(command);
      const engine = new RevenantEngine();
      const direction = normalizeDirection(options.direction);

      const spin = out.spinner(`Resolving xrefs for ${address}`).start();
      const res = await engine.getXrefs(binary, address);
      if (!res.ok || !res.data) {
        spin.fail('Xref lookup failed');
        out.error(res.error ?? 'unknown error');
        process.exitCode = 1;
        return;
      }

      const to = direction === 'from' ? [] : res.data;
      spin.succeed(`Found ${to.length} reference(s)`);

      if (out.isJson) {
        out.data({ address, direction, to });
        return;
      }

      out.banner();
      out.heading(`Cross-references for ${address}`);

      const render = (title: string, refs: CrossReference[]): void => {
        out.heading(`${title} (${refs.length})`);
        const rows: Cell[][] = refs.map((r) => [r.from, r.to, r.kind]);
        out.table(['from', 'to', 'kind'], rows, 'None.');
      };

      if (direction !== 'from') render('References to', to);
      if (direction !== 'to') {
        out.info('Outbound (from) cross-reference recovery is not yet exposed by the engine.');
      }
    });
}
```

```ts
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * REVENANT CLI entry point. Builds the commander program, declares the global

import { Command } from 'commander';

program
  .name('revenant')

  .version('0.1.0')

  .option('-v, --verbose', 'verbose logging', false)

registerVmCommand(program);
```

`packages/cli/src/output/index.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Output registry. Resolves the active format from the global `--json` flag and
 * the per-command `--format <json|table|pretty>` option, and exposes a single
 * `Output` facade the commands render through so each command stays
 * format-agnostic.
 */

import type { Command } from 'commander';
import ora from 'ora';
import { logger, type LogLevel } from '@revenant/shared';
import { printJson } from './json.js';
import * as pretty from './pretty.js';
import { renderTable, renderKeyValue, type Cell } from './table.js';

export { printJson, toJson } from './json.js';
export { renderTable, renderKeyValue } from './table.js';
export * as pretty from './pretty.js';
export type { Cell } from './table.js';

export type OutputFormat = 'json' | 'table' | 'pretty';

/** Global + per-command options that influence output. */
export interface OutputOptions {
  json?: boolean;
  quiet?: boolean;
  verbose?: boolean;
  format?: string;
}

/** A spinner-shaped handle; a no-op stub is used in json/quiet mode. */
export interface Spinner {
  start(text?: string): Spinner;
  succeed(text?: string): Spinner;
  fail(text?: string): Spinner;
  info(text?: string): Spinner;
  warn(text?: string): Spinner;
  stop(): Spinner;
}

const NOOP_SPINNER: Spinner = {
  start: () => NOOP_SPINNER,
  succeed: () => NOOP_SPINNER,
  fail: () => NOOP_SPINNER,
  info: () => NOOP_SPINNER,
  warn: () => NOOP_SPINNER,
  stop: () => NOOP_SPINNER,
};

/** Resolve the format from merged option values. */
export function resolveFormat(opts: OutputOptions): OutputFormat {
  if (opts.json) return 'json';
  if (opts.format === 'json' || opts.format === 'table' || opts.format === 'pretty') {
    return opts.format;
  }
  return 'pretty';
}

export class Output {
  readonly format: OutputFormat;
  readonly quiet: boolean;
  readonly verbose: boolean;
  private bannerShown = false;

  constructor(opts: OutputOptions) {
    this.format = resolveFormat(opts);
    this.quiet = opts.quiet ?? false;
    this.verbose = opts.verbose ?? false;
  }

  get isJson(): boolean {
    return this.format === 'json';
  }

  /** Whether human-oriented chrome (banner, headings, spinners) should render. */
  private get decorated(): boolean {
    return !this.isJson && !this.quiet;
  }

  /** Print the startup banner (pretty format only, once). */
  banner(): void {
    if (this.format === 'pretty' && !this.quiet && !this.bannerShown) {
      pretty.banner();
      this.bannerShown = true;
    }
  }

  /** Create a spinner for a long operation (stubbed when json/quiet). */
  spinner(text: string): Spinner {
    if (!this.decorated) return NOOP_SPINNER;
    // ora's Ora is structurally compatible with our Spinner surface.
    return ora({ text, stream: process.stderr }) as unknown as Spinner;
  }

  /** Emit the machine-readable payload (json format only). */
  data(value: unknown): void {
    if (this.isJson) printJson(value);
  }

  heading(text: string): void {
    if (!this.isJson) pretty.heading(text);
  }

  section(text: string): void {
    if (!this.isJson) pretty.section(text);
  }

  /** Render an aligned block of key/value pairs. */
  keyValues(pairs: Array<[string, Cell]>): void {
    if (this.isJson) return;
    if (this.format === 'table') {
      process.stdout.write(`${renderKeyValue(pairs)}\n`);
    } else {
      for (const [key, value] of pairs) pretty.keyValue(key, value);
    }
  }

  /** Render a headed table (used by both table and pretty formats). */
  table(head: string[], rows: Cell[][], emptyNote = '(none)'): void {
    if (this.isJson) return;
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      if (this.decorated) pretty.info(emptyNote);
      return;
    }
    process.stdout.write(`${renderTable(head, rows)}\n`);
  }

  bullet(text: string): void {
    if (!this.isJson) pretty.bullet(text);
  }

  success(text: string): void {
    if (!this.isJson && !this.quiet) pretty.success(text);
  }

  info(text: string): void {
    if (!this.isJson && !this.quiet) pretty.info(text);
  }

  warn(text: string): void {
    if (!this.isJson) pretty.warn(text);
  }

  error(text: string): void {
    if (!this.isJson) pretty.failure(text);
  }
}

/**
 * Build an Output for a command invocation, reading the merged global +
 * command options, and align the shared logger's verbosity with the flags.
 */
export function outputFor(command: Command): Output {
  const opts = command.optsWithGlobals() as OutputOptions;
  const level: LogLevel = opts.quiet ? 'error' : opts.verbose ? 'debug' : 'info';
  logger.setLevel(level);
  return new Output(opts);
}
```

```ts
 * Pretty formatter — colored, human-readable output using chalk, with headers,

 |  _ \| ____\ \   / / ____| \ | |  / \  | \ | |_   _|
```

`packages/cli/src/output/table.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Table formatter — tabular display built on cli-table3.
 */

import Table from 'cli-table3';

export type Cell = string | number | boolean | null | undefined;

const stringify = (cell: Cell): string => (cell == null ? '' : String(cell));

/** Render a headed table of rows to a string. */
export function renderTable(head: string[], rows: Cell[][]): string {
  const table = new Table({
    head,
    style: { head: ['cyan', 'bold'], border: ['grey'] },
    wordWrap: true,
  });
  for (const row of rows) {
    table.push(row.map(stringify));
  }
  return table.toString();
}

/** Render a two-column key/value table (vertical layout). */
export function renderKeyValue(pairs: Array<[string, Cell]>): string {
  const table = new Table({
    style: { border: ['grey'] },
    colWidths: [22, 56],
    wordWrap: true,
  });
  for (const [key, value] of pairs) {
    table.push({ [key]: stringify(value) });
  }
  return table.toString();
}

/** Print a headed table to stdout. */
export function printTable(head: string[], rows: Cell[][]): void {
  process.stdout.write(`${renderTable(head, rows)}\n`);
}
```

`packages/core/src/analysis/cfg.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Control-flow graph construction.
 *
 * `CfgAnalyzer` recovers basic blocks and edges from linear disassembly using
 * the classic "leaders" algorithm: a block begins at the function entry, at any
 * branch target, and at any instruction following a branch. It consumes the
 * decoded-instruction stream produced by `linearDisassemble` (or any external
 * disassembler that yields the same shape).
 */

import type { BasicBlock, ControlFlowGraph } from '@revenant/shared';
import { linearDisassemble, type DecodedInstruction, type FlowKind } from './disasm.js';

function hex(addr: number): string {
  return `0x${(addr >>> 0).toString(16)}`;
}

function blockId(addr: number): string {
  return `bb_${(addr >>> 0).toString(16)}`;
}

/** Terminators that end a basic block. */
const BLOCK_ENDING: ReadonlySet<FlowKind> = new Set<FlowKind>([
  'jmp',
  'cjmp',
  'ret',
  'indirect',
]);

export class CfgAnalyzer {
  /**
   * Build a CFG for a function from its raw machine code.
   * @param code     bytes of the function body
   * @param baseAddr virtual address of the first byte
   * @param name     optional function name
   */
  fromCode(code: Uint8Array, baseAddr: number, name?: string): ControlFlowGraph {
    const instructions = linearDisassemble(code, baseAddr);
    return this.build(instructions, baseAddr, name);
  }

  /** Build a CFG from a decoded-instruction stream. */
  build(
    instructions: DecodedInstruction[],
    functionAddr: number,
    name?: string,
  ): ControlFlowGraph {
    if (instructions.length === 0) {
      return {
        function: hex(functionAddr),
        name,
        blocks: [],
        entry: blockId(functionAddr),
      };
    }

    const addresses = new Set(instructions.map((ins) => ins.address));
    const endOfRange =
      instructions[instructions.length - 1]!.address +
      instructions[instructions.length - 1]!.size;

    // 1. Identify leaders.
    const leaders = new Set<number>([functionAddr]);
    for (const ins of instructions) {
      if (ins.flow === 'jmp' || ins.flow === 'cjmp' || ins.flow === 'call') {
        if (ins.target !== undefined && addresses.has(ins.target)) {
          leaders.add(ins.target);
        }
      }
      if (BLOCK_ENDING.has(ins.flow)) {
        const next = ins.address + ins.size;
        if (next < endOfRange && addresses.has(next)) leaders.add(next);
      }
    }

    const sortedLeaders = [...leaders].filter((a) => addresses.has(a)).sort((a, b) => a - b);

    // 2. Slice instructions into blocks delimited by leaders.
    const insnByAddr = new Map(instructions.map((ins) => [ins.address, ins]));
    const blocks: BasicBlock[] = [];
    const blockIndex = new Map<number, BasicBlock>();
    const terminators = new Map<string, DecodedInstruction | undefined>();

    for (let i = 0; i < sortedLeaders.length; i++) {
      const start = sortedLeaders[i]!;
      const limit = i + 1 < sortedLeaders.length ? sortedLeaders[i + 1]! : endOfRange;

      let count = 0;
      let addr = start;
      let terminator: DecodedInstruction | undefined;
      let lastInsnEnd = start;
      while (addr < limit) {
        const ins = insnByAddr.get(addr);
        if (!ins) break;
        count++;
        lastInsnEnd = ins.address + ins.size;
        if (BLOCK_ENDING.has(ins.flow)) {
          terminator = ins;
          break;
        }
        addr += ins.size;
      }

      const block: BasicBlock = {
        id: blockId(start),
        start: hex(start),
        end: hex(lastInsnEnd),
        instructionCount: count,
        successors: [],
        predecessors: [],
      };
      // Stash the terminator for the edge pass (encoded in a side map).
      terminators.set(block.id, terminator);
      blocks.push(block);
      blockIndex.set(start, block);
    }

    // 3. Wire edges.
    const blockStarts = sortedLeaders;
    for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
      const block = blocks[i]!;
      const term = terminators.get(block.id);
      const fallthroughAddr = i + 1 < blockStarts.length ? blockStarts[i + 1]! : undefined;

      const addSucc = (targetAddr: number | undefined): void => {
        if (targetAddr === undefined) return;
        const target = blockIndex.get(targetAddr);
        if (!target) return;
        if (!block.successors.includes(target.id)) block.successors.push(target.id);
        if (!target.predecessors.includes(block.id)) target.predecessors.push(block.id);
      };

      if (!term) {
        // Straight-line block: falls through to the next block.
        addSucc(fallthroughAddr);
        continue;
      }

      switch (term.flow) {
        case 'jmp':
          addSucc(term.target);
          break;
        case 'cjmp':
          addSucc(term.target);
          addSucc(fallthroughAddr);
          break;
        case 'ret':
        case 'indirect':
          // No statically-resolvable successors.
          break;
        default:
          addSucc(fallthroughAddr);
          break;
      }
    }

    return {
      function: hex(functionAddr),
      name,
      blocks,
      entry: blockId(functionAddr),
    };
  }
}

export interface CfgBuildInput {
  functionAddress: string;
  name?: string;
  /** Pre-computed basic blocks, if available from a native disassembler. */
  blocks?: BasicBlock[];
}

/** Build a control-flow graph from pre-computed blocks (legacy helper). */
export function buildControlFlowGraph(input: CfgBuildInput): ControlFlowGraph {
  const blocks = input.blocks ?? [];
  const entry = blocks[0]?.id ?? 'entry';
  return {
    function: input.functionAddress,
    name: input.name,
    blocks,
    entry,
  };
}

/** Compute a reverse-postorder of the blocks for display/analysis. */
export function reversePostOrder(cfg: ControlFlowGraph): string[] {
  const byId = new Map(cfg.blocks.map((b) => [b.id, b]));
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const order: string[] = [];

  const visit = (id: string): void => {
    if (visited.has(id)) return;
    visited.add(id);
    const block = byId.get(id);
    if (!block) return;
    for (const succ of block.successors) visit(succ);
    order.push(id);
  };

  visit(cfg.entry);
  return order.reverse();
}
```

`packages/core/src/analysis/disasm.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Compact x86/x86-64 linear-sweep length decoder.
 *
 * This is NOT a full semantic disassembler — it computes instruction *lengths*
 * and classifies *control flow* (call / jmp / conditional / return / indirect),
 * which is exactly what the CFG and xref analyzers need to recover basic blocks
 * and direct references. It handles legacy prefixes, REX, ModRM/SIB/displacement,
 * immediates (including operand-size and REX.W effects), and the common one-byte
 * and 0x0F two-byte opcode maps. Exotic SSE encodings fall back to a conservative
 * ModRM-only length.
 */

export type FlowKind = 'seq' | 'call' | 'jmp' | 'cjmp' | 'ret' | 'indirect';

export interface DecodedInstruction {
  /** Virtual address of this instruction. */
  address: number;
  /** Encoded length in bytes. */
  size: number;
  /** Control-flow classification. */
  flow: FlowKind;
  /** Resolved absolute branch target (direct rel8/rel32 only). */
  target?: number;
}

/** Immediate-size selector. */
enum Imm {
  None,
  B, // 1 byte
  W, // 2 bytes
  Z, // 2 if operand-size override else 4
  V, // 8 if REX.W, else 2 if operand-size override, else 4 (mov r,imm)
  Moffs, // address-size dependent (8 or 4)
}

interface OpProps {
  modrm: boolean;
  imm: Imm;
  flow: FlowKind;
  /** grp3 (0xF6/0xF7): immediate only when modrm.reg in {0,1}. */
  grp3?: boolean;
}

function byteAt(code: Uint8Array, i: number): number {
  return i >= 0 && i < code.length ? code[i]! : 0;
}

/** Properties for a one-byte opcode (after prefixes/REX). */
function oneByteProps(op: number): OpProps {
  // Arithmetic families: ADD/OR/ADC/SBB/AND/SUB/XOR/CMP (0x00..0x3F).
  if (op <= 0x3f && (op & 0x07) <= 0x05 && (op & 0xc0) === 0x00) {
    const low = op & 0x07;
    if (low <= 0x03) return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
    if (low === 0x04) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'seq' }; // low === 0x05
  }

  if (op >= 0x50 && op <= 0x5f) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };

  switch (op) {
    case 0x68:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0x69:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0x6a:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0x6b:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    default:
      break;
  }

  // Jcc rel8.
  if (op >= 0x70 && op <= 0x7f) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'cjmp' };

  switch (op) {
    case 0x80:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0x81:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0x83:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0x84:
    case 0x85:
    case 0x86:
    case 0x87:
    case 0x88:
    case 0x89:
    case 0x8a:
    case 0x8b:
    case 0x8c:
    case 0x8d:
    case 0x8e:
    case 0x8f:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
    default:
      break;
  }

  // moffs mov (A0..A3): address-size-dependent immediate.
  if (op >= 0xa0 && op <= 0xa3) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.Moffs, flow: 'seq' };

  switch (op) {
    case 0xa8:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0xa9:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'seq' };
    default:
      break;
  }

  if (op >= 0xb0 && op <= 0xb7) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
  if (op >= 0xb8 && op <= 0xbf) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.V, flow: 'seq' };

  switch (op) {
    case 0xc0:
    case 0xc1:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0xc2:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.W, flow: 'ret' };
    case 0xc3:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'ret' };
    case 0xc6:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0xc7:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0xc8:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' }; // enter: handled via extra below
    case 0xc9:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0xca:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.W, flow: 'ret' };
    case 0xcb:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'ret' };
    case 0xcc:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0xcd:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0xcf:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'ret' };
    default:
      break;
  }

  if (op >= 0xd0 && op <= 0xd3) return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
  if (op === 0xd4 || op === 0xd5) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
  if (op >= 0xd8 && op <= 0xdf) return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };

  // loop/jrcxz rel8.
  if (op >= 0xe0 && op <= 0xe3) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'cjmp' };
  if (op === 0xe4 || op === 0xe5 || op === 0xe6 || op === 0xe7)
    return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };

  switch (op) {
    case 0xe8:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'call' };
    case 0xe9:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'jmp' };
    case 0xeb:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'jmp' };
    case 0xf4:
      return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'ret' }; // hlt terminates a block
    case 0xf6:
    case 0xf7:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq', grp3: true };
    case 0xfe:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
    case 0xff:
      return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'indirect' };
    default:
      break;
  }

  // Default: most remaining one-byte ops are no-operand (flags, string ops).
  return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
}

/** Properties for a 0x0F two-byte opcode. */
function twoByteProps(op2: number): OpProps {
  if (op2 >= 0x80 && op2 <= 0x8f) return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.Z, flow: 'cjmp' };
  // Instructions with an extra imm8.
  if (
    (op2 >= 0x70 && op2 <= 0x73) ||
    op2 === 0xa4 ||
    op2 === 0xac ||
    op2 === 0xba ||
    op2 === 0xc2 ||
    (op2 >= 0xc4 && op2 <= 0xc6)
  ) {
    return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
  }
  // No-operand 0x0F ops (syscall, cpuid, rdtsc, ud2, push/pop seg, ...).
  if (
    op2 === 0x05 ||
    op2 === 0x06 ||
    op2 === 0x07 ||
    op2 === 0x08 ||
    op2 === 0x09 ||
    op2 === 0x0b ||
    op2 === 0x0e ||
    op2 === 0x30 ||
    op2 === 0x31 ||
    op2 === 0x32 ||
    op2 === 0x33 ||
    op2 === 0x34 ||
    op2 === 0x35 ||
    op2 === 0x77 ||
    op2 === 0xa0 ||
    op2 === 0xa1 ||
    op2 === 0xa2 ||
    op2 === 0xa8 ||
    op2 === 0xa9 ||
    op2 === 0xaa
  ) {
    return { modrm: false, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
  }
  // Default: ModRM, no immediate (mov, movzx, SSE loads, setcc, cmov, ...).
  return { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
}

/** Decode a single instruction at `offset`; returns its length and flow. */
function decodeOne(
  code: Uint8Array,
  offset: number,
  base: number,
): DecodedInstruction {
  let i = offset;
  let operandSize = false; // 0x66
  let addressSize = false; // 0x67
  let rexW = false;

  // Legacy prefixes.
  for (; i < code.length; i++) {
    const b = code[i]!;
    if (b === 0x66) operandSize = true;
    else if (b === 0x67) addressSize = true;
    else if (
      b === 0xf0 ||
      b === 0xf2 ||
      b === 0xf3 ||
      b === 0x2e ||
      b === 0x36 ||
      b === 0x3e ||
      b === 0x26 ||
      b === 0x64 ||
      b === 0x65
    ) {
      // segment/lock/rep prefixes carry no length effect
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }

  // REX (0x40..0x4F), only meaningful immediately before the opcode.
  if (i < code.length) {
    const b = code[i]!;
    if (b >= 0x40 && b <= 0x4f) {
      rexW = (b & 0x08) !== 0;
      i++;
    }
  }

  let props: OpProps;
  let op = byteAt(code, i);
  i++;

  if (op === 0x0f) {
    const op2 = byteAt(code, i);
    i++;
    if (op2 === 0x38) {
      i++; // third opcode byte
      props = { modrm: true, imm: Imm.None, flow: 'seq' };
    } else if (op2 === 0x3a) {
      i++; // third opcode byte
      props = { modrm: true, imm: Imm.B, flow: 'seq' };
    } else {
      props = twoByteProps(op2);
      op = op2;
    }
  } else {
    props = oneByteProps(op);
  }

  let flow: FlowKind = props.flow;
  let regField = -1;

  // ModRM / SIB / displacement.
  if (props.modrm) {
    const modrm = byteAt(code, i);
    i++;
    const mod = modrm >> 6;
    regField = (modrm >> 3) & 0x07;
    const rm = modrm & 0x07;

    if (mod !== 0x03 && rm === 0x04) {
      // SIB byte.
      const sib = byteAt(code, i);
      i++;
      const sibBase = sib & 0x07;
      if (mod === 0x00 && sibBase === 0x05) i += 4; // disp32
    }

    if (mod === 0x00) {
      if (rm === 0x05) i += 4; // RIP-relative disp32 (64-bit) / disp32 (32-bit)
    } else if (mod === 0x01) {
      i += 1; // disp8
    } else if (mod === 0x02) {
      i += 4; // disp32
    }

    // grp5 (0xFF): reg selects call/jmp/push.
    if (op === 0xff) {
      if (regField === 2 || regField === 3) flow = 'indirect'; // indirect call
      else if (regField === 4 || regField === 5) flow = 'indirect'; // indirect jmp
      else flow = 'seq';
    }
  }

  // Immediate.
  let immBytes = 0;
  switch (props.imm) {
    case Imm.B:
      immBytes = 1;
      break;
    case Imm.W:
      immBytes = 2;
      break;
    case Imm.Z:
      immBytes = operandSize ? 2 : 4;
      break;
    case Imm.V:
      immBytes = rexW ? 8 : operandSize ? 2 : 4;
      break;
    case Imm.Moffs:
      immBytes = addressSize ? 4 : 8;
      break;
    case Imm.None:
    default:
      immBytes = 0;
      break;
  }

  // grp3 (0xF6/0xF7): TEST (reg 0/1) carries an immediate.
  if (props.grp3 && (regField === 0 || regField === 1)) {
    immBytes = op === 0xf6 ? 1 : operandSize ? 2 : 4;
  }
  // enter (0xC8): iw + ib.
  if (op === 0xc8) immBytes = 3;

  // Resolve a direct relative branch target.
  let target: number | undefined;
  const immStart = i;
  i += immBytes;
  const size = i - offset;

  if (
    (flow === 'call' || flow === 'jmp' || flow === 'cjmp') &&
    (props.imm === Imm.B || props.imm === Imm.Z)
  ) {
    const rel =
      immBytes === 1
        ? (byteAt(code, immStart) << 24) >> 24 // sign-extend int8
        : readInt32(code, immStart);
    target = base + offset + size + rel;
  }

  return { address: base + offset, size: Math.max(size, 1), flow, target };
}

function readInt32(code: Uint8Array, offset: number): number {
  const b0 = byteAt(code, offset);
  const b1 = byteAt(code, offset + 1);
  const b2 = byteAt(code, offset + 2);
  const b3 = byteAt(code, offset + 3);
  return (b0 | (b1 << 8) | (b2 << 16) | (b3 << 24)) | 0; // force int32
}

/**
 * Linearly disassemble a code buffer starting at virtual address `base`.
 * Stops at the end of the buffer. Returns instruction boundaries + flow.
 */
export function linearDisassemble(
  code: Uint8Array,
  base: number,
  maxInstructions = 1_000_000,
): DecodedInstruction[] {
  const out: DecodedInstruction[] = [];
  let offset = 0;
  while (offset < code.length && out.length < maxInstructions) {
    const insn = decodeOne(code, offset, base);
    out.push(insn);
    offset += insn.size;
  }
  return out;
}
```

`packages/core/src/analysis/manager.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * AnalysisManager — the static-analysis facade owned by the engine. It loads a
 * binary (via the BinaryLoader) and runs string extraction, CFG recovery,
 * cross-reference discovery, and protector detection over it.
 */

import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import type {
  BinaryInfo,
  ControlFlowGraph,
  CrossReference,
  ExtractedString,
  ProtectorDetection,
  ProtectorKind,
} from '@revenant/shared';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import { BinaryLoader } from '../binary/loader.js';
import { StringExtractor } from './strings.js';
import { CfgAnalyzer } from './cfg.js';
import { XrefAnalyzer } from './xrefs.js';
import type { StringExtractOptions } from './types.js';

const log = logger.child('analysis:manager');

/** Known protector section-name markers → protector family. */
const PROTECTOR_SECTIONS: Array<{ pattern: RegExp; kind: ProtectorKind }> = [
  { pattern: /^\.vmp\d?$/i, kind: 'vmprotect' },
  { pattern: /^\.themida$/i, kind: 'themida' },
  { pattern: /^\.winlic/i, kind: 'winlicense' },
  { pattern: /^\.enigma\d?$/i, kind: 'enigma' },
  { pattern: /^(bss|idata)$/i, kind: 'unknown' },
];

export class AnalysisManager {
  private readonly strings = new StringExtractor();
  private readonly cfg = new CfgAnalyzer();
  private readonly xrefs = new XrefAnalyzer();

  constructor(private readonly loader: BinaryLoader = new BinaryLoader()) {}

  /** Extract strings from every mapped section of the binary. */
  async getStrings(path: string, options?: StringExtractOptions): Promise<ExtractedString[]> {
    const bytes = await readFile(path);
    const info = await this.loader.load(path);
    const extractor = options ? new StringExtractor(options) : this.strings;
    return extractor.fromBinary(bytes, info);
  }

  /** Recover a control-flow graph for the function at `functionAddr` (hex). */
  async getCfg(path: string, functionAddr: string): Promise<ControlFlowGraph> {
    const bytes = await readFile(path);
    const info = await this.loader.load(path);
    const addr = this.parseAddr(functionAddr);

    const section = this.sectionContaining(info, addr);
    if (!section) {
      throw new Error(`Address ${functionAddr} is not inside any mapped section`);
    }
    const sectionVa = this.parseAddr(section.virtualAddress);
    const fileStart = section.rawOffset + (addr - sectionVa);
    const sectionEnd = section.rawOffset + section.rawSize;
    // Bound the window so a missing `ret` can't run to EOF.
    const windowEnd = Math.min(sectionEnd, fileStart + 0x10000);
    const code = bytes.subarray(fileStart, windowEnd);

    return this.cfg.fromCode(code, addr, functionAddr);
  }

  /** Find direct cross-references that target `addr` (hex). */
  async getXrefs(path: string, addr: string): Promise<CrossReference[]> {
    const bytes = await readFile(path);
    const info = await this.loader.load(path);
    const target = this.parseAddr(addr);

    const all: CrossReference[] = [];
    for (const section of info.sections) {
      if (!section.flags.executable || section.rawSize <= 0) continue;
      const sectionVa = this.parseAddr(section.virtualAddress);
      const code = bytes.subarray(section.rawOffset, section.rawOffset + section.rawSize);
      // Filter while iterating: spreading a multi-million-entry array into
      // push() overflows the stack on large binaries.
      for (const ref of this.xrefs.fromCode(code, sectionVa)) {
        if (this.parseAddr(ref.to) === target) all.push(ref);
      }
    }
    return all;
  }

  /** Detect a commercial protector from section names, entropy, and imports. */
  async detectProtector(path: string): Promise<ProtectorDetection> {
    const info = await this.loader.load(path);
    const evidence: string[] = [];
    const votes = new Map<ProtectorKind, number>();

    const vote = (kind: ProtectorKind, weight: number, why: string): void => {
      if (kind === 'unknown' || kind === 'none') return;
      votes.set(kind, (votes.get(kind) ?? 0) + weight);
      evidence.push(why);
    };

    for (const section of info.sections) {
      for (const marker of PROTECTOR_SECTIONS) {
        if (marker.pattern.test(section.name) && marker.kind !== 'unknown') {
          vote(marker.kind, 0.6, `section '${section.name}' matches ${marker.kind}`);
        }
      }
      // High-entropy executable sections are a generic packing signal.
      if (section.flags.executable && (section.entropy ?? 0) > 7.2) {
        evidence.push(
          `section '${section.name}' entropy ${section.entropy?.toFixed(2)} (packed/encrypted)`,
        );
      }
    }

    // Very few imports + high entropy is characteristic of VM-based protectors.
    if (info.imports.length > 0 && info.imports.length < 12) {
      const packed = info.sections.some((s) => s.flags.executable && (s.entropy ?? 0) > 7.2);
      if (packed) vote('vmprotect', 0.25, `only ${info.imports.length} imports + packed code`);
    }

    let best: { kind: ProtectorKind; confidence: number } = { kind: 'none', confidence: 0 };
    for (const [kind, score] of votes) {
      const confidence = Math.min(1, score);
      if (confidence > best.confidence) best = { kind, confidence };
    }

    log.debug('protector detection', { path, kind: best.kind, confidence: best.confidence });
    return {
      kind: best.kind,
      confidence: best.confidence,
      evidence,
    };
  }

  private sectionContaining(info: BinaryInfo, addr: number): BinaryInfo['sections'][number] | undefined {
    for (const section of info.sections) {
      const va = this.parseAddr(section.virtualAddress);
      const size = Math.max(section.virtualSize, section.rawSize);
      if (addr >= va && addr < va + size) return section;
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  private parseAddr(addr: string): number {
    const n = Number.parseInt(addr.replace(/^0x/i, ''), 16);
    if (Number.isNaN(n)) throw new Error(`Invalid address: ${addr}`);
    return n;
  }
}
```

`packages/core/src/analysis/strings.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * String extraction. Scans raw bytes for printable ASCII and UTF-16LE runs.
 */

import type { BinaryInfo, ExtractedString } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { StringExtractOptions } from './types.js';

function isPrintableAscii(byte: number): boolean {
  return byte >= 0x20 && byte <= 0x7e;
}

/** Extract printable strings from a byte buffer. */
export function extractStrings(
  bytes: Uint8Array,
  baseAddress = 0,
  options: StringExtractOptions = {},
): ExtractedString[] {
  const minLength = options.minLength ?? 4;
  const encodings = options.encodings ?? ['ascii', 'utf-16'];
  const results: ExtractedString[] = [];

  // NOTE: never `push(...hits)` here — large binaries yield millions of hits and
  // spreading them as call arguments overflows the stack.
  if (encodings.includes('ascii')) {
    for (const hit of scanAscii(bytes, baseAddress, minLength)) results.push(hit);
  }
  if (encodings.includes('utf-16')) {
    for (const hit of scanUtf16(bytes, baseAddress, minLength)) results.push(hit);
  }
  return results;
}

/**
 * Object-oriented facade over the string scanners. Can extract from a flat
 * buffer or from the mapped sections of a parsed binary (tagging each hit with
 * the section it was found in).
 */
export class StringExtractor {
  constructor(private readonly options: StringExtractOptions = {}) {}

  /** Extract strings from a raw buffer at a given base address. */
  fromBuffer(bytes: Uint8Array, baseAddress = 0): ExtractedString[] {
    return extractStrings(bytes, baseAddress, this.options);
  }

  /**
   * Extract strings per section of a parsed binary, labeling each result with
   * its section name. `bytes` is the full file image.
   */
  fromBinary(bytes: Uint8Array, info: BinaryInfo): ExtractedString[] {
    const results: ExtractedString[] = [];
    for (const section of info.sections) {
      if (section.rawSize <= 0) continue;
      const slice = bytes.subarray(section.rawOffset, section.rawOffset + section.rawSize);
      const base = Number.parseInt(section.virtualAddress, 16) || section.rawOffset;
      for (const s of extractStrings(slice, base, this.options)) {
        results.push({ ...s, section: section.name });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }
}

function scanAscii(bytes: Uint8Array, base: number, minLength: number): ExtractedString[] {
  const out: ExtractedString[] = [];
  let start = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i <= bytes.length; i++) {
    const printable = i < bytes.length && isPrintableAscii(bytes[i]!);
    if (printable && start === -1) {
      start = i;
    } else if (!printable && start !== -1) {
      if (i - start >= minLength) {
        out.push({
          value: new TextDecoder('ascii').decode(bytes.subarray(start, i)),
          address: `0x${(base + start).toString(16)}`,
          encoding: 'ascii',
        });
      }
      start = -1;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function scanUtf16(bytes: Uint8Array, base: number, minLength: number): ExtractedString[] {
  const out: ExtractedString[] = [];
  let start = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < bytes.length; i += 2) {
    const lo = bytes[i]!;
    const hi = bytes[i + 1]!;
    const printable = hi === 0 && isPrintableAscii(lo);
    if (printable && start === -1) {
      start = i;
    } else if (!printable && start !== -1) {
      const charCount = (i - start) / 2;
      if (charCount >= minLength) {
        out.push({
          value: new TextDecoder('utf-16le').decode(bytes.subarray(start, i)),
          address: `0x${(base + start).toString(16)}`,
          encoding: 'utf-16',
        });
      }
      start = -1;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```

`packages/core/src/analysis/xrefs.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Cross-reference tracking. Maintains a bidirectional index of references
 * between addresses discovered during analysis.
 */

import type { CrossReference } from '@revenant/shared';
import { linearDisassemble, type DecodedInstruction } from './disasm.js';

function hex(addr: number): string {
  return `0x${(addr >>> 0).toString(16)}`;
}

/**
 * Recovers direct cross-references (calls and jumps) from machine code via
 * linear-sweep disassembly. Indirect and data references require deeper
 * analysis and are not recovered here.
 */
export class XrefAnalyzer {
  /** Analyze a code buffer and return the direct references it contains. */
  fromCode(code: Uint8Array, baseAddr: number): CrossReference[] {
    return this.fromInstructions(linearDisassemble(code, baseAddr));
  }

  /** Extract references from a decoded-instruction stream. */
  fromInstructions(instructions: DecodedInstruction[]): CrossReference[] {
    const refs: CrossReference[] = [];
    for (const ins of instructions) {
      if (ins.target === undefined) continue;
      if (ins.flow === 'call') {
        refs.push({ from: hex(ins.address), to: hex(ins.target), kind: 'call' });
      } else if (ins.flow === 'jmp' || ins.flow === 'cjmp') {
        refs.push({ from: hex(ins.address), to: hex(ins.target), kind: 'jump' });
      }
    }
    return refs;
  }

  /** Build a bidirectional index from a set of references. */
  index(refs: Iterable<CrossReference>): XrefIndex {
    const idx = new XrefIndex();
    idx.addAll(refs);
    return idx;
  }
}

export class XrefIndex {
  private readonly fromIndex = new Map<string, CrossReference[]>();
  private readonly toIndex = new Map<string, CrossReference[]>();

  add(ref: CrossReference): void {
    this.push(this.fromIndex, ref.from, ref);
    this.push(this.toIndex, ref.to, ref);
  }

  addAll(refs: Iterable<CrossReference>): void {
    for (const ref of refs) this.add(ref);
  }

  /** References originating at `address`. */
  from(address: string): CrossReference[] {
    return this.fromIndex.get(address) ?? [];
  }

  /** References pointing at `address`. */
  to(address: string): CrossReference[] {
    return this.toIndex.get(address) ?? [];
  }

  all(): CrossReference[] {
    return [...this.fromIndex.values()].flat();
  }

  private push(index: Map<string, CrossReference[]>, key: string, ref: CrossReference): void {
    const list = index.get(key);
    if (list) list.push(ref);
    else index.set(key, [ref]);
  }
}
```
