`packages/core/src/binary/elf.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * ELF parser. Reads the ELF header, the section header table, and the dynamic
 * symbol table (.dynsym/.dynstr) to recover imports (undefined symbols) and
 * exports (defined global/weak symbols).
 */

import type {
  Architecture,
  BinaryInfo,
  BinarySection,
  Endianness,
  ExportSymbol,
  ImportSymbol,
} from '@revenant/shared';
import { MAGIC, type BinaryParser } from './types.js';

const EM_386 = 3;
const EM_ARM = 40;
const EM_X86_64 = 62;
const EM_AARCH64 = 183;
const EM_MIPS = 8;
const EM_RISCV = 243;

const SHT_SYMTAB = 2;
const SHT_STRTAB = 3;
const SHT_DYNSYM = 11;

const SHF_WRITE = 0x1n;
const SHF_EXECINSTR = 0x4n;
const SHF_ALLOC = 0x2n;

const STB_GLOBAL = 1;
const STB_WEAK = 2;

function machineToArch(machine: number): Architecture {
  switch (machine) {
    case EM_386:
      return 'x86';
    case EM_X86_64:
      return 'x86_64';
    case EM_ARM:
      return 'arm';
    case EM_AARCH64:
      return 'arm64';
    case EM_MIPS:
      return 'mips';
    case EM_RISCV:
      return 'riscv';
    default:
      return 'unknown';
  }
}

interface RawSection {
  nameIdx: number;
  name: string;
  type: number;
  flags: bigint;
  addr: bigint;
  offset: number;
  size: number;
  link: number;
  entsize: number;
}

export class ElfParser implements BinaryParser {
  readonly format = 'elf' as const;

  canParse(header: Uint8Array): boolean {
    return MAGIC.ELF.every((byte, i) => header[i] === byte);
  }

  async parse(path: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<BinaryInfo> {
    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);

    const eiClass = bytes[4]; // 1 = 32-bit, 2 = 64-bit
    const eiData = bytes[5]; // 1 = little, 2 = big
    const bits: 32 | 64 = eiClass === 2 ? 64 : 32;
    const endianness: Endianness = eiData === 2 ? 'big' : 'little';
    const le = endianness === 'little';

    const machine = view.getUint16(18, le);

    let entryPoint: bigint;
    let shoff: number;
    let shentsize: number;
    let shnum: number;
    let shstrndx: number;

    if (bits === 64) {
      entryPoint = view.getBigUint64(24, le);
      shoff = Number(view.getBigUint64(40, le));
      shentsize = view.getUint16(58, le);
      shnum = view.getUint16(60, le);
      shstrndx = view.getUint16(62, le);
    } else {
      entryPoint = BigInt(view.getUint32(24, le));
      shoff = view.getUint32(32, le);
      shentsize = view.getUint16(46, le);
      shnum = view.getUint16(48, le);
      shstrndx = view.getUint16(50, le);
    }

    const rawSections = this.parseSectionHeaders(view, bytes, {
      bits,
      le,
      shoff,
      shentsize,
      shnum,
      shstrndx,
    });

    const sections: BinarySection[] = rawSections
      .filter((s) => (s.flags & SHF_ALLOC) !== 0n || s.name !== '')
      .map((s) => ({
        name: s.name,
        virtualAddress: `0x${s.addr.toString(16)}`,
        virtualSize: s.size,
        rawOffset: s.offset,
        rawSize: s.size,
        flags: {
          readable: true,
          writable: (s.flags & SHF_WRITE) !== 0n,
          executable: (s.flags & SHF_EXECINSTR) !== 0n,
        },
      }));

    const { imports, exports } = this.parseSymbols(view, bytes, rawSections, bits, le);

    return {
      path,
      format: 'elf',
      architecture: machineToArch(machine),
      endianness,
      bits,
      entryPoint: `0x${entryPoint.toString(16)}`,
      imageBase: '0x0',
      sections,
      imports,
      exports,
      hash: '',
      size: bytes.length,
    };
  }

  private parseSectionHeaders(
    view: DataView,
    bytes: Uint8Array,
    opts: {
      bits: 32 | 64;
      le: boolean;
      shoff: number;
      shentsize: number;
      shnum: number;
      shstrndx: number;
    },
  ): RawSection[] {
    const { bits, le, shoff, shentsize, shnum, shstrndx } = opts;
    if (shoff === 0 || shnum === 0) return [];

    // The section-header string table gives section names.
    const strHdr = shoff + shstrndx * shentsize;
    const strTabOffset =
      bits === 64 ? Number(view.getBigUint64(strHdr + 24, le)) : view.getUint32(strHdr + 16, le);

    const sections: RawSection[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < shnum; i++) {
      const base = shoff + i * shentsize;
      if (base + shentsize > bytes.length) break;
      const nameIdx = view.getUint32(base, le);
      const type = view.getUint32(base + 4, le);

      let flags: bigint;
      let addr: bigint;
      let offset: number;
      let size: number;
      let link: number;
      let entsize: number;

      if (bits === 64) {
        flags = view.getBigUint64(base + 8, le);
        addr = view.getBigUint64(base + 16, le);
        offset = Number(view.getBigUint64(base + 24, le));
        size = Number(view.getBigUint64(base + 32, le));
        link = view.getUint32(base + 40, le);
        entsize = Number(view.getBigUint64(base + 56, le));
      } else {
        flags = BigInt(view.getUint32(base + 8, le));
        addr = BigInt(view.getUint32(base + 12, le));
        offset = view.getUint32(base + 16, le);
        size = view.getUint32(base + 20, le);
        link = view.getUint32(base + 24, le);
        entsize = view.getUint32(base + 36, le);
      }

      sections.push({
        nameIdx,
        name: this.readString(bytes, strTabOffset + nameIdx),
        type,
        flags,
        addr,
        offset,
        size,
        link,
        entsize,
      });
    }
    return sections;
  }

  private parseSymbols(
    view: DataView,
    bytes: Uint8Array,
    sections: RawSection[],
    bits: 32 | 64,
    le: boolean,
  ): { imports: ImportSymbol[]; exports: ExportSymbol[] } {
    const imports: ImportSymbol[] = [];
    const exports: ExportSymbol[] = [];

    // Prefer .dynsym (dynamic linking) and fall back to .symtab (static).
    const symtab =
      sections.find((s) => s.type === SHT_DYNSYM) ??
      sections.find((s) => s.type === SHT_SYMTAB);
    if (!symtab) return { imports, exports };

    const strtab = sections[symtab.link];
    if (!strtab || strtab.type !== SHT_STRTAB) return { imports, exports };

    const symEntSize = symtab.entsize > 0 ? symtab.entsize : bits === 64 ? 24 : 16;
    const count = Math.floor(symtab.size / symEntSize);

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const base = symtab.offset + i * symEntSize;
      if (base + symEntSize > bytes.length) break;

      let nameIdx: number;
      let info: number;
      let shndx: number;
      let value: bigint;

      if (bits === 64) {
        nameIdx = view.getUint32(base, le);
        info = bytes[base + 4]!;
        shndx = view.getUint16(base + 6, le);
        value = view.getBigUint64(base + 8, le);
      } else {
        nameIdx = view.getUint32(base, le);
        value = BigInt(view.getUint32(base + 4, le));
        info = bytes[base + 12]!;
        shndx = view.getUint16(base + 14, le);
      }

      const name = this.readString(bytes, strtab.offset + nameIdx);
      if (name === '') continue;
      const bind = info >> 4;

      if (shndx === 0) {
        // SHN_UNDEF → imported symbol resolved at load time.
        imports.push({ library: '', name });
      } else if (bind === STB_GLOBAL || bind === STB_WEAK) {
        exports.push({ name, address: `0x${value.toString(16)}` });
      }
    }

    return { imports, exports };
  }

  private readString(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): string {
    if (offset < 0 || offset >= bytes.length) return '';
    let end = offset;
    while (end < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end++;
    return new TextDecoder('ascii').decode(bytes.subarray(offset, end));
  }
}

```

`packages/core/src/binary/loader.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Binary loader: sniffs the container format (PE/ELF/Mach-O) and dispatches to
 * the appropriate parser.
 */

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import type { BinaryFormat, BinaryInfo } from '@revenant/shared';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import { MAGIC, type BinaryParser } from './types.js';
import { PeParser } from './pe.js';
import { ElfParser } from './elf.js';

const log = logger.child('binary:loader');

function matches(header: Uint8Array, magic: readonly number[]): boolean {
  if (header.length < magic.length) return false;
  return magic.every((byte, i) => header[i] === byte);
}

/** Detect the container format from the leading bytes of a file. */
export function detectFormat(header: Uint8Array): BinaryFormat {
  if (matches(header, MAGIC.PE_MZ)) return 'pe';
  if (matches(header, MAGIC.ELF)) return 'elf';
  if (
    matches(header, MAGIC.MACHO_32) ||
    matches(header, MAGIC.MACHO_64) ||
    matches(header, MAGIC.MACHO_FAT)
  ) {
    return 'macho';
  }
  return 'unknown';
}

export class BinaryLoader {
  private readonly parsers: BinaryParser[];

  constructor(parsers?: BinaryParser[]) {
    // Mach-O parser is a TODO; register PE + ELF for now.
    this.parsers = parsers ?? [new PeParser(), new ElfParser()];
  }

  /** Load and fully parse a binary from disk. */
  async load(path: string): Promise<BinaryInfo> {
    const bytes = await readFile(path);
    const header = bytes.subarray(0, 64);
    const format = detectFormat(header);
    log.debug('detected format', { path, format });

    if (format === 'unknown') {
      throw new Error(`Unrecognized binary format for ${path}`);
    }

    const parser = this.parsers.find((p) => p.canParse(header));
    if (!parser) {
      throw new Error(`No registered parser for format ${format} (${path})`);
    }

    const info = await parser.parse(path, bytes);
    info.hash = createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
    info.size = bytes.length;
    return info;
  }
}

```

`packages/core/src/binary/pe.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * PE (Portable Executable) parser.
 *
 * Parses the DOS header, the PE/COFF file header, the optional header (PE32 and
 * PE32+), the section table, and the import/export data directories. All struct
 * reads go through a DataView so endianness and bounds are explicit.
 */

import type {
  Architecture,
  BinaryInfo,
  BinarySection,
  ExportSymbol,
  ImportSymbol,
} from '@revenant/shared';
import { MAGIC, type BinaryParser } from './types.js';

const IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 = 0x014c;
const IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64 = 0x8664;
const IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM = 0x01c0;
const IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARMNT = 0x01c4;
const IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64 = 0xaa64;

const IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC = 0x10b;
const IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC = 0x20b;

const IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE = 0x20000000;
const IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ = 0x40000000;
const IMAGE_SCN_MEM_WRITE = 0x80000000;

const IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT = 0;
const IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT = 1;

function machineToArch(machine: number): Architecture {
  switch (machine) {
    case IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386:
      return 'x86';
    case IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64:
      return 'x86_64';
    case IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM:
    case IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARMNT:
      return 'arm';
    case IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64:
      return 'arm64';
    default:
      return 'unknown';
  }
}

/** A data-directory entry (RVA + size) from the optional header. */
interface DataDirectory {
  virtualAddress: number;
  size: number;
}

/** A section-table entry retained for RVA↔offset translation. */
interface RawSection {
  name: string;
  virtualAddress: number;
  virtualSize: number;
  rawOffset: number;
  rawSize: number;
  characteristics: number;
}

export class PeParser implements BinaryParser {
  readonly format = 'pe' as const;

  canParse(header: Uint8Array): boolean {
    return header[0] === MAGIC.PE_MZ[0] && header[1] === MAGIC.PE_MZ[1];
  }

  async parse(path: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<BinaryInfo> {
    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);

    // --- DOS header: e_lfanew @ 0x3C points at the PE signature. ------------
    const peOffset = view.getUint32(0x3c, true);
    if (peOffset + 4 > bytes.length || view.getUint32(peOffset, true) !== 0x00004550) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid PE signature in ${path}`);
    }

    // --- COFF file header. --------------------------------------------------
    const coffOffset = peOffset + 4;
    const machine = view.getUint16(coffOffset, true);
    const numberOfSections = view.getUint16(coffOffset + 2, true);
    const sizeOfOptionalHeader = view.getUint16(coffOffset + 16, true);

    // --- Optional header. ---------------------------------------------------
    const optOffset = coffOffset + 20;
    const optMagic = view.getUint16(optOffset, true);
    const isPe32Plus = optMagic === IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC;
    if (optMagic !== IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR32_MAGIC && !isPe32Plus) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown PE optional-header magic 0x${optMagic.toString(16)} in ${path}`);
    }
    const bits: 32 | 64 = isPe32Plus ? 64 : 32;

    const addressOfEntryPoint = view.getUint32(optOffset + 16, true);
    const imageBase = isPe32Plus
      ? Number(view.getBigUint64(optOffset + 24, true))
      : view.getUint32(optOffset + 28, true);

    // Data directories live at different offsets for PE32 vs PE32+.
    const numberOfRvaAndSizesOffset = isPe32Plus ? optOffset + 108 : optOffset + 92;
    const dataDirOffset = numberOfRvaAndSizesOffset + 4;
    const numberOfRvaAndSizes = view.getUint32(numberOfRvaAndSizesOffset, true);
    const directories: DataDirectory[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < numberOfRvaAndSizes; i++) {
      const base = dataDirOffset + i * 8;
      if (base + 8 > bytes.length) break;
      directories.push({
        virtualAddress: view.getUint32(base, true),
        size: view.getUint32(base + 4, true),
      });
    }

    // --- Section table. -----------------------------------------------------
    const sectionTableOffset = optOffset + sizeOfOptionalHeader;
    const rawSections: RawSection[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < numberOfSections; i++) {
      const base = sectionTableOffset + i * 40;
      if (base + 40 > bytes.length) break;
      rawSections.push({
        name: this.readSectionName(bytes, base),
        virtualSize: view.getUint32(base + 8, true),
        virtualAddress: view.getUint32(base + 12, true),
        rawSize: view.getUint32(base + 16, true),
        rawOffset: view.getUint32(base + 20, true),
        characteristics: view.getUint32(base + 36, true),
      });
    }

    const sections: BinarySection[] = rawSections.map((s) => ({
      name: s.name,
      virtualAddress: `0x${(imageBase + s.virtualAddress).toString(16)}`,
      virtualSize: s.virtualSize,
      rawOffset: s.rawOffset,
      rawSize: s.rawSize,
      flags: {
        readable: (s.characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ) !== 0,
        writable: (s.characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_WRITE) !== 0,
        executable: (s.characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE) !== 0,
      },
      entropy: this.sectionEntropy(bytes, s.rawOffset, s.rawSize),
    }));

    const imports = this.parseImports(
      view,
      bytes,
      rawSections,
      directories[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT],
      isPe32Plus,
      imageBase,
    );
    const exports = this.parseExports(
      view,
      bytes,
      rawSections,
      directories[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT],
      imageBase,
    );

    return {
      path,
      format: 'pe',
      architecture: machineToArch(machine),
      endianness: 'little',
      bits,
      entryPoint: `0x${(imageBase + addressOfEntryPoint).toString(16)}`,
      imageBase: `0x${imageBase.toString(16)}`,
      sections,
      imports,
      exports,
      hash: '',
      size: bytes.length,
    };
  }

  // -- Import directory ------------------------------------------------------

  private parseImports(
    view: DataView,
    bytes: Uint8Array,
    sections: RawSection[],
    dir: DataDirectory | undefined,
    isPe32Plus: boolean,
    imageBase: number,
  ): ImportSymbol[] {
    if (!dir || dir.virtualAddress === 0) return [];
    const out: ImportSymbol[] = [];

    // IMAGE_IMPORT_DESCRIPTOR is 20 bytes; the array ends with an all-zero entry.
    let descOffset = this.rvaToOffset(sections, dir.virtualAddress);
    if (descOffset < 0) return [];

    const ORDINAL_FLAG = isPe32Plus ? 0x8000000000000000n : 0x80000000n;
    const thunkSize = isPe32Plus ? 8 : 4;

    for (let guard = 0; guard < 4096; guard++) {
      if (descOffset + 20 > bytes.length) break;
      const originalFirstThunk = view.getUint32(descOffset, true);
      const nameRva = view.getUint32(descOffset + 12, true);
      const firstThunk = view.getUint32(descOffset + 16, true);
      if (originalFirstThunk === 0 && nameRva === 0 && firstThunk === 0) break;

      const nameOffset = this.rvaToOffset(sections, nameRva);
      const library = nameOffset >= 0 ? this.readCString(bytes, nameOffset) : 'unknown';

      // Prefer the import name table (OFT); fall back to the IAT (FT).
      const thunkRva = originalFirstThunk !== 0 ? originalFirstThunk : firstThunk;
      const thunkOffset = this.rvaToOffset(sections, thunkRva);
      const iatRva = firstThunk;

      if (thunkOffset >= 0) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 65536; i++) {
          const entryOffset = thunkOffset + i * thunkSize;
          if (entryOffset + thunkSize > bytes.length) break;
          const value = isPe32Plus
            ? view.getBigUint64(entryOffset, true)
            : BigInt(view.getUint32(entryOffset, true));
          if (value === 0n) break;

          const iatAddr = `0x${(imageBase + iatRva + i * thunkSize).toString(16)}`;
          if ((value & ORDINAL_FLAG) !== 0n) {
            out.push({
              library,
              name: `#${Number(value & 0xffffn)}`,
              address: iatAddr,
              ordinal: Number(value & 0xffffn),
            });
          } else {
            const hintNameOffset = this.rvaToOffset(sections, Number(value & 0x7fffffffn));
            const name =
              hintNameOffset >= 0 ? this.readCString(bytes, hintNameOffset + 2) : 'unknown';
            out.push({ library, name, address: iatAddr });
          }
        }
      }

      descOffset += 20;
    }

    return out;
  }

  // -- Export directory ------------------------------------------------------

  private parseExports(
    view: DataView,
    bytes: Uint8Array,
    sections: RawSection[],
    dir: DataDirectory | undefined,
    imageBase: number,
  ): ExportSymbol[] {
    if (!dir || dir.virtualAddress === 0) return [];
    const base = this.rvaToOffset(sections, dir.virtualAddress);
    if (base < 0 || base + 40 > bytes.length) return [];

    const out: ExportSymbol[] = [];
    const ordinalBase = view.getUint32(base + 16, true);
    const numberOfFunctions = view.getUint32(base + 20, true);
    const numberOfNames = view.getUint32(base + 24, true);
    const addressOfFunctions = this.rvaToOffset(sections, view.getUint32(base + 28, true));
    const addressOfNames = this.rvaToOffset(sections, view.getUint32(base + 32, true));
    const addressOfNameOrdinals = this.rvaToOffset(sections, view.getUint32(base + 36, true));

    // Map each named export to its function RVA via the name-ordinal table.
    const named = new Map<number, string>();
    if (addressOfNames >= 0 && addressOfNameOrdinals >= 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < numberOfNames; i++) {
        const nameRvaOffset = addressOfNames + i * 4;
        const ordOffset = addressOfNameOrdinals + i * 2;
        if (nameRvaOffset + 4 > bytes.length || ordOffset + 2 > bytes.length) break;
        const nameOffset = this.rvaToOffset(sections, view.getUint32(nameRvaOffset, true));
        const ordinal = view.getUint16(ordOffset, true);
        if (nameOffset >= 0) named.set(ordinal, this.readCString(bytes, nameOffset));
      }
    }

    if (addressOfFunctions >= 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < numberOfFunctions; i++) {
        const funcOffset = addressOfFunctions + i * 4;
        if (funcOffset + 4 > bytes.length) break;
        const funcRva = view.getUint32(funcOffset, true);
        if (funcRva === 0) continue; // empty slot
        out.push({
          name: named.get(i) ?? `#${ordinalBase + i}`,
          address: `0x${(imageBase + funcRva).toString(16)}`,
          ordinal: ordinalBase + i,
        });
      }
    }

    return out;
  }

  // -- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Translate a relative virtual address to a file offset using the sections. */
  private rvaToOffset(sections: RawSection[], rva: number): number {
    for (const s of sections) {
      const size = Math.max(s.virtualSize, s.rawSize);
      if (rva >= s.virtualAddress && rva < s.virtualAddress + size) {
        return s.rawOffset + (rva - s.virtualAddress);
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  private readSectionName(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): string {
    const raw = bytes.subarray(offset, offset + 8);
    const end = raw.indexOf(0);
    const slice = end === -1 ? raw : raw.subarray(0, end);
    return new TextDecoder('ascii').decode(slice);
  }

  private readCString(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): string {
    let end = offset;
    while (end < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end++;
    return new TextDecoder('ascii').decode(bytes.subarray(offset, end));
  }

  /** Shannon entropy (bits/byte, 0..8) of a section's raw bytes. */
  private sectionEntropy(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number, size: number): number {
    if (size <= 0 || offset < 0 || offset >= bytes.length) return 0;
    const end = Math.min(offset + size, bytes.length);
    const counts = new Array<number>(256).fill(0);
    let total = 0;
    for (let i = offset; i < end; i++) {
      counts[bytes[i]!]! += 1;
      total += 1;
    }
    if (total === 0) return 0;
    let entropy = 0;
    for (const c of counts) {
      if (c === 0) continue;
      const p = c / total;
      entropy -= p * Math.log2(p);
    }
    return Number(entropy.toFixed(4));
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Internal binary-format types for the core loader. Re-exports the shared
 * public types and adds parser-only structures not exposed across packages.
 */

export type {
  Address,
  Architecture,
  BinaryFormat,
  BinaryInfo,
  BinarySection,
  Endianness,
  ExportSymbol,
  ImportSymbol,
} from '@revenant/shared';

/** The classic "magic" bytes used to sniff a container format. */
export const MAGIC = {
  PE_MZ: [0x4d, 0x5a], // "MZ"
  ELF: [0x7f, 0x45, 0x4c, 0x46], // 0x7F "ELF"
  MACHO_32: [0xfe, 0xed, 0xfa, 0xce],
  MACHO_64: [0xfe, 0xed, 0xfa, 0xcf],
  MACHO_FAT: [0xca, 0xfe, 0xba, 0xbe],
} as const;

/** A parser is responsible for one container format. */
export interface BinaryParser {
  readonly format: 'pe' | 'elf' | 'macho';
  /** Cheap check: does this parser recognize the given header bytes? */
  canParse(header: Uint8Array): boolean;
  /** Fully parse the file at `path` into a normalized BinaryInfo. */
  parse(path: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<import('@revenant/shared').BinaryInfo>;
}
```

`packages/core/src/devirt/index.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Devirt plugin registry. Tracks available devirtualization plugins and routes
 * a binary to the first plugin that recognizes it.
 */

import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { IDevirtPlugin } from './plugin.js';
import type { DevirtOptions, DevirtResult } from './types.js';
import { NoVmpPlugin } from './novmp.js';
import { UnthemidatorPlugin } from './unthemidator.js';

const log = logger.child('devirt:registry');

export class DevirtRegistry {
  private readonly plugins = new Map<string, IDevirtPlugin>();

  constructor(plugins?: IDevirtPlugin[]) {
    const defaults = plugins ?? [new NoVmpPlugin(), new UnthemidatorPlugin()];
    for (const plugin of defaults) this.register(plugin.name, plugin);
  }

  register(name: string, plugin: IDevirtPlugin): void {
    this.plugins.set(name, plugin);
    log.debug('registered devirt plugin', { name });
  }

  get(name: string): IDevirtPlugin | undefined {
    return this.plugins.get(name);
  }

  list(): string[] {
    return [...this.plugins.keys()];
  }

  /** Find the first plugin that recognizes the binary. */
  async detect(binaryPath: string): Promise<IDevirtPlugin | undefined> {
    for (const plugin of this.plugins.values()) {
      try {
        if (await plugin.detect(binaryPath)) return plugin;
      } catch (err) {
        log.warn('plugin detect failed', { plugin: plugin.name, error: String(err) });
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  /** Run devirtualization with an explicit plugin, or auto-detect when omitted. */
  async run(
    binaryPath: string,
    pluginName?: string,
    options?: DevirtOptions,
  ): Promise<DevirtResult> {
    let plugin: IDevirtPlugin | undefined;
    if (pluginName) {
      plugin = this.plugins.get(pluginName);
      if (!plugin) throw new Error(`Unknown devirt plugin: ${pluginName}`);
    } else {
      plugin = await this.detect(binaryPath);
      if (!plugin) throw new Error('Could not auto-detect a protector for this binary');
    }

    if (!(await plugin.isAvailable())) {
      throw new Error(`Devirt plugin '${plugin.name}' is not available (tool missing?)`);
    }
    return plugin.run(binaryPath, options);
  }
}

export * from './types.js';
export type { IDevirtPlugin } from './plugin.js';
export { NoVmpPlugin } from './novmp.js';
export { UnthemidatorPlugin } from './unthemidator.js';
```

`packages/core/src/devirt/novmp.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * NoVmp devirtualization plugin — targets VMProtect-virtualized x86_64 code.
 *
 * NoVmp consumes a VTIL-lifted representation of the VM and emits devirtualized
 * output. REVENANT drives it as a subprocess.
 *
 * @see https://github.com/can1357/NoVmp
 */

import { execa } from 'execa';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { ProtectorKind } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { IDevirtPlugin } from './plugin.js';
import type { DevirtOptions, DevirtResult } from './types.js';
import { fileContainsAny } from './signatures.js';

const log = logger.child('devirt:novmp');

/** VMProtect section-name markers. */
const VMPROTECT_MARKERS = ['.vmp0', '.vmp1', '.vmp2', 'VMProtect'];

export interface NoVmpConfig {
  /** Path to the NoVmp executable. Defaults to `NoVmp` on PATH. */
  binaryPath?: string;
}

export class NoVmpPlugin implements IDevirtPlugin {
  readonly name = 'novmp';
  readonly supportedProtectors: ProtectorKind[] = ['vmprotect'];
  private readonly exe: string;

  constructor(config: NoVmpConfig = {}) {
    this.exe = config.binaryPath ?? 'NoVmp';
  }

  async isAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
    return (await this.getVersion()) !== undefined;
  }

  async getVersion(): Promise<string | undefined> {
    try {
      const { stdout, stderr } = await execa(this.exe, ['--help'], {
        timeout: 10_000,
        reject: false,
      });
      const text = `${stdout}\n${stderr}`;
      const match = text.match(/NoVmp\s+v?[\d.]+/i);
      return match ? match[0] : 'NoVmp';
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async detect(binaryPath: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return fileContainsAny(binaryPath, VMPROTECT_MARKERS);
  }

  async run(binaryPath: string, options: DevirtOptions = {}): Promise<DevirtResult> {
    const start = Date.now();
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const errors: string[] = [];

    const output = options.outputPath ?? `${binaryPath}.devirt`;
    const args: string[] = [binaryPath];
    if (options.imageBase) args.push('--base', options.imageBase);
    for (const vm of options.vmEntries ?? []) args.push('--vms', vm);
    for (const section of options.sections ?? []) args.push('--sections', section);
    if (options.extraArgs?.length) args.push(...options.extraArgs);

    log.info('running NoVmp', { exe: this.exe, args });

    let success = false;
    try {
      const result = await execa(this.exe, args, {
        timeout: options.timeoutMs ?? 600_000,
        reject: false,
      });
      if (result.stderr) warnings.push(result.stderr);
      success = result.exitCode === 0;
      if (!success) errors.push(`NoVmp exited with code ${result.exitCode}`);
    } catch (err) {
      errors.push((err as Error).message);
    }

    return {
      plugin: this.name,
      success,
      outputPath: success ? output : undefined,
      devirtualizedFunctions: [],
      protector: 'vmprotect',
      durationMs: Date.now() - start,
      warnings,
      errors,
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The devirtualization plugin interface. Each commercial protector gets its own
 * plugin (NoVmp for VMProtect, unthemidator for Themida/WinLicense).
 */

import type { ProtectorKind } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { DevirtOptions, DevirtResult } from './types.js';

export interface IDevirtPlugin {
  /** Stable identifier used in the registry and CLI (`--engine <name>`). */
  readonly name: string;

  /** Protector families this plugin can handle. */
  readonly supportedProtectors: ProtectorKind[];

  /** Is the backing native tool available on this machine? */
  isAvailable(): Promise<boolean>;

  /** Version string of the backing tool, or undefined if unavailable. */
  getVersion(): Promise<string | undefined>;

  /** Does this plugin recognize the target (signature/section detection)? */
  detect(binaryPath: string): Promise<boolean>;

  /** Run devirtualization against the binary. */
  run(binaryPath: string, options?: DevirtOptions): Promise<DevirtResult>;
}
```

`packages/core/src/devirt/signatures.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Lightweight on-disk signature scanning used by devirt plugins to decide
 * whether they recognize a target. Reads the file once and searches for ASCII
 * markers (section names / embedded strings) left by known protectors.
 */

import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

/** Return true if any of the ASCII markers appears in the file. */
export async function fileContainsAny(path: string, markers: string[]): Promise<boolean> {
  let bytes: Buffer;
  try {
    bytes = await readFile(path);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  // Latin1 keeps a 1:1 byte→char mapping so section names match exactly.
  const haystack = bytes.toString('latin1');
  return markers.some((m) => haystack.includes(m));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Devirtualization types.

import type { DevirtResult, ProtectorKind } from '@revenant/shared';

export type { DevirtResult, ProtectorKind };

/**
 * Options controlling a devirtualization run. The superset covers every backend;
 * each plugin reads only the fields relevant to it.
 */
export interface DevirtOptions {
  /** Output path for the recovered/cleaned binary (generic "out-file"). */
  outputPath?: string;

  // --- NoVmp (VMProtect) ---------------------------------------------------
  /** Image base override (NoVmp `--base`). */
  imageBase?: string;
  /** Explicit VM-entry / stub addresses to recover (NoVmp `--vms`). */
  vmEntries?: string[];
  /** Restrict devirtualization to these section names (NoVmp `--sections`). */
  sections?: string[];

  // --- unthemidator (Themida/WinLicense) -----------------------------------
  /** Maximum VM nesting depth to follow (unthemidator `--vm-depth`). */
  vmDepth?: number;
  /** License file to supply to the target (unthemidator `--license-file`). */
  licenseFile?: string;

  /** Extra flags passed verbatim to the backend tool. */
  extraArgs?: string[];
  /** Timeout for the devirt subprocess, in milliseconds. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
}
```

`packages/core/src/devirt/unthemidator.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * unthemidator devirtualization plugin — targets Themida / WinLicense
 * virtualization. REVENANT drives the unthemidator tool as a subprocess.
 */

import { execa } from 'execa';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { ProtectorKind } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { IDevirtPlugin } from './plugin.js';
import type { DevirtOptions, DevirtResult } from './types.js';
import { fileContainsAny } from './signatures.js';

const log = logger.child('devirt:unthemidator');

/** Themida / WinLicense section-name and string markers. */
const THEMIDA_MARKERS = ['.themida', '.winlic', 'Themida', 'WinLicense', '.vlizer'];

export interface UnthemidatorConfig {
  /** Path to the unthemidator executable. Defaults to `unthemidator` on PATH. */
  binaryPath?: string;
}

export class UnthemidatorPlugin implements IDevirtPlugin {
  readonly name = 'unthemidator';
  readonly supportedProtectors: ProtectorKind[] = ['themida', 'winlicense'];
  private readonly exe: string;

  constructor(config: UnthemidatorConfig = {}) {
    this.exe = config.binaryPath ?? 'unthemidator';
  }

  async isAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
    return (await this.getVersion()) !== undefined;
  }

  async getVersion(): Promise<string | undefined> {
    try {
      const { stdout, stderr } = await execa(this.exe, ['--help'], {
        timeout: 10_000,
        reject: false,
      });
      const text = `${stdout}\n${stderr}`;
      const match = text.match(/unthemidator\s+v?[\d.]+/i);
      return match ? match[0] : 'unthemidator';
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async detect(binaryPath: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return fileContainsAny(binaryPath, THEMIDA_MARKERS);
  }

  async run(binaryPath: string, options: DevirtOptions = {}): Promise<DevirtResult> {
    const start = Date.now();
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const errors: string[] = [];

    const output = options.outputPath ?? `${binaryPath}.unthemida`;
    const args: string[] = [binaryPath, '--out-file', output];
    if (options.vmDepth !== undefined) args.push('--vm-depth', String(options.vmDepth));
    if (options.licenseFile) args.push('--license-file', options.licenseFile);
    if (options.extraArgs?.length) args.push(...options.extraArgs);

    log.info('running unthemidator', { exe: this.exe, args });

    let success = false;
    try {
      const result = await execa(this.exe, args, {
        timeout: options.timeoutMs ?? 600_000,
        reject: false,
      });
      if (result.stderr) warnings.push(result.stderr);
      success = result.exitCode === 0;
      if (!success) errors.push(`unthemidator exited with code ${result.exitCode}`);
    } catch (err) {
      errors.push((err as Error).message);
    }

    return {
      plugin: this.name,
      success,
      outputPath: success ? output : undefined,
      devirtualizedFunctions: [],
      protector: 'themida',
      durationMs: Date.now() - start,
      warnings,
      errors,
    };
  }
}
```

`packages/core/src/engine.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * RevenantEngine — the top-level facade used by every frontend (CLI, MCP,
 * VS Code). It owns the binary loader, the lifter and devirt registries, the
 * static-analysis manager, the VM manager, and the project store, and surfaces
 * progress through a shared EventBus.
 *
 * Every public operation returns a `Result<T>` so frontends get a uniform,
 * serializable success/error envelope across the process boundary.
 */

import { EventBus, logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type {
  BinaryInfo,
  ControlFlowGraph,
  CrossReference,
  DevirtResult,
  ExtractedString,
  LiftResult,
  ProtectorDetection,
  Result,
  RuntimeAnalysisConfig,
  RuntimeAnalysisResult,
  VmInfo,
} from '@revenant/shared';
import type { LogLevel } from '@revenant/shared';
import { BinaryLoader } from './binary/loader.js';
import { LifterRegistry } from './lifter/index.js';
import type { LiftOptions } from './lifter/types.js';
import { DevirtRegistry } from './devirt/index.js';
import type { DevirtOptions } from './devirt/types.js';
import { AnalysisManager } from './analysis/manager.js';
import { VmManager } from './vm/manager.js';
import { RuntimeAnalysisPipeline } from './vm/runtime-analysis.js';
import { ProjectManager } from './project/project.js';

export interface EngineConfig {
  /** Shared event bus; a fresh one is created when omitted. */
  events?: EventBus;
  /** Log level for the engine logger. */
  logLevel?: LogLevel;
  loader?: BinaryLoader;
  lifters?: LifterRegistry;
  devirt?: DevirtRegistry;
  analysis?: AnalysisManager;
  vm?: VmManager;
  projects?: ProjectManager;
}

/** Summary returned by the full `analyze` pipeline. */
export interface AnalysisReport {
  projectId: string;
  binary: BinaryInfo;
  stringCount: number;
  xrefCount: number;
  protector: ProtectorDetection;
}

function ok<T>(data: T): Result<T> {
  return { ok: true, data };
}

function err<T>(error: unknown): Result<T> {
  return { ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) };
}

export class RevenantEngine {
  readonly events: EventBus;
  readonly loader: BinaryLoader;
  readonly lifters: LifterRegistry;
  readonly devirtRegistry: DevirtRegistry;
  readonly analysis: AnalysisManager;
  readonly vm: VmManager;
  readonly runtime: RuntimeAnalysisPipeline;
  readonly projects: ProjectManager;

  constructor(config: EngineConfig = {}) {
    this.events = config.events ?? new EventBus();
    this.loader = config.loader ?? new BinaryLoader();
    this.lifters = config.lifters ?? new LifterRegistry();
    this.devirtRegistry = config.devirt ?? new DevirtRegistry();
    this.analysis = config.analysis ?? new AnalysisManager(this.loader);
    this.vm = config.vm ?? new VmManager();
    this.runtime = new RuntimeAnalysisPipeline(this.vm, this.events);
    this.projects = config.projects ?? new ProjectManager();
    if (config.logLevel) logger.setLevel(config.logLevel);
  }

  // --- Binary ---------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Load and parse a binary into a normalized BinaryInfo. */
  async loadBinary(path: string): Promise<Result<BinaryInfo>> {
    try {
      const info = await this.loader.load(path);
      this.events.emit('binary:loaded', info);
      return ok(info);
    } catch (e) {
      this.events.emit('error', { source: 'loadBinary', message: String(e) });
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  // --- Lifting --------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Lift a binary to IR using a named (or default) lifter. */
  async lift(binaryPath: string, opts?: LiftOptions & { lifter?: string }): Promise<Result<LiftResult>> {
    try {
      const result = await this.lifters.lift(binaryPath, opts?.lifter, opts);
      this.events.emit('lift:completed', result);
      return ok(result);
    } catch (e) {
      this.events.emit('error', { source: 'lift', message: String(e) });
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  // --- Devirtualization -----------------------------------------------------

  /** Devirtualize a protected binary (auto-detect the protector if unspecified). */
  async devirt(
    binaryPath: string,
    opts?: DevirtOptions & { plugin?: string },
  ): Promise<Result<DevirtResult>> {
    try {
      this.events.emit('devirt:progress', { plugin: opts?.plugin ?? 'auto', percent: 0, message: 'starting' });
      const result = await this.devirtRegistry.run(binaryPath, opts?.plugin, opts);
      this.events.emit('devirt:completed', result);
      return ok(result);
    } catch (e) {
      this.events.emit('error', { source: 'devirt', message: String(e) });
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  // --- Analysis -------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Extract strings from a binary. */
  async getStrings(binaryPath: string): Promise<Result<ExtractedString[]>> {
    try {
      return ok(await this.analysis.getStrings(binaryPath));
    } catch (e) {
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  /** Recover the control-flow graph for a function. */
  async getCfg(binaryPath: string, functionAddr: string): Promise<Result<ControlFlowGraph>> {
    try {
      return ok(await this.analysis.getCfg(binaryPath, functionAddr));
    } catch (e) {
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  /** Find direct cross-references that target an address. */
  async getXrefs(binaryPath: string, addr: string): Promise<Result<CrossReference[]>> {
    try {
      return ok(await this.analysis.getXrefs(binaryPath, addr));
    } catch (e) {
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  /** Detect a commercial protector on a binary. */
  async detectProtector(binaryPath: string): Promise<Result<ProtectorDetection>> {
    try {
      return ok(await this.analysis.detectProtector(binaryPath));
    } catch (e) {
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  /** Run the full static-analysis pipeline and persist it in a project. */
  async analyze(binaryPath: string): Promise<Result<AnalysisReport>> {
    try {
      const binary = await this.loader.load(binaryPath);
      this.events.emit('binary:loaded', binary);

      const project = await this.projects.create(binary.path, binaryPath);
      const projectId = project.info.id;
      this.events.emit('analysis:started', { projectId, stage: 'analyze' });

      // Strings.
      this.events.emit('analysis:progress', { projectId, stage: 'strings', percent: 25 });
      const strings = await this.analysis.getStrings(binaryPath);
      project.db.insertStrings(strings);

      // Protector detection.
      this.events.emit('analysis:progress', { projectId, stage: 'protector', percent: 55 });
      const protector = await this.analysis.detectProtector(binaryPath);

      // Cross-references across executable sections (xrefs to each export).
      this.events.emit('analysis:progress', { projectId, stage: 'xrefs', percent: 80 });
      let xrefCount = 0;
      for (const exp of binary.exports) {
        const refs = await this.analysis.getXrefs(binaryPath, exp.address);
        if (refs.length) {
          project.db.insertXrefs(refs);
          xrefCount += refs.length;
        }
      }

      project.db.touch();
      this.events.emit('analysis:completed', { projectId, stage: 'analyze' });

      return ok({
        projectId,
        binary,
        stringCount: strings.length,
        xrefCount,
        protector,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      this.events.emit('error', { source: 'analyze', message: String(e) });
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  // --- VM -------------------------------------------------------------------

  async listVms(): Promise<Result<VmInfo[]>> {
    try {
      return ok(await this.vm.list());
    } catch (e) {
      return err(e);
    }
  }

  // --- Runtime analysis ----------------------------------------------------

  /** Run an automated runtime analysis session inside a hardened VM. */
  async runRuntimeAnalysis(config: RuntimeAnalysisConfig): Promise<Result<RuntimeAnalysisResult>> {
    try {
      return ok(await this.runtime.run(config));
    } catch (e) {
      this.events.emit('error', { source: 'runtimeAnalysis', message: String(e) });
      return err(e);
    }
  }
}

```

`packages/core/src/lifter/index.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Lifter registry. Holds the available lifters and selects one for a lift job.
 */

import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { ILifter, LiftOptions, LiftResult } from './types.js';
import { RevngLifter } from './revng.js';

const log = logger.child('lifter:registry');

export class LifterRegistry {
  private readonly lifters = new Map<string, ILifter>();

  constructor(lifters?: ILifter[]) {
    const defaults = lifters ?? [new RevngLifter()];
    for (const lifter of defaults) this.register(lifter.name, lifter);
  }

  register(name: string, lifter: ILifter): void {
    this.lifters.set(name, lifter);
    log.debug('registered lifter', { name });
  }

  get(name: string): ILifter | undefined {
    return this.lifters.get(name);
  }

  list(): string[] {
    return [...this.lifters.keys()];
  }

  /** Lift using a named lifter (default: the first registered). */
  async lift(binaryPath: string, lifterName?: string, options?: LiftOptions): Promise<LiftResult> {
    const name = lifterName ?? this.list()[0];
    if (!name) throw new Error('No lifters registered');
    const lifter = this.lifters.get(name);
    if (!lifter) throw new Error(`Unknown lifter: ${name}`);
    if (!(await lifter.isAvailable())) {
      throw new Error(`Lifter '${name}' is not available (tool not found on PATH?)`);
    }
    return lifter.lift(binaryPath, options);
  }
}

export * from './types.js';
export { RevngLifter } from './revng.js';
```

`packages/core/src/lifter/revng.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * revng lifter integration. Drives the `revng` CLI as a subprocess to lift a
 * binary to LLVM IR.
 *
 * @see https://github.com/revng/revng
 */

import { execa } from 'execa';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { ILifter, LiftOptions, LiftResult } from './types.js';

const log = logger.child('lifter:revng');

export interface RevngLifterConfig {
  /** Path to the revng executable. Defaults to `revng` on PATH. */
  binaryPath?: string;
}

export class RevngLifter implements ILifter {
  readonly name = 'revng';
  private readonly exe: string;

  constructor(config: RevngLifterConfig = {}) {
    this.exe = config.binaryPath ?? 'revng';
  }

  async isAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
    return (await this.findBinary()) !== undefined;
  }

  /** Locate the revng executable (configured path or PATH lookup). */
  async findBinary(): Promise<string | undefined> {
    try {
      await execa(this.exe, ['--version'], { timeout: 10_000 });
      return this.exe;
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  /** Return the revng version string, or undefined if unavailable. */
  async getVersion(): Promise<string | undefined> {
    try {
      const { stdout } = await execa(this.exe, ['--version'], { timeout: 10_000 });
      return stdout.trim().split(/\r?\n/)[0];
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  async lift(binaryPath: string, options: LiftOptions = {}): Promise<LiftResult> {
    const start = Date.now();
    const warnings: string[] = [];

    // revng pipeline: `revng lift <input> <output.ll>` (simplified).
    // TODO: use `revng artifact` / pipeline manager for finer control and to
    // collect per-function metadata instead of a single IR blob.
    const output = options.outputPath ?? `${binaryPath}.ll`;
    const args = ['lift', binaryPath, output, ...(options.extraArgs ?? [])];

    log.debug('invoking revng', { exe: this.exe, args });

    try {
      const result = await execa(this.exe, args, {
        timeout: options.timeoutMs ?? 300_000,
      });
      if (result.stderr) warnings.push(result.stderr);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(`revng lift failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
    }

    return {
      tool: this.name,
      irFormat: 'llvm-ir',
      irPath: output,
      // TODO: parse revng output/model to count lifted functions.
      functionsLifted: 0,
      durationMs: Date.now() - start,
      warnings,
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * IR / lifter types for the core engine.

import type { LiftResult } from '@revenant/shared';

export type { LiftResult };

/** Options controlling a lift operation. */
export interface LiftOptions {
  /** Output path for the generated IR. If omitted, IR is returned in-memory. */
  outputPath?: string;
  /** Limit lifting to a specific set of function addresses. */
  functions?: string[];
  /** Pass extra flags directly to the underlying lifter tool. */
  extraArgs?: string[];
  /** Timeout for the lifter subprocess, in milliseconds. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

/** A lifter drives a native tool to produce IR from a binary. */
export interface ILifter {
  readonly name: string;
  /** Is the backing native tool available on this machine? */
  isAvailable(): Promise<boolean>;
  /** Lift the binary at `binaryPath` to IR. */
  lift(binaryPath: string, options?: LiftOptions): Promise<LiftResult>;
}
```

`packages/core/src/project/database.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * SQLite-backed project database (better-sqlite3).
 *
 * One database file per project holds project metadata, discovered functions,
 * extracted strings, cross-references, user annotations, and devirtualization
 * results. A tiny migration system (keyed on `PRAGMA user_version`) keeps the
 * schema forward-compatible.
 */

import Database from 'better-sqlite3';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type {
  CrossReference,
  DevirtResult,
  ExtractedString,
  ProjectInfo,
} from '@revenant/shared';

const log = logger.child('project:db');

/** Ordered migrations. Index + 1 is the resulting `user_version`. */
const MIGRATIONS: string[] = [
  // v1 — initial schema.
  `
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS functions (
    address TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name    TEXT,
    size    INTEGER,
    block_count INTEGER
  );

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS strings (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    address  TEXT NOT NULL,
    value    TEXT NOT NULL,
    encoding TEXT NOT NULL,
    section  TEXT
  );
  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_strings_value ON strings(value);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS xrefs (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    from_addr TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_addr   TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind      TEXT NOT NULL
  );
  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_xrefs_from ON xrefs(from_addr);
  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_xrefs_to   ON xrefs(to_addr);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS annotations (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    address    TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind       TEXT NOT NULL,
    text       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  );
  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_annotations_addr ON annotations(address);

  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS devirt_results (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    plugin     TEXT NOT NULL,
    protector  TEXT NOT NULL,
    success    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    json       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  );
  `,
];

export interface FunctionRow {
  address: string;
  name?: string;
  size?: number;
  blockCount?: number;
}

export interface AnnotationRow {
  address: string;
  kind: string;
  text: string;
}

export class ProjectDatabase {
  private readonly db: Database.Database;

  constructor(path: string) {
    this.db = new Database(path);
    this.db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');
    this.migrate();
    log.debug('opened project database', { path });
  }

  // -- Migrations ------------------------------------------------------------

  private migrate(): void {
    const row = this.db.pragma('user_version', { simple: true });
    const current = typeof row === 'number' ? row : 0;
    for (let v = current; v < MIGRATIONS.length; v++) {
      const sql = MIGRATIONS[v]!;
      this.db.exec(sql);
      this.db.pragma(`user_version = ${v + 1}`);
      log.info('applied migration', { version: v + 1 });
    }
  }

  // -- Project metadata ------------------------------------------------------

  setInfo(info: ProjectInfo): void {
    const entries: Array<[string, string]> = [
      ['id', info.id],
      ['name', info.name],
      ['binaryPath', info.binaryPath],
      ['binaryHash', info.binaryHash],
      ['createdAt', info.createdAt],
      ['updatedAt', info.updatedAt],
      ['databasePath', info.databasePath],
    ];
    const stmt = this.db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO project(key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value',
    );
    const tx = this.db.transaction((rows: Array<[string, string]>) => {
      for (const [k, val] of rows) stmt.run(k, val);
    });
    tx(entries);
  }

  getInfo(): ProjectInfo | undefined {
    const rows = this.db.prepare('SELECT key, value FROM project').all() as Array<{
      key: string;
      value: string;
    }>;
    if (rows.length === 0) return undefined;
    const map = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.key, r.value]));
    const id = map.get('id');
    if (!id) return undefined;
    return {
      id,
      name: map.get('name') ?? '',
      binaryPath: map.get('binaryPath') ?? '',
      binaryHash: map.get('binaryHash') ?? '',
      createdAt: map.get('createdAt') ?? '',
      updatedAt: map.get('updatedAt') ?? '',
      databasePath: map.get('databasePath') ?? '',
    };
  }

  touch(): void {
    this.db
      .prepare(
        'INSERT INTO project(key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value',
      )
      .run('updatedAt', new Date().toISOString());
  }

  // -- Functions -------------------------------------------------------------

  upsertFunction(fn: FunctionRow): void {
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO functions(address, name, size, block_count) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(address) DO UPDATE SET
           name = excluded.name, size = excluded.size, block_count = excluded.block_count`,
      )
      .run(fn.address, fn.name ?? null, fn.size ?? null, fn.blockCount ?? null);
  }

  listFunctions(): FunctionRow[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare('SELECT address, name, size, block_count FROM functions ORDER BY address')
      .all() as Array<{ address: string; name: string | null; size: number | null; block_count: number | null }>;
    return rows.map((r) => ({
      address: r.address,
      name: r.name ?? undefined,
      size: r.size ?? undefined,
      blockCount: r.block_count ?? undefined,
    }));
  }

  // -- Strings ---------------------------------------------------------------

  insertStrings(strings: ExtractedString[]): void {
    const stmt = this.db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO strings(address, value, encoding, section) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
    );
    const tx = this.db.transaction((items: ExtractedString[]) => {
      for (const s of items) stmt.run(s.address, s.value, s.encoding, s.section ?? null);
    });
    tx(strings);
  }

  listStrings(limit = 1000): ExtractedString[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare('SELECT address, value, encoding, section FROM strings LIMIT ?')
      .all(limit) as Array<{
      address: string;
      value: string;
      encoding: ExtractedString['encoding'];
      section: string | null;
    }>;
    return rows.map((r) => ({
      address: r.address,
      value: r.value,
      encoding: r.encoding,
      section: r.section ?? undefined,
    }));
  }

  // -- Xrefs -----------------------------------------------------------------

  insertXrefs(xrefs: CrossReference[]): void {
    const stmt = this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO xrefs(from_addr, to_addr, kind) VALUES (?, ?, ?)');
    const tx = this.db.transaction((items: CrossReference[]) => {
      for (const x of items) stmt.run(x.from, x.to, x.kind);
    });
    tx(xrefs);
  }

  xrefsTo(address: string): CrossReference[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare('SELECT from_addr, to_addr, kind FROM xrefs WHERE to_addr = ?')
      .all(address) as Array<{ from_addr: string; to_addr: string; kind: CrossReference['kind'] }>;
    return rows.map((r) => ({ from: r.from_addr, to: r.to_addr, kind: r.kind }));
  }

  // -- Annotations -----------------------------------------------------------

  addAnnotation(ann: AnnotationRow): void {
    this.db
      .prepare('INSERT INTO annotations(address, kind, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?)')
      .run(ann.address, ann.kind, ann.text);
  }

  annotationsAt(address: string): AnnotationRow[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare('SELECT address, kind, text FROM annotations WHERE address = ? ORDER BY id')
      .all(address) as Array<{ address: string; kind: string; text: string }>;
    return rows;
  }

  // -- Devirt results --------------------------------------------------------

  saveDevirtResult(result: DevirtResult): void {
    this.db
      .prepare(
        'INSERT INTO devirt_results(plugin, protector, success, json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
      )
      .run(result.plugin, result.protector, result.success ? 1 : 0, JSON.stringify(result));
  }

  listDevirtResults(): DevirtResult[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare('SELECT json FROM devirt_results ORDER BY id DESC')
      .all() as Array<{ json: string }>;
    return rows.map((r) => JSON.parse(r.json) as DevirtResult);
  }

  close(): void {
    this.db.close();
  }
}
```

`packages/core/src/project/project.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Project / session management.
 *
 * A project pins one target binary and owns its analysis database. Projects are
 * stored under a root directory, one folder per project (named by its id), each
 * containing a `project.sqlite`.
 */

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, readFile, readdir, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { ProjectInfo } from '@revenant/shared';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import { ProjectDatabase } from './database.js';

const log = logger.child('project');

export interface ProjectManagerConfig {
  /** Root directory holding all projects. Defaults to ~/.revenant/projects. */
  root?: string;
}

/** A live project: its metadata plus an open database handle. */
export interface OpenProject {
  info: ProjectInfo;
  db: ProjectDatabase;
}

export class ProjectManager {
  private readonly root: string;
  private readonly openProjects = new Map<string, OpenProject>();

  constructor(config: ProjectManagerConfig = {}) {
    this.root = config.root ?? join(homedir(), '.revenant', 'projects');
  }

  /** Create a new project for a binary and open it. */
  async create(name: string, binaryPath: string): Promise<OpenProject> {
    const id = randomUUID();
    const dir = join(this.root, id);
    await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });

    const databasePath = join(dir, 'project.sqlite');
    const hash = await this.hashFile(binaryPath);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const info: ProjectInfo = {
      id,
      name: name || basename(binaryPath),
      binaryPath,
      binaryHash: hash,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      databasePath,
    };

    const db = new ProjectDatabase(databasePath);
    db.setInfo(info);

    const project: OpenProject = { info, db };
    this.openProjects.set(id, project);
    log.info('created project', { id, name: info.name });
    return project;
  }

  /** Open an existing project by id. */
  async open(id: string): Promise<OpenProject> {
    const existing = this.openProjects.get(id);
    if (existing) return existing;

    const databasePath = join(this.root, id, 'project.sqlite');
    const db = new ProjectDatabase(databasePath);
    const info = db.getInfo();
    if (!info) {
      db.close();
      throw new Error(`Project '${id}' has no metadata`);
    }
    const project: OpenProject = { info, db };
    this.openProjects.set(id, project);
    log.info('opened project', { id, name: info.name });
    return project;
  }

  /** Close a project and release its database handle. */
  close(id: string): void {
    const project = this.openProjects.get(id);
    if (!project) return;
    project.db.touch();
    project.db.close();
    this.openProjects.delete(id);
    log.info('closed project', { id });
  }

  /** Get an already-open project without touching disk. */
  get(id: string): OpenProject | undefined {
    return this.openProjects.get(id);
  }

  /** List all projects found under the root directory. */
  async list(): Promise<ProjectInfo[]> {
    let entries: string[];
    try {
      entries = await readdir(this.root);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }

    const out: ProjectInfo[] = [];
    for (const id of entries) {
      const cached = this.openProjects.get(id);
      if (cached) {
        out.push(cached.info);
        continue;
      }
      try {
        const db = new ProjectDatabase(join(this.root, id, 'project.sqlite'));
        const info = db.getInfo();
        db.close();
        if (info) out.push(info);
      } catch {
        // Not a valid project directory; skip.
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Delete a project and all of its data. */
  async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
    this.close(id);
    await rm(join(this.root, id), { recursive: true, force: true });
    log.info('deleted project', { id });
  }

  private async hashFile(path: string): Promise<string> {
    const bytes = await readFile(path);
    return createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
  }
}
```

`packages/core/src/vm/agent.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Guest agent client.
 *
 * Talks to the REVENANT agent running inside the VM over a newline-delimited
 * JSON-RPC 2.0 channel on TCP. The agent exposes command execution, file
 * transfer, driver loading, and process inspection so the host can drive dynamic
 * analysis without VM-vendor tooling that would fingerprint the sandbox.
 */

import { Socket } from 'node:net';
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { GuestCommand, GuestCommandResult } from './types.js';

const log = logger.child('vm:agent');

interface JsonRpcRequest {
  jsonrpc: '2.0';
  id: number;
  method: string;
  params?: unknown;
}

interface JsonRpcResponse {
  jsonrpc: '2.0';
  id: number;
  result?: unknown;
  error?: { code: number; message: string };
}

export interface GuestProcessInfo {
  pid: number;
  name: string;
  ppid?: number;
  path?: string;
}

export class GuestAgent {
  private socket?: Socket;
  private buffer = '';
  private nextId = 1;
  private readonly pending = new Map<number, (res: JsonRpcResponse) => void>();

  /** Open a TCP connection to the in-guest agent. */
  async connect(host: string, port: number, timeoutMs = 15_000): Promise<void> {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const socket = new Socket();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        socket.destroy();
        reject(new Error(`Guest agent connect timed out (${host}:${port})`));
      }, timeoutMs);

      socket.once('error', (err) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(err);
      });
      socket.connect(port, host, () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        this.socket = socket;
        socket.on('data', (chunk) => this.onData(chunk));
        socket.on('close', () => this.failPending('guest agent connection closed'));
        resolve();
      });
    });
    log.debug('connected to guest agent', { host, port });
  }

  private onData(chunk: Buffer): void {
    this.buffer += chunk.toString('utf8');
    let nl: number;
    while ((nl = this.buffer.indexOf('\n')) !== -1) {
      const line = this.buffer.slice(0, nl).trim();
      this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(nl + 1);
      if (!line) continue;
      let msg: JsonRpcResponse;
      try {
        msg = JSON.parse(line) as JsonRpcResponse;
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      const resolver = this.pending.get(msg.id);
      if (resolver) {
        this.pending.delete(msg.id);
        resolver(msg);
      }
    }
  }

  private failPending(reason: string): void {
    for (const resolver of this.pending.values()) {
      resolver({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: -1, error: { code: -1, message: reason } });
    }
    this.pending.clear();
  }

  /** Issue a JSON-RPC call and await its result. */
  private async call<T>(method: string, params?: unknown, timeoutMs = 60_000): Promise<T> {
    if (!this.socket) throw new Error('Guest agent is not connected');
    const id = this.nextId++;
    const request: JsonRpcRequest = { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method, params };

    const response = await new Promise<JsonRpcResponse>((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.pending.delete(id);
        reject(new Error(`Guest RPC '${method}' timed out`));
      }, timeoutMs);
      this.pending.set(id, (res) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(res);
      });
      this.socket!.write(`${JSON.stringify(request)}\n`);
    });

    if (response.error) {
      throw new Error(`Guest RPC '${method}' failed: ${response.error.message}`);
    }
    return response.result as T;
  }

  /** Run a command inside the guest and capture its output. */
  async execute(command: GuestCommand): Promise<GuestCommandResult> {
    return this.call<GuestCommandResult>(
      'exec',
      { command: command.command, args: command.args ?? [] },
      command.timeoutMs ?? 120_000,
    );
  }

  /** Upload a file from the host into the guest (base64 over the channel). */
  async uploadFile(localPath: string, remotePath: string): Promise<void> {
    const data = await readFile(localPath);
    await this.call<void>(
      'writeFile',
      { path: remotePath, dataBase64: data.toString('base64') },
      300_000,
    );
    log.debug('uploaded file', { localPath, remotePath, bytes: data.length });
  }

  /** Download a file from the guest to the host. */
  async downloadFile(remotePath: string, localPath: string): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.call<{ dataBase64: string }>(
      'readFile',
      { path: remotePath },
      300_000,
    );
    await writeFile(localPath, Buffer.from(result.dataBase64, 'base64'));
    log.debug('downloaded file', { remotePath, localPath });
  }

  /** Load a kernel driver inside the guest. */
  async loadDriver(driverPath: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.call<void>('loadDriver', { path: driverPath }, 120_000);
  }

  /** Begin monitoring a process (the agent streams/collects events for it). */
  async monitorProcess(pid: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.call<void>('monitorProcess', { pid });
  }

  /** List processes currently running in the guest. */
  async getProcessList(): Promise<GuestProcessInfo[]> {
    return this.call<GuestProcessInfo[]>('listProcesses');
  }

  /** Health check. */
  async ping(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await this.call<unknown>('ping', undefined, 5_000);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  close(): void {
    this.socket?.destroy();
    this.socket = undefined;
    this.failPending('guest agent closed');
  }
}
```

`packages/core/src/vm/hardening.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * QEMU anti-detection hardening.
 *
 * `VmHardening.buildQemuArgs()` assembles a `qemu-system-x86_64` command line
 * engineered to defeat every category VMAware and comparable detectors probe:
 * CPUID/hypervisor leaves, SMBIOS/DMI strings, ACPI OEM signatures, NIC OUI,
 * disk identity, firmware strings, timing sources, and display adapter.
 *
 * In-guest giveaways (QEMU guest-agent service, virtio driver fingerprints,
 * tell-tale registry keys) are handled separately by the GuestAgent.
 */

import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { HardeningOptions, SpoofedIdentity } from './types.js';

/**
 * MAC OUI prefixes that give away common hypervisors. Generated MACs avoid
 * these and instead use a real, mundane vendor OUI.
 */
const VM_MAC_PREFIXES = [
  '08:00:27', // VirtualBox
  '00:0c:29', // VMware
  '00:05:69', // VMware
  '00:1c:14', // VMware
  '00:50:56', // VMware
  '52:54:00', // QEMU/KVM default
  '00:16:3e', // Xen
  '00:15:5d', // Hyper-V
];

/** Real, unremarkable vendor OUIs used when synthesizing a MAC. */
const REAL_OUIS = [
  'd8:5e:d3', // ASUSTek
  '1c:1b:0d', // Gigabyte
  '04:d9:f5', // ASUSTek
  '40:b0:76', // ASUSTek
  '00:1a:a0', // Dell
  'b0:6e:bf', // ASUSTek
];

/** Plausible consumer disk models for disk-identity spoofing. */
const DISK_MODELS = [
  'Samsung SSD 970 EVO Plus 1TB',
  'Samsung SSD 860 EVO 500GB',
  'WDC WDS100T2B0A-00SM50',
  'CT1000MX500SSD1',
  'Seagate ST2000DM008-2FR102',
];

export class VmHardening {
  /** Build the complete, hardened QEMU argument vector. */
  buildQemuArgs(opts: HardeningOptions): string[] {
    const identity = opts.identity ?? this.generateIdentity();
    const args: string[] = [];

    // --- Machine + accelerator ---------------------------------------------
    // Q35 chipset looks like a modern consumer board. WHPX on Windows hosts,
    // TCG otherwise. kernel-irqchip=off avoids one more KVM/accel tell.
    const accel = opts.whpx === false ? 'tcg' : 'whpx,kernel-irqchip=off';
    args.push('-machine', `type=q35,accel=${accel}`);

    // --- CPU: host passthrough with the hypervisor bit masked --------------
    // kvm=off removes the KVM signature leaf; Hyper-V enlightenments present a
    // consistent "real Windows on real hardware" profile; hv-vendor-id is set to
    // a mundane value and the +hypervisor feature is removed entirely.
    args.push(
      '-cpu',
      [
        'host',
        'hv-vendor-id=AuthenticAMD',
        'kvm=off',
        'hv-time=on',
        'hv-relaxed=on',
        'hv-vapic=on',
        'hv-spinlocks=0x1fff',
        '-hypervisor',
      ].join(','),
    );

    args.push('-smp', String(opts.cpuCount));
    args.push('-m', String(opts.memoryMb));

    // --- SMBIOS / DMI spoofing ---------------------------------------------
    args.push(
      '-smbios',
      `type=0,vendor=${identity.biosVendor},version=${identity.biosVersion},date=${identity.biosDate}`,
    );
    args.push(
      '-smbios',
      `type=1,manufacturer=${identity.manufacturer},product=${identity.product},` +
        `serial=${identity.systemSerial},uuid=${identity.systemUuid}`,
    );
    args.push(
      '-smbios',
      `type=2,manufacturer=${identity.boardManufacturer},product=${identity.product}`,
    );
    args.push('-smbios', `type=3,manufacturer=${identity.manufacturer}`);
    args.push('-smbios', `type=4,manufacturer=${identity.cpuManufacturer}`);

    // --- ACPI OEM signatures (no QEMU/BOCHS/VBOX) --------------------------
    args.push('-acpitable', 'sig=RSDT,oem_id=ALASKA,oem_table_id=A M I');

    // --- System UUID at the top level (matches SMBIOS type 1) --------------
    args.push('-uuid', identity.systemUuid);

    // --- Network: real-vendor NIC + non-VM MAC -----------------------------
    args.push('-netdev', 'user,id=net0');
    args.push('-device', `e1000,netdev=net0,mac=${identity.mac}`);

    // --- Disk: realistic serial + model string -----------------------------
    args.push('-drive', `file=${opts.diskPath},if=none,id=drive0,format=qcow2`);
    args.push(
      '-device',
      `ide-hd,drive=drive0,serial=${identity.diskSerial},model=${identity.diskModel}`,
    );

    // --- Firmware: patched OVMF (no QEMU/BOCHS strings) when provided -------
    if (opts.ovmfPath) {
      args.push('-bios', opts.ovmfPath);
    }

    // --- Timing: host TSC/RTC, no obvious kvm-clock giveaway ----------------
    args.push('-rtc', 'base=localtime,clock=host');

    // --- Display: standard VGA (not virtio-vga/qxl which guests fingerprint)-
    args.push('-vga', 'std');
    args.push('-display', opts.headless ? 'none' : 'sdl');

    // --- VNC: always available so the user can pop out a window any time ---
    if (opts.vncDisplay !== undefined) {
      args.push('-vnc', `localhost:${opts.vncDisplay}`);
    }

    // --- Control channel: QMP over TCP -------------------------------------
    args.push('-qmp', `tcp:127.0.0.1:${opts.qmpPort},server=on,wait=off`);

    if (opts.extraArgs?.length) args.push(...opts.extraArgs);

    return args;
  }

  /** Generate a complete spoofed hardware identity. */
  generateIdentity(): SpoofedIdentity {
    return {
      manufacturer: 'ASUS',
      product: 'PRIME B550-PLUS',
      biosVendor: 'American Megatrends Inc.',
      biosVersion: 'F15',
      biosDate: '04/25/2024',
      boardManufacturer: 'ASUSTeK COMPUTER INC.',
      cpuManufacturer: 'Advanced Micro Devices',
      systemSerial: this.generateSerial(),
      systemUuid: this.generateUuid(),
      mac: this.generateMac(),
      diskSerial: this.generateSerial(),
      diskModel: DISK_MODELS[randomBytes(1)[0]! % DISK_MODELS.length]!,
    };
  }

  /** Generate a MAC with a real vendor OUI (never a hypervisor prefix). */
  generateMac(): string {
    const oui = REAL_OUIS[randomBytes(1)[0]! % REAL_OUIS.length]!;
    const tail = randomBytes(3);
    const mac = `${oui}:${this.hex(tail[0]!)}:${this.hex(tail[1]!)}:${this.hex(tail[2]!)}`;
    // Defensive: if anything ever collides with a known VM prefix, retry.
    if (VM_MAC_PREFIXES.some((p) => mac.startsWith(p))) return this.generateMac();
    return mac;
  }

  /** Generate a realistic-looking alphanumeric hardware serial. */
  generateSerial(): string {
    const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';
    const bytes = randomBytes(12);
    let out = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) out += alphabet[bytes[i]! % alphabet.length];
    return out;
  }

  /** Generate a random SMBIOS/system UUID. */
  generateUuid(): string {
    return randomUUID();
  }

  private hex(byte: number): string {
    return byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  }
}
```
