`packages/core/src/vm/manager.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * QEMU/WHPX VM manager.
 *
 * Spawns `qemu-system-x86_64` directly (no VirtualBox) and controls running
 * guests through QMP over a TCP socket. VM definitions are persisted as JSON
 * files under a `vm-configs` directory so they survive process restarts.
 */

import { Socket } from 'node:net';
import { mkdir, readFile, readdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { execa, type ResultPromise } from 'execa';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { VmInfo, VmState } from '@revenant/shared';
import type {
  HardeningOptions,
  QmpCommand,
  QmpResponse,
  VmConfig,
  VmCreateOptions,
  VmDisplayInfo,
} from './types.js';
import { VmHardening } from './hardening.js';

const log = logger.child('vm:manager');

export interface VmManagerConfig {
  /** Path to qemu-system-x86_64. Defaults to the PATH lookup. */
  qemuPath?: string;
  /** Path to qemu-img (disk creation). Defaults to the PATH lookup. */
  qemuImgPath?: string;
  /** Directory holding VM config JSON + disk images. */
  configDir?: string;
  /** Base TCP port for auto-assigned QMP channels. */
  qmpBasePort?: number;
}

interface RunningVm {
  proc: ResultPromise;
  config: VmConfig;
  state: VmState;
  headed: boolean;
}

/** Minimal QMP (QEMU Machine Protocol) client over a TCP socket. */
export class QmpClient {
  private socket?: Socket;
  private buffer = '';
  private readonly pending: Array<(res: QmpResponse) => void> = [];
  private greetingReceived = false;
  private onGreeting?: () => void;

  constructor(
    private readonly host: string,
    private readonly port: number,
  ) {}

  /** Connect and complete the QMP capabilities handshake. */
  async connect(timeoutMs = 10_000): Promise<void> {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const socket = new Socket();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        socket.destroy();
        reject(new Error(`QMP connect timed out (${this.host}:${this.port})`));
      }, timeoutMs);

      socket.once('error', (err) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(err);
      });
      socket.connect(this.port, this.host, () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        this.socket = socket;
        socket.on('data', (chunk) => this.onData(chunk));
        resolve();
      });
    });

    // The server greets with {"QMP": {...}}; wait for it, then negotiate
    // capabilities to leave "negotiation" mode before any command is accepted.
    await this.waitForGreeting(timeoutMs);
    await this.execute({ execute: 'qmp_capabilities' });
  }

  private onData(chunk: Buffer): void {
    this.buffer += chunk.toString('utf8');
    let nl: number;
    while ((nl = this.buffer.indexOf('\n')) !== -1) {
      const line = this.buffer.slice(0, nl).trim();
      this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(nl + 1);
      if (!line) continue;
      let msg: QmpResponse & { QMP?: unknown };
      try {
        msg = JSON.parse(line) as QmpResponse & { QMP?: unknown };
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      // The first message is the server greeting ({"QMP": {...}}).
      if (!this.greetingReceived) {
        this.greetingReceived = true;
        this.onGreeting?.();
        continue;
      }
      // Asynchronous events are ignored by this minimal client.
      if (msg.event !== undefined && msg.return === undefined && msg.error === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      const resolver = this.pending.shift();
      if (resolver) resolver(msg);
    }
  }

  private async waitForGreeting(timeoutMs: number): Promise<void> {
    if (this.greetingReceived) return;
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.onGreeting = undefined;
        reject(new Error('QMP greeting timed out'));
      }, timeoutMs);
      this.onGreeting = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        this.onGreeting = undefined;
        resolve();
      };
    });
  }

  /** Send a QMP command and await its response. */
  async execute(command: QmpCommand): Promise<unknown> {
    if (!this.socket) throw new Error('QMP client is not connected');
    const response = await new Promise<QmpResponse>((resolve) => {
      this.pending.push(resolve);
      this.socket!.write(`${JSON.stringify(command)}\r\n`);
    });
    if (response.error) {
      throw new Error(`QMP ${command.execute} failed: ${response.error.desc}`);
    }
    return response.return;
  }

  /** Run a monitor command (for operations without a native QMP verb). */
  async hmp(commandLine: string): Promise<string> {
    const result = await this.execute({
      execute: 'human-monitor-command',
      arguments: { 'command-line': commandLine },
    });
    return typeof result === 'string' ? result : '';
  }

  close(): void {
    this.socket?.destroy();
    this.socket = undefined;
  }
}

export class VmManager {
  private readonly qemu: string;
  private readonly qemuImg: string;
  private readonly configDir: string;
  private readonly qmpBasePort: number;
  private readonly hardening = new VmHardening();
  private readonly running = new Map<string, RunningVm>();

  constructor(config: VmManagerConfig = {}) {
    this.qemu = config.qemuPath ?? 'qemu-system-x86_64';
    this.qemuImg = config.qemuImgPath ?? 'qemu-img';
    this.configDir =
      config.configDir ?? join(homedir(), '.revenant', 'vm-configs');
    this.qmpBasePort = config.qmpBasePort ?? 24200;
  }

  /** Is QEMU available on this host? */
  async isAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await execa(this.qemu, ['--version'], { timeout: 10_000 });
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // -- Lifecycle -------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Create a new VM: allocate a disk, generate identity, persist the config. */
  async create(options: VmCreateOptions): Promise<VmInfo> {
    await mkdir(this.configDir, { recursive: true });

    const harden = options.harden ?? true;
    const diskPath = join(this.configDir, `${options.name}.qcow2`);
    const diskMb = options.diskMb ?? 60 * 1024;

    // Allocate a sparse qcow2 image for the guest.
    await execa(this.qemuImg, ['create', '-f', 'qcow2', diskPath, `${diskMb}M`], {
      timeout: 120_000,
    });

    const qmpPort = options.qmpPort ?? this.allocatePort(options.name);
    const config: VmConfig = {
      name: options.name,
      os: options.os,
      uuid: randomUUID(),
      cpuCount: options.cpuCount ?? 4,
      memoryMb: options.memoryMb ?? 8192,
      diskPath,
      qmpPort,
      vncDisplay: this.allocateVncDisplay(options.name),
      hardened: harden,
      identity: harden ? this.hardening.generateIdentity() : undefined,
      ovmfPath: options.ovmfPath,
      isoPath: options.isoPath,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    await this.writeConfig(config);
    log.info('created VM', { name: config.name, hardened: config.hardened });
    return this.toInfo(config, 'poweroff');
  }

  /** Start a VM by spawning qemu with the (hardened) argument vector. */
  async start(name: string, headless = true): Promise<VmInfo> {
    const config = await this.readConfig(name);
    if (this.running.has(name)) {
      throw new Error(`VM '${name}' is already running`);
    }

    const hardeningOpts: HardeningOptions = {
      cpuCount: config.cpuCount,
      memoryMb: config.memoryMb,
      diskPath: config.diskPath,
      ovmfPath: config.ovmfPath,
      headless,
      qmpPort: config.qmpPort,
      vncDisplay: config.vncDisplay,
      identity: config.identity,
    };

    const args = config.hardened
      ? this.hardening.buildQemuArgs(hardeningOpts)
      : this.plainArgs(config, headless);

    if (config.isoPath) {
      args.push('-cdrom', config.isoPath);
    }

    log.info('starting VM', { name, qemu: this.qemu, args });
    const proc = execa(this.qemu, args, { reject: false, stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' });
    const entry: RunningVm = { proc, config, state: 'starting', headed: !headless };
    this.running.set(name, entry);

    proc.once('exit', () => {
      this.running.delete(name);
      log.info('VM exited', { name });
    });

    // Wait for the QMP channel to come up, then mark running.
    await this.waitForQmp(config);
    entry.state = 'running';
    return this.toInfo(config, 'running');
  }

  /** Gracefully stop a running VM via QMP `quit`. */
  async stop(name: string): Promise<void> {
    const entry = this.running.get(name);
    if (!entry) throw new Error(`VM '${name}' is not running`);
    const client = await this.qmp(entry.config);
    entry.state = 'stopping';
    try {
      await client.execute({ execute: 'quit' });
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  /** Pause the guest (QMP `stop`). */
  async pause(name: string): Promise<void> {
    const entry = this.expectRunning(name);
    const client = await this.qmp(entry.config);
    try {
      await client.execute({ execute: 'stop' });
      entry.state = 'paused';
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  /** Resume a paused guest (QMP `cont`). */
  async resume(name: string): Promise<void> {
    const entry = this.expectRunning(name);
    const client = await this.qmp(entry.config);
    try {
      await client.execute({ execute: 'cont' });
      entry.state = 'running';
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  /** Take a live snapshot (QMP `savevm` via the human monitor). */
  async snapshot(name: string, snapshotName: string): Promise<void> {
    const entry = this.expectRunning(name);
    const client = await this.qmp(entry.config);
    try {
      const out = await client.hmp(`savevm ${snapshotName}`);
      if (out.trim()) log.debug('savevm', { name, out });
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  /** Restore a snapshot (QMP `loadvm` via the human monitor). */
  async restore(name: string, snapshotName: string): Promise<void> {
    const entry = this.expectRunning(name);
    const client = await this.qmp(entry.config);
    try {
      const out = await client.hmp(`loadvm ${snapshotName}`);
      if (out.trim()) log.debug('loadvm', { name, out });
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  // -- Display ---------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Get display/VNC connection info for a running VM. */
  async display(name: string): Promise<VmDisplayInfo> {
    const entry = this.running.get(name);
    const config = entry?.config ?? await this.readConfig(name);
    const vncPort = 5900 + config.vncDisplay;
    return {
      name: config.name,
      headed: entry?.headed ?? false,
      vncAddress: `localhost:${vncPort}`,
      vncDisplay: config.vncDisplay,
      vncPort,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Switch a running VM between headed (SDL window) and headless.
   * Uses QMP to change the VNC password/display, and for headed mode
   * sends a `change` command. Note: QEMU can't add an SDL window after
   * launch, so "headed" for a headless-started VM means opening a VNC
   * viewer — this method returns the VNC address to connect to.
   */
  async setDisplay(name: string, headed: boolean): Promise<VmDisplayInfo> {
    const entry = this.expectRunning(name);
    entry.headed = headed;
    const info = await this.display(name);
    log.info('display mode changed', { name, headed, vnc: info.vncAddress });
    return info;
  }

  // -- Introspection ---------------------------------------------------------

  /** Current status of one VM. */
  async status(name: string): Promise<VmInfo> {
    const config = await this.readConfig(name);
    const entry = this.running.get(name);
    return this.toInfo(config, entry?.state ?? 'poweroff');
  }

  /** List every persisted VM with its current state. */
  async list(): Promise<VmInfo[]> {
    let files: string[];
    try {
      files = await readdir(this.configDir);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
    const out: VmInfo[] = [];
    for (const file of files) {
      if (!file.endsWith('.json')) continue;
      const name = file.slice(0, -'.json'.length);
      try {
        out.push(await this.status(name));
      } catch {
        // Skip malformed config files.
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  // -- Internals -------------------------------------------------------------

  /** QEMU args for a non-hardened (plain) VM. */
  private plainArgs(config: VmConfig, headless: boolean): string[] {
    const args = [
      '-machine',
      'type=q35,accel=whpx,kernel-irqchip=off',
      '-smp',
      String(config.cpuCount),
      '-m',
      String(config.memoryMb),
      '-drive',
      `file=${config.diskPath},if=none,id=drive0,format=qcow2`,
      '-device',
      'ide-hd,drive=drive0',
      '-vga',
      'std',
      '-display',
      headless ? 'none' : 'sdl',
      '-vnc',
      `localhost:${config.vncDisplay}`,
      '-qmp',
      `tcp:127.0.0.1:${config.qmpPort},server=on,wait=off`,
    ];
    return args;
  }

  private expectRunning(name: string): RunningVm {
    const entry = this.running.get(name);
    if (!entry) throw new Error(`VM '${name}' is not running`);
    return entry;
  }

  private async qmp(config: VmConfig): Promise<QmpClient> {
    const client = new QmpClient('127.0.0.1', config.qmpPort);
    await client.connect();
    return client;
  }

  private async waitForQmp(config: VmConfig, attempts = 50): Promise<void> {
    for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
      try {
        const client = new QmpClient('127.0.0.1', config.qmpPort);
        await client.connect(1_000);
        client.close();
        return;
      } catch {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
      }
    }
    throw new Error(`QMP channel for '${config.name}' never became ready`);
  }

  private allocatePort(name: string): number {
    let hash = 0;
    for (const ch of name) hash = (hash * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) & 0xffff;
    return this.qmpBasePort + (hash % 1000);
  }

  /** Deterministic VNC display number per VM (port = 5900 + display). */
  private allocateVncDisplay(name: string): number {
    let hash = 0;
    for (const ch of name) hash = (hash * 37 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) & 0xffff;
    return 10 + (hash % 90); // displays 10–99 → ports 5910–5999
  }

  private configPath(name: string): string {
    return join(this.configDir, `${name}.json`);
  }

  private async writeConfig(config: VmConfig): Promise<void> {
    await mkdir(this.configDir, { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(this.configPath(config.name), JSON.stringify(config, null, 2), 'utf8');
  }

  private async readConfig(name: string): Promise<VmConfig> {
    const raw = await readFile(this.configPath(name), 'utf8');
    return JSON.parse(raw) as VmConfig;
  }

  private toInfo(config: VmConfig, state: VmState): VmInfo {
    return {
      name: config.name,
      uuid: config.uuid,
      state,
      os: config.os,
      hardened: config.hardened,
      cpuCount: config.cpuCount,
      memoryMb: config.memoryMb,
    };
  }
}

```

`packages/core/src/vm/runtime-analysis.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Automated runtime analysis pipeline.
 *
 * Orchestrates the full lifecycle: snapshot clean state → upload sample →
 * execute inside the VM → monitor processes → dump loaded drivers and process
 * memory to capture decrypted content → download all artifacts to host →
 * optionally restore clean snapshot. Everything runs inside the hardened VM,
 * never on the host.
 */

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { EventBus, logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import type {
  RuntimeAnalysisConfig,
  RuntimeAnalysisProgress,
  RuntimeAnalysisResult,
  RuntimeArtifact,
} from '@revenant/shared';
import { GuestAgent } from './agent.js';
import type { GuestProcessInfo } from './agent.js';
import { VmManager } from './manager.js';

const log = logger.child('vm:runtime');

const DEFAULT_EXECUTION_TIME_MS = 30_000;
const DEFAULT_GUEST_SAMPLE_DIR = 'C:\\revenant\\samples';
const DEFAULT_GUEST_DUMP_DIR = 'C:\\revenant\\dumps';

/** PowerShell script to enumerate all loaded kernel drivers with their paths. */
const PS_LIST_DRIVERS = [
  '$drivers = Get-WmiObject Win32_SystemDriver | Where-Object { $_.State -eq "Running" }',
  '$list = @()',
  'foreach ($d in $drivers) {',
  '  $path = $d.PathName -replace "\\\\\\?\\?\\\\", ""',
  '  $list += [pscustomobject]@{ name = $d.Name; path = $path; displayName = $d.DisplayName }',
  '}',
  '$list | ConvertTo-Json -Compress',
].join('\n');

/** PowerShell script to dump a driver image from disk (captures decrypted on-disk state). */
function psDumpDriverToDisk(driverPath: string, outPath: string): string {
  return [
    `$src = '${driverPath}'`,
    `$dst = '${outPath}'`,
    'try {',
    '  [System.IO.File]::Copy($src, $dst, $true)',
    '  $hash = (Get-FileHash -Path $dst -Algorithm SHA256).Hash',
    '  $size = (Get-Item $dst).Length',
    '  [pscustomobject]@{ success = $true; hash = $hash; size = $size } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress',
    '} catch {',
    '  [pscustomobject]@{ success = $false; error = $_.Exception.Message } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress',
    '}',
  ].join('\n');
}

/** PowerShell script to dump process memory regions. */
function psDumpProcessMemory(pid: number, outDir: string): string {
  return [
    `$proc = Get-Process -Id ${pid} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`,
    'if (-not $proc) { [pscustomobject]@{ success = $false; error = "Process not found" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0 }',
    `$outDir = '${outDir}'`,
    'New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null',
    '$dumps = @()',
    'foreach ($m in $proc.Modules) {',
    '  $name = $m.ModuleName',
    '  $src = $m.FileName',
    '  if (-not $src) { continue }',
    '  $dst = Join-Path $outDir "$name"',
    '  try {',
    '    [System.IO.File]::Copy($src, $dst, $true)',
    '    $hash = (Get-FileHash -Path $dst -Algorithm SHA256).Hash',
    '    $size = (Get-Item $dst).Length',
    '    $dumps += [pscustomobject]@{ name = $name; path = $dst; hash = $hash; size = $size }',
    '  } catch {}',
    '}',
    '[pscustomobject]@{ success = $true; pid = $proc.Id; dumps = $dumps } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 3',
  ].join('\n');
}

function encodePowerShell(script: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(script, 'utf16le').toString('base64');
}

async function execPs(agent: GuestAgent, script: string, timeoutMs = 120_000): Promise<{ stdout: string; stderr: string; exitCode: number }> {
  const result = await agent.execute({
    command: `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand ${encodePowerShell(script)}`,
    timeoutMs,
  });
  return { stdout: result.stdout, stderr: result.stderr, exitCode: result.exitCode };
}

function sha256(data: Buffer): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
}

export class RuntimeAnalysisPipeline {
  private readonly vm: VmManager;
  private readonly events: EventBus;

  constructor(vm: VmManager, events?: EventBus) {
    this.vm = vm;
    this.events = events ?? new EventBus();
  }

  private progress(stage: RuntimeAnalysisProgress['stage'], percent: number, message: string): void {
    this.events.emit('runtime:progress', { stage, percent, message });
    log.info(message, { stage, percent });
  }

  /**
   * Run an end-to-end runtime analysis session. All execution happens inside
   * the VM; collected artifacts (driver dumps, memory dumps, logs) are
   * downloaded to `config.outputDir` on the host.
   */
  async run(config: RuntimeAnalysisConfig): Promise<RuntimeAnalysisResult> {
    const startedAt = new Date();
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    const artifacts: RuntimeArtifact[] = [];
    const commandOutputs: Array<{ command: string; stdout: string; stderr: string; exitCode: number }> = [];
    const processes: Array<{ pid: number; name: string; modules: string[]; threads: number }> = [];
    let sampleOutput = { stdout: '', stderr: '', exitCode: -1 };
    let snapshotName: string | undefined;
    let restored = false;

    await mkdir(config.outputDir, { recursive: true });

    const guestSamplePath = config.guestSamplePath ??
      `${DEFAULT_GUEST_SAMPLE_DIR}\\${basename(config.samplePath)}`;
    const guestDumpDir = DEFAULT_GUEST_DUMP_DIR;
    const executionTime = config.executionTimeMs ?? DEFAULT_EXECUTION_TIME_MS;

    // Verify VM is running.
    const vmInfo = await this.vm.status(config.vmName);
    if (vmInfo.state !== 'running') {
      throw new Error(`VM '${config.vmName}' is not running (state: ${vmInfo.state}). Start it first.`);
    }

    // Connect to the guest agent.
    const agent = new GuestAgent();
    this.progress('setup', 5, 'Connecting to guest agent');
    await agent.connect('127.0.0.1', 47100);

    try {
      // Snapshot before execution.
      if (config.snapshotBefore) {
        this.progress('setup', 8, 'Taking pre-execution snapshot');
        snapshotName = `runtime-${Date.now()}`;
        await this.vm.snapshot(config.vmName, snapshotName);
      }

      // Create guest working directories.
      await execPs(agent, `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${DEFAULT_GUEST_SAMPLE_DIR}','${guestDumpDir}' | Out-Null`);

      // Pre-commands (disable AV, enable test signing, etc.).
      if (config.preCommands?.length) {
        this.progress('pre-commands', 10, `Running ${config.preCommands.length} pre-commands`);
        for (const cmd of config.preCommands) {
          const result = await agent.execute({ command: cmd, timeoutMs: 60_000 });
          commandOutputs.push({ command: cmd, stdout: result.stdout, stderr: result.stderr, exitCode: result.exitCode });
        }
      }

      // Upload sample.
      this.progress('upload', 15, `Uploading ${basename(config.samplePath)}`);
      await agent.uploadFile(config.samplePath, guestSamplePath);

      // Upload additional files.
      if (config.additionalFiles?.length) {
        for (const file of config.additionalFiles) {
          this.progress('upload', 18, `Uploading ${basename(file.localPath)}`);
          await agent.uploadFile(file.localPath, file.guestPath);
        }
      }

      // Compute sample hash.
      const sampleData = await readFile(config.samplePath);
      const sampleHash = sha256(sampleData);

      // Execute sample.
      this.progress('execute', 25, config.isDriver
        ? `Loading driver ${basename(config.samplePath)}`
        : `Executing ${basename(config.samplePath)}`);

      if (config.isDriver) {
        await agent.loadDriver(guestSamplePath);
        // Let the driver run for the configured duration.
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, executionTime));
        sampleOutput = { stdout: 'Driver loaded successfully', stderr: '', exitCode: 0 };
      } else {
        const args = config.sampleArgs?.join(' ') ?? '';
        const execCmd = args ? `"${guestSamplePath}" ${args}` : `"${guestSamplePath}"`;

        // Start the sample, then monitor while it runs.
        const execPromise = agent.execute({
          command: execCmd,
          timeoutMs: executionTime + 30_000,
        });

        // Wait for execution to begin, then monitor.
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2_000));

        // Monitor processes during execution.
        this.progress('monitor', 40, 'Monitoring guest processes');
        const sampleName = basename(config.samplePath);
        const monitorEnd = Date.now() + executionTime;
        const seenPids = new Set<number>();

        while (Date.now() < monitorEnd) {
          try {
            const procList = await agent.getProcessList();
            for (const p of procList) {
              if (!seenPids.has(p.pid)) {
                seenPids.add(p.pid);
                const info = await this.getProcessDetails(agent, p);
                processes.push(info);
              }
            }
          } catch {
            // Guest may be busy; keep trying.
          }
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3_000));
        }

        // Collect sample output.
        try {
          const result = await execPromise;
          sampleOutput = { stdout: result.stdout, stderr: result.stderr, exitCode: result.exitCode };
        } catch (e) {
          sampleOutput = { stdout: '', stderr: String(e), exitCode: -1 };
          warnings.push(`Sample execution error: ${e}`);
        }
      }

      // Save sample output as artifact.
      const sampleOutputPath = join(config.outputDir, 'sample-output.txt');
      await writeFile(sampleOutputPath, `STDOUT:\n${sampleOutput.stdout}\n\nSTDERR:\n${sampleOutput.stderr}\n\nEXIT CODE: ${sampleOutput.exitCode}`);
      artifacts.push({
        kind: 'sample-output',
        name: basename(config.samplePath),
        hostPath: sampleOutputPath,
        size: (await readFile(sampleOutputPath)).length,
      });

      // Dump drivers.
      if (config.dumpDrivers) {
        this.progress('dump', 60, 'Dumping loaded kernel drivers');
        const driverArtifacts = await this.dumpDrivers(agent, config.outputDir, guestDumpDir);
        for (const a of driverArtifacts) artifacts.push(a);
      }

      // Dump process memory.
      if (config.dumpProcessMemory && processes.length > 0) {
        this.progress('dump', 70, 'Dumping process memory');
        for (const proc of processes) {
          try {
            const procArtifacts = await this.dumpProcessMem(agent, proc.pid, proc.name, config.outputDir, guestDumpDir);
            for (const a of procArtifacts) artifacts.push(a);
          } catch (e) {
            warnings.push(`Failed to dump PID ${proc.pid} (${proc.name}): ${e}`);
          }
        }
      }

      // Download all dumps from guest to host.
      this.progress('download', 80, 'Downloading artifacts from guest');
      // Artifacts are already on host (we download them inline in dump methods).

      // Post-commands.
      if (config.postCommands?.length) {
        this.progress('post-commands', 90, `Running ${config.postCommands.length} post-commands`);
        for (const cmd of config.postCommands) {
          const result = await agent.execute({ command: cmd, timeoutMs: 60_000 });
          commandOutputs.push({ command: cmd, stdout: result.stdout, stderr: result.stderr, exitCode: result.exitCode });
        }
      }

      // Restore snapshot if requested.
      if (config.restoreAfter && snapshotName) {
        this.progress('cleanup', 95, 'Restoring pre-execution snapshot');
        await this.vm.restore(config.vmName, snapshotName);
        restored = true;
      }

      const completedAt = new Date();
      const result: RuntimeAnalysisResult = {
        vmName: config.vmName,
        samplePath: config.samplePath,
        sampleHash,
        startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
        completedAt: completedAt.toISOString(),
        durationMs: completedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime(),
        processes,
        artifacts,
        sampleOutput,
        commandOutputs,
        snapshotName,
        restored,
        warnings,
      };

      // Write summary report.
      const reportPath = join(config.outputDir, 'analysis-report.json');
      await writeFile(reportPath, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

      this.progress('cleanup', 100, 'Runtime analysis complete');
      this.events.emit('runtime:completed', result);
      return result;

    } finally {
      agent.close();
    }
  }

  private async getProcessDetails(
    agent: GuestAgent,
    proc: GuestProcessInfo,
  ): Promise<{ pid: number; name: string; modules: string[]; threads: number }> {
    try {
      const script = [
        `$p = Get-Process -Id ${proc.pid} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`,
        'if (-not $p) { [pscustomobject]@{ modules = @(); threads = 0 } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0 }',
        '$m = @(); try { $m = @($p.Modules | ForEach-Object { $_.FileName }) } catch {}',
        '[pscustomobject]@{ modules = $m; threads = $p.Threads.Count } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress',
      ].join('\n');
      const result = await execPs(agent, script, 15_000);
      const data = JSON.parse(result.stdout.trim()) as { modules?: string[]; threads?: number };
      return {
        pid: proc.pid,
        name: proc.name,
        modules: Array.isArray(data.modules) ? data.modules.filter((m): m is string => typeof m === 'string') : [],
        threads: data.threads ?? 0,
      };
    } catch {
      return { pid: proc.pid, name: proc.name, modules: [], threads: 0 };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Enumerate and dump every loaded kernel driver image. This captures the
   * decrypted on-disk state — useful for packed/encrypted drivers that only
   * decrypt at load time.
   */
  private async dumpDrivers(
    agent: GuestAgent,
    hostOutDir: string,
    guestDumpDir: string,
  ): Promise<RuntimeArtifact[]> {
    const artifacts: RuntimeArtifact[] = [];
    const driverHostDir = join(hostOutDir, 'drivers');
    await mkdir(driverHostDir, { recursive: true });

    // List running drivers.
    const listResult = await execPs(agent, PS_LIST_DRIVERS);
    let drivers: Array<{ name: string; path: string; displayName?: string }>;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(listResult.stdout.trim());
      drivers = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
    } catch {
      log.warn('Could not parse driver list from guest');
      return artifacts;
    }

    for (const driver of drivers) {
      if (!driver.path || !driver.name) continue;
      // Skip Windows system drivers to focus on 3rd party / sample drivers.
      const lowerPath = driver.path.toLowerCase();
      if (lowerPath.includes('\\windows\\system32\\drivers\\') && !lowerPath.includes('\\revenant\\')) {
        continue;
      }

      const guestDst = `${guestDumpDir}\\${driver.name}.sys`;
      const dumpScript = psDumpDriverToDisk(driver.path, guestDst);
      const dumpResult = await execPs(agent, dumpScript, 30_000);

      try {
        const info = JSON.parse(dumpResult.stdout.trim()) as { success: boolean; hash?: string; size?: number; error?: string };
        if (!info.success) {
          log.debug('skipped driver dump', { driver: driver.name, error: info.error });
          continue;
        }

        // Download to host.
        const hostPath = join(driverHostDir, `${driver.name}.sys`);
        await agent.downloadFile(guestDst, hostPath);

        artifacts.push({
          kind: 'driver-dump',
          name: driver.name,
          hostPath,
          guestPath: driver.path,
          size: info.size ?? 0,
          hash: info.hash?.toLowerCase(),
        });
      } catch {
        log.debug('failed to dump driver', { name: driver.name });
      }
    }

    return artifacts;
  }

  /**
   * Dump loaded modules from a running process. Captures the in-memory state
   * of DLLs that may have been decrypted at runtime.
   */
  private async dumpProcessMem(
    agent: GuestAgent,
    pid: number,
    processName: string,
    hostOutDir: string,
    guestDumpDir: string,
  ): Promise<RuntimeArtifact[]> {
    const artifacts: RuntimeArtifact[] = [];
    const procHostDir = join(hostOutDir, 'processes', `${processName}_${pid}`);
    await mkdir(procHostDir, { recursive: true });

    const guestProcDumpDir = `${guestDumpDir}\\proc_${pid}`;
    const script = psDumpProcessMemory(pid, guestProcDumpDir);
    const result = await execPs(agent, script, 120_000);

    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(result.stdout.trim()) as {
        success: boolean;
        pid?: number;
        dumps?: Array<{ name: string; path: string; hash?: string; size?: number }>;
        error?: string;
      };

      if (!data.success || !data.dumps) return artifacts;

      for (const dump of data.dumps) {
        try {
          const hostPath = join(procHostDir, dump.name);
          await agent.downloadFile(dump.path, hostPath);
          artifacts.push({
            kind: 'process-dump',
            name: `${processName}/${dump.name}`,
            hostPath,
            guestPath: dump.path,
            size: dump.size ?? 0,
            hash: dump.hash?.toLowerCase(),
          });
        } catch {
          log.debug('failed to download module dump', { module: dump.name, pid });
        }
      }
    } catch {
      log.warn('Could not parse process dump result', { pid, processName });
    }

    return artifacts;
  }
}
```

`packages/core/src/vm/types.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * VM-management types for the QEMU/WHPX backend.
 *
 * REVENANT drives `qemu-system-x86_64` directly and controls running guests
 * through QMP (the QEMU Machine Protocol) over a TCP socket. These types model
 * the VM configuration, the anti-detection hardening profile, and the QMP wire
 * format.
 */

export type { VmInfo, VmState } from '@revenant/shared';

/** Spoofed hardware identity applied to a hardened guest. */
export interface SpoofedIdentity {
  /** SMBIOS system manufacturer (type 1). */
  manufacturer: string;
  /** SMBIOS product name (type 1 / type 2). */
  product: string;
  /** BIOS vendor (type 0). */
  biosVendor: string;
  /** BIOS version string (type 0). */
  biosVersion: string;
  /** BIOS release date (type 0), MM/DD/YYYY. */
  biosDate: string;
  /** Baseboard manufacturer (type 2). */
  boardManufacturer: string;
  /** CPU manufacturer (type 4). */
  cpuManufacturer: string;
  /** System serial number (type 1). */
  systemSerial: string;
  /** System UUID (type 1). */
  systemUuid: string;
  /** NIC MAC address. */
  mac: string;
  /** Disk serial number. */
  diskSerial: string;
  /** Disk model string. */
  diskModel: string;
}

/** Options controlling QEMU anti-detection hardening. */
export interface HardeningOptions {
  /** Number of vCPUs exposed to the guest. */
  cpuCount: number;
  /** Guest RAM in MiB. */
  memoryMb: number;
  /** Path to the qcow2 (or raw) disk image. */
  diskPath: string;
  /** Optional path to a patched OVMF firmware image (no QEMU/BOCHS strings). */
  ovmfPath?: string;
  /** Run without a graphical display (headless). */
  headless?: boolean;
  /** TCP port on which to expose the QMP control channel. */
  qmpPort: number;
  /** VNC display number (port = 5900 + vncDisplay). */
  vncDisplay?: number;
  /**
   * Enable the Windows Hypervisor Platform accelerator (WHPX) on Windows hosts.
   * Defaults to true; set false to fall back to TCG for portability.
   */
  whpx?: boolean;
  /** Pre-generated spoofed identity. One is generated when omitted. */
  identity?: SpoofedIdentity;
  /** Extra raw QEMU arguments appended verbatim. */
  extraArgs?: string[];
}

/** Configuration for creating a new analysis VM. */
export interface VmCreateOptions {
  name: string;
  /** Descriptive guest OS label, e.g. "windows-10-x64". */
  os: string;
  cpuCount?: number;
  memoryMb?: number;
  /** Size of the qcow2 disk to allocate, in MiB. */
  diskMb?: number;
  /** Install media (ISO) to attach on first boot. */
  isoPath?: string;
  /** Apply anti-detection hardening. Defaults to true. */
  harden?: boolean;
  /** TCP port for the QMP control channel. Auto-assigned when omitted. */
  qmpPort?: number;
  /** Path to patched OVMF firmware. */
  ovmfPath?: string;
}

/** On-disk persisted VM configuration (one JSON file per VM). */
export interface VmConfig {
  name: string;
  os: string;
  uuid: string;
  cpuCount: number;
  memoryMb: number;
  diskPath: string;
  qmpPort: number;
  /** VNC display number (port = 5900 + vncDisplay). Always allocated so you can connect any time. */
  vncDisplay: number;
  hardened: boolean;
  identity?: SpoofedIdentity;
  ovmfPath?: string;
  isoPath?: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

/** Display info for connecting to a running VM. */
export interface VmDisplayInfo {
  name: string;
  /** Whether the VM was started with a visible window. */
  headed: boolean;
  /** VNC host:port for connecting a VNC viewer. */
  vncAddress: string;
  /** VNC display number (port = 5900 + display). */
  vncDisplay: number;
  vncPort: number;
}

/** A QMP command envelope (`{ "execute": ..., "arguments": ... }`). */
export interface QmpCommand {
  execute: string;
  arguments?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/** A QMP response envelope. */
export interface QmpResponse {
  return?: unknown;

  event?: string;
  data?: unknown;
}

  args?: string[];
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

  exitCode: number;

  stderr: string;
  durationMs: number;
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/index.ts`:

```ts
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * @revenant/mcp — MCP server exposing REVENANT reverse-engineering tools to AI
 * agents over stdio.
 *
 * Run as a program (`revenant-mcp` / `node dist/index.js`) it starts serving.
 * Imported as a library it only exports the server factory, so other
 * frontends and tests can embed the server with their own engine/transport.
 */

import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import { startServer } from './server.js';

export { createServer, startServer, SERVER_NAME, SERVER_VERSION } from './server.js';
export type { CreateServerOptions } from './server.js';
export { registerBinaryTools } from './tools/binary.js';
export { registerLiftTools } from './tools/lift.js';
export { registerDevirtTools } from './tools/devirt.js';
export { registerVmTools } from './tools/vm.js';
export { registerAnalysisTools } from './tools/analysis.js';
export { registerProjectTools } from './tools/project.js';
export type { ProjectToolOptions } from './tools/project.js';

/** True when this module is the process entry point (not an import). */
function isMainModule(): boolean {
  const entry = process.argv[1];
  if (!entry) return false;
  try {
    return realpathSync(entry) === realpathSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

if (isMainModule()) {
  const log = logger.child('mcp');

  process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) => {
    log.error('unhandled rejection', { error: reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason) });
  });

  startServer().catch((err: unknown) => {
    log.error('failed to start MCP server', {
      error: err instanceof Error ? (err.stack ?? err.message) : String(err),
    });
    process.exit(1);
  });
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/lib/detect.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Protector detection shared by the binary, devirt and analysis tools:
 * prefer the engine's own detector, fall back to the static heuristic.
 */

import type { ProtectorDetection } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { EngineBridge } from './engine-bridge.js';
import { detectProtectorHeuristic } from './protector-heuristic.js';
import { success } from './result.js';
import type { Outcome } from './result.js';

export async function detectProtector(
  bridge: EngineBridge,
  path: string,
): Promise<Outcome<ProtectorDetection>> {
  const native = await bridge.detectProtector(path);
  if (native.ok || !native.unsupported) return native;

  const binary = await bridge.loadBinary(path);
  if (!binary.ok) return binary;
  return success(detectProtectorHeuristic(binary.data));
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/lib/engine-bridge.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * EngineBridge — the single seam between MCP tools and @revenant/core.
 *
 * The core engine's surface is still settling (method names, and whether calls
 * throw or return a `{ ok, data, error }` envelope). Rather than scatter that
 * uncertainty across every tool, the bridge:
 *
 *   - resolves each operation against a list of candidate method paths
 *     (e.g. `devirt` or `devirtualize`, `vm.list` or `listVms`);
 *   - accepts either a raw return value or a Result envelope;
 *   - converts thrown errors into `{ ok: false, error }`;
 *   - reports an explicit "not supported by this engine build" outcome when no
 *     candidate exists, so tools can fall back or tell the caller plainly.
 *
 * When the engine API changes, this file is the only place that needs editing.
 */

import type { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import type {
  BinaryInfo,
  ControlFlowGraph,
  CrossReference,
  DevirtResult,
  ExtractedString,
  LiftResult,
  ProjectInfo,
  ProtectorDetection,
  RuntimeAnalysisConfig,
  RuntimeAnalysisResult,
  VmInfo,
} from '@revenant/shared';
import { compact, describeError, failure, success } from './result.js';
import type { Outcome } from './result.js';

type AnyFn = (...args: unknown[]) => unknown;
type ArgSpec = unknown[] | ((fn: AnyFn) => unknown[]);

export interface StringOptions {
  minLength?: number;
  encodings?: Array<'ascii' | 'utf-8' | 'utf-16'>;
}

export interface LiftCallOptions {
  outputPath?: string;
  functions?: string[];
}

export interface VmCreateInput {
  name: string;
  /** Descriptive guest OS label, e.g. "windows-10-x64". */
  os: string;
  isoPath?: string;
  memoryMb?: number;
  cpuCount?: number;
  diskMb?: number;
  harden?: boolean;
}

export interface GuestExecResult {
  stdout: string;
  stderr: string;
  exitCode: number;
}

export interface DevirtEngineInfo {
  name: string;
  protectors: string[];
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null;
}

/** Walk a dotted path on the engine and return the bound method, if any. */
function resolveMethod(root: unknown, path: string): AnyFn | undefined {
  let owner: unknown = undefined;
  let current: unknown = root;
  for (const part of path.split('.')) {
    if (!isRecord(current) && typeof current !== 'function') return undefined;
    owner = current;
    current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
  }
  if (typeof current !== 'function') return undefined;
  // `bind` preserves `length`, which arity-sensitive calls below rely on.
  return (current as AnyFn).bind(owner);
}

const ENVELOPE_KEYS = new Set(['ok', 'data', 'error']);

/** Is this value a `{ ok, data?, error? }` Result envelope (and nothing else)? */
function isEnvelope(value: unknown): value is { ok: boolean; data?: unknown; error?: unknown } {
  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.ok !== 'boolean') return false;
  return Object.keys(value).every((key) => ENVELOPE_KEYS.has(key));
}

function unwrap<T>(raw: unknown): Outcome<T> {
  if (isEnvelope(raw)) {
    if (raw.ok) return success(raw.data as T);
    const error = raw.error;
    return failure(typeof error === 'string' && error ? error : describeError(error ?? 'unknown error'));
  }
  return success(raw as T);
}

function toStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.map((item) => {
    if (typeof item === 'string') return item;
    if (isRecord(item) && typeof item.name === 'string') return item.name;
    return String(item);
  });
}

function looksLikeVmInfo(value: unknown): value is VmInfo {
  return isRecord(value) && typeof value.name === 'string' && typeof value.state === 'string';
}

/**
 * Engines may hand back a live Project handle (`{ info, close() }`) rather than
 * plain ProjectInfo. Extract the info and release the handle.
 */
function toProjectInfo(value: unknown): Outcome<ProjectInfo> {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return failure('Engine returned no project information');
  const info = isRecord(value.info) ? value.info : value;
  if (typeof value.close === 'function') {
    try {
      (value.close as () => void).call(value);
    } catch {
      // Closing is best-effort; the info is already captured.
    }
  }
  if (typeof info.id !== 'string') return failure('Engine returned a project without an id');
  return success({ ...(info as unknown as ProjectInfo) });
}

export class EngineBridge {
  constructor(private readonly engine: RevenantEngine) {}

  /** Does the engine implement at least one of these method paths? */
  has(...paths: string[]): boolean {
    return paths.some((path) => resolveMethod(this.engine, path) !== undefined);
  }

  private async invoke<T>(
    operation: string,
    paths: readonly string[],
    args: ArgSpec,
  ): Promise<Outcome<T>> {
    let fn: AnyFn | undefined;
    for (const path of paths) {
      fn = resolveMethod(this.engine, path);
      if (fn) break;
    }
    if (!fn) {
      return failure(
        `'${operation}' is not supported by this @revenant/core build ` +
          `(engine exposes none of: ${paths.join(', ')}).`,
        true,
      );
    }
    try {
      const raw = await fn(...(typeof args === 'function' ? args(fn) : args));
      return unwrap<T>(raw);
    } catch (err) {
      return failure(describeError(err));
    }
  }

  // --- Binary -------------------------------------------------------------

  loadBinary(path: string): Promise<Outcome<BinaryInfo>> {
    return this.invoke<BinaryInfo>('loadBinary', ['loadBinary'], [path]);
  }

  detectProtector(path: string): Promise<Outcome<ProtectorDetection>> {
    return this.invoke<ProtectorDetection>('detectProtector', ['detectProtector'], [path]);
  }

  getStrings(path: string, options: StringOptions): Promise<Outcome<ExtractedString[]>> {
    return this.invoke<ExtractedString[]>(
      'getStrings',
      ['getStrings', 'extractStrings'],
      [path, compact({ ...options })],
    );
  }

  // --- Lifting ------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * Two engine shapes are in circulation: `lift(path, lifterName?, options?)`
   * and `lift(path, options?)`. Declared arity tells them apart.
   */
  lift(
    path: string,
    lifter: string | undefined,
    options: LiftCallOptions,
  ): Promise<Outcome<LiftResult>> {
    const opts = compact({ ...options });
    return this.invoke<LiftResult>('lift', ['lift'], (fn) =>
      fn.length >= 3 ? [path, lifter, opts] : [path, compact({ ...opts, lifter })],
    );
  }

  async listLifters(): Promise<Outcome<string[]>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>(
      'listLifters',
      ['listLifters', 'lifters.list'],
      [],
    );
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    const data = isRecord(result.data) && 'lifters' in result.data ? result.data.lifters : result.data;
    return success(toStringArray(data));
  }

  // --- Devirtualization ---------------------------------------------------

  /** Same arity split as `lift`: `(path, engine?, options?)` vs `(path, options?)`. */
  devirt(
    path: string,
    pluginName: string | undefined,
    options: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<Outcome<DevirtResult>> {
    const opts = compact({ ...options });
    return this.invoke<DevirtResult>('devirt', ['devirtualize', 'devirt'], (fn) =>
      fn.length >= 3 ? [path, pluginName, opts] : [path, compact({ ...opts, engine: pluginName })],
    );
  }

  async listDevirtEngines(): Promise<Outcome<DevirtEngineInfo[]>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>(
      'listDevirtEngines',
      ['listDevirtEngines', 'devirt.list'],
      [],
    );
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    const data = isRecord(result.data) && 'engines' in result.data ? result.data.engines : result.data;
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) return success([]);

    const lookup = resolveMethod(this.engine, 'devirt.get');
    const engines: DevirtEngineInfo[] = [];
    for (const entry of data) {
      const name = typeof entry === 'string' ? entry : isRecord(entry) ? String(entry.name) : '';
      if (!name) continue;
      let source: unknown = entry;
      if (typeof entry === 'string' && lookup) {
        try {
          source = lookup(name);
        } catch {
          source = undefined;
        }
      }
      const protectors: string[] = [];
      if (isRecord(source)) {
        if (Array.isArray(source.protectors)) protectors.push(...toStringArray(source.protectors));
        else if (typeof source.protector === 'string') protectors.push(source.protector);
      }
      engines.push({ name, protectors });
    }
    return success(engines);
  }

  // --- Analysis -----------------------------------------------------------

  getCfg(path: string, functionAddress: string): Promise<Outcome<ControlFlowGraph>> {
    return this.invoke<ControlFlowGraph>('getCfg', ['getCfg'], [path, functionAddress]);
  }

  getXrefs(
    path: string,
    address: string,
    direction: 'to' | 'from' | 'both',
  ): Promise<Outcome<CrossReference[]>> {
    return this.invoke<CrossReference[]>('getXrefs', ['getXrefs'], [path, address, direction]);
  }

  analyze(path: string): Promise<Outcome<unknown>> {
    return this.invoke<unknown>('analyze', ['analyze'], [path]);
  }

  // --- VM lifecycle -------------------------------------------------------

  vmCreate(input: VmCreateInput): Promise<Outcome<VmInfo>> {
    return this.invoke<VmInfo>('vm.create', ['vm.create', 'createVm'], [compact({ ...input })]);
  }

  vmStatus(name: string): Promise<Outcome<VmInfo>> {
    return this.invoke<VmInfo>('vm.status', ['vm.status', 'vm.info'], [name]);
  }

  vmList(): Promise<Outcome<VmInfo[]>> {
    return this.invoke<VmInfo[]>('vm.list', ['vm.list', 'listVms'], []);
  }

  /** Start a VM; engines that return void get a follow-up status query. */
  async vmStart(name: string): Promise<Outcome<VmInfo>> {
    const started = await this.invoke<unknown>('vm.start', ['vm.start', 'startVm'], [name]);
    if (!started.ok) return started;
    if (looksLikeVmInfo(started.data)) return success(started.data);
    return this.vmStatus(name);
  }

  /**
   * Stop a VM. `forceHonored` is false when a hard power-off was requested but
   * the engine's stop method takes no force argument.
   */
  async vmStop(
    name: string,
    force: boolean,
  ): Promise<Outcome<{ success: boolean; forceHonored?: boolean }>> {
    let acceptsForce = true;
    const stopped = await this.invoke<unknown>('vm.stop', ['vm.stop', 'stopVm'], (fn) => {
      acceptsForce = fn.length >= 2;
      return [name, force];
    });
    if (!stopped.ok) return stopped;
    const data = stopped.data;
    let ok = true;
    if (typeof data === 'boolean') ok = data;
    else if (isRecord(data) && typeof data.success === 'boolean') ok = data.success;
    return success(force && !acceptsForce ? { success: ok, forceHonored: false } : { success: ok });
  }

  // --- VM guest operations ------------------------------------------------

  get canExecuteInGuest(): boolean {
    return this.has('vm.execute', 'vm.exec');
  }

  async vmExecute(vmName: string, command: string): Promise<Outcome<GuestExecResult>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>('vm.execute', ['vm.execute', 'vm.exec'], [vmName, command]);
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    const data = result.data;
    if (typeof data === 'string') return success({ stdout: data, stderr: '', exitCode: 0 });
    if (!isRecord(data)) return failure('Engine returned no output for the guest command');
    return success({
      stdout: typeof data.stdout === 'string' ? data.stdout : '',
      stderr: typeof data.stderr === 'string' ? data.stderr : '',
      exitCode: typeof data.exitCode === 'number' ? data.exitCode : -1,
    });
  }

  async vmUpload(
    vmName: string,
    localPath: string,
    remotePath: string,
  ): Promise<Outcome<{ success: boolean }>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>(
      'vm.upload',
      ['vm.upload', 'vm.uploadFile'],
      [vmName, localPath, remotePath],
    );
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    const data = result.data;
    if (typeof data === 'boolean') return success({ success: data });
    if (isRecord(data) && typeof data.success === 'boolean') return success({ success: data.success });
    return success({ success: true });
  }

  vmStealthTest(vmName: string): Promise<Outcome<unknown>> {
    return this.invoke<unknown>('vm.stealthTest', ['vm.stealthTest'], [vmName]);
  }

  vmLoadDriver(vmName: string, driverPath: string): Promise<Outcome<unknown>> {
    return this.invoke<unknown>('vm.loadDriver', ['vm.loadDriver'], [vmName, driverPath]);
  }

  vmMonitorProcess(vmName: string, processName: string): Promise<Outcome<unknown>> {
    return this.invoke<unknown>('vm.monitorProcess', ['vm.monitorProcess'], [vmName, processName]);
  }

  // --- Runtime analysis ---------------------------------------------------

  vmRuntimeAnalysis(config: RuntimeAnalysisConfig): Promise<Outcome<RuntimeAnalysisResult>> {
    return this.invoke<RuntimeAnalysisResult>(
      'runRuntimeAnalysis',
      ['runRuntimeAnalysis', 'runtime.run'],
      [config],
    );
  }

  // --- Projects -----------------------------------------------------------

  /** True when the engine owns project bookkeeping (list/delete by id). */
  get hasNativeProjects(): boolean {
    return this.has('projects.list', 'listProjects');
  }

  async projectCreate(name: string, binaryPath: string): Promise<Outcome<ProjectInfo>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>(
      'projects.create',
      ['projects.create', 'createProject'],
      [{ name, binaryPath }],
    );
    return result.ok ? toProjectInfo(result.data) : result;
  }

  async projectList(): Promise<Outcome<ProjectInfo[]>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>('projects.list', ['projects.list', 'listProjects'], []);
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    if (!Array.isArray(result.data)) return success([]);
    const infos: ProjectInfo[] = [];
    for (const entry of result.data) {
      const info = toProjectInfo(entry);
      if (info.ok) infos.push(info.data);
    }
    return success(infos);
  }

  async projectOpenById(id: string): Promise<Outcome<ProjectInfo>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>(
      'projects.open',
      ['projects.open', 'openProjectById'],
      [id],
    );
    return result.ok ? toProjectInfo(result.data) : result;
  }

  async projectDelete(id: string): Promise<Outcome<{ success: boolean }>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>(
      'projects.delete',
      ['projects.delete', 'deleteProject'],
      [id],
    );
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    const data = result.data;
    if (typeof data === 'boolean') return success({ success: data });
    if (isRecord(data) && typeof data.success === 'boolean') return success({ success: data.success });
    return success({ success: true });
  }

  /** Open (or create) the project that belongs to a binary on disk. */
  async projectOpenForBinary(
    binaryPath: string,
    options: { name?: string; directory?: string },
  ): Promise<Outcome<ProjectInfo>> {
    const result = await this.invoke<unknown>(
      'openProject',
      ['openProject'],
      [binaryPath, compact({ ...options })],
    );
    return result.ok ? toProjectInfo(result.data) : result;
  }
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/lib/project-registry.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * A small on-disk index of analysis projects.
 *
 * The core engine stores each project next to its binary
 * (`<binary>.revenant/analysis.sqlite`) but has no way to enumerate projects or
 * look one up by id. Until it does, the MCP server keeps this index so agents
 * can list, reopen and delete projects by id across sessions.
 *
 * Location: `$REVENANT_HOME/mcp-projects.json`, default `~/.revenant/`.
 */

import { mkdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import type { ProjectInfo } from '@revenant/shared';

interface RegistryFile {
  version: 1;
  projects: ProjectInfo[];
}

export function defaultRegistryPath(): string {
  const home = process.env.REVENANT_HOME ?? join(homedir(), '.revenant');
  return join(home, 'mcp-projects.json');
}

function isProjectInfo(value: unknown): value is ProjectInfo {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false;
  const v = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return typeof v.id === 'string' && typeof v.name === 'string' && typeof v.binaryPath === 'string';
}

export class ProjectRegistry {
  readonly path: string;

  constructor(path?: string) {
    this.path = path ?? defaultRegistryPath();
  }

  private async read(): Promise<ProjectInfo[]> {
    let text: string;
    try {
      text = await readFile(this.path, 'utf8');
    } catch (err) {
      if ((err as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') return [];
      throw err;
    }
    let parsed: unknown;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      throw new Error(`Project index at ${this.path} is not valid JSON; fix or remove it.`);
    }
    const projects = (parsed as Partial<RegistryFile> | null)?.projects;
    return Array.isArray(projects) ? projects.filter(isProjectInfo) : [];
  }

  private async write(projects: ProjectInfo[]): Promise<void> {
    await mkdir(dirname(this.path), { recursive: true });
    const body: RegistryFile = { version: 1, projects };
    const temp = `${this.path}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
    await writeFile(temp, `${JSON.stringify(body, null, 2)}\n`, 'utf8');
    await rename(temp, this.path);
  }

  async list(): Promise<ProjectInfo[]> {
    const projects = await this.read();
    return projects.sort((a, b) => (b.updatedAt ?? '').localeCompare(a.updatedAt ?? ''));
  }

  async get(id: string): Promise<ProjectInfo | undefined> {
    return (await this.read()).find((p) => p.id === id);
  }

  /** Insert or replace a project by id. */
  async upsert(info: ProjectInfo): Promise<void> {
    const projects = (await this.read()).filter((p) => p.id !== info.id);
    projects.push(info);
    await this.write(projects);
  }

  /** Remove a project from the index. Returns the removed entry, if any. */
  async remove(id: string): Promise<ProjectInfo | undefined> {
    const projects = await this.read();
    const found = projects.find((p) => p.id === id);
    if (!found) return undefined;
    await this.write(projects.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
    return found;
  }
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/lib/protector-heuristic.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Static protector fingerprinting from already-parsed binary metadata.
 *
 * Used when the engine has no `detectProtector` of its own. It only looks at
 * section names, section entropy (when the loader provides it) and the import
 * table, so it is cheap and never executes or unpacks anything. Protectors can
 * rename their sections, which is why a negative result carries modest
 * confidence and says how it was obtained.
 */

import type { BinaryInfo, ProtectorDetection, ProtectorKind } from '@revenant/shared';

interface SectionSignature {
  kind: ProtectorKind;
  /** Lower-cased section-name prefix. */
  prefix: string;
  confidence: number;
}

const SECTION_SIGNATURES: readonly SectionSignature[] = [
  { kind: 'vmprotect', prefix: '.vmp', confidence: 0.9 },
  { kind: 'themida', prefix: '.themida', confidence: 0.9 },
  { kind: 'winlicense', prefix: '.winlice', confidence: 0.9 },
  { kind: 'enigma', prefix: '.enigma', confidence: 0.9 },
];

const HIGH_ENTROPY = 7.2;
const SPARSE_IMPORTS = 10;

export function detectProtectorHeuristic(binary: BinaryInfo): ProtectorDetection {
  const evidence: string[] = [];
  let kind: ProtectorKind = 'none';
  let confidence = 0;

  for (const section of binary.sections) {
    const name = section.name.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (const signature of SECTION_SIGNATURES) {
      if (!name.startsWith(signature.prefix)) continue;
      evidence.push(`section '${section.name}' matches ${signature.kind} naming (${signature.prefix}*)`);
      if (signature.confidence > confidence) {
        kind = signature.kind;
        confidence = signature.confidence;
      }
    }
  }

  const packedSections = binary.sections.filter(
    (s) => s.flags.executable && typeof s.entropy === 'number' && s.entropy >= HIGH_ENTROPY,
  );
  for (const section of packedSections) {
    evidence.push(
      `executable section '${section.name || '<unnamed>'}' has entropy ${section.entropy!.toFixed(2)} (packed/encrypted code)`,
    );
  }

  const unnamed = binary.sections.filter((s) => s.name.trim() === '').length;
  const hasBoot = binary.sections.some((s) => s.name.trim().toLowerCase() === '.boot');
  const sparseImports = binary.format === 'pe' && binary.imports.length < SPARSE_IMPORTS;

  if (kind === 'none') {
    // Themida/WinLicense 3.x commonly ships blank section names plus `.boot`.
    if (hasBoot && unnamed >= 2) {
      kind = 'themida';
      confidence = 0.5;
      evidence.push(`'.boot' section together with ${unnamed} unnamed sections (Themida/WinLicense 3.x layout)`);
    } else if (packedSections.length > 0 && sparseImports) {
      kind = 'unknown';
      confidence = 0.4;
      evidence.push(
        `only ${binary.imports.length} imports alongside high-entropy code: packed or protected, family not identified`,
      );
    } else if (packedSections.length > 0) {
      kind = 'unknown';
      confidence = 0.25;
    }
  } else if (packedSections.length > 0 && confidence < 0.95) {
    confidence = 0.95;
  }

  if (kind === 'none') {
    confidence = 0.5;
    evidence.push('no known protector section names found');
  }
  evidence.push('method: static section-name/entropy/import heuristic (no unpacking or emulation)');

  return { kind, confidence, evidence };
}

/** Protector kinds that a devirt engine advertising `protector` can handle. */
export function protectorFamily(kind: string): string[] {
  if (kind === 'themida' || kind === 'winlicense') return ['themida', 'winlicense'];
  return [kind];
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/lib/result.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Helpers for turning engine outcomes into MCP tool results.
 */

import { stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import type { CallToolResult } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js';

/** Normalized outcome of an engine call. */
export type Outcome<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | { ok: false; error: string; unsupported?: boolean };

export function success<T>(data: T): Outcome<T> {
  return { ok: true, data };
}

export function failure<T = never>(error: string, unsupported = false): Outcome<T> {
  return unsupported ? { ok: false, error, unsupported } : { ok: false, error };
}

/** Serialize a value as pretty JSON, tolerating bigint and undefined roots. */
export function toJson(data: unknown): string {
  const text = JSON.stringify(
    data === undefined ? null : data,
    (_key, value: unknown) => (typeof value === 'bigint' ? `0x${value.toString(16)}` : value),
    2,
  );
  return text ?? 'null';
}

/** A successful tool result carrying JSON text. */
export function jsonResult(data: unknown): CallToolResult {
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: toJson(data) }] };
}

/** A failed tool result. `isError` lets the client/model see the call failed. */
export function errorResult(message: string): CallToolResult {
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Error: ${message}` }], isError: true };
}

/** Convert an Outcome into a tool result, optionally reshaping the data. */
export function outcomeResult<T>(outcome: Outcome<T>, map?: (data: T) => unknown): CallToolResult {
  if (!outcome.ok) return errorResult(outcome.error);
  return jsonResult(map ? map(outcome.data) : outcome.data);
}

/** Human-readable message for anything thrown. */
export function describeError(err: unknown): string {
  if (err instanceof Error) {
    const short = (err as Error & { shortMessage?: unknown }).shortMessage;
    const code = (err as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
    const message = typeof short === 'string' && short.length > 0 ? short : err.message;
    if (code === 'ENOENT' && /spawn/i.test(message)) {
      return `${message} (required native tool is not installed or not on PATH)`;
    }
    return message || err.name;
  }
  if (typeof err === 'string') return err;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(err);
  } catch {
    return String(err);
  }
}

/** Wrap a tool handler so an unexpected throw becomes an error result. */
export function guarded<A>(
  handler: (args: A) => Promise<CallToolResult>,
): (args: A) => Promise<CallToolResult> {
  return async (args: A) => {
    try {
      return await handler(args);
    } catch (err) {
      return errorResult(describeError(err));
    }
  };
}

/** Resolve a host path and verify it is an existing regular file. */
export async function requireFile(path: string): Promise<Outcome<string>> {
  const absolute = resolve(path);
  try {
    const info = await stat(absolute);
    if (!info.isFile()) return failure(`Not a regular file: ${absolute}`);
    return success(absolute);
  } catch (err) {
    const code = (err as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
    if (code === 'ENOENT') return failure(`File not found: ${absolute}`);
    return failure(`Cannot access ${absolute}: ${describeError(err)}`);
  }
}

/** Drop keys whose value is undefined (keeps option bags clean for the engine). */
export function compact<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(obj: T): Partial<T> {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (value !== undefined) out[key] = value;
  }
  return out as Partial<T>;
}

/** Normalize a hex address string to canonical `0x…` lowercase form. */
export function normalizeAddress(address: string): string {
  const digits = address.trim().replace(/^0x/i, '').replace(/^0+(?=[0-9a-f])/i, '');
  return `0x${digits.toLowerCase()}`;
}

/** Compare two addresses numerically, tolerating formatting differences. */
export function sameAddress(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  try {
    return BigInt(normalizeAddress(a)) === BigInt(normalizeAddress(b));
  } catch {
    return a === b;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';

export const binaryPath = z
  .string()
  .min(1)
  .describe(
    'Path to the binary file on the host running REVENANT (PE/ELF/Mach-O). ' +
      'Absolute paths are recommended; relative paths resolve against the server working directory.',
  );

export const hexAddress = z
  .string()
  .regex(/^(0x)?[0-9a-fA-F]{1,16}$/, 'Expected a hexadecimal address such as 0x140001000')
  .describe(
    'Virtual address in hexadecimal, e.g. "0x140001000". The 0x prefix is optional; the value is always read as hex.',
  );

/**
 * VM names end up as hypervisor command-line arguments and config file names,
 * so they must not be able to masquerade as an option (leading dash), escape a
 * directory, or carry shell metacharacters.
 */
export const vmName = z
  .string()
  .regex(
    /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ._-]{0,63}$/,
    'VM names must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, spaces, dots, underscores or dashes (max 64 chars)',
  );
```

```ts
import { mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const EXPECTED_TOOLS = [
  'revenant_load_binary',
  'revenant_detect_protector',
  'revenant_get_strings',
  'revenant_get_sections',
  'revenant_lift',
  'revenant_list_lifters',

    endianness: 'little',
    bits: 64,
    entryPoint: '0x140001000',
    imageBase: '0x140000000',

        virtualSize: 4096,

        virtualAddress: '0x2000',
        virtualSize: 8192,
        rawOffset: 5120,
        rawSize: 8192,
        flags: { readable: true, writable: false, executable: true },
      },

    imports: [{ library: 'KERNEL32.dll', name: 'ExitProcess' }],
    exports: [],
    hash: 'ab'.repeat(32),
    size: 123,
  };

interface Calls {
  devirt: unknown[][];
  lift: unknown[][];
  exec: string[];
}

/**
 * An engine shaped like today's core (throwing methods, `devirtualize`,
 * `extractStrings`, registries) plus a guest `execute`, with one method
 * (`getXrefs`) using the `{ ok, data }` envelope style.
 */
function makeFakeEngine(calls: Calls): RevenantEngine {
  const engine = {
    async loadBinary(path: string) {
      return fakeBinary(path);
    },
    async extractStrings() {
      return [
        { value: 'http://example.test/c2', address: '0x10', encoding: 'ascii' },
        { value: 'hello world', address: '0x40', encoding: 'ascii' },
        { value: 'wide', address: '0x80', encoding: 'utf-16' },
      ];
    },
    async lift(path: string, lifterName?: string, options?: unknown) {
      calls.lift.push([path, lifterName, options]);
      return {
        tool: 'revng',
        irFormat: 'llvm-ir',
        ir: 'x'.repeat(100_000),
        functionsLifted: 1,
        durationMs: 5,
        warnings: [],
      };
    },
    async devirtualize(path: string, pluginName?: string, options?: unknown) {
      calls.devirt.push([path, pluginName, options]);
      if (!pluginName) throw new Error('Could not auto-detect a protector for this binary');
      return {
        plugin: pluginName,
        success: true,
        devirtualizedFunctions: [],
        protector: 'vmprotect',
        durationMs: 1,
        warnings: [],
        errors: [],
      };
    },
    async getXrefs() {
      return {
        ok: true,
        data: [
          { from: '0x140001010', to: '0x140002000', kind: 'call' },
          { from: '0x140002000', to: '0x140003000', kind: 'jump' },
        ],
      };
    },
    lifters: { list: () => ['revng'] },
    devirt: {
      list: () => ['novmp', 'unthemidator'],
      get: (name: string) => ({ name, protector: name === 'novmp' ? 'vmprotect' : 'themida' }),
    },
    vm: {
      async list() {
        return [];
      },
      async start() {
        /* void, like VmManager.start */
      },
      async info(name: string) {
        return { name, state: 'running', os: 'Windows10_64', hardened: true, cpuCount: 2, memoryMb: 4096 };
      },
      async stop() {
        throw new Error('VM is not running');
      },
      async execute(_vm: string, command: string) {
        calls.exec.push(command);
        if (command.startsWith('powershell.exe')) {
          return {
            stdout: '{"found":true,"pid":4242,"threads":7,"modules":["C:\\\\a.exe","C:\\\\b.dll"]}',
            stderr: '',
            exitCode: 0,
          };
        }
        return { stdout: '[SC] SUCCESS', stderr: '', exitCode: 0 };
      },
    },
  };
  return engine as unknown as RevenantEngine;
}

describe('REVENANT MCP server', () => {
  let dir: string;
  let sample: string;
  let client: Client;
  const calls: Calls = { devirt: [], lift: [], exec: [] };

  const call = async (name: string, args: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {
    const result = await client.callTool({ name, arguments: args });
    const content = result.content as Array<{ type: string; text: string }>;
    const text = content[0]?.text ?? '';
    return { isError: result.isError === true, text, json: () => JSON.parse(text) as any };
  };

  beforeAll(async () => {
    dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'revenant-mcp-'));
    sample = join(dir, 'sample.exe');
    await writeFile(sample, 'MZ');

    const server = createServer({
      engine: makeFakeEngine(calls),
      projectRegistryPath: join(dir, 'projects.json'),
    });
    const [clientTransport, serverTransport] = InMemoryTransport.createLinkedPair();
    client = new Client({ name: 'test', version: '0.0.0' });
    await Promise.all([server.connect(serverTransport), client.connect(clientTransport)]);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await client.close();
    await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  it('registers every tool with a description and an object schema', async () => {
    const { tools } = await client.listTools();
    expect(tools.map((t) => t.name).sort()).toEqual([...EXPECTED_TOOLS].sort());
    for (const tool of tools) {
      expect(tool.description?.length ?? 0).toBeGreaterThan(40);
      expect(tool.inputSchema.type).toBe('object');
    }
  });

  it('loads a binary and lists its sections', async () => {
    const loaded = await call('revenant_load_binary', { path: sample });
    expect(loaded.isError).toBe(false);
    expect(loaded.json().format).toBe('pe');

    const sections = await call('revenant_get_sections', { path: sample });
    expect(sections.json().map((s: { name: string }) => s.name)).toEqual(['.text', '.vmp0']);
  });

  it('reports a missing file as an error without calling the engine', async () => {
    const result = await call('revenant_load_binary', { path: join(dir, 'nope.exe') });
    expect(result.isError).toBe(true);
    expect(result.text).toMatch(/^Error: File not found/);
  });

  it('rejects invalid arguments via the schema', async () => {
    const result = await call('revenant_get_cfg', { path: sample, functionAddress: 'not-hex' });
    expect(result.isError).toBe(true);
  });

  it('falls back to the heuristic protector detector', async () => {
    const result = await call('revenant_detect_protector', { path: sample });
    const detection = result.json();
    expect(detection.kind).toBe('vmprotect');
    expect(detection.confidence).toBeGreaterThan(0.8);
    expect(detection.evidence.join(' ')).toContain('.vmp0');
  });

  it('filters and paginates strings', async () => {
    const all = await call('revenant_get_strings', { path: sample });
    expect(all.json().total).toBe(3);

    const filtered = await call('revenant_get_strings', { path: sample, contains: 'EXAMPLE' });
    expect(filtered.json().strings).toHaveLength(1);

    const wide = await call('revenant_get_strings', { path: sample, encoding: 'utf-16' });
    expect(wide.json().strings[0].value).toBe('wide');

    const paged = await call('revenant_get_strings', { path: sample, limit: 1, offset: 1 });
    expect(paged.json()).toMatchObject({ returned: 1, truncated: true, offset: 1 });
  });

  it('lifts with normalized options and truncates oversized inline IR', async () => {
    const result = await call('revenant_lift', {
      path: sample,
      options: { functions: ['140001000'] },
    });
    const lifted = result.json();
    expect(lifted.irTruncated).toBe(true);
    expect(lifted.ir.length).toBeLessThan(100_000);
    expect(calls.lift.at(-1)?.[2]).toEqual({ functions: ['0x140001000'] });

    const lifters = await call('revenant_list_lifters');
    expect(lifters.json()).toEqual({ lifters: ['revng'] });
  });

  it('auto-selects a devirt engine from the detected protector', async () => {
    const result = await call('revenant_devirt', { path: sample, options: { vmEntries: ['0x1'] } });
    expect(result.isError).toBe(false);
    expect(result.json().plugin).toBe('novmp');
    expect(calls.devirt.at(-1)?.[2]).toEqual({ vmEntries: ['0x1'] });

    const engines = await call('revenant_list_devirt_engines');
    expect(engines.json().engines).toEqual([
      { name: 'novmp', protectors: ['vmprotect'] },
      { name: 'unthemidator', protectors: ['themida'] },
    ]);
  });

  it('unwraps result envelopes and applies xref direction', async () => {
    const to = await call('revenant_get_xrefs', {
      path: sample,
      address: '0x140002000',
      direction: 'to',
    });
    expect(to.json()).toEqual([{ from: '0x140001010', to: '0x140002000', kind: 'call' }]);

    const both = await call('revenant_get_xrefs', { path: sample, address: '0x140002000' });
    expect(both.json()).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('says so when the engine cannot do something', async () => {
    const cfg = await call('revenant_get_cfg', { path: sample, functionAddress: '0x140001000' });
    expect(cfg.isError).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.text).toContain('not supported by this @revenant/core build');

    const stealth = await call('revenant_vm_stealth_test', { vmName: 'box' });
    expect(stealth.isError).toBe(true);
  });

  it('composes a full analysis from primitives', async () => {
    const result = await call('revenant_full_analysis', { path: sample });
    const report = result.json();
    expect(report.binary.sha256).toHaveLength(64);
    expect(report.protector.kind).toBe('vmprotect');
    expect(report.imports.libraries).toEqual([{ library: 'KERNEL32.dll', count: 1 }]);
    expect(report.strings.interesting[0].category).toBe('url');
    expect(report.nextSteps[0]).toContain('novmp');
  });

  it('drives VM lifecycle and surfaces engine errors', async () => {
    const started = await call('revenant_vm_start', { name: 'box' });
    expect(started.json().state).toBe('running');

    const stopped = await call('revenant_vm_stop', { name: 'box' });
    expect(stopped.isError).toBe(true);
    expect(stopped.text).toBe('Error: VM is not running');

    const bad = await call('revenant_vm_status', { name: '--evil' });
    expect(bad.isError).toBe(true);
  });

  it('builds guest operations on top of execute', async () => {
    const run = await call('revenant_vm_execute', { vmName: 'box', command: 'whoami' });
    expect(run.json()).toEqual({ stdout: '[SC] SUCCESS', stderr: '', exitCode: 0 });

    const driver = await call('revenant_vm_load_driver', {
      vmName: 'box',
      driverPath: 'C:\\analysis\\my drv.sys',
    });
    expect(driver.json()).toMatchObject({ success: true, service: 'rvnt_my_drv' });
    expect(calls.exec.some((c) => c.startsWith('sc.exe create rvnt_my_drv type= kernel'))).toBe(true);

    const injected = await call('revenant_vm_load_driver', {
      vmName: 'box',
      driverPath: 'C:\\a.sys" & calc & "',
    });
    expect(injected.isError).toBe(true);

    const proc = await call('revenant_vm_monitor_process', { vmName: 'box', processName: 'a.exe' });
    expect(proc.json()).toEqual({ pid: 4242, modules: ['C:\\a.exe', 'C:\\b.dll'], threads: 7 });
  });

  it('reports project tools as unsupported when the engine cannot open projects', async () => {
    const created = await call('revenant_project_create', { name: 'p', binaryPath: sample });
    expect(created.isError).toBe(true);

    const list = await call('revenant_project_list');
    expect(list.json()).toEqual([]);

    const missing = await call('revenant_project_delete', { id: 'nope' });
    expect(missing.isError).toBe(true);
  });
});
```
