```ts
/**
 * REVENANT MCP server assembly: builds the engine, registers every tool group,
 * and (for `startServer`) serves them over stdio.
 */

import { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import { StdioServerTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js';
import { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import { logger } from '@revenant/shared';
import { registerAnalysisTools } from './tools/analysis.js';
import { registerBinaryTools } from './tools/binary.js';
import { registerDevirtTools } from './tools/devirt.js';
import { registerLiftTools } from './tools/lift.js';
import { registerProjectTools } from './tools/project.js';
import { registerRuntimeTools } from './tools/runtime.js';
import { registerVmTools } from './tools/vm.js';

export const SERVER_NAME = 'revenant';
export const SERVER_VERSION = '0.1.0';

const log = logger.child('mcp');

const INSTRUCTIONS = [
  'REVENANT is a reverse-engineering platform. These tools analyze binaries on the host that runs this server.',
  '',
  'Typical workflow:',
  '1. revenant_full_analysis (or revenant_load_binary) on a new sample for format, sections, imports, protector and notable strings.',
  '2. If a protector is reported, revenant_devirt; otherwise go straight to revenant_lift for LLVM IR.',
  '3. revenant_get_cfg / revenant_get_xrefs / revenant_get_strings to study specific code and data.',
  '4. For dynamic work, use an isolated hardened VM: revenant_vm_create, revenant_vm_start, revenant_vm_stealth_test, then revenant_runtime_analyze to automatically upload, execute, monitor, dump drivers/memory, and download artifacts. For manual control use revenant_vm_upload, revenant_vm_execute, etc. Samples and drivers are only ever run inside the VM, never on the host.',
  '5. revenant_project_* tools persist analysis state per binary.',
  '',
  'All paths are host paths unless a parameter says it is a guest path. Addresses are hexadecimal strings.',
  'A failed call returns text starting with "Error:" and is flagged as an error; some tools depend on native tools (rev.ng, NoVmp, unthemidator, QEMU) being installed and say so when they are missing.',
].join('\n');

export interface CreateServerOptions {
  /** Engine to expose. A default RevenantEngine is created when omitted. */
  engine?: RevenantEngine;
  /** Override where the project index is stored (mainly for tests). */
  projectRegistryPath?: string;
}

/** Create the REVENANT MCP server with every tool registered. Does not connect a transport. */
export function createServer(options: CreateServerOptions = {}): McpServer {
  const engine = options.engine ?? new RevenantEngine();

  const server = new McpServer(
    { name: SERVER_NAME, version: SERVER_VERSION },
    { instructions: INSTRUCTIONS },
  );

  registerBinaryTools(server, engine);
  registerLiftTools(server, engine);
  registerDevirtTools(server, engine);
  registerVmTools(server, engine);
  registerRuntimeTools(server, engine);
  registerAnalysisTools(server, engine);
  registerProjectTools(server, engine, { registryPath: options.projectRegistryPath });

  return server;
}

/**
 * Create the server and serve it over stdio until the client disconnects or
 * the process is signalled.
 */
export async function startServer(options: CreateServerOptions = {}): Promise<McpServer> {
  // stdout carries the JSON-RPC stream. Anything else printed there (a stray
  // console.log in a dependency) would corrupt it, so route it to stderr.
  console.log = console.error;
  console.info = console.error;
  console.debug = console.error;

  const server = createServer(options);
  const transport = new StdioServerTransport();

  let closing = false;
  const shutdown = (reason: string): void => {
    if (closing) return;
    closing = true;
    log.info('shutting down', { reason });
    server
      .close()
      .catch((err: unknown) => log.error('error during shutdown', { error: String(err) }))
      .finally(() => process.exit(0));
  };
  process.once('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));
  process.once('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));
  transport.onclose = () => shutdown('transport closed');
  // The client going away shows up as stdin ending; do not linger as an orphan.
  process.stdin.once('end', () => shutdown('stdin closed'));

  await server.connect(transport);
  log.info('REVENANT MCP server ready', { transport: 'stdio', version: SERVER_VERSION });
  return server;
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/tools/analysis.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * MCP tools for static analysis: control-flow graphs, cross-references and the
 * one-shot triage pipeline.
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import type { CallToolResult } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js';
import type { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import type { BinaryInfo, ExtractedString, ProtectorDetection } from '@revenant/shared';
import { EngineBridge } from '../lib/engine-bridge.js';
import { detectProtector } from '../lib/detect.js';
import { protectorFamily } from '../lib/protector-heuristic.js';
import {
  errorResult,
  guarded,
  jsonResult,
  normalizeAddress,
  outcomeResult,
  requireFile,
  sameAddress,
} from '../lib/result.js';
import { binaryPath, hexAddress } from '../lib/schemas.js';

const NEEDS_DISASSEMBLY =
  ' This analysis needs the disassembly layer of the engine; revenant_lift can still produce ' +
  'IR for the function, and revenant_get_strings / revenant_get_sections work without it.';

const MAX_INTERESTING_STRINGS = 100;
const MAX_EXPORT_SAMPLE = 50;

interface StageReport {
  stage: string;
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

const INTERESTING: ReadonlyArray<{ category: string; pattern: RegExp }> = [
  { category: 'url', pattern: /\b[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]{1,10}:\/\/[^\s"'<>]{4,}/i },
  { category: 'ip', pattern: /\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b/ },
  { category: 'registry', pattern: /\b(?:HKEY_|HKLM|HKCU|SOFTWARE\\|SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet)/i },
  { category: 'device', pattern: /\\(?:Device|DosDevices|\?\?|Driver)\\/ },
  { category: 'path', pattern: /^(?:[A-Za-z]:\\|\\\\|\/(?:etc|usr|var|tmp|home)\/)/ },
  { category: 'module', pattern: /\.(?:dll|sys|exe|pdb|so|dylib)\b/i },
];

function pickInteresting(strings: ExtractedString[]): Array<ExtractedString & { category: string }> {
  const out: Array<ExtractedString & { category: string }> = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const s of strings) {
    if (out.length >= MAX_INTERESTING_STRINGS) break;
    if (seen.has(s.value)) continue;
    const hit = INTERESTING.find((rule) => rule.pattern.test(s.value));
    if (!hit) continue;
    seen.add(s.value);
    out.push({ ...s, category: hit.category });
  }
  return out;
}

function summarizeBinary(binary: BinaryInfo): Record<string, unknown> {
  const byLibrary = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const imp of binary.imports ?? []) {
    byLibrary.set(imp.library, (byLibrary.get(imp.library) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const exports = binary.exports ?? [];
  return {
    binary: {
      path: binary.path,
      format: binary.format,
      architecture: binary.architecture,
      bits: binary.bits,
      endianness: binary.endianness,
      entryPoint: binary.entryPoint,
      imageBase: binary.imageBase,
      size: binary.size,
      sha256: binary.hash,
    },
    sections: binary.sections ?? [],
    imports: {
      total: (binary.imports ?? []).length,
      libraries: [...byLibrary.entries()]
        .map(([library, count]) => ({ library, count }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count),
    },
    exports: {
      total: exports.length,
      sample: exports.slice(0, MAX_EXPORT_SAMPLE),
      truncated: exports.length > MAX_EXPORT_SAMPLE,
    },
  };
}

function nextSteps(protector: ProtectorDetection | undefined, engines: string[]): string[] {
  const steps: string[] = [];
  if (protector && protector.kind !== 'none' && protector.kind !== 'unknown') {
    steps.push(
      engines.length > 0
        ? `Protected with ${protector.kind}: run revenant_devirt (engine: ${engines.join(' or ')}) before lifting.`
        : `Protected with ${protector.kind}, but no registered devirt engine targets it (see revenant_list_devirt_engines).`,
    );
    steps.push(
      'For dynamic unpacking, use a hardened VM: revenant_vm_create, revenant_vm_stealth_test, then revenant_vm_upload / revenant_vm_execute.',
    );
  } else if (protector?.kind === 'unknown') {
    steps.push(
      'The binary looks packed but the protector was not identified; inspect revenant_get_sections and consider dynamic analysis in a hardened VM.',
    );
  } else {
    steps.push('No protector fingerprinted: revenant_lift can be run directly on this binary.');
  }
  steps.push('Use revenant_get_strings with "contains" to search the full string table.');
  return steps;
}

/** Triage pipeline assembled from primitive engine calls. */
async function composeAnalysis(bridge: EngineBridge, path: string): Promise<CallToolResult> {
  const stages: StageReport[] = [];

  const binary = await bridge.loadBinary(path);
  if (!binary.ok) return errorResult(binary.error);
  stages.push({ stage: 'load', ok: true });

  const [protector, strings, engines] = await Promise.all([
    detectProtector(bridge, path),
    bridge.getStrings(path, { minLength: 5 }),
    bridge.listDevirtEngines(),
  ]);
  stages.push(
    protector.ok ? { stage: 'protector', ok: true } : { stage: 'protector', ok: false, error: protector.error },
  );
  stages.push(
    strings.ok ? { stage: 'strings', ok: true } : { stage: 'strings', ok: false, error: strings.error },
  );

  const detection = protector.ok ? protector.data : undefined;
  const family = detection ? protectorFamily(detection.kind) : [];
  const matching = engines.ok
    ? engines.data.filter((e) => e.protectors.some((p) => family.includes(p))).map((e) => e.name)
    : [];

  const all = strings.ok ? (strings.data ?? []) : [];
  const byEncoding: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const s of all) byEncoding[s.encoding] = (byEncoding[s.encoding] ?? 0) + 1;

  return jsonResult({
    ...summarizeBinary(binary.data),
    protector: detection ?? null,
    strings: {
      total: all.length,
      minLength: 5,
      byEncoding,
      interesting: pickInteresting(all),
    },
    stages,
    nextSteps: nextSteps(detection, matching),
  });
}

export function registerAnalysisTools(server: McpServer, engine: RevenantEngine): void {
  const bridge = new EngineBridge(engine);

  server.tool(
    'revenant_get_cfg',
    'Get the control-flow graph of one function. Returns a ControlFlowGraph: function ' +
      'address, optional name, entry block id and blocks[] (id, start, end, instructionCount, ' +
      'successors, predecessors). Use it to understand branching, find loops, or spot ' +
      'flattened/virtualized dispatchers (one block with a very large number of successors).',
    {
      path: binaryPath,
      functionAddress: hexAddress.describe(
        'Virtual address of the function entry in hex, e.g. "0x140001000".',
      ),
    },
    guarded(async ({ path, functionAddress }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);
      const result = await bridge.getCfg(file.data, normalizeAddress(functionAddress));
      if (!result.ok) {
        return errorResult(result.unsupported ? result.error + NEEDS_DISASSEMBLY : result.error);
      }
      return jsonResult(result.data);
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_get_xrefs',
    'Get cross-references for an address. direction "to" lists code/data that references the ' +
      'address (who calls or reads it), "from" lists what the address itself references, ' +
      '"both" (default) returns both. Returns CrossReference[] of { from, to, kind } where ' +
      'kind is call, jump, data, read or write.',
    {
      path: binaryPath,
      address: hexAddress.describe('Virtual address to query in hex, e.g. "0x140003f20".'),
      direction: z
        .enum(['to', 'from', 'both'])
        .optional()
        .describe('"to" = references to the address, "from" = references made by it, "both" (default).'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ path, address, direction }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);

      const target = normalizeAddress(address);
      const dir = direction ?? 'both';
      const result = await bridge.getXrefs(file.data, target, dir);
      if (!result.ok) {
        return errorResult(result.unsupported ? result.error + NEEDS_DISASSEMBLY : result.error);
      }
      // Enforce the requested direction even if the engine returned both.
      const refs = (result.data ?? []).filter(
        (ref) =>
          dir === 'both' ||
          (dir === 'to' ? sameAddress(ref.to, target) : sameAddress(ref.from, target)),
      );
      return jsonResult(refs);
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_full_analysis',
    'Run the complete static triage pipeline on a binary in one call: parse the container, ' +
      'fingerprint the protector, extract strings, and summarize. Returns binary metadata, ' +
      'sections, an import summary per library, an export sample, the protector verdict with ' +
      'evidence, string statistics with notable strings (URLs, IPs, registry keys, device ' +
      'names, paths, module names), a per-stage status list and suggested next steps. Best ' +
      'first call on an unknown sample. Nothing is executed.',
    { path: binaryPath },
    guarded(async ({ path }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);

      const native = await bridge.analyze(file.data);
      if (native.ok) return jsonResult(native.data);
      if (!native.unsupported) return outcomeResult(native);
      return composeAnalysis(bridge, file.data);
    }),
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * MCP tools for binary loading and static inspection.
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import type { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import type { ExtractedString } from '@revenant/shared';
import { EngineBridge } from '../lib/engine-bridge.js';
import { detectProtector } from '../lib/detect.js';
import { errorResult, guarded, jsonResult, outcomeResult, requireFile } from '../lib/result.js';
import { binaryPath } from '../lib/schemas.js';

export function registerBinaryTools(server: McpServer, engine: RevenantEngine): void {
  const bridge = new EngineBridge(engine);

  server.tool(
    'revenant_load_binary',
    'Load and parse a binary file (PE/ELF/Mach-O). Returns normalized metadata: format, ' +
      'architecture, bitness, endianness, entry point, image base, sections, imports, exports, ' +
      'SHA-256 and size. Start here before any other analysis of a new file.',
    { path: binaryPath },
    guarded(async ({ path }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);
      return outcomeResult(await bridge.loadBinary(file.data));
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_detect_protector',
    'Detect obfuscation/protection on a binary (VMProtect, Themida, WinLicense, Enigma). ' +
      'Returns { kind, confidence (0..1), version?, evidence[] }. kind "none" means no known ' +
      'protector was fingerprinted; "unknown" means the file looks packed but the family was ' +
      'not identified. Read the evidence list to judge how the verdict was reached. Use the ' +
      'result to pick an engine for revenant_devirt.',
    { path: binaryPath },
    guarded(async ({ path }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);
      return outcomeResult(await detectProtector(bridge, file.data));
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_get_strings',
    'Extract printable strings from a binary with their file offsets/addresses and encoding. ' +
      'Results are paginated: the response is { total, offset, returned, truncated, strings[] }. ' +
      'Use "contains" to search (case-insensitive substring) instead of paging through ' +
      'everything, and raise minLength to cut noise on packed files.',
    {
      path: binaryPath,
      minLength: z
        .number()
        .int()
        .min(1)
        .max(1024)
        .optional()
        .describe('Minimum string length in characters (default 4).'),
      encoding: z
        .enum(['ascii', 'utf-8', 'utf-16', 'all'])
        .optional()
        .describe('Restrict to one encoding: "ascii", "utf-8", "utf-16", or "all" (default).'),
      contains: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .optional()
        .describe('Only return strings containing this text (case-insensitive).'),
      offset: z.number().int().min(0).optional().describe('Number of matches to skip (default 0).'),
      limit: z
        .number()
        .int()
        .min(1)
        .max(5000)
        .optional()
        .describe('Maximum number of strings to return (default 500, max 5000).'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ path, minLength, encoding, contains, offset, limit }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);

      const min = minLength ?? 4;
      const wanted = encoding && encoding !== 'all' ? encoding : undefined;
      const result = await bridge.getStrings(file.data, {
        minLength: min,
        ...(wanted ? { encodings: [wanted] } : {}),
      });
      if (!result.ok) return errorResult(result.error);

      // Re-apply the filters here so the contract holds even if the engine
      // ignores an option.
      const needle = contains?.toLowerCase();
      const matches: ExtractedString[] = (result.data ?? []).filter(
        (s) =>
          s.value.length >= min &&
          (!wanted || s.encoding === wanted) &&
          (!needle || s.value.toLowerCase().includes(needle)),
      );

      const start = offset ?? 0;
      const page = matches.slice(start, start + (limit ?? 500));
      return jsonResult({
        total: matches.length,
        offset: start,
        returned: page.length,
        truncated: start + page.length < matches.length,
        strings: page,
      });
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_get_sections',
    'List the sections/segments of a binary: name, virtual address and size, raw file offset ' +
      'and size, read/write/execute flags, and entropy when available. Useful for spotting ' +
      'packer sections (odd names, writable+executable, raw size 0, high entropy).',
    { path: binaryPath },
    guarded(async ({ path }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);
      return outcomeResult(await bridge.loadBinary(file.data), (info) => info.sections ?? []);
    }),
  );
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/tools/devirt.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * MCP tools for devirtualizing protected binaries.
 */

import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import type { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import { EngineBridge } from '../lib/engine-bridge.js';
import { detectProtector } from '../lib/detect.js';
import { protectorFamily } from '../lib/protector-heuristic.js';
import { errorResult, guarded, jsonResult, outcomeResult, requireFile } from '../lib/result.js';
import { binaryPath } from '../lib/schemas.js';

/**
 * Choose a devirt engine from the detected protector. Returns undefined when
 * nothing matches, leaving the decision to the core engine's own auto-detect.
 */
async function selectEngine(bridge: EngineBridge, path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const [detection, engines] = await Promise.all([
    detectProtector(bridge, path),
    bridge.listDevirtEngines(),
  ]);
  if (!detection.ok || !engines.ok) return undefined;
  const kind = detection.data.kind;
  if (kind === 'none' || kind === 'unknown') return undefined;
  const family = protectorFamily(kind);
  return engines.data.find((e) => e.protectors.some((p) => family.includes(p)))?.name;
}

export function registerDevirtTools(server: McpServer, engine: RevenantEngine): void {
  const bridge = new EngineBridge(engine);

  server.tool(
    'revenant_devirt',
    'Devirtualize a binary protected by a code-virtualizing protector (VMProtect via NoVmp, ' +
      'Themida/WinLicense via unthemidator). If "engine" is omitted the protector is detected ' +
      'and a matching engine is chosen. Returns a DevirtResult: plugin, success, outputPath, ' +
      'devirtualizedFunctions, protector, durationMs, warnings, errors. Check "success" and ' +
      '"errors": a completed call can still report a failed run. This can run for many ' +
      'minutes and requires the native tool behind the engine to be installed on the host.',
    {
      path: binaryPath,
      engine: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .optional()
        .describe(
          'Devirt engine name from revenant_list_devirt_engines. Omit to auto-select from the detected protector.',
        ),
      outputPath: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .optional()
        .describe(
          'Host path for the recovered output. Defaults to a path next to the input chosen by the engine.',
        ),
      options: z
        .record(z.unknown())
        .optional()
        .describe(
          'Engine-specific options passed through unchanged, e.g. { "vmEntries": ["0x140012340"], ' +
            '"timeoutMs": 900000, "extraArgs": ["--flag"] }.',
        ),
    },
    guarded(async ({ path, engine: requested, outputPath, options }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);

      const chosen = requested ?? (await selectEngine(bridge, file.data));
      const result = await bridge.devirt(file.data, chosen, {
        ...(options ?? {}),
        outputPath: outputPath ? resolve(outputPath) : undefined,
      });
      if (!result.ok) {
        const hint =
          requested === undefined && chosen === undefined
            ? ' No engine could be matched to this binary automatically; run ' +
              'revenant_detect_protector and pass "engine" explicitly.'
            : '';
        return errorResult(hint ? `${result.error.replace(/\.?\s*$/, '.')}${hint}` : result.error);
      }
      return jsonResult(result.data);
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_list_devirt_engines',
    'List the devirtualization engines (plugins) registered with the engine and the protector ' +
      'families each one targets. Returns { engines: [{ name, protectors[] }] }; pass a name ' +
      'as "engine" to revenant_devirt.',
    guarded(async () => outcomeResult(await bridge.listDevirtEngines(), (engines) => ({ engines }))),
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * MCP tools for lifting binaries to intermediate representation.
 */

import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import type { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import { EngineBridge } from '../lib/engine-bridge.js';
import {
  errorResult,
  guarded,
  jsonResult,
  normalizeAddress,
  outcomeResult,
  requireFile,
} from '../lib/result.js';
import { binaryPath, hexAddress } from '../lib/schemas.js';

/** Inline IR larger than this is cut in the response; the full text needs outputPath. */
const MAX_INLINE_IR_CHARS = 60_000;

export function registerLiftTools(server: McpServer, engine: RevenantEngine): void {
  const bridge = new EngineBridge(engine);

  server.tool(
    'revenant_lift',
    'Lift a binary to LLVM IR using a lifter backend (default: the first registered, normally ' +
      'rev.ng). Returns a LiftResult: tool, irFormat, irPath or inline ir, functionsLifted, ' +
      'durationMs, warnings. Lifting a whole binary can take minutes; pass options.functions ' +
      'to lift only specific functions, and outputPath to write the IR to disk instead of ' +
      `returning it inline (inline IR over ${MAX_INLINE_IR_CHARS} characters is truncated). ` +
      'Requires the native tool behind the lifter to be installed on the host.',
    {
      path: binaryPath,
      outputPath: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .optional()
        .describe('Host path to write the generated IR to. Recommended for anything but tiny inputs.'),
      lifter: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .optional()
        .describe('Lifter backend name from revenant_list_lifters. Omit for the default.'),
      options: z
        .object({
          functions: z
            .array(hexAddress)
            .max(4096)
            .optional()
            .describe('Limit lifting to these function addresses (hex).'),
        })
        .optional()
        .describe('Lifting options.'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ path, outputPath, lifter, options }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(path);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);

      const result = await bridge.lift(file.data, lifter, {
        outputPath: outputPath ? resolve(outputPath) : undefined,
        functions: options?.functions?.map(normalizeAddress),
      });
      if (!result.ok) return errorResult(result.error);

      const lifted = result.data;
      if (typeof lifted?.ir === 'string' && lifted.ir.length > MAX_INLINE_IR_CHARS) {
        return jsonResult({
          ...lifted,
          ir: lifted.ir.slice(0, MAX_INLINE_IR_CHARS),
          irTruncated: true,
          irTotalChars: lifted.ir.length,
          note: 'Inline IR was truncated. Re-run with outputPath to get the complete IR on disk.',
        });
      }
      return jsonResult(lifted);
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_list_lifters',
    'List the lifter backends registered with the engine. Returns { lifters: string[] }; pass ' +
      'one of the names as "lifter" to revenant_lift. A listed lifter still needs its native ' +
      'tool installed on the host to run.',
    guarded(async () => outcomeResult(await bridge.listLifters(), (lifters) => ({ lifters }))),
  );
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/tools/project.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * MCP tools for analysis-project management.
 *
 * A project pins one target binary and owns its analysis database. When the
 * engine manages projects itself (list/open/delete by id) these tools delegate
 * to it. Otherwise the engine only knows how to open the project that sits
 * next to a binary, and the MCP server keeps the id -> project index.
 */

import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { basename, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import type { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import { EngineBridge } from '../lib/engine-bridge.js';
import { ProjectRegistry } from '../lib/project-registry.js';
import { describeError, errorResult, guarded, jsonResult, outcomeResult, requireFile } from '../lib/result.js';
import { binaryPath } from '../lib/schemas.js';

export interface ProjectToolOptions {
  /** Override the project index location (defaults to ~/.revenant/mcp-projects.json). */
  registryPath?: string;
}

const projectId = z
  .string()
  .min(1)
  .max(128)
  .describe('Project id as returned by revenant_project_create or revenant_project_list.');

export function registerProjectTools(
  server: McpServer,
  engine: RevenantEngine,
  options: ProjectToolOptions = {},
): void {
  const bridge = new EngineBridge(engine);
  const registry = new ProjectRegistry(options.registryPath);

  server.tool(
    'revenant_project_create',
    'Create an analysis project for a binary. A project pins the target file (by path and ' +
      'SHA-256) and owns a database where analysis results persist between sessions. Returns ' +
      'ProjectInfo: id, name, binaryPath, binaryHash, createdAt, updatedAt, databasePath. ' +
      'Creating a project for a binary that already has one returns the existing project.',
    {
      name: z.string().min(1).max(128).describe('Human-readable project name.'),
      binaryPath: binaryPath.describe('Path to the target binary on the host.'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ name, binaryPath: target }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(target);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(file.error);

      if (bridge.hasNativeProjects) {
        return outcomeResult(await bridge.projectCreate(name, file.data));
      }
      const opened = await bridge.projectOpenForBinary(file.data, { name });
      if (!opened.ok) return errorResult(opened.error);
      await registry.upsert(opened.data);
      return jsonResult(opened.data);
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_project_list',
    'List known analysis projects, most recently used first. Returns ProjectInfo[] (id, ' +
      'name, binaryPath, binaryHash, createdAt, updatedAt, databasePath).',
    guarded(async () => {
      if (bridge.hasNativeProjects) return outcomeResult(await bridge.projectList());
      return jsonResult(await registry.list());
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_project_open',
    'Open an existing analysis project by id and return its ProjectInfo. Fails if the ' +
      'project is unknown or its binary is no longer at the recorded path.',
    { id: projectId },
    guarded(async ({ id }) => {
      if (bridge.hasNativeProjects) return outcomeResult(await bridge.projectOpenById(id));

      const known = await registry.get(id);
      if (!known) {
        return errorResult(`No project with id '${id}'. Use revenant_project_list to see known projects.`);
      }
      const file = await requireFile(known.binaryPath);
      if (!file.ok) {
        return errorResult(`Project '${known.name}' points at a binary that is unavailable. ${file.error}`);
      }
      const opened = await bridge.projectOpenForBinary(file.data, {
        name: known.name,
        directory: known.databasePath ? dirname(known.databasePath) : undefined,
      });
      if (!opened.ok) return errorResult(opened.error);
      await registry.upsert(opened.data);
      return jsonResult(opened.data);
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_project_delete',
    'Delete an analysis project by id. By default this only removes the project from the ' +
      'index and leaves its analysis database on disk; set deleteData to also remove the ' +
      'project directory (irreversible). The target binary itself is never touched. ' +
      'Returns { success }.',
    {
      id: projectId,
      deleteData: z
        .boolean()
        .optional()
        .describe('Also delete the on-disk project directory with its analysis database (default false).'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ id, deleteData }) => {
      if (bridge.hasNativeProjects) return outcomeResult(await bridge.projectDelete(id));

      const removed = await registry.remove(id);
      if (!removed) {
        return errorResult(`No project with id '${id}'. Use revenant_project_list to see known projects.`);
      }
      if (!deleteData) return jsonResult({ success: true, dataDeleted: false });

      // Only ever remove a directory that is recognizably a REVENANT project dir.
      const directory = removed.databasePath ? dirname(removed.databasePath) : '';
      if (!directory || !basename(directory).toLowerCase().endsWith('.revenant')) {
        return jsonResult({
          success: true,
          dataDeleted: false,
          note: `Project removed from the index. Its data directory was left in place because it is not a '.revenant' directory: ${directory || '(unknown)'}`,
        });
      }
      try {
        await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
      } catch (err) {
        return jsonResult({
          success: true,
          dataDeleted: false,
          note: `Project removed from the index, but its data directory could not be deleted: ${describeError(err)}`,
        });
      }
      return jsonResult({ success: true, dataDeleted: true, directory });
    }),
  );
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/tools/runtime.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * MCP tools for automated runtime analysis inside hardened VMs.
 *
 * These tools orchestrate the full dynamic-analysis lifecycle: upload a sample
 * into the VM, execute it, monitor processes, dump loaded drivers and process
 * memory to capture decrypted content, and download everything to the host for
 * further static analysis. Everything runs inside the VM, never on the host.
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import type { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import { EngineBridge } from '../lib/engine-bridge.js';
import { errorResult, guarded, outcomeResult, requireFile } from '../lib/result.js';
import { vmName } from '../lib/schemas.js';

export function registerRuntimeTools(server: McpServer, engine: RevenantEngine): void {
  const bridge = new EngineBridge(engine);

  server.tool(
    'revenant_runtime_analyze',
    'Run a fully automated runtime analysis session inside a hardened VM. ' +
      'Uploads the sample, executes it (or loads it as a kernel driver), monitors processes ' +
      'during execution, then dumps all loaded kernel drivers and process memory to capture ' +
      'decrypted content. All artifacts are downloaded to the host output directory for further ' +
      'static analysis. Optionally snapshots the VM before and restores after, so the same ' +
      'clean VM can be reused. Returns a RuntimeAnalysisResult with all collected artifacts, ' +
      'observed processes, and execution output.',
    {
      vmName: vmName.describe('Name of a running hardened VM to use for analysis.'),
      samplePath: z.string().min(1).describe('Host path to the sample binary to analyze.'),
      outputDir: z.string().min(1).describe('Host directory to store collected artifacts (dumps, logs, report).'),
      guestSamplePath: z
        .string()
        .optional()
        .describe('Where to place the sample inside the guest (default: C:\\revenant\\samples\\<filename>).'),
      sampleArgs: z
        .array(z.string())
        .optional()
        .describe('Command-line arguments to pass when executing the sample.'),
      executionTimeMs: z
        .number()
        .int()
        .min(5000)
        .max(600000)
        .optional()
        .describe('How long (ms) to let the sample run before collecting artifacts (default: 30000).'),
      isDriver: z
        .boolean()
        .optional()
        .describe('Load as a kernel driver (.sys) instead of executing as a usermode process (default: false).'),
      dumpDrivers: z
        .boolean()
        .optional()
        .describe('Dump all loaded non-system kernel driver images after execution to capture decrypted state (default: true).'),
      dumpProcessMemory: z
        .boolean()
        .optional()
        .describe('Dump loaded modules from observed processes to capture runtime-decrypted DLLs (default: true).'),
      snapshotBefore: z
        .boolean()
        .optional()
        .describe('Take a VM snapshot before execution so the analysis can be repeated from a clean state (default: true).'),
      restoreAfter: z
        .boolean()
        .optional()
        .describe('Restore the VM to its pre-execution snapshot after collection (default: true).'),
      preCommands: z
        .array(z.string())
        .optional()
        .describe('Guest commands to run before the sample (e.g. disable Defender, enable test signing).'),
      postCommands: z
        .array(z.string())
        .optional()
        .describe('Guest commands to run after collection (e.g. collect event logs).'),
      additionalFiles: z
        .array(z.object({
          localPath: z.string().min(1).describe('Host path to the file.'),
          guestPath: z.string().min(1).describe('Destination path inside the guest.'),
        }))
        .optional()
        .describe('Additional files to upload before running the sample (DLLs, configs, tools).'),
    },
    guarded(async (args) => {
      const file = await requireFile(args.samplePath);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(`samplePath: ${file.error}`);

      // Validate additional files exist on host.
      if (args.additionalFiles) {
        for (const f of args.additionalFiles) {
          const check = await requireFile(f.localPath);
          if (!check.ok) return errorResult(`additionalFiles: ${check.error}`);
        }
      }

      return outcomeResult(
        await bridge.vmRuntimeAnalysis({
          vmName: args.vmName,
          samplePath: file.data,
          outputDir: args.outputDir,
          guestSamplePath: args.guestSamplePath,
          sampleArgs: args.sampleArgs,
          executionTimeMs: args.executionTimeMs,
          isDriver: args.isDriver,
          dumpDrivers: args.dumpDrivers ?? true,
          dumpProcessMemory: args.dumpProcessMemory ?? true,
          snapshotBefore: args.snapshotBefore ?? true,
          restoreAfter: args.restoreAfter ?? true,
          preCommands: args.preCommands,
          postCommands: args.postCommands,
          additionalFiles: args.additionalFiles,
        }),
      );
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_runtime_dump_drivers',
    'Dump all currently loaded non-system kernel driver images from a running VM to the host. ' +
      'Captures the on-disk state of each driver, which for packed/encrypted drivers will be the ' +
      'decrypted version that the OS loaded. Returns the list of dumped drivers with paths and hashes.',
    {
      vmName: vmName.describe('Name of the running VM.'),
      outputDir: z.string().min(1).describe('Host directory to save driver dumps.'),
    },
    guarded(async (args) => {
      // This calls the runtime analysis pipeline with only driver dumping enabled.
      return outcomeResult(
        await bridge.vmRuntimeAnalysis({
          vmName: args.vmName,
          samplePath: '', // No sample — just dump existing state.
          outputDir: args.outputDir,
          dumpDrivers: true,
          dumpProcessMemory: false,
          snapshotBefore: false,
          restoreAfter: false,
          executionTimeMs: 5000,
        }),
        (result) => ({
          drivers: result.artifacts.filter((a) => a.kind === 'driver-dump'),
          count: result.artifacts.filter((a) => a.kind === 'driver-dump').length,
        }),
      );
    }),
  );
}
```

`packages/mcp/src/tools/vm.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * MCP tools for managing hardened analysis VMs and working inside them.
 *
 * Lifecycle tools (create/start/stop/list/status) drive the engine's VM
 * manager. Guest tools (execute/upload/stealth test/driver load/process
 * monitor) need the in-guest agent; when the engine build has no guest support
 * they return an explicit "not supported" error instead of pretending.
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import type { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import type { CallToolResult } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js';
import type { RevenantEngine } from '@revenant/core';
import { EngineBridge } from '../lib/engine-bridge.js';
import { errorResult, guarded, jsonResult, outcomeResult, requireFile } from '../lib/result.js';
import { vmName } from '../lib/schemas.js';

const GUEST_NOTE =
  'The VM must be running with the REVENANT guest agent reachable (see revenant_vm_status).';

/** Guest driver paths we are willing to splice into an `sc.exe` command line. */
const SAFE_GUEST_DRIVER_PATH = /^[A-Za-z]:\\(?:[\w .()-]+\\)*[\w .()-]+\.sys$/;
const SAFE_PROCESS_NAME = /^[\w .-]{1,128}$/;

/** Encode a PowerShell script for `-EncodedCommand` (UTF-16LE base64), avoiding all quoting. */
function encodePowerShell(script: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(script, 'utf16le').toString('base64');
}

function serviceNameFor(driverPath: string): string {
  const base = driverPath.split('\\').pop() ?? 'driver.sys';
  const stem = base.replace(/\.sys$/i, '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '_');
  return `rvnt_${stem}`.slice(0, 64);
}

/** Load a kernel driver through plain guest command execution (`sc.exe`). */
async function loadDriverViaExec(
  bridge: EngineBridge,
  vm: string,
  driverPath: string,
): Promise<CallToolResult> {
  if (!SAFE_GUEST_DRIVER_PATH.test(driverPath)) {
    return errorResult(
      'driverPath must be an absolute Windows guest path to a .sys file using only letters, ' +
        'digits, spaces, dots, dashes, underscores and parentheses (e.g. C:\\analysis\\sample.sys).',
    );
  }
  const service = serviceNameFor(driverPath);

  const created = await bridge.vmExecute(
    vm,
    `sc.exe create ${service} type= kernel start= demand binPath= "${driverPath}"`,
  );
  if (!created.ok) return errorResult(created.error);
  // 1073 = ERROR_SERVICE_EXISTS: a previous load registered it; just start it.
  if (created.data.exitCode !== 0 && created.data.exitCode !== 1073) {
    return jsonResult({
      success: false,
      service,
      stage: 'create',
      exitCode: created.data.exitCode,
      output: `${created.data.stdout}\n${created.data.stderr}`.trim(),
    });
  }

  const started = await bridge.vmExecute(vm, `sc.exe start ${service}`);
  if (!started.ok) return errorResult(started.error);
  // 1056 = ERROR_SERVICE_ALREADY_RUNNING.
  const success = started.data.exitCode === 0 || started.data.exitCode === 1056;
  return jsonResult({
    success,
    service,
    ...(success ? {} : { stage: 'start', exitCode: started.data.exitCode }),
    output: `${started.data.stdout}\n${started.data.stderr}`.trim(),
  });
}

/** Snapshot a guest process through plain guest command execution (PowerShell). */
async function monitorProcessViaExec(
  bridge: EngineBridge,
  vm: string,
  processName: string,
): Promise<CallToolResult> {
  if (!SAFE_PROCESS_NAME.test(processName)) {
    return errorResult(
      'processName may contain only letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores.',
    );
  }
  const name = processName.replace(/\.exe$/i, '');
  const script = [
    `$p = Get-Process -Name '${name}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1`,
    `if (-not $p) { Write-Output '{"found":false}'; exit 0 }`,
    `$m = @(); try { $m = @($p.Modules | ForEach-Object { $_.FileName }) } catch {}`,
    `[pscustomobject]@{ found = $true; pid = $p.Id; threads = $p.Threads.Count; modules = $m } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`,
  ].join('\n');

  const run = await bridge.vmExecute(
    vm,
    `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand ${encodePowerShell(script)}`,
  );
  if (!run.ok) return errorResult(run.error);

  let parsed: unknown;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(run.data.stdout.trim());
  } catch {
    return errorResult(
      `Could not read process information from the guest (exit code ${run.data.exitCode}): ` +
        (run.data.stderr.trim() || run.data.stdout.trim() || 'no output'),
    );
  }
  const info = parsed as { found?: boolean; pid?: number; threads?: number; modules?: unknown };
  if (!info.found) {
    return errorResult(`No process named '${processName}' is running in VM '${vm}'.`);
  }
  return jsonResult({
    pid: info.pid ?? -1,
    modules: Array.isArray(info.modules) ? info.modules.filter((m) => typeof m === 'string') : [],
    threads: info.threads ?? 0,
  });
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null;
}

export function registerVmTools(server: McpServer, engine: RevenantEngine): void {
  const bridge = new EngineBridge(engine);

  // --- Lifecycle ----------------------------------------------------------

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_create',
    'Create a new isolated analysis VM, by default with anti-VM-detection hardening applied ' +
      '(spoofed SMBIOS, disk and NIC identity, hypervisor signature masking) so protected ' +
      'samples behave as they would on real hardware. Returns the VmInfo of the new VM (state ' +
      'will be "poweroff"). Requires the hypervisor used by the engine to be installed on the ' +
      'host. An OS still has to be installed from the ISO before guest tools can be used.',
    {
      name: vmName.describe('Unique name for the new VM, e.g. "revenant-win10".'),
      isoPath: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .optional()
        .describe('Host path to an OS installer ISO to attach as install media.'),
      memoryMb: z
        .number()
        .int()
        .min(1024)
        .max(262144)
        .optional()
        .describe('Guest RAM in MiB (default 4096). Under 4096 is itself a VM-detection signal.'),
      cpuCount: z
        .number()
        .int()
        .min(1)
        .max(64)
        .optional()
        .describe('Number of virtual CPUs (default 2). A single CPU is a VM-detection signal.'),
      os: z
        .string()
        .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/)
        .optional()
        .describe('Guest OS label (default "windows-10-x64").'),
      diskMb: z
        .number()
        .int()
        .min(8192)
        .optional()
        .describe('Virtual disk size in MiB. Small disks (<60 GB) are a VM-detection signal.'),
      harden: z
        .boolean()
        .optional()
        .describe('Apply anti-detection hardening after creation (default true).'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ name, isoPath, memoryMb, cpuCount, os, diskMb, harden }) => {
      let iso: string | undefined;
      if (isoPath !== undefined) {
        const file = await requireFile(isoPath);
        if (!file.ok) return errorResult(`isoPath: ${file.error}`);
        iso = file.data;
      }
      return outcomeResult(
        await bridge.vmCreate({
          name,
          os: os ?? 'windows-10-x64',
          isoPath: iso,
          memoryMb: memoryMb ?? 4096,
          cpuCount: cpuCount ?? 2,
          diskMb,
          harden: harden ?? true,
        }),
      );
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_start',
    'Start (boot) an analysis VM headless. Returns its VmInfo after the start request; the ' +
      'state may still be "starting", so poll revenant_vm_status until it is "running" before ' +
      'using guest tools.',
    { name: vmName.describe('Name of the VM to start.') },
    guarded(async ({ name }) => outcomeResult(await bridge.vmStart(name))),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_stop',
    'Stop an analysis VM. By default requests a clean guest shutdown; set force to cut power ' +
      'immediately (unsaved guest state is lost). Returns { success }; if the response also ' +
      'has forceHonored: false, the engine has no hard power-off and did a normal stop.',
    {
      name: vmName.describe('Name of the VM to stop.'),
      force: z
        .boolean()
        .optional()
        .describe('Hard power-off instead of a graceful shutdown (default false).'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ name, force }) => outcomeResult(await bridge.vmStop(name, force ?? false))),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_list',
    'List all analysis VMs known to REVENANT with their state (absent, poweroff, starting, ' +
      'running, paused, stopping, error), OS, CPU count, memory and current snapshot. ' +
      'Returns VmInfo[].',
    guarded(async () => outcomeResult(await bridge.vmList())),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_status',
    'Get the current status of one VM: state, OS type, hardening flag, CPU count, memory and ' +
      'current snapshot. Returns VmInfo.',
    { name: vmName.describe('Name of the VM to query.') },
    guarded(async ({ name }) => outcomeResult(await bridge.vmStatus(name))),
  );

  // --- Display -------------------------------------------------------------

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_start_headed',
    'Start a VM with a visible interactive window (like VirtualBox). The window is an SDL ' +
      'display that the user can click into and control directly with keyboard and mouse. ' +
      'Returns VmInfo plus VNC connection details. Use this when the user needs to interact ' +
      'with the guest manually (install an OS, navigate a UI, etc.).',
    { name: vmName.describe('Name of the VM to start with a display window.') },
    guarded(async ({ name }) => {
      try {
        const info = await engine.vm.start(name, false);
        const display = await engine.vm.display(name);
        return jsonResult({ ...info, display });
      } catch (err) {
        return errorResult(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
      }
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_display',
    'Get the VNC connection info for a VM. Every REVENANT VM runs a VNC server, so the ' +
      'user can connect any time with a VNC viewer to get a live interactive window — even ' +
      'if the VM was started headless. Returns { name, headed, vncAddress, vncPort, vncDisplay }.',
    { name: vmName.describe('Name of the VM to get display info for.') },
    guarded(async ({ name }) => {
      try {
        const display = await engine.vm.display(name);
        return jsonResult(display);
      } catch (err) {
        return errorResult(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
      }
    }),
  );

  // --- Guest operations ---------------------------------------------------

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_execute',
    'Execute a command inside the guest OS of an analysis VM (not on the host) and capture ' +
      'its output. Returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Use this to run samples, tools and ' +
      `inspection commands in the isolated guest. ${GUEST_NOTE}`,
    {
      vmName: vmName.describe('Name of the running VM.'),
      command: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .max(8192)
        .describe('Command line to run in the guest, e.g. "C:\\\\analysis\\\\sample.exe --arg".'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ vmName: vm, command }) => outcomeResult(await bridge.vmExecute(vm, command))),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_upload',
    'Copy a file from the host into the guest filesystem of an analysis VM, e.g. the sample ' +
      `to analyze or a driver to load. Returns { success }. ${GUEST_NOTE}`,
    {
      vmName: vmName.describe('Name of the running VM.'),
      localPath: z.string().min(1).describe('Path of the file on the host.'),
      remotePath: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .describe('Destination path inside the guest, e.g. "C:\\\\analysis\\\\sample.exe".'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ vmName: vm, localPath, remotePath }) => {
      const file = await requireFile(localPath);
      if (!file.ok) return errorResult(`localPath: ${file.error}`);
      return outcomeResult(await bridge.vmUpload(vm, file.data, remotePath));
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_stealth_test',
    'Run VMAware inside the guest to measure how detectable the VM is. Returns { passed, ' +
      'score, detections[] }: detections lists the VM-detection techniques that fired, and ' +
      'passed is true when the guest looks like bare metal. Run this after creating or ' +
      `re-hardening a VM and before detonating VM-aware samples. ${GUEST_NOTE}`,
    { vmName: vmName.describe('Name of the running VM to test.') },
    guarded(async ({ vmName: vm }) => outcomeResult(await bridge.vmStealthTest(vm))),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_load_driver',
    'Load a kernel driver (.sys) inside the guest for dynamic analysis. The driver file must ' +
      'already be in the guest (use revenant_vm_upload first) and the guest must allow it to ' +
      'load (test-signing or a valid signature). Returns { success, loadAddress? }. ' +
      `Never loads anything on the host. ${GUEST_NOTE}`,
    {
      vmName: vmName.describe('Name of the running VM.'),
      driverPath: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .describe('Path of the driver inside the guest, e.g. "C:\\\\analysis\\\\sample.sys".'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ vmName: vm, driverPath }) => {
      const native = await bridge.vmLoadDriver(vm, driverPath);
      if (native.ok) return jsonResult(native.data);
      if (native.unsupported && bridge.canExecuteInGuest) {
        return loadDriverViaExec(bridge, vm, driverPath);
      }
      return errorResult(native.error);
    }),
  );

  server.tool(
    'revenant_vm_monitor_process',
    'Inspect a running process inside the guest by image name. Returns { pid, modules[], ' +
      'threads }: the process id, the paths of its loaded modules and its thread count. Call ' +
      `repeatedly to watch a sample unpack or load modules over time. ${GUEST_NOTE}`,
    {
      vmName: vmName.describe('Name of the running VM.'),
      processName: z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .max(128)
        .describe('Process image name in the guest, e.g. "sample.exe".'),
    },
    guarded(async ({ vmName: vm, processName }) => {
      const native = await bridge.vmMonitorProcess(vm, processName);
      if (native.ok) return jsonResult(native.data);
      if (native.unsupported && bridge.canExecuteInGuest) {
        return monitorProcessViaExec(bridge, vm, processName);
      }
      return errorResult(native.error);
    }),
  );
}
```

`packages/shared/src/events.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * A small, typed event bus shared across REVENANT. Frontends subscribe to
 * engine progress events (analysis started, devirt progress, VM state changes).
 */

import type {
  BinaryInfo,
  DevirtResult,
  LiftResult,
  ProjectInfo,
  RuntimeAnalysisProgress,
  RuntimeAnalysisResult,
  VmInfo,
} from './types.js';

/** The full map of event names to their payloads. */
export interface RevenantEventMap {
  'binary:loaded': BinaryInfo;
  'analysis:started': { projectId: string; stage: string };
  'analysis:progress': { projectId: string; stage: string; percent: number };
  'analysis:completed': { projectId: string; stage: string };
  'lift:completed': LiftResult;
  'devirt:progress': { plugin: string; percent: number; message: string };
  'devirt:completed': DevirtResult;
  'vm:state': VmInfo;
  'project:opened': ProjectInfo;
  'project:closed': { id: string };
  'runtime:progress': RuntimeAnalysisProgress;
  'runtime:completed': RuntimeAnalysisResult;
  error: { source: string; message: string; cause?: unknown };
  log: { level: string; message: string; meta?: Record<string, unknown> };
}

export type RevenantEventName = keyof RevenantEventMap;

export type EventHandler<E extends RevenantEventName> = (
  payload: RevenantEventMap[E],
) => void;

/** Minimal typed event emitter (no Node EventEmitter dependency). */
export class EventBus {
  private handlers: {
    [E in RevenantEventName]?: Set<EventHandler<E>>;
  } = {};

  on<E extends RevenantEventName>(event: E, handler: EventHandler<E>): () => void {
    let set = this.handlers[event] as Set<EventHandler<E>> | undefined;
    if (!set) {
      set = new Set<EventHandler<E>>();
      (this.handlers as Record<E, Set<EventHandler<E>>>)[event] = set;
    }
    set.add(handler);
    return () => this.off(event, handler);
  }

  once<E extends RevenantEventName>(event: E, handler: EventHandler<E>): () => void {
    const off = this.on(event, (payload) => {
      off();
      handler(payload);
    });
    return off;
  }

  off<E extends RevenantEventName>(event: E, handler: EventHandler<E>): void {
    this.handlers[event]?.delete(handler);
  }

  emit<E extends RevenantEventName>(event: E, payload: RevenantEventMap[E]): void {
    const set = this.handlers[event];
    if (!set) return;
    for (const handler of set) {
      try {
        handler(payload);
      } catch {
        // A faulty subscriber must never break the emitter.
      }
    }
  }

  removeAll(): void {
    this.handlers = {};
  }
}
```

`packages/shared/src/logger.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Structured logger shared across REVENANT. Writes JSON lines to stderr by
 * default so stdout stays clean for machine-readable output (CLI json mode,
 * MCP stdio transport).
 */

export type LogLevel = 'trace' | 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error';

const LEVEL_ORDER: Record<LogLevel, number> = {
  trace: 10,
  debug: 20,
  info: 30,
  warn: 40,
  error: 50,
};

export interface LogRecord {
  level: LogLevel;
  time: string;
  name: string;
  message: string;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type LogSink = (record: LogRecord) => void;

/** Default sink: one JSON object per line on stderr. */
export const stderrSink: LogSink = (record) => {
  process.stderr.write(`${JSON.stringify(record)}\n`);
};

export interface LoggerOptions {
  name?: string;
  level?: LogLevel;
  sink?: LogSink;
}

export class Logger {
  private readonly name: string;
  private level: LogLevel;
  private readonly sink: LogSink;

  constructor(options: LoggerOptions = {}) {
    this.name = options.name ?? 'revenant';
    this.level = options.level ?? 'info';
    this.sink = options.sink ?? stderrSink;
  }

  setLevel(level: LogLevel): void {
    this.level = level;
  }

  child(name: string): Logger {
    return new Logger({ name: `${this.name}:${name}`, level: this.level, sink: this.sink });
  }

  private log(level: LogLevel, message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    if (LEVEL_ORDER[level] < LEVEL_ORDER[this.level]) return;
    this.sink({
      level,
      time: new Date().toISOString(),
      name: this.name,
      message,
      ...(meta ? { meta } : {}),
    });
  }

  trace(message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.log('trace', message, meta);
  }

  debug(message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.log('debug', message, meta);
  }

  info(message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.log('info', message, meta);
  }

  warn(message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.log('warn', message, meta);
  }

  error(message: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.log('error', message, meta);
  }
}

/** A shared default logger instance. */
export const logger = new Logger();
```

```ts
/**
 * Shared type definitions used across every REVENANT package.
 *
 * These types are the lingua franca between the core engine and its frontends
 * (CLI, MCP, VS Code). Keep them serializable (JSON-safe) so results can cross
 * process boundaries.
 */

/** Supported executable container formats. */
export type BinaryFormat = 'pe' | 'elf' | 'macho' | 'unknown';

/** Instruction set architectures REVENANT can reason about. */
export type Architecture =
  | 'x86'
  | 'x86_64'
  | 'arm'
  | 'arm64'
  | 'mips'
  | 'riscv'
  | 'unknown';

/** Endianness of a binary. */
export type Endianness = 'little' | 'big';

/** A virtual or file address. Stored as a string to preserve 64-bit precision. */
export type Address = string;

/** A parsed section/segment of a binary image. */
export interface BinarySection {
  name: string;
  virtualAddress: Address;
  virtualSize: number;
  rawOffset: number;
  rawSize: number;
  flags: {
    readable: boolean;
    writable: boolean;
    executable: boolean;
  };
  entropy?: number;
}

/** An imported symbol. */
export interface ImportSymbol {
  library: string;
  name: string;
  address?: Address;
  ordinal?: number;
}

/** An exported symbol. */
export interface ExportSymbol {
  name: string;
  address: Address;
  ordinal?: number;
}

/** High-level, normalized description of a loaded binary. */
export interface BinaryInfo {
  path: string;
  format: BinaryFormat;
  architecture: Architecture;
  endianness: Endianness;
  bits: 32 | 64;
  entryPoint: Address;
  imageBase: Address;
  sections: BinarySection[];
  imports: ImportSymbol[];
  exports: ExportSymbol[];
  /** sha256 of the file contents. */
  hash: string;
  size: number;
}

/** Protection/obfuscation technologies we can detect on a binary. */
export type ProtectorKind =
  | 'vmprotect'
  | 'themida'
  | 'winlicense'
  | 'enigma'
  | 'none'
  | 'unknown';

/** Result of a protector-detection pass. */
export interface ProtectorDetection {
  kind: ProtectorKind;
  confidence: number; // 0..1
  version?: string;
  evidence: string[];
}

/** An extracted string with its location. */
export interface ExtractedString {
  value: string;
  address: Address;
  encoding: 'ascii' | 'utf-8' | 'utf-16';
  section?: string;
}

/** A cross-reference between two addresses. */
export interface CrossReference {
  from: Address;
  to: Address;
  kind: 'call' | 'jump' | 'data' | 'read' | 'write';
}

/** A single basic block in a control-flow graph. */
export interface BasicBlock {
  id: string;
  start: Address;
  end: Address;
  instructionCount: number;
  successors: string[];
  predecessors: string[];
}

/** A control-flow graph for a function. */
export interface ControlFlowGraph {
  function: Address;
  name?: string;
  blocks: BasicBlock[];
  entry: string;
}

/** Lifted intermediate representation output. */
export interface LiftResult {
  tool: string;
  irFormat: 'llvm-ir' | 'revng-ir' | 'custom';
  irPath?: string;
  ir?: string;
  functionsLifted: number;
  durationMs: number;
  warnings: string[];
}

/** Result of a devirtualization run. */
export interface DevirtResult {
  plugin: string;
  success: boolean;
  outputPath?: string;
  devirtualizedFunctions: Address[];
  protector: ProtectorKind;
  durationMs: number;
  warnings: string[];
  errors: string[];
}

/** Status of a managed analysis VM. */
export type VmState =
  | 'absent'
  | 'poweroff'
  | 'starting'
  | 'running'
  | 'paused'
  | 'stopping'
  | 'error';

/** Description of a managed VM. */
export interface VmInfo {
  name: string;
  uuid?: string;
  state: VmState;
  os: string;
  hardened: boolean;
  snapshotName?: string;
  cpuCount: number;
  memoryMb: number;
}

/** Configuration for an automated runtime analysis session. */
export interface RuntimeAnalysisConfig {
  /** Name of the VM to use (must exist and be provisioned). */
  vmName: string;
  /** Host path to the sample binary. */
  samplePath: string;
  /** Where to place the sample inside the guest. */
  guestSamplePath?: string;
  /** Arguments to pass when executing the sample. */
  sampleArgs?: string[];
  /** How long (ms) to let the sample run before collecting artifacts. */
  executionTimeMs?: number;
  /** Whether to load the sample as a kernel driver instead of a usermode exe. */
  isDriver?: boolean;
  /** Dump all loaded driver images from guest memory after execution. */
  dumpDrivers?: boolean;
  /** Dump specific process memory regions after execution. */
  dumpProcessMemory?: boolean;
  /** Take a VM snapshot before execution (allows re-analysis from clean state). */
  snapshotBefore?: boolean;
  /** Restore the VM to its pre-execution snapshot after collection. */
  restoreAfter?: boolean;
  /** Host directory to store collected artifacts (dumps, logs). */
  outputDir: string;
  /** Additional files to upload before running the sample (e.g. DLLs, configs). */
  additionalFiles?: Array<{ localPath: string; guestPath: string }>;
  /** Guest commands to run before the sample (e.g. disable AV, enable test signing). */
  preCommands?: string[];
  /** Guest commands to run after the sample finishes (e.g. collect logs). */
  postCommands?: string[];
}

/** A single dumped artifact from runtime analysis. */
export interface RuntimeArtifact {
  kind: 'driver-dump' | 'process-dump' | 'memory-region' | 'log' | 'sample-output';
  /** Name of the artifact (e.g. driver name, process name). */
  name: string;
  /** Host path where the artifact was saved. */
  hostPath: string;
  /** Guest path it was collected from. */
  guestPath?: string;
  /** Size in bytes. */
  size: number;
  /** SHA-256 of the dumped content. */
  hash?: string;
}

/** Progress update during runtime analysis. */
export interface RuntimeAnalysisProgress {
  stage: 'setup' | 'upload' | 'pre-commands' | 'execute' | 'monitor' | 'dump' | 'download' | 'post-commands' | 'cleanup';
  percent: number;
  message: string;
}

/** Full result of an automated runtime analysis session. */
export interface RuntimeAnalysisResult {
  vmName: string;
  samplePath: string;
  sampleHash: string;
  startedAt: string;
  completedAt: string;
  durationMs: number;
  /** Processes observed during execution. */
  processes: Array<{
    pid: number;
    name: string;
    modules: string[];
    threads: number;
  }>;
  /** Collected artifacts (driver dumps, memory dumps, logs). */
  artifacts: RuntimeArtifact[];
  /** Output from the sample itself. */
  sampleOutput: { stdout: string; stderr: string; exitCode: number };
  /** Output from pre/post commands. */
  commandOutputs: Array<{ command: string; stdout: string; stderr: string; exitCode: number }>;
  /** Snapshot name used (if any). */
  snapshotName?: string;
  /** Whether the VM was restored to pre-execution state. */
  restored: boolean;
  warnings: string[];
}

/** A persisted analysis project/session. */
export interface ProjectInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  binaryPath: string;
  binaryHash: string;
  createdAt: string; // ISO-8601
  updatedAt: string; // ISO-8601
  databasePath: string;
}

/** Generic result envelope used by engine operations. */
export interface Result<T> {
  ok: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
}
```
