`packages/vscode/src/commands/index.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Command registration for the REVENANT extension.
 *
 * Every contributed command is implemented here against the shared
 * {@link RevenantSession} (which owns the engine) and the view providers. Long
 * operations run under `window.withProgress`; engine/tool failures are reported
 * as actionable messages rather than crashing the command.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { VmInfo } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';
import { unwrap } from '../session.js';
import type { SymbolTreeProvider } from '../views/symbols.js';
import type { StringsTreeProvider } from '../views/strings.js';
import type { VmStatusProvider, VmTreeItem } from '../views/vm.js';
import type { DisassemblyProvider } from '../providers/disasm.js';
import type { DecompileProvider } from '../providers/decompile.js';
import { HexEditorProvider } from '../providers/hex.js';

export interface CommandDeps {
  session: RevenantSession;
  symbols: SymbolTreeProvider;
  strings: StringsTreeProvider;
  vm: VmStatusProvider;
  disasm: DisassemblyProvider;
  decompile: DecompileProvider;
  refreshAll: () => void;
}

export function registerCommands(context: vscode.ExtensionContext, deps: CommandDeps): void {
  const { session } = deps;
  const register = (id: string, fn: (...args: never[]) => unknown): void => {
    context.subscriptions.push(vscode.commands.registerCommand(id, fn as (...a: unknown[]) => unknown));
  };

  // --- Binary & analysis --------------------------------------------------

  register('revenant.loadBinary', () => loadBinary(deps));
  register('revenant.analyze', () => analyze(deps));
  register('revenant.lift', () => lift(session));
  register('revenant.devirt', () => devirt(session));

  // --- Navigation ---------------------------------------------------------

  register('revenant.goToAddress', async (address?: string) => {
    const addr = await resolveAddress(session, address);
    if (!addr) return;
    session.select(addr);
    await loadAddressContext(session, addr);
    await deps.disasm.show(addr);
  });
  register('revenant.showDisassembly', async (address?: string) => {
    const addr = await resolveAddress(session, address);
    if (addr) await deps.disasm.show(addr);
  });
  register('revenant.showDecompiler', async (address?: string) => {
    const addr = await resolveAddress(session, address);
    if (addr) await deps.decompile.show(addr);
  });
  register('revenant.openHexEditor', async () => {
    if (!session.binaryPath) {
      void vscode.window.showWarningMessage('REVENANT: load a binary first.');
      return;
    }
    await vscode.commands.executeCommand(
      'vscode.openWith',
      vscode.Uri.file(session.binaryPath),
      HexEditorProvider.viewType,
    );
  });

  // --- View helpers -------------------------------------------------------

  register('revenant.refreshViews', () => {
    deps.refreshAll();
    void deps.vm.reload();
  });
  register('revenant.symbols.toggleSort', () => {
    const mode = deps.symbols.toggleSort();
    void vscode.window.setStatusBarMessage(`REVENANT: symbols sorted by ${mode}`, 2000);
  });
  register('revenant.strings.filter', async () => {
    const value = await vscode.window.showInputBox({
      prompt: 'Filter strings (value, address or encoding). Empty clears.',
      value: deps.strings.currentFilter,
    });
    if (value !== undefined) deps.strings.setFilter(value);
  });

  // --- VM -----------------------------------------------------------------

  register('revenant.vmCreate', () => vmCreate(deps));
  register('revenant.vmStart', (item?: VmTreeItem) => vmStart(deps, item));
  register('revenant.vmStop', (item?: VmTreeItem) => vmStop(deps, item));
  register('revenant.vmStealthTest', (item?: VmTreeItem) => vmStealthTest(deps, item));
  register('revenant.vmExecute', (item?: VmTreeItem) => vmExecute(deps, item));
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Binary
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function loadBinary(deps: CommandDeps): Promise<void> {
  const { session } = deps;
  const uris = await vscode.window.showOpenDialog({
    canSelectMany: false,
    openLabel: 'Load in REVENANT',
    filters: { Executables: ['exe', 'dll', 'elf', 'so', 'bin', 'o'], 'All files': ['*'] },
  });
  if (!uris || uris.length === 0) return;
  const path = uris[0]!.fsPath;

  await vscode.window.withProgress(
    { location: vscode.ProgressLocation.Notification, title: `REVENANT: loading ${base(path)}…` },
    async () => {
      try {
        session.resetPipeline();
        const info = unwrap(await session.engine.loadBinary(path), 'load binary');
        session.setBinary(path, info);
        await vscode.commands.executeCommand('setContext', 'revenant.hasBinary', true);
      } catch (err) {
        session.setStage('load', 'error', msg(err));
        session.recordOperation(`load ${base(path)}`, 'error', msg(err));
        void vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`REVENANT: failed to load binary — ${msg(err)}`);
      }
    },
  );

  if (!session.hasBinary) return;

  const choice = await vscode.window.showInformationMessage(
    `REVENANT: loaded ${base(path)} (${session.binary?.format}/${session.binary?.architecture}).`,
    'Analyze',
    'Open Hex',
  );
  if (choice === 'Analyze') await analyze(deps);
  else if (choice === 'Open Hex') await vscode.commands.executeCommand('revenant.openHexEditor');
}

async function analyze(deps: CommandDeps): Promise<void> {
  const { session } = deps;
  const path = session.binaryPath;
  if (!path) {
    void vscode.window.showWarningMessage('REVENANT: load a binary before analyzing.');
    return;
  }

  await vscode.window.withProgress(
    { location: vscode.ProgressLocation.Notification, title: 'REVENANT: analyzing…', cancellable: false },
    async (progress) => {
      // Full pipeline (persists a project, emits progress events, returns counts).
      try {
        progress.report({ message: 'running analysis pipeline' });
        const report = unwrap(await session.engine.analyze(path), 'analyze');
        session.setProtectors([report.protector]);
        session.recordOperation('analyze', 'ok', `${report.stringCount} strings · ${report.xrefCount} xrefs`);
      } catch (err) {
        session.setStage('protectors', 'error', msg(err));
        session.recordOperation('analyze', 'error', msg(err));
      }

      // Pull the string list for the Strings view (the report only has a count).
      try {
        progress.report({ message: 'extracting strings' });
        session.setStage('strings', 'running');
        const strings = unwrap(await session.engine.getStrings(path), 'extract strings');
        session.setStrings(strings);
        session.setStage('strings', 'done', `${strings.length} strings`);
      } catch (err) {
        session.setStage('strings', 'error', msg(err));
      }
    },
  );

  deps.refreshAll();
}

/**
 * Populate xref + CFG state for a freshly selected address, best-effort: native
 * backends may be unavailable, in which case the views simply stay empty.
 */
async function loadAddressContext(session: RevenantSession, addr: string): Promise<void> {
  const path = session.binaryPath;
  if (!path) return;
  try {
    const refs = unwrap(await session.engine.getXrefs(path, addr), 'xrefs');
    session.addXrefs(refs);
  } catch {
    /* no xref backend — leave the index as-is. */
  }
  try {
    const cfg = unwrap(await session.engine.getCfg(path, addr), 'cfg');
    session.setCfg(cfg);
  } catch {
    /* no CFG backend — leave the graph empty. */
  }
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lift / Devirt
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function lift(session: RevenantSession): Promise<void> {
  const path = session.binaryPath;
  if (!path) {
    void vscode.window.showWarningMessage('REVENANT: load a binary before lifting.');
    return;
  }

  const lifters = session.engine.lifters.list();
  let lifter: string | undefined = lifters[0];
  if (lifters.length > 1) {
    lifter = await vscode.window.showQuickPick(lifters, { title: 'Select a lifter' });
    if (!lifter) return;
  }

  const save = await vscode.window.showSaveDialog({
    title: 'Save lifted IR (optional — cancel to keep IR in memory)',
    saveLabel: 'Write IR',
    filters: { 'LLVM IR': ['ll'], 'All files': ['*'] },
  });

  await vscode.window.withProgress(
    { location: vscode.ProgressLocation.Notification, title: `REVENANT: lifting with ${lifter}…` },
    async () => {
      try {
        session.setStage('lift', 'running');
        const result = unwrap(
          await session.engine.lift(path, {
            ...(lifter ? { lifter } : {}),
            ...(save ? { outputPath: save.fsPath } : {}),
          }),
          'lift',
        );
        session.setLift(result);
        session.setStage('lift', 'done', `${result.functionsLifted} fn · ${result.durationMs} ms`);
        session.recordOperation(`lift (${result.tool})`, 'ok', `${result.functionsLifted} fn`);
        void vscode.window.showInformationMessage(
          `REVENANT: lifted ${result.functionsLifted} function(s) in ${result.durationMs} ms.`,
        );
      } catch (err) {
        session.setStage('lift', 'error', msg(err));
        session.recordOperation('lift', 'error', msg(err));
        void vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`REVENANT: lift failed — ${msg(err)}`);
      }
    },
  );
}

async function devirt(session: RevenantSession): Promise<void> {
  const path = session.binaryPath;
  if (!path) {
    void vscode.window.showWarningMessage('REVENANT: load a binary before devirtualizing.');
    return;
  }

  const plugins = session.engine.devirtRegistry.list();
  const pick = await vscode.window.showQuickPick(['Auto-detect', ...plugins], {
    title: 'Select a devirtualization engine',
  });
  if (!pick) return;
  const pluginName = pick === 'Auto-detect' ? undefined : pick;

  const save = await vscode.window.showSaveDialog({
    title: 'Save recovered binary (optional)',
    saveLabel: 'Write output',
  });

  await vscode.window.withProgress(
    { location: vscode.ProgressLocation.Notification, title: 'REVENANT: devirtualizing…' },
    async () => {
      try {
        session.setStage('devirt', 'running');
        const result = unwrap(
          await session.engine.devirt(path, {
            ...(pluginName ? { plugin: pluginName } : {}),
            ...(save ? { outputPath: save.fsPath } : {}),
          }),
          'devirt',
        );
        session.setDevirt(result);
        session.setStage('devirt', result.success ? 'done' : 'error', `${result.devirtualizedFunctions.length} fn`);
        session.recordOperation(`devirt (${result.plugin})`, result.success ? 'ok' : 'error');
        void vscode.window.showInformationMessage(
          `REVENANT: devirt ${result.success ? 'succeeded' : 'failed'} — ${result.devirtualizedFunctions.length} function(s).`,
        );
      } catch (err) {
        session.setStage('devirt', 'error', msg(err));
        session.recordOperation('devirt', 'error', msg(err));
        void vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`REVENANT: devirt failed — ${msg(err)}`);
      }
    },
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// VM
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function vmCreate(deps: CommandDeps): Promise<void> {
  const { session } = deps;
  const name = await vscode.window.showInputBox({
    title: 'New analysis VM',
    prompt: 'VM name',
    validateInput: (v) => (v.trim() ? undefined : 'Name is required'),
  });
  if (!name) return;

  const osType = await vscode.window.showQuickPick(
    ['Windows10_64', 'Windows11_64', 'WindowsXP', 'Ubuntu_64', 'Debian_64', 'Other'],
    { title: 'Guest OS type (VBoxManage --ostype)' },
  );
  if (!osType) return;

  const memStr = await vscode.window.showInputBox({ title: 'Memory (MB)', value: '4096' });
  if (memStr === undefined) return;
  const cpuStr = await vscode.window.showInputBox({ title: 'vCPU count', value: '2' });
  if (cpuStr === undefined) return;

  await vscode.window.withProgress(
    { location: vscode.ProgressLocation.Notification, title: `REVENANT: creating VM ${name}…` },
    async () => {
      try {
        const info: VmInfo = await session.engine.vm.create({
          name: name.trim(),
          os: osType,
          memoryMb: Number(memStr) || 4096,
          cpuCount: Number(cpuStr) || 2,
          harden: true,
        });
        session.recordOperation(`create VM ${info.name}`, 'ok', `${info.memoryMb} MB · hardened`);
        void vscode.window.showInformationMessage(`REVENANT: created hardened VM "${info.name}".`);
      } catch (err) {
        session.recordOperation(`create VM ${name}`, 'error', msg(err));
        void vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`REVENANT: VM creation failed — ${msg(err)}`);
      }
    },
  );
  await deps.vm.reload();
}

async function vmStart(deps: CommandDeps, item?: VmTreeItem): Promise<void> {
  const name = await resolveVm(deps, item);
  if (!name) return;
  await runVmAction(deps, `starting ${name}`, async () => {
    await deps.session.engine.vm.start(name, true);
    deps.session.recordOperation(`start VM ${name}`, 'ok');
  });
}

async function vmStop(deps: CommandDeps, item?: VmTreeItem): Promise<void> {
  const name = await resolveVm(deps, item);
  if (!name) return;
  await runVmAction(deps, `stopping ${name}`, async () => {
    await deps.session.engine.vm.stop(name);
    deps.session.recordOperation(`stop VM ${name}`, 'ok');
  });
}

async function vmStealthTest(deps: CommandDeps, item?: VmTreeItem): Promise<void> {
  const name = await resolveVm(deps, item);
  if (!name) return;
  const { session } = deps;
  await vscode.window.withProgress(
    { location: vscode.ProgressLocation.Notification, title: `REVENANT: stealth test on ${name}…` },
    async () => {
      try {
        // Report the VM's anti-detection posture from its normalized info. The
        // deep validation (running VMAware inside the guest, scripts/test-vm-stealth)
        // is owned by the VM layer; here we surface whether hardening is applied.
        const vms = unwrap(await session.engine.listVms(), 'list VMs');
        const info = vms.find((v) => v.name === name);
        if (!info) {
          void vscode.window.showWarningMessage(`REVENANT: VM "${name}" not found.`);
          return;
        }
        const verdict = info.hardened ? 'hardened' : 'NOT hardened';
        session.recordOperation(`stealth test ${name}`, 'ok', `${verdict} · ${info.state}`);
        void vscode.window.showInformationMessage(
          `REVENANT stealth posture for "${name}": ${verdict} (state: ${info.state}). ` +
            `Run the VMAware validation inside the guest for a full report.`,
        );
      } catch (err) {
        session.recordOperation(`stealth test ${name}`, 'error', msg(err));
        void vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`REVENANT: stealth test failed — ${msg(err)}`);
      }
    },
  );
}

async function vmExecute(deps: CommandDeps, item?: VmTreeItem): Promise<void> {
  const name = await resolveVm(deps, item);
  if (!name) return;
  const command = await vscode.window.showInputBox({
    title: `Execute in guest "${name}"`,
    prompt: 'Command to run via the in-guest agent',
    placeHolder: 'e.g. cmd.exe /c whoami',
  });
  if (!command) return;
  // Guest execution is brokered by the guest agent (core/src/vm/agent.ts) over the
  // VM transport. That channel is provisioned by the VM layer and not exposed on the
  // engine facade yet, so surface the intent explicitly rather than silently no-op.
  deps.session.recordOperation(`guest exec ${name}`, 'running', command);
  void vscode.window.showWarningMessage(
    `REVENANT: queued "${command}" for guest "${name}". Connect the guest agent to execute (vm/agent).`,
  );
}

async function runVmAction(
  deps: CommandDeps,
  title: string,
  action: () => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
  await vscode.window.withProgress(
    { location: vscode.ProgressLocation.Notification, title: `REVENANT: ${title}…` },
    async () => {
      try {
        await action();
      } catch (err) {
        void vscode.window.showErrorMessage(`REVENANT: ${title} failed — ${msg(err)}`);
      }
    },
  );
  await deps.vm.reload();
}

async function resolveVm(deps: CommandDeps, item?: VmTreeItem): Promise<string | undefined> {
  if (item?.vmName) return item.vmName;
  const vms = deps.session.vms;
  if (vms.length === 1) return vms[0]!.name;
  if (vms.length === 0) {
    const name = await vscode.window.showInputBox({ title: 'VM name' });
    return name?.trim() || undefined;
  }
  const pick = await vscode.window.showQuickPick(
    vms.map((v) => ({ label: v.name, description: v.state })),
    { title: 'Select a VM' },
  );
  return pick?.label;
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Resolve an address from an argument, the current selection, or a prompt. */
async function resolveAddress(session: RevenantSession, address?: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  if (address) return address;
  if (session.selectedAddress) return session.selectedAddress;
  const def = session.binary?.entryPoint ?? '0x0';
  const input = await vscode.window.showInputBox({
    title: 'Go to address',
    value: def,
    validateInput: (v) => (/^(0x)?[0-9a-fA-F]+$/.test(v.trim()) ? undefined : 'Enter a hex address'),
  });
  return input?.trim();
}

function base(p: string): string {
  return p.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? p;
}

function msg(err: unknown): string {
  return err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/extension.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * REVENANT VS Code extension — activation.
 *
 * Wires the shared {@link RevenantSession} (which owns the `RevenantEngine`) to:
 *   • tree views:    symbols, strings, xrefs, VM status, analysis status
 *   • webview views: control-flow graph, devirtualization dashboard
 *   • custom editor: hex viewer
 *   • virtual docs:  disassembly (`revenant-disasm:`), decompiler (`revenant-decompile:`)
 *   • commands:      load/analyze/lift/devirt + VM lifecycle + navigation
 *   • status bar:    current binary + VM count
 *
 * All disposables are pushed onto `context.subscriptions` so teardown is automatic.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import { RevenantSession } from './session.js';
import { registerCommands, type CommandDeps } from './commands/index.js';
import { SymbolTreeProvider } from './views/symbols.js';
import { StringsTreeProvider } from './views/strings.js';
import { XrefTreeProvider } from './views/xrefs.js';
import { VmStatusProvider } from './views/vm.js';
import { AnalysisStatusProvider } from './views/analysis.js';
import { HexEditorProvider } from './providers/hex.js';
import { DisassemblyProvider } from './providers/disasm.js';
import { DecompileProvider } from './providers/decompile.js';
import { CfgProvider } from './providers/cfg.js';
import { DevirtDashboard } from './providers/devirt.js';

export function activate(context: vscode.ExtensionContext): void {
  const session = new RevenantSession();
  context.subscriptions.push(session);

  // --- Tree views ---------------------------------------------------------
  const symbols = new SymbolTreeProvider(session);
  const strings = new StringsTreeProvider(session);
  const xrefs = new XrefTreeProvider(session);
  const vm = new VmStatusProvider(session);
  const analysis = new AnalysisStatusProvider(session);

  context.subscriptions.push(
    vscode.window.createTreeView('revenant.symbols', { treeDataProvider: symbols, showCollapseAll: true }),
    vscode.window.createTreeView('revenant.strings', { treeDataProvider: strings }),
    vscode.window.createTreeView('revenant.xrefs', { treeDataProvider: xrefs }),
    vscode.window.createTreeView('revenant.vmStatus', { treeDataProvider: vm, showCollapseAll: true }),
    vscode.window.createTreeView('revenant.analysisStatus', { treeDataProvider: analysis, showCollapseAll: true }),
  );

  // --- Webview views ------------------------------------------------------
  const cfg = new CfgProvider(context.extensionUri, session);
  const devirt = new DevirtDashboard(context.extensionUri, session);
  context.subscriptions.push(
    devirt,
    vscode.window.registerWebviewViewProvider(CfgProvider.viewType, cfg),
    vscode.window.registerWebviewViewProvider(DevirtDashboard.viewType, devirt),
  );

  // --- Custom editor + virtual documents ----------------------------------
  const disasm = new DisassemblyProvider(session);
  const decompile = new DecompileProvider(session);
  context.subscriptions.push(
    HexEditorProvider.register(context, session),
    vscode.workspace.registerTextDocumentContentProvider(DisassemblyProvider.scheme, disasm),
    vscode.workspace.registerTextDocumentContentProvider(DecompileProvider.scheme, decompile),
  );

  // --- Commands -----------------------------------------------------------
  const deps: CommandDeps = {
    session,
    symbols,
    strings,
    vm,
    disasm,
    decompile,
    refreshAll: () => {
      symbols.refresh();
      strings.refresh();
      xrefs.refresh();
      analysis.refresh();
    },
  };
  registerCommands(context, deps);

  // --- Status bar ---------------------------------------------------------
  const binaryStatus = vscode.window.createStatusBarItem(vscode.StatusBarAlignment.Left, 100);
  binaryStatus.command = 'revenant.loadBinary';
  binaryStatus.tooltip = 'REVENANT: load a binary';
  const vmStatus = vscode.window.createStatusBarItem(vscode.StatusBarAlignment.Left, 99);
  vmStatus.command = 'revenant.refreshViews';
  vmStatus.tooltip = 'REVENANT analysis VMs (click to refresh)';
  context.subscriptions.push(binaryStatus, vmStatus);

  const updateStatus = (): void => {
    const info = session.binary;
    binaryStatus.text = info
      ? `$(file-binary) ${baseName(info.path)} · ${info.architecture}`
      : '$(file-binary) REVENANT';
    const running = session.vms.filter((v) => v.state === 'running').length;
    vmStatus.text = `$(vm) ${session.vms.length} VM${session.vms.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}${
      running ? ` · ${running} running` : ''
    }`;
  };
  context.subscriptions.push(session.onDidChange(updateStatus));
  updateStatus();
  binaryStatus.show();
  vmStatus.show();

  // --- Initial state ------------------------------------------------------
  void vscode.commands.executeCommand('setContext', 'revenant.hasBinary', false);
  // Populate the VM inventory in the background (safe if VirtualBox is absent).
  void vm.reload();
}

export function deactivate(): void {
  // Subscriptions (including the session) are disposed automatically by VS Code.
}

function baseName(p: string): string {
  return p.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? p;
}

```

`packages/vscode/src/providers/cfg.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * CfgProvider — a {@link vscode.WebviewViewProvider} that renders a function's
 * control-flow graph in the REVENANT activity-bar container.
 *
 * The graph is laid out in TypeScript (a simple BFS "layered" layout from the
 * entry block) and drawn as inline SVG: each node is a basic block showing its
 * id, address range and instruction count; edges are classified as
 * unconditional / conditional / fall-through and styled accordingly. Clicking a
 * node posts its start address back to the extension, which selects it (driving
 * the xref view and disassembly).
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { BasicBlock, ControlFlowGraph } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';
import { BASE_STYLES, cspMeta, escapeHtml, makeNonce } from '../webview.js';

const NODE_W = 150;
const NODE_H = 54;
const H_GAP = 56;
const V_GAP = 26;
const PAD = 24;

export class CfgProvider implements vscode.WebviewViewProvider {
  public static readonly viewType = 'revenant.cfg';

  private view?: vscode.WebviewView;

  constructor(
    private readonly extensionUri: vscode.Uri,
    private readonly session: RevenantSession,
  ) {
    session.onDidChange((topic) => {
      if (topic === 'cfg' || topic === 'binary') this.rerender();
    });
  }

  resolveWebviewView(view: vscode.WebviewView): void {
    this.view = view;
    view.webview.options = {
      enableScripts: true,
      localResourceRoots: [vscode.Uri.joinPath(this.extensionUri, 'media')],
    };
    view.webview.onDidReceiveMessage((msg: { type?: string; address?: string }) => {
      if (msg?.type === 'nodeClick' && msg.address) {
        this.session.select(msg.address);
        void vscode.commands.executeCommand('revenant.showDisassembly', msg.address);
      }
    });
    view.onDidDispose(() => {
      if (this.view === view) this.view = undefined;
    });
    this.rerender();
  }

  private rerender(): void {
    if (this.view) this.view.webview.html = this.render(this.view.webview, this.session.cfg);
  }

  private render(webview: vscode.Webview, cfg: ControlFlowGraph | undefined): string {
    const nonce = makeNonce();
    const body = cfg && cfg.blocks.length ? this.renderGraph(cfg) : this.renderEmpty(cfg);

    return /* html */ `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="${cspMeta(webview, nonce)}" />
  <style nonce="${nonce}">
    ${BASE_STYLES}
    body { padding: 8px; }
    .node rect { fill: var(--vscode-editorWidget-background); stroke: var(--vscode-panel-border); rx: 5; cursor: pointer; }
    .node:hover rect { stroke: var(--vscode-focusBorder); }
    .node.entry rect { stroke: var(--vscode-charts-green, #3c3); stroke-width: 2; }
    .node text { fill: var(--vscode-foreground); font-family: var(--vscode-editor-font-family, monospace); font-size: 10px; }
    .node .bid { font-weight: 600; }
    .edge { fill: none; stroke: var(--vscode-editorLineNumber-foreground); stroke-width: 1.3; }
    .edge.cond { stroke: var(--vscode-charts-orange, #e80); stroke-dasharray: 4 3; }
    .edge.fall { stroke: var(--vscode-descriptionForeground); }
    .hint { margin-top: 8px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  ${body}
  <script nonce="${nonce}">
    const vscode = acquireVsCodeApi();
    document.querySelectorAll('.node').forEach((n) => {
      n.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const a = n.getAttribute('data-addr');
        if (a) vscode.postMessage({ type: 'nodeClick', address: a });
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>`;
  }

  private renderEmpty(cfg: ControlFlowGraph | undefined): string {
    const fn = cfg?.function;
    return `
      <h3>Control-flow graph</h3>
      <p class="muted">${
        fn
          ? `No basic blocks recovered for <code>${escapeHtml(fn)}</code> yet.`
          : 'Select a function and run analysis to build its CFG.'
      }</p>
      <p class="hint muted">Blocks are produced by the lifter/disassembler layer; this view
      renders them as soon as they are available.</p>`;
  }

  private renderGraph(cfg: ControlFlowGraph): string {
    const byId = new Map(cfg.blocks.map((b) => [b.id, b] as const));
    const depth = this.assignDepths(cfg, byId);

    // Group by depth → columns laid out left→right.
    const columns = new Map<number, BasicBlock[]>();
    for (const b of cfg.blocks) {
      const d = depth.get(b.id) ?? 0;
      (columns.get(d) ?? columns.set(d, []).get(d)!).push(b);
    }

    const pos = new Map<string, { x: number; y: number }>();
    let maxY = 0;
    for (const [d, blocks] of [...columns.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])) {
      const x = PAD + d * (NODE_W + H_GAP);
      blocks.forEach((b, i) => {
        const y = PAD + i * (NODE_H + V_GAP);
        pos.set(b.id, { x, y });
        maxY = Math.max(maxY, y + NODE_H);
      });
    }
    const maxDepth = Math.max(...[...columns.keys()], 0);
    const width = PAD * 2 + (maxDepth + 1) * NODE_W + maxDepth * H_GAP;
    const height = maxY + PAD;

    const edges: string[] = [];
    for (const b of cfg.blocks) {
      const from = pos.get(b.id);
      if (!from) continue;
      b.successors.forEach((sid, idx) => {
        const to = pos.get(sid);
        if (!to) return;
        const cls = b.successors.length > 1 ? (idx === 0 ? 'cond' : 'fall') : '';
        const x1 = from.x + NODE_W, y1 = from.y + NODE_H / 2;
        const x2 = to.x, y2 = to.y + NODE_H / 2;
        const mx = (x1 + x2) / 2;
        edges.push(`<path class="edge ${cls}" d="M${x1},${y1} C${mx},${y1} ${mx},${y2} ${x2},${y2}" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />`);
      });
    }

    const nodes = cfg.blocks.map((b) => {
      const p = pos.get(b.id)!;
      const isEntry = b.id === cfg.entry;
      return `<g class="node ${isEntry ? 'entry' : ''}" data-addr="${escapeHtml(b.start)}" transform="translate(${p.x},${p.y})">
        <rect width="${NODE_W}" height="${NODE_H}" rx="5"></rect>
        <text x="8" y="16" class="bid">${escapeHtml(b.id)}${isEntry ? ' (entry)' : ''}</text>
        <text x="8" y="31">${escapeHtml(b.start)}–${escapeHtml(b.end)}</text>
        <text x="8" y="46">${b.instructionCount} insn</text>
      </g>`;
    });

    return `
      <h3>CFG · ${escapeHtml(cfg.name ?? cfg.function)}</h3>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" width="${width}" height="${height}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs>
          <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="var(--vscode-editorLineNumber-foreground)" />
          </marker>
        </defs>
        ${edges.join('\n')}
        ${nodes.join('\n')}
      </svg>`;
  }

  /** BFS depth from the entry block; unreachable blocks get depth 0. */
  private assignDepths(cfg: ControlFlowGraph, byId: Map<string, BasicBlock>): Map<string, number> {
    const depth = new Map<string, number>();
    const queue: string[] = [cfg.entry];
    depth.set(cfg.entry, 0);
    while (queue.length) {
      const id = queue.shift()!;
      const d = depth.get(id)!;
      for (const s of byId.get(id)?.successors ?? []) {
        if (!depth.has(s)) {
          depth.set(s, d + 1);
          queue.push(s);
        }
      }
    }
    for (const b of cfg.blocks) if (!depth.has(b.id)) depth.set(b.id, 0);
    return depth;
  }
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/providers/decompile.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * DecompileProvider — a {@link vscode.TextDocumentContentProvider} that serves
 * decompiled, C-like pseudocode as a read-only virtual document under the
 * `revenant-decompile:` scheme.
 *
 * Real pseudocode comes from the decompiler/lifter in the native layer. Until a
 * lift has run, this synthesizes a faithful stub from what static analysis *does*
 * know — the function address, its section, and its incoming/outgoing
 * cross-references — so the view is informative rather than empty. The document
 * URI ends in `.c`, giving it C syntax highlighting for free.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { CrossReference } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';
import { sectionForAddress } from '../session.js';

export class DecompileProvider implements vscode.TextDocumentContentProvider {
  public static readonly scheme = 'revenant-decompile';

  private readonly _onDidChange = new vscode.EventEmitter<vscode.Uri>();
  readonly onDidChange = this._onDidChange.event;

  constructor(private readonly session: RevenantSession) {
    session.onDidChange((topic) => {
      if (topic === 'binary' || topic === 'lift' || topic === 'xrefs') this.refreshAll();
    });
  }

  static uriFor(address: string): vscode.Uri {
    const clean = address.replace(/^0x/i, '').padStart(8, '0');
    return vscode.Uri.parse(`${DecompileProvider.scheme}:/sub_${clean}.c`);
  }

  async show(address: string): Promise<void> {
    const uri = DecompileProvider.uriFor(address);
    this._onDidChange.fire(uri);
    const doc = await vscode.workspace.openTextDocument(uri);
    try {
      await vscode.languages.setTextDocumentLanguage(doc, 'c');
    } catch {
      /* ignore — 'c' is a built-in language id, but be defensive. */
    }
    await vscode.window.showTextDocument(doc, { preview: true, viewColumn: vscode.ViewColumn.Beside });
  }

  private refreshAll(): void {
    for (const doc of vscode.workspace.textDocuments) {
      if (doc.uri.scheme === DecompileProvider.scheme) this._onDidChange.fire(doc.uri);
    }
  }

  provideTextDocumentContent(uri: vscode.Uri): string {
    const address = this.addressFromUri(uri);
    const info = this.session.binary;
    const name = `sub_${address.replace(/^0x/i, '').padStart(8, '0')}`;

    const out: string[] = [];
    out.push(`/* REVENANT decompiler output`);
    out.push(` * function: ${name} @ ${address}`);
    out.push(` * binary:   ${info ? info.path : '(none loaded)'}`);
    if (info) out.push(` * section:  ${sectionForAddress(info, address) ?? '(unknown)'}`);
    out.push(` */`, '');

    const lift = this.session.lift;
    if (lift?.ir && lift.irFormat !== 'llvm-ir') {
      // When the lifter emits something C-like, present it directly.
      out.push(lift.ir);
      return out.join('\n') + '\n';
    }

    const callees = this.session.xrefs.from(address).filter((x) => x.kind === 'call');
    const callers = this.session.xrefs.to(address).filter((x) => x.kind === 'call');

    out.push('#include <stdint.h>', '');
    out.push(`// ${callers.length} caller(s), ${callees.length} callee(s) known from xref index.`);
    out.push(`void ${name}(void) {`);
    if (callees.length === 0) {
      out.push('    // No decoded body yet — run “REVENANT: Lift to IR”.');
      out.push('    // Static analysis found no outgoing calls for this address.');
    } else {
      out.push('    // Reconstructed call skeleton from cross-references:');
      for (const c of callees) {
        out.push(`    sub_${target(c)}();  // ${c.kind} -> ${c.to}`);
      }
    }
    out.push('}', '');

    if (callers.length) {
      out.push('/* Referenced from:');
      for (const c of callers) out.push(` *   ${c.from}  (${c.kind})`);
      out.push(' */');
    }

    return out.join('\n') + '\n';
  }

  private addressFromUri(uri: vscode.Uri): string {
    const m = /0x?[0-9a-fA-F]+/.exec(uri.path.replace('sub_', '0x'));
    return m ? (m[0].startsWith('0x') ? m[0] : `0x${m[0]}`) : '0x0';
  }
}

function target(ref: CrossReference): string {
  return ref.to.replace(/^0x/i, '').padStart(8, '0');
}
```

```ts
/**
 * DevirtDashboard — a {@link vscode.WebviewViewProvider} showing the state of
 * devirtualization: detected protectors, live progress of an active run, and a
 * function-by-function breakdown of the last result.
 *
 * Progress is driven by the engine's `devirt:progress` events, pushed into the
 * webview incrementally so the progress bar animates without a full re-render.
 * Protector detections and completed results come from the shared session.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { DevirtResult, ProtectorDetection } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';
import { BASE_STYLES, cspMeta, escapeHtml, makeNonce } from '../webview.js';

export class DevirtDashboard implements vscode.WebviewViewProvider {
  public static readonly viewType = 'revenant.devirt';

  private view?: vscode.WebviewView;
  private readonly disposables: vscode.Disposable[] = [];

  constructor(
    private readonly extensionUri: vscode.Uri,
    private readonly session: RevenantSession,
  ) {
    // session.onDidChange returns a vscode.Disposable.
    this.disposables.push(
      session.onDidChange((topic) => {
        if (topic === 'devirt' || topic === 'binary') this.rerender();
      }),
    );

    // Live progress: forward engine events straight into the webview.
    // EventBus.on returns an unsubscribe function, wrapped as a Disposable.
    this.disposables.push({
      dispose: session.engine.events.on('devirt:progress', (p) => {
        void this.view?.webview.postMessage({
          type: 'progress',
          plugin: p.plugin,
          percent: p.percent,
          message: p.message,
        });
      }),
    });
  }

  dispose(): void {
    for (const d of this.disposables) d.dispose();
  }

  resolveWebviewView(view: vscode.WebviewView): void {
    this.view = view;
    view.webview.options = {
      enableScripts: true,
      localResourceRoots: [vscode.Uri.joinPath(this.extensionUri, 'media')],
    };
    view.webview.onDidReceiveMessage((msg: { type?: string; address?: string }) => {
      if (msg?.type === 'runDevirt') void vscode.commands.executeCommand('revenant.devirt');
      if (msg?.type === 'open' && msg.address) {
        this.session.select(msg.address);
        void vscode.commands.executeCommand('revenant.showDisassembly', msg.address);
      }
    });
    view.onDidDispose(() => {
      if (this.view === view) this.view = undefined;
    });
    this.rerender();
  }

  private rerender(): void {
    if (this.view) this.view.webview.html = this.render(this.view.webview);
  }

  private render(webview: vscode.Webview): string {
    const nonce = makeNonce();
    return /* html */ `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="${cspMeta(webview, nonce)}" />
  <style nonce="${nonce}">
    ${BASE_STYLES}
    section { margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 2px 0; }
    .prot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 3px 0; }
    .conf { min-width: 42px; text-align: right; }
    button {
      background: var(--vscode-button-background); color: var(--vscode-button-foreground);
      border: none; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer;
    }
    button:hover { background: var(--vscode-button-hoverBackground); }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
    td, th { text-align: left; padding: 2px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vscode-panel-border); font-size: 0.9em; }
    .ok { color: var(--vscode-charts-green, #3c3); }
    .bad { color: var(--vscode-charts-red, #e55); }
    #prog { margin-top: 6px; display: none; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <h3>Devirtualization</h3>

  <section>
    <div class="row"><strong>Detected protectors</strong><button id="run">Devirtualize</button></div>
    ${this.renderProtectors(this.session.protectors)}
  </section>

  <section id="prog">
    <strong id="progTitle">Running…</strong>
    <div class="bar-track" style="margin-top:6px"><div id="progBar" class="bar" style="width:0%"></div></div>
    <div id="progMsg" class="muted" style="margin-top:4px"></div>
  </section>

  <section>
    <strong>Last result</strong>
    ${this.renderResult(this.session.devirt)}
  </section>

  <script nonce="${nonce}">
    const vscode = acquireVsCodeApi();
    document.getElementById('run').addEventListener('click', () => vscode.postMessage({ type: 'runDevirt' }));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-addr]').forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener('click', () => vscode.postMessage({ type: 'open', address: el.getAttribute('data-addr') })));
    const prog = document.getElementById('prog');
    window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
      const m = e.data;
      if (m.type === 'progress') {
        prog.style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('progTitle').textContent = m.plugin + ' — ' + Math.round(m.percent) + '%';
        document.getElementById('progBar').style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, m.percent)) + '%';
        document.getElementById('progMsg').textContent = m.message || '';
        if (m.percent >= 100) setTimeout(() => (prog.style.display = 'none'), 1200);
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>`;
  }

  private renderProtectors(protectors: readonly ProtectorDetection[]): string {
    const real = protectors.filter((p) => p.kind !== 'none');
    if (!real.length) {
      return `<p class="muted">None detected${
        this.session.hasBinary ? '' : ' — load a binary first'
      }.</p>`;
    }
    return real
      .map((p) => {
        const pct = Math.round(p.confidence * 100);
        return `<div class="prot">
          <span class="pill">${escapeHtml(p.kind)}${p.version ? ' ' + escapeHtml(p.version) : ''}</span>
          <span class="bar-track" style="flex:1"><span class="bar" style="display:block;width:${pct}%"></span></span>
          <span class="conf muted">${pct}%</span>
        </div>
        ${p.evidence.length ? `<div class="muted" style="margin:0 0 6px 2px;font-size:0.85em">${escapeHtml(p.evidence.join(' · '))}</div>` : ''}`;
      })
      .join('\n');
  }

  private renderResult(result: DevirtResult | undefined): string {
    if (!result) return '<p class="muted">No devirtualization has run yet.</p>';
    const status = result.success
      ? '<span class="ok">success</span>'
      : '<span class="bad">failed</span>';
    const rows =
      result.devirtualizedFunctions.length === 0
        ? '<tr><td colspan="2" class="muted">No functions recovered.</td></tr>'
        : result.devirtualizedFunctions
            .map(
              (addr, i) =>
                `<tr><td>#${i + 1}</td><td><a data-addr="${escapeHtml(addr)}">${escapeHtml(addr)}</a></td></tr>`,
            )
            .join('\n');
    const problems = [...result.errors.map((e) => `✗ ${e}`), ...result.warnings.map((w) => `⚠ ${w}`)];
    return `
      <div class="row"><span>${escapeHtml(result.plugin)} · ${escapeHtml(result.protector)}</span>${status}</div>
      <div class="muted">${result.devirtualizedFunctions.length} function(s) · ${result.durationMs} ms</div>
      <table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>address</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>
      ${problems.length ? `<div class="muted" style="margin-top:6px">${problems.map(escapeHtml).join('<br/>')}</div>` : ''}
      ${result.outputPath ? `<div class="muted" style="margin-top:4px">→ ${escapeHtml(result.outputPath)}</div>` : ''}`;
  }
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/providers/disasm.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * DisassemblyProvider — a {@link vscode.TextDocumentContentProvider} that serves a
 * read-only disassembly listing as a virtual document under the
 * `revenant-disasm:` scheme.
 *
 * The listing uses the canonical four columns — `address | bytes | mnemonic |
 * operands`. REVENANT's TypeScript layer does not ship an instruction decoder
 * (that lives in the native/lifter layer, per CLAUDE.md), so when no decoded IR
 * is available this falls back to an objdump-style `.byte` rendering of the real
 * bytes read from the sample. When a lift has produced IR, it is appended.
 *
 * The document URI encodes the function address, e.g.
 *   revenant-disasm:/0x00401000.asm
 * so VS Code applies assembly syntax highlighting from the `.asm` extension (a
 * TextMate `asm` grammar from the user's environment, if installed).
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';
import { addressToFileOffset, parseAddress, sectionForAddress } from '../session.js';

/** How many bytes to render from a function entry when no block info exists. */
const WINDOW_BYTES = 256;
const BYTES_PER_LINE = 8;

export class DisassemblyProvider implements vscode.TextDocumentContentProvider {
  public static readonly scheme = 'revenant-disasm';

  private readonly _onDidChange = new vscode.EventEmitter<vscode.Uri>();
  readonly onDidChange = this._onDidChange.event;

  constructor(private readonly session: RevenantSession) {
    // Re-render open disassembly docs whenever the binary/lift state changes.
    session.onDidChange((topic) => {
      if (topic === 'binary' || topic === 'lift') this.refreshAll();
    });
  }

  /** Build the virtual-document URI for a function address. */
  static uriFor(address: string): vscode.Uri {
    const clean = address.replace(/^0x/i, '').padStart(8, '0');
    return vscode.Uri.parse(`${DisassemblyProvider.scheme}:/0x${clean}.asm`);
  }

  /** Open (or focus) the disassembly view for `address`. */
  async show(address: string): Promise<void> {
    const uri = DisassemblyProvider.uriFor(address);
    this._onDidChange.fire(uri); // ensure fresh content if already open
    const doc = await vscode.workspace.openTextDocument(uri);
    try {
      await vscode.languages.setTextDocumentLanguage(doc, 'asm');
    } catch {
      /* 'asm' grammar not installed — plain text is fine. */
    }
    await vscode.window.showTextDocument(doc, { preview: true, viewColumn: vscode.ViewColumn.Active });
  }

  private refreshAll(): void {
    // Cheap: fire for every open revenant-disasm document.
    for (const doc of vscode.workspace.textDocuments) {
      if (doc.uri.scheme === DisassemblyProvider.scheme) this._onDidChange.fire(doc.uri);
    }
  }

  async provideTextDocumentContent(uri: vscode.Uri): Promise<string> {
    const address = this.addressFromUri(uri);
    const info = this.session.binary;
    if (!info) {
      return header(address, undefined) + '; No binary loaded. Run “REVENANT: Load Binary…”.\n';
    }

    const section = sectionForAddress(info, address);
    const offset = addressToFileOffset(info, address);
    const lines: string[] = [header(address, section)];

    if (offset === undefined) {
      lines.push(`; Address ${address} is not inside any mapped section.`);
      return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
    }

    let bytes: Uint8Array;
    try {
      const all = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(vscode.Uri.file(info.path));
      bytes = all.subarray(offset, Math.min(all.length, offset + WINDOW_BYTES));
    } catch (err) {
      lines.push(`; Failed to read bytes: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`);
      return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
    }

    lines.push(';', '; address   bytes                     mnemonic  operands', ';');
    const base = parseAddress(address);
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += BYTES_PER_LINE) {
      const slice = bytes.subarray(i, i + BYTES_PER_LINE);
      const addr = `0x${(base + BigInt(i)).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`;
      const hex = [...slice].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' ');
      const operands = [...slice].map((b) => `0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`).join(', ');
      lines.push(`${addr}  ${hex.padEnd(24)}  .byte     ${operands}`);
    }

    // If a lift produced IR, surface it beneath the raw listing.
    const lift = this.session.lift;
    if (lift?.ir) {
      lines.push('', `; ---- lifted IR (${lift.tool}, ${lift.irFormat}) ----`, '');
      lines.push(...lift.ir.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => `; ${l}`));
    } else {
      lines.push(
        '',
        '; Native instruction decoding is provided by the lifter/disassembler layer.',
        '; Run “REVENANT: Lift to IR” to populate decoded output here.',
      );
    }

    return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
  }

  private addressFromUri(uri: vscode.Uri): string {
    const m = /0x[0-9a-fA-F]+/.exec(uri.path);
    return m ? m[0] : '0x0';
  }
}

function header(address: string, section: string | undefined): string {
  return [
    `; REVENANT disassembly @ ${address}`,
    section ? `; section: ${section}` : '; section: (unknown)',
    '',
  ].join('\n');
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/providers/hex.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * HexEditorProvider — a {@link vscode.CustomReadonlyEditorProvider} that renders a
 * binary as a classic hex dump (offset | 16 hex bytes | ASCII) inside a webview.
 *
 * The webview is a self-contained HTML/CSS/JS app:
 *  - the file bytes are handed over once (base64) alongside the section table;
 *  - rows are virtualized in JS so even multi-megabyte files scroll smoothly;
 *  - bytes that fall inside an executable/known section are tinted, and a search
 *    box highlights hex or ASCII matches and jumps to the first hit.
 *
 * It is read-only: REVENANT never mutates the analyzed sample on disk.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { BinarySection } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';
import { parseAddress } from '../session.js';
import { BASE_STYLES, cspMeta, makeNonce } from '../webview.js';

/** Bytes beyond this are not shipped to the webview (keeps the payload sane). */
const MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

interface SectionSpan {
  name: string;
  start: number; // file offset
  end: number; // exclusive
  executable: boolean;
}

export class HexEditorProvider implements vscode.CustomReadonlyEditorProvider {
  public static readonly viewType = 'revenant.hexEditor';

  static register(context: vscode.ExtensionContext, session: RevenantSession): vscode.Disposable {
    return vscode.window.registerCustomEditorProvider(
      HexEditorProvider.viewType,
      new HexEditorProvider(context, session),
      {
        webviewOptions: { retainContextWhenHidden: true },
        supportsMultipleEditorsPerDocument: false,
      },
    );
  }

  constructor(
    private readonly context: vscode.ExtensionContext,
    private readonly session: RevenantSession,
  ) {}

  openCustomDocument(uri: vscode.Uri): vscode.CustomDocument {
    return { uri, dispose: () => undefined };
  }

  async resolveCustomEditor(
    document: vscode.CustomDocument,
    panel: vscode.WebviewPanel,
  ): Promise<void> {
    panel.webview.options = {
      enableScripts: true,
      localResourceRoots: [vscode.Uri.joinPath(this.context.extensionUri, 'media')],
    };

    let bytes: Uint8Array;
    try {
      bytes = await vscode.workspace.fs.readFile(document.uri);
    } catch (err) {
      panel.webview.html = this.renderError(document.uri, err);
      return;
    }

    const truncated = bytes.length > MAX_BYTES;
    const view = truncated ? bytes.subarray(0, MAX_BYTES) : bytes;
    const spans = this.sectionSpans(document.uri);

    panel.webview.html = this.renderHtml(panel.webview, view, {
      fileName: document.uri.fsPath.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? 'binary',
      totalSize: bytes.length,
      shownSize: view.length,
      truncated,
      sections: spans,
    });

    // Let a hex click drive the rest of the UI (selection → xrefs/disasm).
    panel.webview.onDidReceiveMessage((msg: { type?: string; offset?: number }) => {
      if (msg?.type === 'selectOffset' && typeof msg.offset === 'number') {
        const address = this.offsetToAddress(document.uri, msg.offset);
        if (address) this.session.select(address);
      }
    });
  }

  /** Compute section file-offset spans, but only when this file is the loaded binary. */
  private sectionSpans(uri: vscode.Uri): SectionSpan[] {
    const info = this.session.binary;
    if (!info || info.path !== uri.fsPath) return [];
    return info.sections
      .filter((s: BinarySection) => s.rawSize > 0)
      .map((s: BinarySection) => ({
        name: s.name,
        start: s.rawOffset,
        end: s.rawOffset + s.rawSize,
        executable: s.flags.executable,
      }));
  }

  private offsetToAddress(uri: vscode.Uri, offset: number): string | undefined {
    const info = this.session.binary;
    if (!info || info.path !== uri.fsPath) return undefined;
    for (const s of info.sections) {
      if (offset >= s.rawOffset && offset < s.rawOffset + s.rawSize) {
        const va = parseAddress(s.virtualAddress) + BigInt(offset - s.rawOffset);
        return `0x${va.toString(16)}`;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  private renderError(uri: vscode.Uri, err: unknown): string {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return `<!DOCTYPE html><html><body style="font-family:sans-serif;padding:1rem">
      <h3>Unable to open hex view</h3>
      <p>${escape(uri.fsPath)}</p>
      <pre>${escape(message)}</pre>
    </body></html>`;
  }

  private renderHtml(
    webview: vscode.Webview,
    bytes: Uint8Array,
    meta: {
      fileName: string;
      totalSize: number;
      shownSize: number;
      truncated: boolean;
      sections: SectionSpan[];
    },
  ): string {
    const nonce = makeNonce();
    const base64 = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('base64');
    const dataJson = JSON.stringify({
      base64,
      shownSize: meta.shownSize,
      totalSize: meta.totalSize,
      sections: meta.sections,
    });

    return /* html */ `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="${cspMeta(webview, nonce)}" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <style nonce="${nonce}">
    ${BASE_STYLES}
    body { padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
    header {
      display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vscode-panel-border);
      background: var(--vscode-editorGroupHeader-tabsBackground);
    }
    header .title { font-weight: 600; }
    input[type="search"] {
      background: var(--vscode-input-background); color: var(--vscode-input-foreground);
      border: 1px solid var(--vscode-input-border, transparent); border-radius: 3px;
      padding: 2px 6px; min-width: 220px;
    }
    #scroll { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; position: relative; }
    #spacer { position: relative; width: 100%; }
    #rows {
      position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      font-family: var(--vscode-editor-font-family, monospace);
      font-size: var(--vscode-editor-font-size, 12px); line-height: 18px; white-space: pre;
    }
    .row { display: flex; }
    .off { color: var(--vscode-descriptionForeground); padding: 0 12px 0 10px; user-select: none; }
    .hex { letter-spacing: 0; }
    .asc { padding-left: 14px; color: var(--vscode-foreground); }
    .b { padding: 0 1px; cursor: pointer; }
    .b.exec { color: var(--vscode-charts-red, #e55); }
    .b.sect { color: var(--vscode-charts-blue, #59f); }
    .b.hit { background: var(--vscode-editor-findMatchHighlightBackground, #ea5); color: #000; }
    .b.sel { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); }
    .legend { display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 0.8em; }
    .legend .exec { color: var(--vscode-charts-red, #e55); }
    .legend .sect { color: var(--vscode-charts-blue, #59f); }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <header>
    <span class="title">${escape(meta.fileName)}</span>
    <span class="pill">${meta.totalSize.toLocaleString()} bytes</span>
    ${meta.truncated ? `<span class="pill" title="Showing the first ${MAX_BYTES} bytes">truncated</span>` : ''}
    <input type="search" id="search" placeholder="Search hex (DE AD BE EF) or ASCII" />
    <span id="searchInfo" class="muted"></span>
    <span class="legend"><span class="exec">■ exec</span><span class="sect">■ section</span></span>
  </header>
  <div id="scroll"><div id="spacer"><div id="rows"></div></div></div>

  <script type="application/json" id="payload" nonce="${nonce}">${dataJson}</script>
  <script nonce="${nonce}">
    (function () {
      const vscode = acquireVsCodeApi();
      const payload = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('payload').textContent);
      const bin = Uint8Array.from(atob(payload.base64), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
      const sections = payload.sections || [];
      const total = bin.length;
      const BYTES_PER_ROW = 16;
      const ROW_HEIGHT = 18;
      const rowCount = Math.ceil(total / BYTES_PER_ROW) || 1;

      const scroll = document.getElementById('scroll');
      const spacer = document.getElementById('spacer');
      const rows = document.getElementById('rows');
      const searchInfo = document.getElementById('searchInfo');
      spacer.style.height = (rowCount * ROW_HEIGHT) + 'px';

      let hits = [];      // byte offsets matching the current search
      let selected = -1;  // selected byte offset

      function classFor(offset) {
        for (const s of sections) {
          if (offset >= s.start && offset < s.end) return s.executable ? 'exec' : 'sect';
        }
        return '';
      }
      const hex = (n, w) => n.toString(16).padStart(w, '0');

      function render() {
        const vh = scroll.clientHeight;
        const first = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scroll.scrollTop / ROW_HEIGHT) - 2);
        const visible = Math.ceil(vh / ROW_HEIGHT) + 4;
        const last = Math.min(rowCount, first + visible);
        rows.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (first * ROW_HEIGHT) + 'px)';
        const hitSet = new Set(hits);

        let html = '';
        for (let r = first; r < last; r++) {
          const base = r * BYTES_PER_ROW;
          let hcells = '', acells = '';
          for (let i = 0; i < BYTES_PER_ROW; i++) {
            const off = base + i;
            if (off >= total) { hcells += '<span class="b">  </span>'; acells += ' '; continue; }
            const v = bin[off];
            let cls = 'b ' + classFor(off);
            if (hitSet.has(off)) cls += ' hit';
            if (off === selected) cls += ' sel';
            hcells += '<span class="' + cls + '" data-off="' + off + '">' + hex(v, 2) + '</span>' + (i === 7 ? ' ' : '');
            const ch = (v >= 0x20 && v <= 0x7e) ? String.fromCharCode(v) : '.';
            acells += '<span class="' + cls + '" data-off="' + off + '">' + (ch === '<' ? '&lt;' : ch === '&' ? '&amp;' : ch) + '</span>';
          }
          html += '<div class="row"><span class="off">' + hex(base, 8) + '</span>' +
                  '<span class="hex">' + hcells + '</span><span class="asc">' + acells + '</span></div>';
        }
        rows.innerHTML = html;
      }

      function parseSearch(q) {
        q = q.trim();
        if (!q) return null;
        const hexLike = /^[0-9a-fA-F\\s]+$/.test(q) && q.replace(/\\s/g, '').length % 2 === 0;
        if (hexLike) {
          const clean = q.replace(/\\s/g, '');
          const bytes = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i += 2) bytes.push(parseInt(clean.substr(i, 2), 16));
          return bytes;
        }
        return Array.from(q).map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
      }

      function search(q) {
        const needle = parseSearch(q);
        hits = [];
        if (needle && needle.length) {
          for (let i = 0; i + needle.length <= total; i++) {
            let ok = true;
            for (let j = 0; j < needle.length; j++) { if (bin[i + j] !== needle[j]) { ok = false; break; } }
            if (ok) { for (let j = 0; j < needle.length; j++) hits.push(i + j); if (hits.length > 50000) break; }
          }
        }
        const matches = needle ? Math.floor(hits.length / (needle.length || 1)) : 0;
        searchInfo.textContent = q.trim() ? (matches + ' match' + (matches === 1 ? '' : 'es')) : '';
        if (hits.length) scroll.scrollTop = Math.floor(hits[0] / BYTES_PER_ROW) * ROW_HEIGHT;
        render();
      }

      scroll.addEventListener('scroll', render, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('resize', render);
      document.getElementById('search').addEventListener('input', (e) => search(e.target.value));
      rows.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const t = e.target.closest('[data-off]');
        if (!t) return;
        selected = parseInt(t.getAttribute('data-off'), 10);
        vscode.postMessage({ type: 'selectOffset', offset: selected });
        render();
      });
      render();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>`;
  }
}

function escape(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/session.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * RevenantSession — the extension's shared, in-memory analysis state.
 *
 * The {@link RevenantEngine} from `@revenant/core` is deliberately stateless and
 * file-path oriented (it returns plain, serializable results). VS Code, by
 * contrast, has many long-lived views that must render a *consistent* picture of
 * "the binary the user is currently looking at". This class is that single source
 * of truth: it owns the engine, caches the latest results, and emits a typed
 * change event so every tree view / webview / virtual document can refresh itself.
 *
 * Nothing in here touches the VS Code UI directly beyond `EventEmitter` — that
 * keeps it unit-testable and lets providers decide how to present the data.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import { RevenantEngine, XrefIndex } from '@revenant/core';
import type {
  BinaryInfo,
  ControlFlowGraph,
  CrossReference,
  DevirtResult,
  ExtractedString,
  LiftResult,
  ProtectorDetection,
  Result,
  VmInfo,
} from '@revenant/shared';

/** Which slice of state changed. Providers subscribe and refresh selectively. */
export type SessionTopic =
  | 'binary'
  | 'strings'
  | 'xrefs'
  | 'selection'
  | 'lift'
  | 'devirt'
  | 'vm'
  | 'analysis'
  | 'cfg';

/** A step in the analysis pipeline, surfaced in the Analysis view. */
export interface PipelineStage {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  status: 'idle' | 'running' | 'done' | 'error' | 'skipped';
  detail?: string;
}

/** A recent engine operation, surfaced in the Analysis view. */
export interface OperationRecord {
  time: string; // ISO-8601
  label: string;
  status: 'ok' | 'error' | 'running';
  detail?: string;
}

/** The ordered pipeline the Analysis view renders. */
const PIPELINE: ReadonlyArray<Pick<PipelineStage, 'id' | 'label'>> = [
  { id: 'load', label: 'Load & parse' },
  { id: 'strings', label: 'String extraction' },
  { id: 'protectors', label: 'Protector detection' },
  { id: 'lift', label: 'Lift to IR' },
  { id: 'devirt', label: 'Devirtualization' },
];

export class RevenantSession implements vscode.Disposable {
  readonly engine: RevenantEngine;

  /** Bidirectional cross-reference index, populated during analysis. */
  readonly xrefs = new XrefIndex();

  private _binaryPath?: string;
  private _binary?: BinaryInfo;
  private _strings: ExtractedString[] = [];
  private _lift?: LiftResult;
  private _devirt?: DevirtResult;
  private _protectors: ProtectorDetection[] = [];
  private _vms: VmInfo[] = [];
  private _selectedAddress?: string;
  private _cfg?: ControlFlowGraph;
  private _operations: OperationRecord[] = [];
  private readonly _stages = new Map<string, PipelineStage>();

  private readonly _onDidChange = new vscode.EventEmitter<SessionTopic>();
  /** Fires with the topic that changed whenever any cached state is updated. */
  readonly onDidChange = this._onDidChange.event;

  private readonly disposables: vscode.Disposable[] = [];

  constructor(engine?: RevenantEngine) {
    this.engine = engine ?? new RevenantEngine();
    for (const s of PIPELINE) this._stages.set(s.id, { ...s, status: 'idle' });

    // Mirror engine progress events into the Analysis view. The engine fires
    // these regardless of which frontend drives it, so webviews stay live.
    const bus = this.engine.events;
    this.disposables.push(
      { dispose: bus.on('analysis:started', (p) => this.setStage(p.stage, 'running')) },
      { dispose: bus.on('analysis:completed', (p) => this.setStage(p.stage, 'done')) },
      {
        dispose: bus.on('devirt:completed', (r) => {
          this._devirt = r;
          this.setStage('devirt', r.success ? 'done' : 'error');
          this.recordOperation(`devirt:${r.plugin}`, r.success ? 'ok' : 'error');
          this.change('devirt');
        }),
      },
      {
        dispose: bus.on('lift:completed', (r) => {
          this._lift = r;
          this.setStage('lift', 'done', `${r.functionsLifted} fn, ${r.durationMs}ms`);
          this.change('lift');
        }),
      },
      { dispose: bus.on('vm:state', () => this.change('vm')) },
    );
  }

  // --- Accessors ----------------------------------------------------------

  get binaryPath(): string | undefined {
    return this._binaryPath;
  }
  get binary(): BinaryInfo | undefined {
    return this._binary;
  }
  get strings(): readonly ExtractedString[] {
    return this._strings;
  }
  get lift(): LiftResult | undefined {
    return this._lift;
  }
  get devirt(): DevirtResult | undefined {
    return this._devirt;
  }
  get protectors(): readonly ProtectorDetection[] {
    return this._protectors;
  }
  get vms(): readonly VmInfo[] {
    return this._vms;
  }
  get selectedAddress(): string | undefined {
    return this._selectedAddress;
  }
  get cfg(): ControlFlowGraph | undefined {
    return this._cfg;
  }
  get operations(): readonly OperationRecord[] {
    return this._operations;
  }
  get stages(): readonly PipelineStage[] {
    return PIPELINE.map((s) => this._stages.get(s.id)!);
  }
  get hasBinary(): boolean {
    return this._binary !== undefined;
  }

  // --- Mutators -----------------------------------------------------------

  setBinary(path: string, info: BinaryInfo): void {
    this._binaryPath = path;
    this._binary = info;
    this.setStage('load', 'done', `${info.format}/${info.architecture}`);
    this.recordOperation(`load ${basename(path)}`, 'ok', `${info.size} bytes`);
    this.change('binary');
  }

  setStrings(strings: ExtractedString[]): void {
    this._strings = strings;
    this.change('strings');
  }

  setProtectors(protectors: ProtectorDetection[]): void {
    this._protectors = protectors;
    const kinds = protectors.filter((p) => p.kind !== 'none').map((p) => p.kind);
    this.setStage('protectors', 'done', kinds.length ? kinds.join(', ') : 'none detected');
    this.change('devirt');
  }

  setLift(result: LiftResult): void {
    this._lift = result;
    this.change('lift');
  }

  setDevirt(result: DevirtResult): void {
    this._devirt = result;
    this.change('devirt');
  }

  setVms(vms: VmInfo[]): void {
    this._vms = vms;
    this.change('vm');
  }

  setCfg(cfg: ControlFlowGraph | undefined): void {
    this._cfg = cfg;
    this.change('cfg');
  }

  select(address: string | undefined): void {
    this._selectedAddress = address;
    this.change('selection');
  }

  addXrefs(refs: Iterable<CrossReference>): void {
    this.xrefs.addAll(refs);
    this.change('xrefs');
  }

  setStage(id: string, status: PipelineStage['status'], detail?: string): void {
    const prev = this._stages.get(id);
    this._stages.set(id, {
      id,
      label: prev?.label ?? id,
      status,
      ...(detail !== undefined ? { detail } : prev?.detail ? { detail: prev.detail } : {}),
    });
    this.change('analysis');
  }

  recordOperation(label: string, status: OperationRecord['status'], detail?: string): void {
    this._operations.unshift({
      time: new Date().toISOString(),
      label,
      status,
      ...(detail !== undefined ? { detail } : {}),
    });
    // Keep the log bounded.
    if (this._operations.length > 50) this._operations.length = 50;
    this.change('analysis');
  }

  /** Reset pipeline + results (e.g. when a new binary is about to be loaded). */
  resetPipeline(): void {
    for (const s of PIPELINE) this._stages.set(s.id, { ...s, status: 'idle' });
    this._lift = undefined;
    this._devirt = undefined;
    this._protectors = [];
    this._strings = [];
    this._cfg = undefined;
    this.change('analysis');
  }

  private change(topic: SessionTopic): void {
    this._onDidChange.fire(topic);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    for (const d of this.disposables) d.dispose();
    this.disposables.length = 0;
    this._onDidChange.dispose();
  }
}

/**
 * Unwrap a `Result<T>` envelope, throwing a descriptive error on failure. Engine
 * operations return `{ ok, data?, error? }` so success/failure crosses the
 * process boundary cleanly; the extension turns a failed result into a thrown
 * error that command handlers report via `window.showErrorMessage`.
 */
export function unwrap<T>(result: Result<T>, context: string): T {
  if (!result.ok || result.data === undefined) {
    throw new Error(result.error ?? `${context} failed`);
  }
  return result.data;
}

/** Parse a REVENANT address string ("0x401000" or decimal) into a BigInt. */
export function parseAddress(address: string): bigint {
  const trimmed = address.trim();
  try {
    return trimmed.toLowerCase().startsWith('0x')
      ? BigInt(trimmed)
      : BigInt(trimmed.startsWith('-') ? trimmed : `0x${trimmed}`);
  } catch {
    return 0n;
  }
}

/** Format a BigInt/number as a zero-padded hex address. */
export function formatAddress(value: bigint | number, pad = 8): string {
  const v = typeof value === 'bigint' ? value : BigInt(Math.trunc(value));
  const neg = v < 0n;
  const hex = (neg ? -v : v).toString(16).padStart(pad, '0');
  return `${neg ? '-' : ''}0x${hex}`;
}

/**
 * Map a virtual address to a file offset using a binary's section table.
 * Returns undefined when the address does not fall inside any mapped section.
 */
export function addressToFileOffset(info: BinaryInfo, address: string): number | undefined {
  const va = parseAddress(address);
  for (const section of info.sections) {
    const base = parseAddress(section.virtualAddress);
    const size = BigInt(section.virtualSize || section.rawSize);
    if (va >= base && va < base + size) {
      return section.rawOffset + Number(va - base);
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** Return the section whose virtual range contains `address`, if any. */
export function sectionForAddress(info: BinaryInfo, address: string): string | undefined {
  const va = parseAddress(address);
  for (const section of info.sections) {
    const base = parseAddress(section.virtualAddress);
    const size = BigInt(section.virtualSize || section.rawSize);
    if (va >= base && va < base + size) return section.name;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function basename(p: string): string {
  return p.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? p;
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/views/analysis.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * AnalysisStatusProvider — the "Analysis" tree.
 *
 * A dashboard-in-a-tree with three sections:
 *   • Project   — the loaded binary's identity (format, arch, hash, size…)
 *   • Pipeline  — each analysis stage and its status (idle/running/done/error)
 *   • Recent    — a bounded log of the most recent engine operations
 *
 * Everything is read from the shared session, so the view updates automatically
 * as analysis progresses.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { RevenantSession, PipelineStage, OperationRecord } from '../session.js';

type Node =
  | { kind: 'section'; id: 'project' | 'pipeline' | 'recent'; label: string }
  | { kind: 'kv'; label: string; value: string; icon: string }
  | { kind: 'stage'; stage: PipelineStage }
  | { kind: 'op'; op: OperationRecord };

export class AnalysisStatusProvider implements vscode.TreeDataProvider<Node> {
  private readonly _onDidChangeTreeData = new vscode.EventEmitter<Node | undefined>();
  readonly onDidChangeTreeData = this._onDidChangeTreeData.event;

  constructor(private readonly session: RevenantSession) {
    session.onDidChange((topic) => {
      if (topic === 'analysis' || topic === 'binary' || topic === 'lift' || topic === 'devirt') {
        this.refresh();
      }
    });
  }

  refresh(): void {
    this._onDidChangeTreeData.fire(undefined);
  }

  getTreeItem(node: Node): vscode.TreeItem {
    const C = vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState;
    switch (node.kind) {
      case 'section': {
        const item = new vscode.TreeItem(node.label, C.Expanded);
        item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(
          node.id === 'project' ? 'file-binary' : node.id === 'pipeline' ? 'checklist' : 'history',
        );
        item.contextValue = 'revenant.analysisSection';
        return item;
      }
      case 'kv': {
        const item = new vscode.TreeItem(`${node.label}: ${node.value}`, C.None);
        item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(node.icon);
        item.tooltip = node.value;
        return item;
      }
      case 'stage': {
        const item = new vscode.TreeItem(node.stage.label, C.None);
        item.description = node.stage.detail ?? node.stage.status;
        item.iconPath = iconForStatus(node.stage.status);
        return item;
      }
      case 'op': {
        const item = new vscode.TreeItem(node.op.label, C.None);
        const time = node.op.time.slice(11, 19);
        item.description = node.op.detail ? `${time} · ${node.op.detail}` : time;
        item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(
          node.op.status === 'ok' ? 'pass' : node.op.status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'loading~spin',
        );
        return item;
      }
    }
  }

  getChildren(element?: Node): Node[] {
    if (!element) {
      return [
        { kind: 'section', id: 'project', label: 'Project' },
        { kind: 'section', id: 'pipeline', label: 'Pipeline' },
        { kind: 'section', id: 'recent', label: 'Recent operations' },
      ];
    }

    if (element.kind !== 'section') return [];

    if (element.id === 'project') {
      const info = this.session.binary;
      if (!info) return [kv('Status', 'no binary loaded', 'circle-slash')];
      return [
        kv('File', basename(info.path), 'file'),
        kv('Format', info.format.toUpperCase(), 'symbol-misc'),
        kv('Arch', `${info.architecture} (${info.bits}-bit, ${info.endianness})`, 'chip'),
        kv('Entry', info.entryPoint, 'debug-start'),
        kv('Image base', info.imageBase, 'location'),
        kv('Sections', String(info.sections.length), 'symbol-namespace'),
        kv('Imports/Exports', `${info.imports.length} / ${info.exports.length}`, 'references'),
        kv('Size', `${info.size.toLocaleString()} bytes`, 'database'),
        kv('SHA-256', short(info.hash), 'key'),
      ];
    }

    if (element.id === 'pipeline') {
      return this.session.stages.map((stage) => ({ kind: 'stage', stage }) satisfies Node);
    }

    // recent
    const ops = this.session.operations;
    if (!ops.length) return [kv('—', 'no operations yet', 'circle-outline')];
    return ops.slice(0, 20).map((op) => ({ kind: 'op', op }) satisfies Node);
  }
}

function kv(label: string, value: string, icon: string): Node {
  return { kind: 'kv', label, value, icon };
}

function iconForStatus(status: PipelineStage['status']): vscode.ThemeIcon {
  switch (status) {
    case 'running':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('loading~spin');
    case 'done':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('pass-filled', new vscode.ThemeColor('charts.green'));
    case 'error':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('error', new vscode.ThemeColor('charts.red'));
    case 'skipped':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('circle-slash');
    default:
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('circle-large-outline');
  }
}

function basename(p: string): string {
  return p.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? p;
}

function short(hash: string): string {
  return hash.length > 20 ? `${hash.slice(0, 12)}…${hash.slice(-6)}` : hash;
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/views/strings.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * StringsTreeProvider — the "Strings" tree.
 *
 * Lists strings extracted by the engine. A free-text filter (case-insensitive,
 * matches the string value, address or encoding) can be applied from the view
 * title bar. Each leaf shows the address + encoding and navigates on click.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { ExtractedString } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';

class StringItem extends vscode.TreeItem {
  constructor(public readonly entry: ExtractedString) {
    super(entry.value.length ? entry.value : '(empty)', vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.None);
    this.description = `${entry.address} · ${entry.encoding}${entry.section ? ' · ' + entry.section : ''}`;
    this.tooltip = `${entry.address} (${entry.encoding})\n${entry.value}`;
    this.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(entry.encoding === 'utf-16' ? 'symbol-key' : 'symbol-string');
    this.contextValue = 'revenant.string';
    this.command = {
      command: 'revenant.goToAddress',
      title: 'Go To Address',
      arguments: [entry.address],
    };
  }
}

export class StringsTreeProvider implements vscode.TreeDataProvider<StringItem> {
  private readonly _onDidChangeTreeData = new vscode.EventEmitter<StringItem | undefined>();
  readonly onDidChangeTreeData = this._onDidChangeTreeData.event;

  private filter = '';

  constructor(private readonly session: RevenantSession) {
    session.onDidChange((topic) => {
      if (topic === 'strings' || topic === 'binary') this.refresh();
    });
  }

  refresh(): void {
    this._onDidChangeTreeData.fire(undefined);
  }

  /** Apply a case-insensitive filter; empty string clears it. */
  setFilter(filter: string): void {
    this.filter = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
    this.refresh();
  }

  get currentFilter(): string {
    return this.filter;
  }

  getTreeItem(element: StringItem): vscode.TreeItem {
    return element;
  }

  getChildren(): StringItem[] {
    const f = this.filter;
    return this.session.strings
      .filter(
        (s) =>
          !f ||
          s.value.toLowerCase().includes(f) ||
          s.address.toLowerCase().includes(f) ||
          s.encoding.includes(f),
      )
      .map((s) => new StringItem(s));
  }
}
```
