`packages/vscode/src/views/symbols.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * SymbolTreeProvider — the "Symbols" tree.
 *
 * Presents the loaded binary's symbols grouped into three categories:
 *   • Entry point
 *   • Exports  → grouped by the containing section
 *   • Imports  → grouped by originating library
 *
 * Leaves are sortable by name or address (toggled from the view title bar) and
 * carry a `command` so a click selects the address and opens its disassembly.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';
import { parseAddress, sectionForAddress } from '../session.js';

type SortMode = 'address' | 'name';

type Node =
  | { kind: 'category'; id: 'entry' | 'exports' | 'imports'; label: string }
  | { kind: 'group'; label: string; group: 'section' | 'library'; key: string }
  | { kind: 'symbol'; label: string; address?: string; detail?: string };

export class SymbolTreeProvider implements vscode.TreeDataProvider<Node> {
  private readonly _onDidChangeTreeData = new vscode.EventEmitter<Node | undefined>();
  readonly onDidChangeTreeData = this._onDidChangeTreeData.event;

  private sort: SortMode = 'address';

  constructor(private readonly session: RevenantSession) {
    session.onDidChange((topic) => {
      if (topic === 'binary') this.refresh();
    });
  }

  refresh(): void {
    this._onDidChangeTreeData.fire(undefined);
  }

  toggleSort(): SortMode {
    this.sort = this.sort === 'address' ? 'name' : 'address';
    this.refresh();
    return this.sort;
  }

  getTreeItem(node: Node): vscode.TreeItem {
    const C = vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState;
    switch (node.kind) {
      case 'category': {
        const item = new vscode.TreeItem(node.label, C.Expanded);
        item.contextValue = 'revenant.symbolCategory';
        item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(
          node.id === 'entry' ? 'debug-start' : node.id === 'exports' ? 'export' : 'references',
        );
        return item;
      }
      case 'group': {
        const item = new vscode.TreeItem(node.label, C.Collapsed);
        item.contextValue = 'revenant.symbolGroup';
        item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(node.group === 'section' ? 'symbol-namespace' : 'library');
        return item;
      }
      case 'symbol': {
        const item = new vscode.TreeItem(node.label, C.None);
        item.description = node.detail ?? node.address;
        item.tooltip = node.address ? `${node.label}\n${node.address}` : node.label;
        item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon('symbol-function');
        item.contextValue = 'revenant.symbol';
        if (node.address) {
          item.command = {
            command: 'revenant.goToAddress',
            title: 'Go To Address',
            arguments: [node.address],
          };
        }
        return item;
      }
    }
  }

  getChildren(element?: Node): Node[] {
    const info = this.session.binary;
    if (!info) return element ? [] : [];

    if (!element) {
      return [
        { kind: 'category', id: 'entry', label: 'Entry point' },
        { kind: 'category', id: 'exports', label: `Exports (${info.exports.length})` },
        { kind: 'category', id: 'imports', label: `Imports (${info.imports.length})` },
      ];
    }

    if (element.kind === 'category') {
      if (element.id === 'entry') {
        return [
          {
            kind: 'symbol',
            label: 'start',
            address: info.entryPoint,
            detail: `${info.entryPoint} · ${sectionForAddress(info, info.entryPoint) ?? '?'}`,
          },
        ];
      }
      if (element.id === 'exports') {
        const sections = new Set<string>();
        for (const e of info.exports) sections.add(sectionForAddress(info, e.address) ?? '(none)');
        return [...sections]
          .sort()
          .map((s) => ({ kind: 'group', label: s, group: 'section', key: s }) satisfies Node);
      }
      // imports → group by library
      const libs = new Set<string>();
      for (const i of info.imports) libs.add(i.library || '(unknown)');
      return [...libs]
        .sort()
        .map((l) => ({ kind: 'group', label: l, group: 'library', key: l }) satisfies Node);
    }

    if (element.kind === 'group') {
      if (element.group === 'section') {
        const syms = info.exports
          .filter((e) => (sectionForAddress(info, e.address) ?? '(none)') === element.key)
          .map(
            (e) =>
              ({
                kind: 'symbol',
                label: e.name,
                address: e.address,
                detail: e.ordinal !== undefined ? `#${e.ordinal} · ${e.address}` : e.address,
              }) satisfies Node,
          );
        return this.sorted(syms);
      }
      const syms = info.imports
        .filter((i) => (i.library || '(unknown)') === element.key)
        .map(
          (i) =>
            ({
              kind: 'symbol',
              label: i.name,
              address: i.address,
              detail: i.address ?? (i.ordinal !== undefined ? `ordinal #${i.ordinal}` : 'import'),
            }) satisfies Node,
        );
      return this.sorted(syms);
    }

    return [];
  }

  private sorted(nodes: Node[]): Node[] {
    return [...nodes].sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.kind !== 'symbol' || b.kind !== 'symbol') return 0;
      if (this.sort === 'name') return a.label.localeCompare(b.label);
      const av = a.address ? parseAddress(a.address) : 0n;
      const bv = b.address ? parseAddress(b.address) : 0n;
      return av < bv ? -1 : av > bv ? 1 : 0;
    });
  }
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/views/vm.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * VmStatusProvider — the "Analysis VMs" tree.
 *
 * Lists hardened analysis VMs with a state-coloured icon. Expanding a VM shows
 * its details (OS, CPU, memory, hardened flag, current snapshot). The VM leaves
 * carry `contextValue: revenant.vm`, which drives the start/stop/stealth-test/
 * execute context menu contributed in package.json.
 *
 * VBoxManage is queried lazily via the engine; failures (e.g. VirtualBox not
 * installed) surface as an inline message node instead of an error toast.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { VmInfo, VmState } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';

/** A VM row. Exposes `vmName` so command handlers can act on the selection. */
export class VmTreeItem extends vscode.TreeItem {
  constructor(public readonly vm: VmInfo) {
    super(vm.name, vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.Collapsed);
    this.description = vm.state + (vm.hardened ? ' · hardened' : '');
    this.tooltip = `${vm.name}\n${vm.os} · ${vm.cpuCount} vCPU · ${vm.memoryMb} MB\nstate: ${vm.state}`;
    this.iconPath = iconForState(vm.state);
    this.contextValue = 'revenant.vm';
  }

  get vmName(): string {
    return this.vm.name;
  }
}

type Node = VmTreeItem | vscode.TreeItem;

export class VmStatusProvider implements vscode.TreeDataProvider<Node> {
  private readonly _onDidChangeTreeData = new vscode.EventEmitter<Node | undefined>();
  readonly onDidChangeTreeData = this._onDidChangeTreeData.event;

  private loading = false;
  private error?: string;
  private loaded = false;

  constructor(private readonly session: RevenantSession) {
    session.onDidChange((topic) => {
      if (topic === 'vm') this._onDidChangeTreeData.fire(undefined);
    });
  }

  refresh(): void {
    void this.reload();
  }

  /** Query VBoxManage for the current VM inventory and cache it on the session. */
  async reload(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.loading) return;
    this.loading = true;
    this.error = undefined;
    this._onDidChangeTreeData.fire(undefined);
    try {
      const res = await this.session.engine.listVms();
      if (res.ok && res.data) this.session.setVms(res.data); // fires 'vm' → tree refresh
      else this.error = res.error ?? 'Failed to list VMs';
    } catch (err) {
      this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    } finally {
      this.loading = false;
      this.loaded = true;
      this._onDidChangeTreeData.fire(undefined);
    }
  }

  getTreeItem(element: Node): vscode.TreeItem {
    return element;
  }

  getChildren(element?: Node): Node[] {
    if (!element) {
      if (this.loading && !this.loaded) return [message('Querying VirtualBox…', 'loading~spin')];
      if (this.error) {
        return [
          message(`VirtualBox unavailable: ${this.error}`, 'warning'),
          message('Create a VM with “REVENANT: Create Analysis VM…”.', 'info'),
        ];
      }
      const vms = this.session.vms;
      if (!vms.length) return [message('No analysis VMs. Create one to begin.', 'info')];
      return vms.map((vm) => new VmTreeItem(vm));
    }

    if (element instanceof VmTreeItem) {
      const vm = element.vm;
      return [
        detail('State', vm.state, stateIconId(vm.state)),
        detail('OS', vm.os, 'device-desktop'),
        detail('CPU', `${vm.cpuCount} vCPU`, 'chip'),
        detail('Memory', `${vm.memoryMb} MB`, 'server'),
        detail('Hardened', vm.hardened ? 'yes' : 'no', vm.hardened ? 'shield' : 'unlock'),
        ...(vm.snapshotName ? [detail('Snapshot', vm.snapshotName, 'history')] : []),
        ...(vm.uuid ? [detail('UUID', vm.uuid, 'key')] : []),
      ];
    }
    return [];
  }
}

function detail(label: string, value: string, icon: string): vscode.TreeItem {
  const item = new vscode.TreeItem(`${label}: ${value}`, vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.None);
  item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(icon);
  item.contextValue = 'revenant.vmDetail';
  return item;
}

function message(text: string, icon: string): vscode.TreeItem {
  const item = new vscode.TreeItem(text, vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState.None);
  item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(icon);
  item.contextValue = 'revenant.vmMessage';
  return item;
}

function stateIconId(state: VmState): string {
  switch (state) {
    case 'running':
      return 'vm-running';
    case 'paused':
      return 'debug-pause';
    case 'starting':
    case 'stopping':
      return 'loading~spin';
    case 'error':
      return 'vm-outline';
    default:
      return 'vm';
  }
}

function iconForState(state: VmState): vscode.ThemeIcon {
  switch (state) {
    case 'running':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('vm-running', new vscode.ThemeColor('charts.green'));
    case 'paused':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('debug-pause', new vscode.ThemeColor('charts.yellow'));
    case 'starting':
    case 'stopping':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('loading~spin');
    case 'error':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('vm-outline', new vscode.ThemeColor('charts.red'));
    case 'poweroff':
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('vm', new vscode.ThemeColor('descriptionForeground'));
    default:
      return new vscode.ThemeIcon('vm-outline');
  }
}
```

`packages/vscode/src/views/xrefs.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * XrefTreeProvider — the "Cross-references" tree.
 *
 * Shows the cross-references for the session's currently selected address,
 * grouped by direction:
 *   • "To"   — references that point *at* the selected address (callers, reads…)
 *   • "From" — references that originate *at* the selected address (callees…)
 *
 * Each leaf shows the reference kind (call/jump/data/read/write) and navigates to
 * the opposite endpoint on click.
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';
import type { CrossReference } from '@revenant/shared';
import type { RevenantSession } from '../session.js';

type Node =
  | { kind: 'direction'; dir: 'to' | 'from'; label: string }
  | { kind: 'ref'; ref: CrossReference; dir: 'to' | 'from' };

export class XrefTreeProvider implements vscode.TreeDataProvider<Node> {
  private readonly _onDidChangeTreeData = new vscode.EventEmitter<Node | undefined>();
  readonly onDidChangeTreeData = this._onDidChangeTreeData.event;

  constructor(private readonly session: RevenantSession) {
    session.onDidChange((topic) => {
      if (topic === 'selection' || topic === 'xrefs' || topic === 'binary') this.refresh();
    });
  }

  refresh(): void {
    this._onDidChangeTreeData.fire(undefined);
  }

  getTreeItem(node: Node): vscode.TreeItem {
    const C = vscode.TreeItemCollapsibleState;
    if (node.kind === 'direction') {
      const item = new vscode.TreeItem(node.label, C.Expanded);
      item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(node.dir === 'to' ? 'arrow-left' : 'arrow-right');
      item.contextValue = 'revenant.xrefDirection';
      return item;
    }
    // A "to" ref is best navigated to its source; a "from" ref to its target.
    const other = node.dir === 'to' ? node.ref.from : node.ref.to;
    const item = new vscode.TreeItem(other, C.None);
    item.description = node.dir === 'to' ? `${node.ref.kind} from` : `${node.ref.kind} to`;
    item.iconPath = new vscode.ThemeIcon(iconForKind(node.ref.kind));
    item.tooltip = `${node.ref.from} → ${node.ref.to} (${node.ref.kind})`;
    item.contextValue = 'revenant.xref';
    item.command = { command: 'revenant.goToAddress', title: 'Go To Address', arguments: [other] };
    return item;
  }

  getChildren(element?: Node): Node[] {
    const addr = this.session.selectedAddress;
    if (!addr) return [];

    if (!element) {
      const to = this.session.xrefs.to(addr);
      const from = this.session.xrefs.from(addr);
      return [
        { kind: 'direction', dir: 'to', label: `To ${addr} (${to.length})` },
        { kind: 'direction', dir: 'from', label: `From ${addr} (${from.length})` },
      ];
    }

    if (element.kind === 'direction') {
      const refs = element.dir === 'to' ? this.session.xrefs.to(addr) : this.session.xrefs.from(addr);
      return refs.map((ref) => ({ kind: 'ref', ref, dir: element.dir }) satisfies Node);
    }
    return [];
  }
}

function iconForKind(kind: CrossReference['kind']): string {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'call':
      return 'call-outgoing';
    case 'jump':
      return 'arrow-small-right';
    case 'read':
      return 'eye';
    case 'write':
      return 'edit';
    default:
      return 'symbol-field';
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Shared webview helpers: a nonce generator and a strict Content-Security-Policy
 * builder so every webview in the extension opts into the same hardened defaults
 * (no remote content, inline scripts/styles gated by a per-render nonce).
 */

import * as vscode from 'vscode';

/** Cryptographically-flavoured nonce for CSP `script-src`/`style-src`. */
export function makeNonce(): string {
  const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
  let text = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) text += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  return text;
}

/** Build a restrictive CSP meta tag for a webview. */
export function cspMeta(webview: vscode.Webview, nonce: string): string {
  return [
    `default-src 'none'`,
    `img-src ${webview.cspSource} data:`,
    `style-src ${webview.cspSource} 'nonce-${nonce}'`,
    `script-src 'nonce-${nonce}'`,
    `font-src ${webview.cspSource}`,
  ].join('; ');
}

/** HTML-escape a string for safe interpolation into webview markup. */
export function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

/** Baseline stylesheet shared by the extension's webviews (theme-aware). */

    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.75rem;
  }
  h1, h2, h3 { font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; }
  a { color: var(--vscode-textLink-foreground); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }

  code, .mono { font-family: var(--vscode-editor-font-family, monospace); }
  .muted { color: var(--vscode-descriptionForeground); }
  .pill {
    display: inline-block; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.8em;

  }
  .bar { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--vscode-progressBar-background, #0a6); }
  .bar-track { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--vscode-input-background); overflow: hidden; }
`;
```

`scripts/build-native.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Build the REVENANT native layer (native/) with CMake.
 *
 *   npm run build:native
 *   npm run build:native -- --debug
 *   npm run build:native -- --no-revng --no-unthemidator
 *   npm run build:native -- --clean --verbose
 *
 * Options
 *   --release            Release build (default)
 *   --debug              Debug build
 *   --no-revng           do not build the revng lifter
 *   --no-novmp           do not build NoVmp
 *   --no-unthemidator    do not build unthemidator
 *   --no-bindings        do not build the revenant_native N-API addon
 *   --clean              delete native/build before configuring
 *   --jobs <n>           parallel build jobs (default: all cores)
 *   --generator <name>   force a CMake generator (e.g. "Ninja")
 *   --fetch-headers      download Node.js headers with node-gyp if they are missing
 *   --verbose            stream raw CMake/compiler output instead of a spinner
 *
 * Toolchains
 *   Windows  MSVC through the Visual Studio generator (located with vswhere),
 *            or Ninja + cl when run from a Developer Command Prompt.
 *   Linux    GCC or Clang (honours $CC/$CXX), Ninja when available.
 */

import chalk from 'chalk';
import ora, { type Ora } from 'ora';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { cpus, homedir } from 'node:os';
import { join, relative } from 'node:path';
import {
  IS_WINDOWS,
  REPO_ROOT,
  compareVersions,
  extractVersion,
  findVisualStudio,
  firstLine,
  isFile,
  stream,
  which,
} from './lib/util.js';

const NATIVE_DIR = join(REPO_ROOT, 'native');
const BUILD_DIR = join(NATIVE_DIR, 'build');
const LOG_FILE = join(BUILD_DIR, 'revenant-build.log');
const MIN_CMAKE = '3.20.0';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Options
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface Options {
  buildType: 'Release' | 'Debug';
  revng: boolean | undefined; // undefined = let CMake pick its platform default
  novmp: boolean;
  unthemidator: boolean;
  bindings: boolean;
  clean: boolean;
  jobs: number;
  generator?: string;
  fetchHeaders: boolean;
  verbose: boolean;
}

function usage(): never {
  console.log(
    [
      'Usage: npm run build:native -- [options]',
      '',
      '  --release | --debug     build configuration (default: --release)',
      '  --no-revng              skip the revng lifter',
      '  --no-novmp              skip NoVmp',
      '  --no-unthemidator       skip unthemidator',
      '  --no-bindings           skip the N-API addon',
      '  --clean                 remove native/build first',
      '  --jobs <n>              parallel jobs (default: all cores)',
      '  --generator <name>      CMake generator override',
      '  --fetch-headers         fetch Node.js headers via node-gyp when missing',
      '  --verbose               show raw build output',
    ].join('\n'),
  );
  process.exit(0);
}

function parseArgs(argv: string[]): Options {
  const opts: Options = {
    buildType: 'Release',
    revng: undefined,
    novmp: true,
    unthemidator: true,
    bindings: true,
    clean: false,
    jobs: Math.max(1, cpus().length),
    fetchHeaders: false,
    verbose: false,
  };

  const value = (i: number, flag: string): string => {
    const v = argv[i + 1];
    if (v === undefined || v.startsWith('--')) fail(`${flag} requires a value`);
    return v;
  };

  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const arg = argv[i]!;
    switch (arg) {
      case '--release':
        opts.buildType = 'Release';
        break;
      case '--debug':
        opts.buildType = 'Debug';
        break;
      case '--no-revng':
        opts.revng = false;
        break;
      case '--revng':
        opts.revng = true;
        break;
      case '--no-novmp':
        opts.novmp = false;
        break;
      case '--no-unthemidator':
        opts.unthemidator = false;
        break;
      case '--no-bindings':
        opts.bindings = false;
        break;
      case '--clean':
        opts.clean = true;
        break;
      case '--fetch-headers':
        opts.fetchHeaders = true;
        break;
      case '--verbose':
      case '-v':
        opts.verbose = true;
        break;
      case '--jobs':
      case '-j': {
        const n = Number.parseInt(value(i, arg), 10);
        if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) fail('--jobs expects a positive integer');
        opts.jobs = n;
        i++;
        break;
      }
      case '--generator':
      case '-G':
        opts.generator = value(i, arg);
        i++;
        break;
      case '--help':
      case '-h':
        usage();
        break;
      default:
        if (arg.startsWith('--jobs=')) {
          const n = Number.parseInt(arg.slice('--jobs='.length), 10);
          if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) fail('--jobs expects a positive integer');
          opts.jobs = n;
        } else {
          fail(`Unknown option: ${arg} (try --help)`);
        }
    }
  }
  return opts;
}

function fail(message: string, hints: string[] = []): never {
  console.error(chalk.red(`\n${message}`));
  for (const h of hints) console.error(chalk.dim(`  ${h}`));
  process.exit(1);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Toolchain detection
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface Toolchain {
  description: string;
  /** Extra arguments for `cmake` configure (generator, platform, compilers). */
  configureArgs: string[];
  /** True when the generator is multi-config (Visual Studio, Xcode). */
  multiConfig: boolean;
}

function detectToolchain(opts: Options): Toolchain {
  if (opts.generator) {
    const multi = /visual studio|xcode|multi-config/i.test(opts.generator);
    return {
      description: `generator "${opts.generator}" (user override)`,
      configureArgs: ['-G', opts.generator],
      multiConfig: multi,
    };
  }

  const ninja = which('ninja');

  if (IS_WINDOWS) {
    // Inside a Developer Command Prompt cl.exe is on PATH and Ninja works.
    if (which('cl') && ninja) {
      return {
        description: 'MSVC (cl.exe from the developer environment) + Ninja',
        configureArgs: ['-G', 'Ninja', '-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=cl', '-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=cl'],
        multiConfig: false,
      };
    }
    const vs = findVisualStudio();
    if (vs) {
      // No -G: CMake selects the newest Visual Studio generator it supports.
      const arch = process.arch === 'arm64' ? 'ARM64' : 'x64';
      return {
        description: `MSVC via the Visual Studio generator (newest install: ${vs.displayName}), platform ${arch}`,
        configureArgs: ['-A', arch],
        multiConfig: true,
      };
    }
    // MinGW / clang as a last resort.
    const gxx = which('g++') ?? which('clang++');
    if (gxx && ninja) {
      return {
        description: `${gxx} + Ninja (no Visual Studio found)`,
        configureArgs: ['-G', 'Ninja', `-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${gxx}`],
        multiConfig: false,
      };
    }
    fail('No C++ toolchain found.', [
      'Install "Build Tools for Visual Studio" with the "Desktop development with C++" workload,',
      'or run this script from a Developer Command Prompt.',
    ]);
  }

  // Linux / macOS: honour CC/CXX, otherwise let CMake choose between GCC and Clang.
  const args: string[] = [];
  if (ninja) args.push('-G', 'Ninja');
  const cxx = process.env.CXX ?? (which('g++') ? 'g++' : which('clang++') ? 'clang++' : undefined);
  if (!cxx) {
    fail('No C++ compiler found.', ['Install GCC (build-essential) or Clang, or set $CXX.']);
  }
  const version = extractVersion(firstLine(cxx, ['--version']));
  return {
    description: `${cxx}${version ? ` ${version}` : ''} + ${ninja ? 'Ninja' : 'Unix Makefiles'}`,
    configureArgs: args,
    multiConfig: false,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Node.js headers for the addon
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface NodeHeaders {
  includeDir: string;
  /** node.lib import library (Windows only). */
  lib?: string;
}

function nodeGypCacheDirs(): string[] {
  const version = process.versions.node;
  const dirs: string[] = [];
  if (IS_WINDOWS && process.env.LOCALAPPDATA) {
    dirs.push(join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA, 'node-gyp', 'Cache', version));
  }
  dirs.push(
    join(homedir(), '.cache', 'node-gyp', version),
    join(homedir(), 'Library', 'Caches', 'node-gyp', version),
    join(homedir(), '.node-gyp', version),
  );
  return dirs;
}

function findNodeHeaders(): NodeHeaders | undefined {
  const arch = process.arch === 'ia32' ? 'ia32' : process.arch;

  // Headers shipped next to the node binary (typical on Linux/macOS).
  const prefixInclude = join(process.execPath, '..', '..', 'include', 'node');
  if (!IS_WINDOWS && isFile(join(prefixInclude, 'node_api.h'))) {
    return { includeDir: prefixInclude };
  }

  for (const root of nodeGypCacheDirs()) {
    const includeDir = join(root, 'include', 'node');
    if (!isFile(join(includeDir, 'node_api.h'))) continue;
    if (!IS_WINDOWS) return { includeDir };
    const lib = join(root, arch, 'node.lib');
    if (isFile(lib)) return { includeDir, lib };
  }
  return undefined;
}

function findNodeAddonApi(): string | undefined {
  try {
    const require = createRequire(join(REPO_ROOT, 'package.json'));
    const pkg = require.resolve('node-addon-api/package.json');
    const dir = join(pkg, '..');
    return isFile(join(dir, 'napi.h')) ? dir : undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

async function ensureBindingPrereqs(opts: Options): Promise<string[]> {
  const addonApi = findNodeAddonApi();
  if (!addonApi) {
    fail('node-addon-api is not installed.', [
      'Run `npm install` at the repository root, or pass --no-bindings.',
    ]);
  }

  let headers = findNodeHeaders();
  if (!headers && opts.fetchHeaders) {
    const spinner = ora(`Fetching Node.js ${process.versions.node} headers with node-gyp`).start();
    const npx = IS_WINDOWS ? 'npx.cmd' : 'npx';
    // npx.cmd is a batch file: it must go through the shell on Windows. The
    // command line is a fixed string, nothing user-controlled is interpolated.
    const res = IS_WINDOWS
      ? await stream(process.env.ComSpec ?? 'cmd.exe', ['/d', '/s', '/c', `${npx} --yes node-gyp install`], { cwd: REPO_ROOT })
      : await stream(npx, ['--yes', 'node-gyp', 'install'], { cwd: REPO_ROOT });
    if (res.code !== 0) {
      spinner.fail('node-gyp could not download the headers');
      console.error(chalk.dim(tail(res.log, 15)));
      process.exit(1);
    }
    spinner.succeed('Node.js headers installed');
    headers = findNodeHeaders();
  }
  if (!headers) {
    fail(`Node.js ${process.versions.node} development headers were not found.`, [
      'Re-run with --fetch-headers (downloads them from nodejs.org via node-gyp),',
      'or run `npx node-gyp install` yourself, or pass --no-bindings.',
    ]);
  }

  const args = [`-DNODE_INCLUDE_DIR=${headers.includeDir}`, `-DNODE_ADDON_API_DIR=${addonApi}`];
  if (headers.lib) args.push(`-DNODE_LIB=${headers.lib}`);
  return args;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Running CMake with progress
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function tail(log: string, lines: number): string {
  return log.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).slice(-lines).join('\n');
}

/** Turn a raw build line into a short spinner status, or undefined to ignore it. */
function progressFrom(rawLine: string): string | undefined {
  const text = rawLine.trim();
  // Ninja: "[12/340] Building CXX object ..."
  const ninja = text.match(/^\[(\d+)\/(\d+)\]\s+(.*)$/);
  if (ninja) {
    const [, done, total, rest] = ninja;
    const pct = Math.floor((Number(done) / Math.max(1, Number(total))) * 100);
    return `${pct}% (${done}/${total}) ${shorten(rest ?? '')}`;
  }
  // Makefiles: "[ 42%] Building CXX object ..."
  const make = text.match(/^\[\s*(\d+)%\]\s+(.*)$/);
  if (make) return `${make[1]}% ${shorten(make[2] ?? '')}`;
  // MSBuild prints the bare source file name while compiling it.
  if (/^[\w.+-]+\.(c|cc|cpp|cxx)$/i.test(text)) return `compiling ${text}`;
  const link = text.match(/->\s+(.+\.(?:node|exe|dll|lib|so|a))$/i);
  if (link) return `linked ${shorten(link[1] ?? '')}`;
  // CMake configure output.
  if (text.startsWith('-- ')) return shorten(text.slice(3));
  return undefined;
}

function shorten(text: string, max = 70): string {
  const clean = text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  return clean.length > max ? `...${clean.slice(clean.length - max + 3)}` : clean;
}

async function runStep(title: string, args: string[], opts: Options, fullLog: string[]): Promise<void> {
  const started = Date.now();
  const printable = `cmake ${args.map((a) => (/\s/.test(a) ? `"${a}"` : a)).join(' ')}`;
  fullLog.push(`\n$ ${printable}\n`);

  if (opts.verbose) {
    console.log(chalk.dim(`\n$ ${printable}`));
    const res = await stream('cmake', args, { cwd: REPO_ROOT, inherit: true });
    if (res.code !== 0) fail(`${title} failed (exit code ${res.code}).`);
    console.log(chalk.green(`${title} finished in ${seconds(started)}s`));
    return;
  }

  const spinner: Ora = ora({ text: title, spinner: 'dots' }).start();
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const res = await stream('cmake', args, {
    cwd: REPO_ROOT,
    onLine: (l) => {
      if (/\bwarning\b/i.test(l) && warnings.length < 200) warnings.push(l.trim());
      const status = progressFrom(l);
      if (status) spinner.text = `${title}  ${chalk.dim(status)}`;
    },
  });
  fullLog.push(res.log);

  if (res.code !== 0) {
    spinner.fail(`${title} failed (exit code ${res.code})`);
    flushLog(fullLog);
    const errors = res.log
      .split(/\r?\n/)
      .filter((l) => /\berror\b|FAILED:|CMake Error/i.test(l))
      .slice(0, 25);
    console.error(chalk.red('\n' + (errors.length ? errors.join('\n') : tail(res.log, 40))));
    console.error(chalk.dim(`\nFull log: ${LOG_FILE}`));
    console.error(chalk.dim('Re-run with --verbose to stream compiler output.'));
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const suffix = warnings.length ? chalk.yellow(` (${warnings.length} warning line(s), see log)`) : '';
  spinner.succeed(`${title} ${chalk.dim(`${seconds(started)}s`)}${suffix}`);
}

function seconds(since: number): string {
  return ((Date.now() - since) / 1000).toFixed(1);
}

function flushLog(fullLog: string[]): void {
  try {
    mkdirSync(BUILD_DIR, { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(LOG_FILE, fullLog.join(''));
  } catch {
    // The log is a convenience; never let it mask the real failure.
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Post-build verification
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface EngineStatus {
  available: boolean;
  compiledIn: boolean;
  backend: string;
  path: string | null;
}

interface AddonVersion {
  version: string;
  compiler: string;
  buildType: string;
  engines: Record<string, EngineStatus>;
}

function findAddon(): string | undefined {
  const candidates = [
    join(BUILD_DIR, 'bin', 'revenant_native.node'),
    join(BUILD_DIR, 'bin', 'Release', 'revenant_native.node'),
    join(BUILD_DIR, 'bin', 'Debug', 'revenant_native.node'),
  ];
  return candidates.find(isFile);
}

function verifyAddon(): boolean {
  const addon = findAddon();
  if (!addon) {
    console.error(chalk.red('  revenant_native.node was not produced'));
    return false;
  }
  try {
    const require = createRequire(join(REPO_ROOT, 'package.json'));
    const native = require(addon) as { getVersion(): AddonVersion } & Record<string, unknown>;
    const missing = ['loadBinary', 'liftBinary', 'devirtBinary', 'getVersion'].filter(
      (name) => typeof native[name] !== 'function',
    );
    if (missing.length) {
      console.error(chalk.red(`  addon is missing exports: ${missing.join(', ')}`));
      return false;
    }
    const info = native.getVersion();
    console.log(`  ${chalk.green('addon')}   ${relative(REPO_ROOT, addon)}`);
    console.log(chalk.dim(`          v${info.version}, ${info.compiler}, ${info.buildType}`));
    for (const [name, status] of Object.entries(info.engines)) {
      const state = status.available
        ? chalk.green('available')
        : chalk.yellow('not found');
      const where = status.path ? chalk.dim(` ${status.path}`) : '';
      console.log(`  ${name.padEnd(13)} ${state} ${chalk.dim(`[${status.backend}]`)}${where}`);
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(chalk.red(`  addon failed to load: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`));
    return false;
  }
}

function engineSourcePresent(dir: string): boolean {
  const abs = join(NATIVE_DIR, dir);
  return existsSync(abs) && readdirSync(abs).some((e) => e !== '.gitkeep');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const opts = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  const started = Date.now();

  console.log(chalk.bold('\nREVENANT native build'));

  // --- CMake ---------------------------------------------------------------
  const cmakeVersion = extractVersion(firstLine('cmake', ['--version']));
  if (!cmakeVersion) {
    fail('CMake was not found on PATH.', [`Install CMake >= ${MIN_CMAKE} (https://cmake.org/download).`]);
  }
  if (compareVersions(cmakeVersion, MIN_CMAKE) < 0) {
    fail(`CMake ${cmakeVersion} is too old; ${MIN_CMAKE} or newer is required.`);
  }
  if (!isFile(join(NATIVE_DIR, 'CMakeLists.txt'))) {
    fail(`native/CMakeLists.txt not found under ${REPO_ROOT}.`);
  }

  const toolchain = detectToolchain(opts);
  console.log(chalk.dim(`  cmake:      ${cmakeVersion}`));
  console.log(chalk.dim(`  toolchain:  ${toolchain.description}`));
  console.log(chalk.dim(`  config:     ${opts.buildType}, ${opts.jobs} job(s)`));

  // --- Engines -------------------------------------------------------------
  const engines: Array<{ flag: string; dir: string; enabled: boolean | undefined }> = [
    { flag: 'BUILD_REVNG', dir: 'revng', enabled: opts.revng },
    { flag: 'BUILD_NOVMP', dir: 'novmp', enabled: opts.novmp },
    { flag: 'BUILD_UNTHEMIDATOR', dir: 'unthemidator', enabled: opts.unthemidator },
  ];
  const engineArgs: string[] = [];
  for (const e of engines) {
    if (e.enabled !== undefined) engineArgs.push(`-D${e.flag}=${e.enabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`);
    const state =
      e.enabled === false
        ? 'disabled'
        : engineSourcePresent(e.dir)
          ? e.enabled === undefined
            ? 'platform default'
            : 'enabled'
          : chalk.yellow('submodule not checked out (will be skipped; run `npm run setup`)');
    console.log(chalk.dim(`  ${e.dir.padEnd(13)} `) + state);
  }
  console.log(chalk.dim(`  ${'bindings'.padEnd(13)} `) + (opts.bindings ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'));
  console.log('');

  const bindingArgs = opts.bindings ? await ensureBindingPrereqs(opts) : [];

  // --- Clean ---------------------------------------------------------------
  if (opts.clean && existsSync(BUILD_DIR)) {
    rmSync(BUILD_DIR, { recursive: true, force: true });
    console.log(chalk.dim('  removed native/build'));
  }
  mkdirSync(BUILD_DIR, { recursive: true });

  // --- Configure + build ---------------------------------------------------
  const fullLog: string[] = [];
  const configureArgs = [
    '-S',
    NATIVE_DIR,
    '-B',
    BUILD_DIR,
    ...toolchain.configureArgs,
    `-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${opts.buildType}`,
    `-DBUILD_BINDINGS=${opts.bindings ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`,
    ...engineArgs,
    ...bindingArgs,
  ];
  await runStep('Configuring', configureArgs, opts, fullLog);

  const buildArgs = ['--build', BUILD_DIR, '--config', opts.buildType, '--parallel', String(opts.jobs)];
  await runStep(`Building (${opts.buildType})`, buildArgs, opts, fullLog);
  flushLog(fullLog);

  // --- Verify --------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log(chalk.bold('\nArtifacts'));
  let ok = true;
  if (opts.bindings) {
    ok = verifyAddon();
  } else {
    console.log(chalk.dim('  bindings disabled; nothing to load'));
  }

  console.log(
    `\n${ok ? chalk.green('Native build complete') : chalk.red('Native build finished with problems')} ` +
      chalk.dim(`in ${seconds(started)}s. Output: ${relative(REPO_ROOT, join(BUILD_DIR, 'bin'))}, log: ${relative(REPO_ROOT, LOG_FILE)}`),
  );
  process.exitCode = ok ? 0 : 1;
}

main().catch((err: unknown) => {
  console.error(chalk.red(`\nNative build failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`));
  process.exit(1);
});

```

`scripts/lib/util.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Shared helpers for the REVENANT automation scripts (setup, build-native,
 * test-vm-stealth). Node built-ins only, so the scripts can run before the
 * workspace packages have been built.
 */

import { spawn, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { delimiter, dirname, isAbsolute, join, resolve } from 'node:path';

/**
 * Locate the repository root by walking up from the running script (and then
 * from the working directory) to the workspace package.json. This deliberately
 * avoids both `__dirname` and `import.meta.url` so the scripts behave the same
 * whether tsx loads them as CommonJS or as ES modules.
 */
function findRepoRoot(): string {
  const starts = [process.argv[1] ? dirname(resolve(process.argv[1])) : undefined, process.cwd()];
  for (const start of starts) {
    let dir = start;
    while (dir) {
      const manifest = join(dir, 'package.json');
      if (existsSync(manifest)) {
        try {
          const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(manifest, 'utf8')) as { name?: string; workspaces?: unknown };
          if (pkg.name === '@revenant/workspace' || (pkg.workspaces && existsSync(join(dir, 'native')))) {
            return dir;
          }
        } catch {
          // Unreadable manifest: keep walking up.
        }
      }
      const parent = dirname(dir);
      if (parent === dir) break;
      dir = parent;
    }
  }
  throw new Error('Could not locate the REVENANT repository root (run this from inside the repository).');
}

/** Absolute path of the repository root (the directory containing scripts/). */
export const REPO_ROOT = findRepoRoot();

export const IS_WINDOWS = process.platform === 'win32';

export interface RunResult {
  code: number;
  stdout: string;
  stderr: string;
  /** Set when the process could not be started at all. */
  error?: Error;
}

/**
 * Run a command synchronously without a shell and capture its output.
 * Never throws: a missing executable is reported through `error`/`code`.
 */
export function capture(
  cmd: string,
  args: string[] = [],
  options: { cwd?: string; timeoutMs?: number; env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv } = {},
): RunResult {
  const result = spawnSync(cmd, args, {
    cwd: options.cwd,
    env: options.env ?? process.env,
    encoding: 'utf8',
    timeout: options.timeoutMs ?? 30_000,
    windowsHide: true,
    maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024,
  });
  return {
    code: result.status ?? -1,
    stdout: (result.stdout ?? '').toString(),
    stderr: (result.stderr ?? '').toString(),
    error: result.error,
  };
}

/** First non-empty line of a command's output, or undefined if it failed. */
export function firstLine(cmd: string, args: string[] = [], cwd?: string): string | undefined {
  const res = capture(cmd, args, { cwd });
  if (res.error || res.code !== 0) return undefined;
  const text = `${res.stdout}\n${res.stderr}`;
  return text
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => l.trim())
    .find((l) => l.length > 0);
}

/**
 * Locate an executable on PATH (honouring PATHEXT on Windows).
 * Returns the absolute path, or undefined when it is not installed.
 */
export function which(name: string, extraDirs: string[] = []): string | undefined {
  const exts = IS_WINDOWS
    ? ['', ...(process.env.PATHEXT ?? '.EXE;.CMD;.BAT;.COM').split(';').filter(Boolean)]
    : [''];
  const dirs = [...(process.env.PATH ?? '').split(delimiter), ...extraDirs].filter(Boolean);
  if (isAbsolute(name)) return isFile(name) ? name : undefined;
  for (const dir of dirs) {
    for (const ext of exts) {
      const candidate = join(dir.replace(/^"|"$/g, ''), name + ext);
      if (isFile(candidate)) return candidate;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function isFile(path: string): boolean {
  try {
    return statSync(path).isFile();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function isDirectory(path: string): boolean {
  try {
    return statSync(path).isDirectory();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export interface StreamOptions {
  cwd?: string;
  env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
  /** Called for every complete output line (stdout and stderr interleaved). */
  onLine?: (line: string) => void;
  /** Pass the child's output straight through to this terminal. */
  inherit?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Run a command asynchronously without a shell, streaming its output line by
 * line. Resolves with the exit code and the full combined log.
 */
export function stream(
  cmd: string,
  args: string[],
  options: StreamOptions = {},
): Promise<{ code: number; log: string }> {
  return new Promise((resolvePromise, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(cmd, args, {
      cwd: options.cwd,
      env: options.env ?? process.env,
      stdio: options.inherit ? 'inherit' : ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
      windowsHide: true,
    });

    const chunks: string[] = [];
    let pending = '';
    const feed = (data: Buffer): void => {
      const text = data.toString('utf8');
      chunks.push(text);
      pending += text;
      const lines = pending.split(/\r?\n|\r/);
      pending = lines.pop() ?? '';
      for (const line of lines) {
        if (line.trim()) options.onLine?.(line);
      }
    };
    child.stdout?.on('data', feed);
    child.stderr?.on('data', feed);

    child.once('error', reject);
    child.once('close', (code) => {
      if (pending.trim()) options.onLine?.(pending);
      resolvePromise({ code: code ?? -1, log: chunks.join('') });
    });
  });
}

/** Compare dotted version strings. Returns <0, 0 or >0. */
export function compareVersions(a: string, b: string): number {
  const pa = a.split('.').map((n) => Number.parseInt(n, 10) || 0);
  const pb = b.split('.').map((n) => Number.parseInt(n, 10) || 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(pa.length, pb.length); i++) {
    const diff = (pa[i] ?? 0) - (pb[i] ?? 0);
    if (diff !== 0) return diff;
  }
  return 0;
}

/** Pull the first x.y[.z] version number out of arbitrary tool output. */
export function extractVersion(text: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  return text?.match(/(\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/)?.[1];
}

export interface VisualStudioInfo {
  installationPath: string;
  displayName: string;
  version: string;
}

/**
 * Find a Visual Studio installation that includes the MSVC x64 toolset, via
 * vswhere (installed with every VS 2017+ and the Build Tools).
 */
export function findVisualStudio(): VisualStudioInfo | undefined {
  if (!IS_WINDOWS) return undefined;
  const pf86 = process.env['ProgramFiles(x86)'] ?? 'C:\\Program Files (x86)';
  const vswhere = join(pf86, 'Microsoft Visual Studio', 'Installer', 'vswhere.exe');
  if (!existsSync(vswhere)) return undefined;
  const res = capture(vswhere, [
    '-latest',
    '-products',
    '*',
    '-requires',
    'Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64',
    '-format',
    'json',
    '-utf8',
  ]);
  if (res.code !== 0) return undefined;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(res.stdout) as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    const first = parsed[0];
    if (!first || typeof first.installationPath !== 'string') return undefined;
    return {
      installationPath: first.installationPath,
      displayName: typeof first.displayName === 'string' ? first.displayName : 'Visual Studio',
      version: typeof first.installationVersion === 'string' ? first.installationVersion : '',
    };
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

/** Common QEMU install locations that are usually not on PATH (Windows). */
export function qemuExtraDirs(): string[] {
  if (!IS_WINDOWS) return [];
  const dirs = [
    process.env.REVENANT_QEMU_DIR,
    join(process.env.ProgramFiles ?? 'C:\\Program Files', 'qemu'),
    join(process.env['ProgramFiles(x86)'] ?? 'C:\\Program Files (x86)', 'qemu'),
  ];
  return dirs.filter((d): d is string => typeof d === 'string' && d.length > 0);
}
```
