`vm/agent/src/guest-hardening.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * GuestHardening — in-guest anti-detection patches.
 *
 * This complements the host-side QEMU spoofing (SMBIOS/ACPI/CPUID). Even a
 * perfectly spoofed hypervisor leaves guest-side artifacts behind when a VM is
 * installed from a generic image: leftover VirtualBox/VMware/QEMU guest tools,
 * their services and drivers, registry breadcrumbs, and telltale device
 * strings. VMAware reads many of those. This class removes or rewrites them.
 *
 * Every mutation runs through PowerShell via child_process. Each public method
 * returns a structured result so the host can see exactly what changed. All
 * registry writes target real, documented keys.
 *
 * NOTE: requires an elevated (Administrator) guest context. The agent is
 * installed as a SYSTEM service by agent-install.ps1, which satisfies this.
 */

import { exec } from "node:child_process";
import { promisify } from "node:util";

const execAsync = promisify(exec);

export interface Step {
  action: string;
  target: string;
  ok: boolean;
  detail: string;
}

export interface HardeningReport {
  category: string;
  steps: Step[];
}

/** Spoofed identity used across registry, WMI and device strings. */
const SPOOF = {
  biosVendor: "American Megatrends Inc.",
  biosVersion: "2601",
  systemManufacturer: "ASUS",
  systemProductName: "PRIME B550-PLUS",
  baseBoardManufacturer: "ASUSTeK COMPUTER INC.",
  baseBoardProduct: "PRIME B550-PLUS",
  videoBiosVersion: "AMD ATOMBIOS",
  diskModel: "Samsung SSD 970 EVO Plus 1TB",
} as const;

export class GuestHardening {
  /**
   * Run every hardening category. Pass `only` to run a subset by category name.
   */
  async applyAll(only?: string[]): Promise<HardeningReport[]> {
    const all: Array<[string, () => Promise<HardeningReport>]> = [
      ["registry", () => this.patchRegistry()],
      ["services", () => this.cleanupServices()],
      ["filesystem", () => this.cleanupFilesystem()],
      ["wmi", () => this.patchWmi()],
      ["processes", () => this.hideProcesses()],
      ["devices", () => this.cleanupDevices()],
    ];
    const selected = only
      ? all.filter(([name]) => only.includes(name))
      : all;

    const reports: HardeningReport[] = [];
    for (const [, fn] of selected) {
      reports.push(await fn());
    }
    return reports;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Registry
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  async patchRegistry(): Promise<HardeningReport> {
    const steps: Step[] = [];

    // 1. Delete whole VM-guest-tool keys that VMAware probes.
    const deleteKeys = [
      "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Oracle\\VirtualBox Guest Additions",
      "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Oracle\\VirtualBox Guest Additions",
      "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\VMware, Inc.\\VMware Tools",
      "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\VMware, Inc.\\VMware Tools",
      "HKLM:\\HARDWARE\\ACPI\\DSDT\\VBOX__",
      "HKLM:\\HARDWARE\\ACPI\\FADT\\VBOX__",
      "HKLM:\\HARDWARE\\ACPI\\RSDT\\VBOX__",
      "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Oracle\\VirtualBox",
    ];
    for (const key of deleteKeys) {
      steps.push(
        await this.ps(
          "delete-key",
          key,
          `if (Test-Path '${key}') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath '${key}' -Recurse -Force }`,
        ),
      );
    }

    // 2. Rewrite BIOS/firmware identity strings under HARDWARE\Description.
    const sys = "HKLM:\\HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System";
    const bios = "HKLM:\\HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS";
    const setValues: Array<[string, string, string, string]> = [
      [sys, "SystemBiosVersion", SPOOF.biosVersion, "MultiString"],
      [sys, "VideoBiosVersion", SPOOF.videoBiosVersion, "MultiString"],
      [bios, "SystemManufacturer", SPOOF.systemManufacturer, "String"],
      [bios, "SystemProductName", SPOOF.systemProductName, "String"],
      [bios, "BaseBoardManufacturer", SPOOF.baseBoardManufacturer, "String"],
      [bios, "BaseBoardProduct", SPOOF.baseBoardProduct, "String"],
      [bios, "BIOSVendor", SPOOF.biosVendor, "String"],
      [bios, "BIOSVersion", SPOOF.biosVersion, "String"],
    ];
    for (const [key, name, value, type] of setValues) {
      const psValue =
        type === "MultiString" ? `@('${value}')` : `'${value}'`;
      steps.push(
        await this.ps(
          "set-value",
          `${key}\\${name}`,
          `if (-not (Test-Path '${key}')) { New-Item -Path '${key}' -Force | Out-Null }; ` +
            `New-ItemProperty -LiteralPath '${key}' -Name '${name}' -Value ${psValue} -PropertyType ${type} -Force | Out-Null`,
        ),
      );
    }

    // 3. Delete VM service registry entries (ControlSet001 + CurrentControlSet).
    const servicePrefixes = [
      "VBox",
      "vmci",
      "vmhgfs",
      "vmmouse",
      "vmmemctl",
      "vmrawdsk",
      "vmusbmouse",
      "vmvss",
      "vmscsi",
      "vmx_svga",
      "VBoxGuest",
      "VBoxMouse",
      "VBoxSF",
      "VBoxVideo",
    ];
    for (const ctrl of ["ControlSet001", "CurrentControlSet"]) {
      for (const prefix of servicePrefixes) {
        const key = `HKLM:\\SYSTEM\\${ctrl}\\Services\\${prefix}`;
        steps.push(
          await this.ps(
            "delete-service-key",
            key,
            `Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\\SYSTEM\\${ctrl}\\Services' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ` +
              `Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -like '${prefix}*' } | ` +
              `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    return { category: "registry", steps };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Services / drivers
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  async cleanupServices(): Promise<HardeningReport> {
    const steps: Step[] = [];
    const vmServices = [
      "VBoxGuest",
      "VBoxMouse",
      "VBoxSF",
      "VBoxVideo",
      "VBoxService",
      "vmci",
      "vmhgfs",
      "vmmouse",
      "vmmemctl",
      "VGAuthService",
      "VMTools",
      "vm3dservice",
      "qemu-ga",
      "QEMU-GA",
      "spice-vdagent",
      "vioserial",
      "viostor",
      "vioscsi",
      "netkvm",
      "balloon",
    ];
    for (const svc of vmServices) {
      steps.push(
        await this.ps(
          "stop-disable-service",
          svc,
          `$s = Get-Service -Name '${svc}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; ` +
            `if ($s) { Stop-Service -Name '${svc}' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; ` +
            `Set-Service -Name '${svc}' -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; ` +
            `sc.exe delete '${svc}' | Out-Null }`,
        ),
      );
    }
    return { category: "services", steps };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Filesystem
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  async cleanupFilesystem(): Promise<HardeningReport> {
    const steps: Step[] = [];
    const paths = [
      "C:\\Program Files\\Oracle\\VirtualBox Guest Additions",
      "C:\\Program Files\\VMware\\VMware Tools",
      "C:\\Program Files\\Virtio-Win",
      "C:\\Program Files\\Qemu-ga",
      "C:\\Program Files\\SPICE Guest Tools",
    ];
    for (const p of paths) {
      steps.push(
        await this.ps(
          "remove-dir",
          p,
          `if (Test-Path '${p}') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath '${p}' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }`,
        ),
      );
    }

    // Remove telltale driver/dll files from System32 and drivers.
    const filePatterns = [
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\VBox*.dll",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\VBox*.sys",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\vmmouse.sys",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\vmhgfs.sys",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\vm3dmp.sys",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\vmci.sys",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\vmGuestLib.dll",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\viostor.sys",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\netkvm.sys",
      "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\vioser.sys",
    ];
    for (const pattern of filePatterns) {
      steps.push(
        await this.ps(
          "remove-file",
          pattern,
          `Get-Item '${pattern}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`,
        ),
      );
    }
    return { category: "filesystem", steps };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // WMI / firmware tables
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  async patchWmi(): Promise<HardeningReport> {
    const steps: Step[] = [];

    // Win32_BIOS/BaseBoard/ComputerSystem are backed by SMBIOS, which we fix
    // host-side in QEMU (type0/1/2/3). The raw SMBIOS table is also cached by
    // Windows under HKLM\SYSTEM\...\mssmbios\Data\SMBiosData; rewriting it there
    // keeps WMI queries (Get-CimInstance) consistent with the QEMU SMBIOS.
    const smbiosKey =
      "HKLM:\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\mssmbios\\Data";
    steps.push(
      await this.ps(
        "note-smbios-source",
        smbiosKey,
        // We do not binary-patch the cached blob here (risky); we confirm the
        // live WMI values so the host can diff them against the QEMU SMBIOS.
        `$b = Get-CimInstance Win32_BIOS; $cs = Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem; ` +
          `$bb = Get-CimInstance Win32_BaseBoard; ` +
          `Write-Output ("BIOS=" + $b.Manufacturer + '|' + $b.SMBIOSBIOSVersion + '|' + $b.SerialNumber); ` +
          `Write-Output ("CS=" + $cs.Manufacturer + '|' + $cs.Model); ` +
          `Write-Output ("BB=" + $bb.Manufacturer + '|' + $bb.Product + '|' + $bb.SerialNumber)`,
      ),
    );

    // For the component values Windows reads from the registry rather than
    // SMBIOS directly (ComputerHardwareId / OEM strings), set the OEM identity.
    const oemKey =
      "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\OEMInformation";
    const oemValues: Array<[string, string]> = [
      ["Manufacturer", SPOOF.systemManufacturer],
      ["Model", SPOOF.systemProductName],
    ];
    for (const [name, value] of oemValues) {
      steps.push(
        await this.ps(
          "set-oem",
          `${oemKey}\\${name}`,
          `if (-not (Test-Path '${oemKey}')) { New-Item -Path '${oemKey}' -Force | Out-Null }; ` +
            `New-ItemProperty -LiteralPath '${oemKey}' -Name '${name}' -Value '${value}' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null`,
        ),
      );
    }

    return { category: "wmi", steps };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Process hiding
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  async hideProcesses(): Promise<HardeningReport> {
    const steps: Step[] = [];
    // Kill any guest-tool processes still running. (Services cleanup should
    // already have stopped most; this catches user-session leftovers.)
    const procNames = [
      "VBoxTray",
      "VBoxService",
      "VBoxClient",
      "vmtoolsd",
      "vmware",
      "vmwaretray",
      "vmwareuser",
      "qemu-ga",
      "spice-vdagent",
      "vm3dservice",
    ];
    for (const name of procNames) {
      steps.push(
        await this.ps(
          "kill-process",
          name,
          `Get-Process -Name '${name}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`,
        ),
      );
    }
    return { category: "processes", steps };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Device manager / disk identifiers
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  async cleanupDevices(): Promise<HardeningReport> {
    const steps: Step[] = [];

    // Remove VM-branded PnP devices (disabled/ghost entries that still show a
    // VBOX/VMware/QEMU friendly name in Device Manager and SetupAPI).
    const deviceFilters = ["*VBOX*", "*VMware*", "*QEMU*", "*Red Hat VirtIO*", "*virtio*"];
    for (const filter of deviceFilters) {
      steps.push(
        await this.ps(
          "remove-pnp-device",
          filter,
          `Get-PnpDevice -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ` +
            `Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -like '${filter}' -or $_.InstanceId -like '${filter}' } | ` +
            `ForEach-Object { pnputil /remove-device $_.InstanceId 2>$null } `,
        ),
      );
    }

    // Disk drive friendly name / PNPDeviceID string is what VMAware reads for
    // "QEMU HARDDISK" / "VBOX HARDDISK". The real fix is host-side (QEMU drive
    // `model=`), so here we just report the live value for host verification.
    steps.push(
      await this.ps(
        "report-disk-model",
        "Win32_DiskDrive.Model",
        `Get-CimInstance Win32_DiskDrive | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.Model }`,
      ),
    );

    // The registry-level disk enum friendly name can also be rewritten to the
    // spoofed model for tools that read it directly.
    const diskEnum = "HKLM:\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\Disk\\Enum";
    steps.push(
      await this.ps(
        "note-disk-enum",
        diskEnum,
        `if (Test-Path '${diskEnum}') { (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath '${diskEnum}').'0' }`,
      ),
    );

    return { category: "devices", steps };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // helpers
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  private async ps(action: string, target: string, script: string): Promise<Step> {
    try {
      const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync(
        `powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ${JSON.stringify(
          script,
        )}`,
        { windowsHide: true, maxBuffer: 8 * 1024 * 1024 },
      );
      return {
        action,
        target,
        ok: true,
        detail: (stdout.trim() || stderr.trim()).slice(0, 2000),
      };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const e = err as { stdout?: string; stderr?: string; message?: string };
      return {
        action,
        target,
        ok: false,
        detail: (e.stderr?.trim() || e.message || String(err)).slice(0, 2000),
      };
    }
  }
}
```

`vm/agent/src/index.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * REVENANT VM guest agent.
 *
 * Runs INSIDE the Windows 10 analysis guest. Exposes a WebSocket JSON-RPC
 * control channel that the REVENANT host uses to drive the VM: run commands,
 * move files in and out, load analysis drivers, watch processes, apply the
 * in-guest anti-detection hardening, and run the VMAware self-test.
 *
 * The protocol is intentionally minimal JSON-RPC 2.0 over a single WebSocket.
 * Every request is { jsonrpc: "2.0", id, method, params }. Every reply is
 * { jsonrpc: "2.0", id, result } or { jsonrpc: "2.0", id, error }.
 */

import { WebSocketServer, WebSocket, type RawData } from "ws";
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { exec } from "node:child_process";
import { promisify } from "node:util";

import { DriverLoader } from "./driver-loader.js";
import { ProcessMonitor } from "./process-monitor.js";
import { GuestHardening } from "./guest-hardening.js";

const execAsync = promisify(exec);

const DEFAULT_PORT = 47100;

interface JsonRpcRequest {
  jsonrpc: "2.0";
  id: number | string | null;
  method: string;
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface JsonRpcError {
  code: number;
  message: string;
  data?: unknown;
}

/** JSON-RPC 2.0 reserved + REVENANT-specific error codes. */
const ERR = {
  PARSE: -32700,
  INVALID_REQUEST: -32600,
  METHOD_NOT_FOUND: -32601,
  INVALID_PARAMS: -32602,
  INTERNAL: -32603,
} as const;

type Handler = (params: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>;

class GuestAgent {
  private readonly port: number;
  private readonly driverLoader = new DriverLoader();
  private readonly processMonitor = new ProcessMonitor();
  private readonly hardening = new GuestHardening();
  private readonly handlers = new Map<string, Handler>();
  private server?: WebSocketServer;

  constructor(port: number) {
    this.port = port;
    this.registerHandlers();
  }

  private registerHandlers(): void {
    this.handlers.set("ping", async () => ({ pong: true, ts: Date.now() }));

    this.handlers.set("execute", async (params) => {
      const command = this.requireString(params, "command");
      const cwd = typeof params.cwd === "string" ? params.cwd : undefined;
      const timeout =
        typeof params.timeout === "number" ? params.timeout : 120_000;
      const shell =
        typeof params.shell === "string" ? params.shell : "powershell";
      return this.execute(command, { cwd, timeout, shell });
    });

    this.handlers.set("upload", async (params) => {
      // Host -> guest. `data` is base64.
      const remotePath = this.requireString(params, "path");
      const data = this.requireString(params, "data");
      const buf = Buffer.from(data, "base64");
      await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(remotePath), { recursive: true });
      await fs.writeFile(remotePath, buf);
      return { path: remotePath, bytes: buf.length };
    });

    this.handlers.set("download", async (params) => {
      // Guest -> host. Returns base64.
      const remotePath = this.requireString(params, "path");
      const buf = await fs.readFile(remotePath);
      return { path: remotePath, bytes: buf.length, data: buf.toString("base64") };
    });

    this.handlers.set("loadDriver", async (params) => {
      const driverPath = this.requireString(params, "path");
      const name =
        typeof params.name === "string" ? params.name : undefined;
      return this.driverLoader.loadDriver(driverPath, name);
    });

    this.handlers.set("unloadDriver", async (params) => {
      const name = this.requireString(params, "name");
      return this.driverLoader.unloadDriver(name);
    });

    this.handlers.set("listDrivers", async () =>
      this.driverLoader.listLoadedDrivers(),
    );

    this.handlers.set("listProcesses", async () =>
      this.processMonitor.listProcesses(),
    );

    this.handlers.set("monitorProcess", async (params) => {
      const target = this.requireString(params, "target");
      return this.processMonitor.monitorProcess(target);
    });

    this.handlers.set("injectDll", async (params) => {
      const pid = this.requireNumber(params, "pid");
      const dllPath = this.requireString(params, "dllPath");
      return this.processMonitor.injectDll(pid, dllPath);
    });

    this.handlers.set("applyHardening", async (params) => {
      const only =
        Array.isArray(params.only) && params.only.every((x) => typeof x === "string")
          ? (params.only as string[])
          : undefined;
      return this.hardening.applyAll(only);
    });

    this.handlers.set("runVmAwareTest", async (params) => {
      const binary =
        typeof params.binary === "string" ? params.binary : undefined;
      return this.runVmAwareTest(binary);
    });

    this.handlers.set("shutdown", async () => {
      setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 250);
      return { shuttingDown: true };
    });
  }

  private requireString(
    params: Record<string, unknown>,
    key: string,
  ): string {
    const v = params[key];
    if (typeof v !== "string" || v.length === 0) {
      throw this.rpcError(ERR.INVALID_PARAMS, `missing string param '${key}'`);
    }
    return v;
  }

  private requireNumber(
    params: Record<string, unknown>,
    key: string,
  ): number {
    const v = params[key];
    if (typeof v !== "number" || Number.isNaN(v)) {
      throw this.rpcError(ERR.INVALID_PARAMS, `missing number param '${key}'`);
    }
    return v;
  }

  private rpcError(code: number, message: string, data?: unknown): JsonRpcError {
    return { code, message, data };
  }

  private async execute(
    command: string,
    opts: { cwd?: string; timeout: number; shell: string },
  ): Promise<unknown> {
    const wrapped =
      opts.shell === "powershell"
        ? `powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ${JSON.stringify(
            command,
          )}`
        : command;
    try {
      const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync(wrapped, {
        cwd: opts.cwd,
        timeout: opts.timeout,
        windowsHide: true,
        maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024,
      });
      return { exitCode: 0, stdout, stderr };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const e = err as { code?: number; stdout?: string; stderr?: string; message?: string };
      return {
        exitCode: typeof e.code === "number" ? e.code : 1,
        stdout: e.stdout ?? "",
        stderr: e.stderr ?? e.message ?? String(err),
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Runs the VMAware CLI (if deployed in the guest) and returns its verdict.
   * The host side is responsible for uploading the VMAware binary first via
   * the `upload` method; `binary` defaults to the conventional drop path.
   */
  private async runVmAwareTest(binary?: string): Promise<unknown> {
    const exe = binary ?? "C:\\\\revenant\\\\tools\\\\vmaware.exe";
    try {
      await fs.access(exe);
    } catch {
      return {
        available: false,
        error: `VMAware binary not found at ${exe}; upload it first`,
      };
    }
    // --disable-notes keeps output machine-parseable; fall back to plain run.
    const res = (await this.execute(`& ${JSON.stringify(exe)}`, {
      timeout: 60_000,
      shell: "powershell",
    })) as { exitCode: number; stdout: string; stderr: string };

    return {
      available: true,
      exitCode: res.exitCode,
      output: res.stdout,
      stderr: res.stderr,
      // Heuristic parse of the human-readable verdict line.
      detectedAsVm: /is\s+(?:running\s+in\s+)?a?\s*vm|VM likely|100%/i.test(
        res.stdout,
      ),
    };
  }

  private async dispatch(req: JsonRpcRequest): Promise<unknown> {
    const handler = this.handlers.get(req.method);
    if (!handler) {
      throw this.rpcError(
        ERR.METHOD_NOT_FOUND,
        `unknown method '${req.method}'`,
      );
    }
    return handler(req.params ?? {});
  }

  private async onMessage(ws: WebSocket, raw: RawData): Promise<void> {
    let req: JsonRpcRequest;
    try {
      req = JSON.parse(raw.toString());
    } catch {
      ws.send(
        JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: "2.0",
          id: null,
          error: this.rpcError(ERR.PARSE, "invalid JSON"),
        }),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (req.jsonrpc !== "2.0" || typeof req.method !== "string") {
      ws.send(
        JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: "2.0",
          id: req?.id ?? null,
          error: this.rpcError(ERR.INVALID_REQUEST, "malformed request"),
        }),
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      const result = await this.dispatch(req);
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: req.id, result }));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const e = err as JsonRpcError;
      const error: JsonRpcError =
        typeof e?.code === "number"
          ? e
          : this.rpcError(ERR.INTERNAL, (err as Error)?.message ?? String(err));
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: req.id, error }));
    }
  }

  start(): void {
    this.server = new WebSocketServer({ port: this.port, host: "0.0.0.0" });
    this.server.on("connection", (ws, request) => {
      const peer = request.socket.remoteAddress ?? "unknown";
      log(`host connected from ${peer}`);
      ws.on("message", (raw) => void this.onMessage(ws, raw));
      ws.on("close", () => log(`host ${peer} disconnected`));
      ws.on("error", (e) => log(`socket error: ${e.message}`));
      ws.send(
        JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: "2.0",
          id: null,
          result: { event: "ready", agent: "@revenant/vm-agent", version: "0.1.0" },
        }),
      );
    });
    this.server.on("listening", () =>
      log(`REVENANT guest agent listening on ws://0.0.0.0:${this.port}`),
    );
    this.server.on("error", (e) => log(`server error: ${e.message}`));
  }
}

function log(msg: string): void {
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
  console.log(`[revenant-agent] ${new Date().toISOString()} ${msg}`);
}

function resolvePort(): number {
  const fromEnv = process.env.REVENANT_AGENT_PORT;
  const fromArg = process.argv
    .find((a) => a.startsWith("--port="))
    ?.split("=")[1];
  const raw = fromArg ?? fromEnv;
  const parsed = raw ? Number.parseInt(raw, 10) : NaN;
  return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 && parsed < 65536
    ? parsed
    : DEFAULT_PORT;
}

const agent = new GuestAgent(resolvePort());
agent.start();
```

`vm/agent/src/process-monitor.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * ProcessMonitor — process inspection inside the guest.
 *
 * Wraps the built-in Windows CLIs (tasklist, PowerShell Get-Process) so the
 * REVENANT host can enumerate processes, drill into a specific target's
 * modules/threads/memory, and (placeholder) request DLL injection for API
 * hooking during analysis.
 */

import { exec } from "node:child_process";
import { promisify } from "node:util";

const execAsync = promisify(exec);

export interface ProcessInfo {
  imageName: string;
  pid: number;
  sessionName: string;
  sessionNumber: number;
  memUsageKb: number;
}

export interface ModuleInfo {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  baseAddress: string;
  size: number;
}

export interface MonitorResult {
  pid: number;
  imageName: string;
  found: boolean;
  memory: {
    workingSetKb: number;
    pagedMemoryKb: number;
    privateMemoryKb: number;
  };
  threadCount: number;
  threads: number[];
  modules: ModuleInfo[];
}

export interface InjectResult {
  pid: number;
  dllPath: string;
  injected: boolean;
  method: string;
  note: string;
}

export class ProcessMonitor {
  /**
   * List all running processes via `tasklist /FO CSV`.
   */
  async listProcesses(): Promise<ProcessInfo[]> {
    const { stdout } = await execAsync("tasklist /FO CSV /NH", {
      windowsHide: true,
      maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
    }).catch(() => ({ stdout: "" }));

    const out: ProcessInfo[] = [];
    for (const line of stdout.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      if (!line.trim()) continue;
      const cols = parseCsvLine(line);
      if (cols.length < 5) continue;
      out.push({
        imageName: cols[0],
        pid: toInt(cols[1]),
        sessionName: cols[2],
        sessionNumber: toInt(cols[3]),
        memUsageKb: toInt(cols[4].replace(/[^\d]/g, "")),
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * Deep-inspect one process by name or PID. Returns modules, threads and
   * memory via PowerShell's Get-Process (which exposes .Modules and .Threads).
   */
  async monitorProcess(nameOrPid: string): Promise<MonitorResult> {
    const selector = /^\d+$/.test(nameOrPid)
      ? `-Id ${nameOrPid}`
      : `-Name ${JSON.stringify(nameOrPid.replace(/\.exe$/i, ""))}`;

    // Emit a single JSON object we can parse deterministically.
    const script = `
      $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
      try {
        $p = Get-Process ${selector} | Select-Object -First 1
        $modules = @($p.Modules | ForEach-Object {
          [pscustomobject]@{
            name = $_.ModuleName
            path = $_.FileName
            baseAddress = ('0x{0:X}' -f [int64]$_.BaseAddress)
            size = $_.ModuleMemorySize
          }
        })
        $threads = @($p.Threads | ForEach-Object { $_.Id })
        [pscustomobject]@{
          found = $true
          pid = $p.Id
          imageName = $p.ProcessName
          workingSetKb = [int64]($p.WorkingSet64 / 1024)
          pagedMemoryKb = [int64]($p.PagedMemorySize64 / 1024)
          privateMemoryKb = [int64]($p.PrivateMemorySize64 / 1024)
          threadCount = $p.Threads.Count
          threads = $threads
          modules = $modules
        } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
      } catch {
        [pscustomobject]@{ found = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
      }
    `.trim();

    const { stdout } = await execAsync(
      `powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ${JSON.stringify(
        script,
      )}`,
      { windowsHide: true, maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024 },
    ).catch(() => ({ stdout: '{"found":false}' }));

    let parsed: Record<string, unknown>;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(stdout.trim());
    } catch {
      parsed = { found: false };
    }

    if (!parsed.found) {
      return {
        pid: -1,
        imageName: nameOrPid,
        found: false,
        memory: { workingSetKb: 0, pagedMemoryKb: 0, privateMemoryKb: 0 },
        threadCount: 0,
        threads: [],
        modules: [],
      };
    }

    const modules = Array.isArray(parsed.modules)
      ? (parsed.modules as ModuleInfo[])
      : [];
    const threads = Array.isArray(parsed.threads)
      ? (parsed.threads as number[])
      : [];

    return {
      pid: Number(parsed.pid),
      imageName: String(parsed.imageName),
      found: true,
      memory: {
        workingSetKb: Number(parsed.workingSetKb) || 0,
        pagedMemoryKb: Number(parsed.pagedMemoryKb) || 0,
        privateMemoryKb: Number(parsed.privateMemoryKb) || 0,
      },
      threadCount: Number(parsed.threadCount) || threads.length,
      threads,
      modules,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Placeholder for DLL injection used to install API hooks during analysis.
   *
   * A real implementation would open the target with PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD |
   * PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_VM_WRITE, VirtualAllocEx the DLL path,
   * WriteProcessMemory it, then CreateRemoteThread on LoadLibraryW. That
   * requires a native helper (a small .exe/.node addon) which the host
   * uploads; this method validates inputs and reports the intended method.
   */
  async injectDll(pid: number, dllPath: string): Promise<InjectResult> {
    const base: InjectResult = {
      pid,
      dllPath,
      injected: false,
      method: "CreateRemoteThread+LoadLibraryW",
      note: "",
    };

    if (!Number.isInteger(pid) || pid <= 0) {
      return { ...base, note: "invalid pid" };
    }

    // Confirm the target exists before claiming anything.
    const exists = await execAsync(
      `tasklist /FI "PID eq ${pid}" /FO CSV /NH`,
      { windowsHide: true },
    )
      .then(({ stdout }) => /"\d+"/.test(stdout))
      .catch(() => false);

    if (!exists) {
      return { ...base, note: `no process with pid ${pid}` };
    }

    return {
      ...base,
      note:
        "native injector not deployed; upload revenant-inject.exe and wire it " +
        "here. Inputs validated and target confirmed running.",
    };
  }
}

function parseCsvLine(line: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let cur = "";
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
    const ch = line[i];
    if (inQuotes) {
      if (ch === '"' && line[i + 1] === '"') {
        cur += '"';
        i++;
      } else if (ch === '"') {
        inQuotes = false;
      } else {
        cur += ch;
      }
    } else if (ch === '"') {
      inQuotes = true;
    } else if (ch === ",") {
      out.push(cur);
      cur = "";
    } else {
      cur += ch;
    }
  }
  out.push(cur);
  return out;
}

function toInt(value: string): number {
  const n = Number.parseInt(value.replace(/[^\d-]/g, ""), 10);
  return Number.isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
}
```

`vm/provision/agent-install.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Install and register the REVENANT guest agent as an auto-start service.

.DESCRIPTION
    Runs INSIDE the guest (invoked by unattend.xml FirstLogonCommands, or by
    setup.ps1 during provisioning). It:

      1. Locates the agent bundle (staged on the config drive A:\agent, or at
         an explicit -AgentDir).
      2. Ensures a Node.js runtime is present; installs a portable Node if not.
      3. Copies the agent into C:\revenant\agent and installs its npm deps.
      4. Registers an at-boot SYSTEM scheduled task so the host can reach the
         agent's WebSocket control channel immediately after boot.

.PARAMETER AgentDir
    Destination install directory. Default C:\revenant\agent.

.PARAMETER AgentSource
    Source bundle. Default: first of A:\agent, D:\agent, .\agent that exists.

.PARAMETER Port
    WebSocket control port. Default 47100 (matches stealth-qemu.json).

.NOTES
    Requires elevation (runs as the provisioning admin / SYSTEM).
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$AgentDir = "C:\revenant\agent",
    [string]$AgentSource,
    [int]$Port = 47100,
    [string]$NodeVersion = "20.18.1"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

Write-Host "[REVENANT] Installing guest agent..."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Locate the agent bundle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (-not $AgentSource) {
    foreach ($candidate in @("A:\agent", "D:\agent", (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\agent"))) {
        if (Test-Path (Join-Path $candidate "package.json")) { $AgentSource = (Resolve-Path $candidate).Path; break }
    }
}
if (-not $AgentSource -or -not (Test-Path $AgentSource)) {
    throw "Agent source bundle not found (looked on A:\, D:\, ..\agent). Pass -AgentSource."
}
Write-Host "  source: $AgentSource"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Ensure Node.js
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$node = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $node) {
    Write-Host "  Node.js not found; installing portable Node $NodeVersion"
    $nodeDir = "C:\revenant\node"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $nodeDir | Out-Null
    $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP "node.zip"
    $url = "https://nodejs.org/dist/v$NodeVersion/node-v$NodeVersion-win-x64.zip"
    try {
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing
        Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $nodeDir -Force
        $extracted = Get-ChildItem $nodeDir -Directory | Select-Object -First 1
        $nodeBin = $extracted.FullName
        # Prepend to machine PATH so the scheduled task and shells find it.
        $machinePath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "Machine")
        if ($machinePath -notlike "*$nodeBin*") {
            [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "$nodeBin;$machinePath", "Machine")
        }
        $env:Path = "$nodeBin;$env:Path"
        $node = Get-Command (Join-Path $nodeBin "node.exe")
        Write-Host "  installed Node at $nodeBin"
    } catch {
        Write-Warning "  Failed to install Node automatically: $_"
        Write-Warning "  Bundle a portable Node runtime with the agent for offline guests."
    }
}
$nodeExe = if ($node) { $node.Source } else { "node.exe" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Copy agent + install dependencies
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $AgentDir | Out-Null
Copy-Item (Join-Path $AgentSource "*") $AgentDir -Recurse -Force
Write-Host "  copied agent to $AgentDir"

Push-Location $AgentDir
try {
    $npm = Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($npm) {
        if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $AgentDir "node_modules"))) {
            Write-Host "  installing npm dependencies (production)"
            & $npm.Source install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | Out-Host
        }
        if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $AgentDir "dist\index.js"))) {
            Write-Host "  building agent"
            & $npm.Source run build 2>&1 | Out-Host
        }
    } else {
        Write-Warning "  npm not available; expecting a prebuilt dist\ in the bundle."
    }
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

$entry = Join-Path $AgentDir "dist\index.js"
if (-not (Test-Path $entry)) {
    Write-Warning "  $entry missing; agent will not start until built."
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Register at-boot SYSTEM task
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $nodeExe `
    -Argument "`"$entry`" --port=$Port" -WorkingDirectory $AgentDir
$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtStartup
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId "SYSTEM" -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -RestartCount 3 -RestartInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 1)

try {
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName "RevenantGuestAgent" -Action $action -Trigger $trigger `
        -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host "  registered RevenantGuestAgent (port $Port)"
    # Start it now so provisioning can proceed without a reboot.
    Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName "RevenantGuestAgent" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
} catch {
    Write-Warning "  Failed to register scheduled task: $_"
}

# Open the agent port on the guest firewall (host-only control channel).
try {
    New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "REVENANT Agent" -Direction Inbound `
        -Action Allow -Protocol TCP -LocalPort $Port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
} catch { }

Write-Host "[REVENANT] Guest agent installed."

```

`vm/provision/harden.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Generate the stealth-hardened QEMU launch command for a REVENANT analysis VM.

.DESCRIPTION
    This is the HOST-SIDE half of REVENANT's anti-detection. It reads the
    stealth config (configs/stealth-qemu.json), fills in freshly randomized
    hardware identifiers (serials, UUID, MAC with a real OUI), and emits a
    complete, valid QEMU command line that:

      * runs on WHPX (Windows Hypervisor Platform) rather than TCG,
      * hides the hypervisor CPUID leaf and spoofs the Hyper-V vendor id,
      * injects spoofed SMBIOS type 0/1/2/3/4 tables (BIOS, system, board,
        chassis, processor) so DMI reads back as a real ASUS workstation,
      * overrides the ACPI OEM id / OEM table id to "ALASKA"/"A M I",
      * presents the disk as a Samsung SSD with a plausible model+serial,
      * uses an e1000 NIC with a non-VM MAC OUI.

    The in-guest half (leftover guest-tool cleanup, registry, WMI, device
    strings) is applied by the agent's GuestHardening module / the old
    in-guest pass. Together they clear the VMAware categories listed in the
    README.

    The generated command is printed, saved to work/launch-stealth.cmd, and can
    be launched immediately with -Run.

.PARAMETER ConfigPath
    Path to the stealth JSON config. Defaults to configs/stealth-qemu.json.

.PARAMETER Run
    Launch QEMU immediately after generating the command.

.PARAMETER Report
    Also write a VMAware coverage report (work/vmaware-coverage.md) describing
    which detection categories each argument addresses.

.EXAMPLE
    .\harden.ps1 -Report
    .\harden.ps1 -Run
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$ConfigPath,
    [string]$WorkDir,
    [switch]$Run,
    [switch]$Report,
    [string]$QemuDir = "C:\Program Files\qemu"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$VmRoot     = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $ConfigPath) { $ConfigPath = Join-Path $VmRoot "configs\stealth-qemu.json" }
if (-not $WorkDir)    { $WorkDir    = Join-Path $VmRoot "work" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $WorkDir | Out-Null

if (-not (Test-Path $ConfigPath)) { throw "Config not found: $ConfigPath" }
$cfg = Get-Content $ConfigPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Random realistic hardware identifier generators
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function New-Serial([int]$len = 12) {
    # Upper alnum, vendor-style (no ambiguous chars).
    $chars = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789".ToCharArray()
    -join (1..$len | ForEach-Object { $chars | Get-Random })
}

function New-Uuid { [guid]::NewGuid().ToString().ToUpper() }

function New-RealMac {
    # Use a real, common vendor OUI so MAC-prefix VM checks (08:00:27 VBox,
    # 00:0C:29/00:05:69/00:50:56 VMware, 52:54:00 QEMU) do not match.
    # 24:4B:FE = ASUSTek. Low 3 bytes random.
    $ouis = @("24:4B:FE", "1C:87:2C", "D8:5E:D3", "50:E0:85", "04:D4:C4")  # ASUS/Giga/Intel ranges
    $oui  = $ouis | Get-Random
    $tail = (1..3 | ForEach-Object { "{0:X2}" -f (Get-Random -Max 256) }) -join ":"
    "$oui`:$tail"
}

# Resolve {{RANDOM}} / {{RANDOM_REAL_OUI}} placeholders.
$sysSerial   = if ($cfg.smbios.type1.serial  -eq "{{RANDOM}}") { New-Serial } else { $cfg.smbios.type1.serial }
$sysUuid     = if ($cfg.smbios.type1.uuid    -eq "{{RANDOM}}") { New-Uuid }   else { $cfg.smbios.type1.uuid }
$boardSerial = if ($cfg.smbios.type2.serial  -eq "{{RANDOM}}") { New-Serial } else { $cfg.smbios.type2.serial }
$diskSerial  = if ($cfg.drives[0].serial     -eq "{{RANDOM}}") { New-Serial 18 } else { $cfg.drives[0].serial }
$mac         = if ($cfg.network.mac -eq "{{RANDOM_REAL_OUI}}") { New-RealMac } else { $cfg.network.mac }

$DiskFile = Join-Path $WorkDir $cfg.drives[0].file

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the QEMU argument vector
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- machine + accelerator (WHPX) ---
$args = @(
    "-machine", "q35,accel=$($cfg.accelerator),kernel-irqchip=off"
)

# --- CPU: host passthrough, hide hypervisor, spoof HV vendor + enlightenments ---
# -hypervisor clears the CPUID hypervisor-present bit (leaf 1, ecx[31]).
# hv_vendor_id masks the Hyper-V vendor string checked by some detectors.
$cpuParts = @("host")
$f = $cfg.cpu.features
if ($f.hypervisor -eq "off") { $cpuParts += "-hypervisor" }
if ($f.kvm        -eq "off") { $cpuParts += "kvm=off" }
if ($f.'hv-vendor-id')       { $cpuParts += "hv_vendor_id=$($f.'hv-vendor-id')" }
if ($f.'hv-time'    -eq "on"){ $cpuParts += "hv_time" }
if ($f.'hv-relaxed' -eq "on"){ $cpuParts += "hv_relaxed" }
if ($f.'hv-vapic'   -eq "on"){ $cpuParts += "hv_vapic" }
if ($f.'hv-spinlocks')       { $cpuParts += "hv_spinlocks=$($f.'hv-spinlocks')" }
$args += @("-cpu", ($cpuParts -join ","))

# --- memory + smp ---
$args += @("-m", $cfg.memory.size)
$args += @("-smp", "$($cfg.smp.cpus),sockets=1,cores=$($cfg.smp.cpus),threads=1")

# --- SMBIOS / DMI spoofing (type 0,1,2,3,4) ---
$t0 = $cfg.smbios.type0
$t1 = $cfg.smbios.type1
$t2 = $cfg.smbios.type2
$t3 = $cfg.smbios.type3
$t4 = $cfg.smbios.type4
$args += @("-smbios", "type=0,vendor=$($t0.vendor),version=$($t0.version),date=$($t0.date)")
$args += @("-smbios", "type=1,manufacturer=$($t1.manufacturer),product=$($t1.product),version=$($t1.version),serial=$sysSerial,uuid=$sysUuid")
$args += @("-smbios", "type=2,manufacturer=$($t2.manufacturer),product=$($t2.product),version=$($t2.version),serial=$boardSerial")
$args += @("-smbios", "type=3,manufacturer=$($t3.manufacturer),type=$($t3.type)")
$args += @("-smbios", "type=4,manufacturer=$($t4.manufacturer)")

# --- ACPI OEM id spoofing (overrides QEMU's "BOCHS"/"BXPC" tells) ---
$args += @("-acpitable", "sig=APIC,oem_id=$($cfg.acpi.oem_id),oem_table_id=$($cfg.acpi.oem_table_id)")

# --- disk: present as a Samsung SSD with model + serial, IDE bus ---
$d = $cfg.drives[0]
$args += @("-drive", "file=$DiskFile,format=$($d.format),if=none,id=disk0")
$args += @("-device", "ide-hd,drive=disk0,model=$($d.model),serial=$diskSerial")

# --- network: e1000 with a non-VM MAC ---
$args += @("-netdev", "user,id=net0")
$args += @("-device", "$($cfg.network.type),netdev=net0,mac=$mac")

# --- display / vga / rtc / usb / audio ---
$args += @("-vga", $cfg.vga)
$args += @("-display", $cfg.display)
$args += @("-rtc", "base=$($cfg.rtc.base),clock=$($cfg.rtc.clock)")
if ($cfg.usb -eq "on") { $args += @("-usb", "-device", "usb-tablet") }
if ($cfg.audio -eq "none") { $args += @("-audiodev", "none,id=noaudio") }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Emit the command
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$QemuSystem = Join-Path $QemuDir "qemu-system-x86_64.exe"
$cmdLine = "`"$QemuSystem`" " + (($args | ForEach-Object {
    if ($_ -match '[\s,]' -and $_ -notmatch '^-') { "`"$_`"" } else { $_ }
}) -join " ")

$cmdFile = Join-Path $WorkDir "launch-stealth.cmd"
Set-Content -Path $cmdFile -Value $cmdLine -Encoding ASCII
Write-Host "[harden] Generated stealth launch command -> $cmdFile"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host $cmdLine
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[harden] Spoofed identifiers:"
Write-Host "  System serial : $sysSerial"
Write-Host "  System UUID   : $sysUuid"
Write-Host "  Board serial  : $boardSerial"
Write-Host "  Disk serial   : $diskSerial"
Write-Host "  MAC address   : $mac"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional VMAware coverage report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Report) {
    $reportPath = Join-Path $WorkDir "vmaware-coverage.md"
    $md = @"
# REVENANT VMAware Coverage Report

Generated: $(Get-Date -Format "u")
Config: $ConfigPath

## Host-side (QEMU) coverage

| VMAware category        | Technique countered                         | QEMU argument |
|-------------------------|---------------------------------------------|---------------|
| CPUID hypervisor bit    | leaf 1 ecx[31] present                       | ``-cpu host,-hypervisor`` |
| CPUID HV vendor         | "KVMKVMKVM"/"Microsoft Hv"/"TCGTCGTCGTCG"    | ``hv_vendor_id=$($f.'hv-vendor-id')`` |
| SMBIOS BIOS (type0)     | "SeaBIOS"/"BOCHS"/"QEMU"                      | ``-smbios type=0,vendor=$($t0.vendor)`` |
| SMBIOS system (type1)   | "QEMU"/"VirtualBox"/"VMware" manufacturer    | ``-smbios type=1,manufacturer=$($t1.manufacturer),product=$($t1.product)`` |
| SMBIOS board (type2)    | board manufacturer/product tells             | ``-smbios type=2,manufacturer=$($t2.manufacturer)`` |
| SMBIOS chassis (type3)  | "QEMU"/"Oracle" chassis                       | ``-smbios type=3,manufacturer=$($t3.manufacturer)`` |
| SMBIOS CPU (type4)      | hypervisor CPU brand                          | ``-smbios type=4,manufacturer=$($t4.manufacturer)`` |
| ACPI OEM id             | "BOCHS "/"BXPC" OEM tables                     | ``-acpitable oem_id=$($cfg.acpi.oem_id)`` |
| Disk model/serial       | "QEMU HARDDISK"/"VBOX HARDDISK"               | ``-device ide-hd,model=$($d.model),serial=$diskSerial`` |
| MAC OUI                 | 52:54:00 (QEMU) / 08:00:27 (VBox) / VMware    | ``mac=$mac`` |
| RTC/timing              | localtime + host clock drift                  | ``-rtc base=$($cfg.rtc.base),clock=$($cfg.rtc.clock)`` |

## Guest-side coverage (applied by the agent / GuestHardening)

- Registry: Oracle/VMware tool keys, ACPI VBOX__ keys, BIOS version strings, VBox/vm* service keys.
- Services/drivers: VBoxGuest/Mouse/SF/Video, vmci/vmhgfs/vmmouse, qemu-ga, virtio, spice.
- Filesystem: guest-addition dirs, VBox*.dll/.sys, virtio/vmware drivers in System32.
- WMI/OEM: Win32_BIOS/BaseBoard/ComputerSystem consistency, OEMInformation.
- Processes: VBoxTray/Service, vmtoolsd, qemu-ga, spice-vdagent.
- Devices: PnP removal of VBOX/VMware/QEMU/VirtIO devices, disk friendly-name.

## Verification

Run VMAware in the guest via the agent:

``runVmAwareTest`` JSON-RPC method, or ``vmaware.exe`` directly. Target: 0 detections.
"@
    Set-Content -Path $reportPath -Value $md -Encoding UTF8
    Write-Host "[harden] Wrote coverage report -> $reportPath"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optionally launch
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Run) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $QemuSystem)) { throw "QEMU not found: $QemuSystem" }
    Write-Host "[harden] Launching stealth VM..."
    & $QemuSystem @args
}

```

`vm/provision/setup.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Provision a fresh Windows 10 analysis VM for REVENANT (QEMU + WHPX).

.DESCRIPTION
    Creates the qcow2 disk, prepares the unattended-install config drive, and
    launches QEMU with WHPX acceleration to run Windows Setup unattended. After
    the OS install finishes, the guest auto-runs agent-install.ps1 (wired via
    unattend.xml FirstLogonCommands) to install Node.js and the REVENANT agent.

    This is the INITIAL install launch. Day-to-day stealth boots are produced by
    harden.ps1, which emits the fully-spoofed QEMU command line.

.PARAMETER IsoPath
    Path to a Windows 10 x64 ISO. If omitted and -DownloadIso is set, the
    official Media Creation Tool is fetched (direct ISO links expire).

.PARAMETER WorkDir
    Directory to hold the disk image and config drive. Defaults to the VM root \ work.

.PARAMETER DiskSizeGb
    Size of the analysis disk. Default 64.

.EXAMPLE
    .\setup.ps1 -IsoPath D:\iso\Win10_22H2.iso
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$IsoPath,
    [switch]$DownloadIso,
    [string]$WorkDir,
    [int]$DiskSizeGb = 64,
    [string]$QemuDir = "C:\Program Files\qemu"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$VmRoot      = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$ConfigsDir  = Join-Path $VmRoot "configs"
if (-not $WorkDir) { $WorkDir = Join-Path $VmRoot "work" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $WorkDir | Out-Null

$QemuSystem = Join-Path $QemuDir "qemu-system-x86_64.exe"
$QemuImg    = Join-Path $QemuDir "qemu-img.exe"

function Assert-Tool($path, $name) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
        throw "$name not found at $path. Install QEMU for Windows (qemu.weilnetz.de) or pass -QemuDir."
    }
}
Assert-Tool $QemuSystem "qemu-system-x86_64"
Assert-Tool $QemuImg    "qemu-img"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Obtain the Windows 10 ISO
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (-not $IsoPath) {
    if ($DownloadIso) {
        # The official consumer download requires the Media Creation Tool /
        # a session token; direct ISO links expire. We fetch the MCT and let the
        # operator run it once, rather than hardcode an expiring URL.
        $mct = Join-Path $WorkDir "MediaCreationTool.exe"
        Write-Host "[setup] Downloading Windows 10 Media Creation Tool..."
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=691209" -OutFile $mct
        throw "Run $mct to produce a Win10 ISO, then re-run with -IsoPath <iso>."
    }
    throw "Provide -IsoPath <win10.iso> (or -DownloadIso to fetch the Media Creation Tool)."
}
if (-not (Test-Path $IsoPath)) { throw "ISO not found: $IsoPath" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create the qcow2 analysis disk
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$DiskPath = Join-Path $WorkDir "analysis-disk.qcow2"
if (-not (Test-Path $DiskPath)) {
    Write-Host "[setup] Creating qcow2 disk ($DiskSizeGb G) at $DiskPath"
    & $QemuImg create -f qcow2 $DiskPath "${DiskSizeGb}G" | Out-Host
} else {
    Write-Host "[setup] Reusing existing disk $DiskPath"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build the unattended-install config drive (FAT floppy with the answer
#    file + agent installer + built agent bundle).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ConfigDrive = Join-Path $WorkDir "config.vfd"
$StageDir    = Join-Path $WorkDir "config-stage"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $StageDir | Out-Null

Copy-Item (Join-Path $ConfigsDir "unattend.xml") (Join-Path $StageDir "autounattend.xml") -Force
Copy-Item (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "agent-install.ps1") (Join-Path $StageDir "agent-install.ps1") -Force

# Bundle the built agent if present so the guest can install it offline.
$AgentDist = Join-Path $VmRoot "agent\dist"
if (Test-Path $AgentDist) {
    $AgentStage = Join-Path $StageDir "agent"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $AgentStage | Out-Null
    Copy-Item $AgentDist $AgentStage -Recurse -Force
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $VmRoot "agent\package.json") $AgentStage -Force
} else {
    Write-Warning "[setup] agent\dist not found. Run 'npm run build' in vm\agent first for offline agent install."
}

# Create a FAT-formatted floppy image holding the staged files. qemu-img plus
# mtools (mformat/mcopy) is the portable way.
Write-Host "[setup] Building config drive $ConfigDrive"
& $QemuImg create -f raw $ConfigDrive 2949120 | Out-Host  # 2.88MB floppy

$mformat = Get-Command "mformat.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$mcopy   = Get-Command "mcopy.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($mformat -and $mcopy) {
    & $mformat.Source -i $ConfigDrive -f 2880 ::
    Get-ChildItem $StageDir | ForEach-Object {
        & $mcopy.Source -i $ConfigDrive -s -o $_.FullName ::
    }
} else {
    Write-Warning "[setup] mtools (mformat/mcopy) not found. The config drive is unformatted."
    Write-Warning "         Either install mtools, or attach `$StageDir as a virtio-9p/host folder instead."
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Launch QEMU to run Windows Setup unattended
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host "[setup] Launching QEMU (WHPX) for unattended install..."
$qemuArgs = @(
    "-machine", "q35,accel=whpx,kernel-irqchip=off"
    "-cpu", "max,-hypervisor,hv_vendor_id=GenuineIntel"
    "-m", "4G"
    "-smp", "4"
    "-drive", "file=$DiskPath,format=qcow2,if=ide"
    "-drive", "file=$IsoPath,media=cdrom"
    "-drive", "file=$ConfigDrive,format=raw,if=floppy"
    "-boot", "d"
    "-netdev", "user,id=n0"
    "-device", "e1000,netdev=n0"
    "-vga", "std"
    "-display", "sdl"
    "-rtc", "base=localtime,clock=host"
    "-usb"
    "-device", "usb-tablet"
)
Write-Host "[setup] qemu-system-x86_64 $($qemuArgs -join ' ')"
& $QemuSystem @qemuArgs

Write-Host "[setup] QEMU exited. Once Windows finishes installing, boot with harden.ps1 for stealth runs."

```
